A modern-day engineer is transmigrated to a different world... where he becomes a prince. His surroundings remind him of medieval Europe, but it's not quite the same. In this world, witches actually exist, and they have real magic powers! Magic powers... that can be used as a productive force! The witches must be saved. Their powers must be liberated! We must open our map, fight off demons, solve the conspiracy, and climb the tree of technology!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Abyss Azure no Zainin
titleEnglish: A Sinner of the Deep Sea
synopsis:
The ocean covers about 70 percent of the earth's surface—a whole world, yet unknown to humanity...and in its depths a nation, thousands of meters beneath the waves. There, the mermaid Jo has been whiling away her days in peace. But that tranquility is shattered when her friend Ryuu is imprisoned for breaking the gravest of undersea laws: Their existence must be kept hidden from the people above. But why would Ryuu let the secret slip? And who did she tell? The curtain rises on Jo's adventure to save her friend—and on a story of love...?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Old-Fashioned Cupcake with Cappuccino
synopsis:
The six months that Sanae Nozue has been dating his younger coworker Minoru Togawa have been nothing short of bliss. They enjoy sharing meals together, giving each other gifts, and frequenting each other's homes. However, the relationship is at risk when a coworker notices Togawa wearing one of Nozue's ties. Now faced with a dilemma: either changing or explaining their relationship to the office, Nozue's anxiety reaches a boiling point. As the couple look to their possible futures, they wonder whether they can be happily in love forever.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Josou Oniisan ga Nonke wo Torotoro ni Naru made Kaihatsu shitara
titleEnglish: Cross-Dresser Therapy: Make Me a Shameless Bottom
synopsis:
How can someone so nice and pretty get turned on by someone like me?

Ever since he was groped on the train, college student Kei's been scared of men. But, the incident also left him hungering for taboo pleasures... Driven by the raging conflict between his mind and body, Kei visits a crossdresser "massage" parlor. There, he finds himself opening up completely to a "gal" named Nana, despite knowing there's a guy under those clothes. Kei's overwhelmed at first by his body's sheer sensitivity, but he soon starts wanting it... deeper. Blushing and hesitant, he musters the courage to spread his legs for Nana...!

"We only just met, and my finger's practically making you melt... Oh my god, Kei. You're coming so hard with your whole body."

An innocent college student with a weakness for pleasure seeks a lesson in bottom play from a masterful crossdresser!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kimi ga Radio wo Suki dakara
synopsis:
Hardcore radio enthusiast, Taiyou Kimishima, spends his high school days dreaming of establishing a Radio Studies club. However, he is unable to find people who share this interest, and Taiyou serves as the club's only member. Then one day, a fateful encounter brings him to meet a certain girl at a radio festival, bringing a start to this romantic comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Dungeon no Naka no Hito
synopsis:
An unexplored dungeon, filled with monsters and traps. An expert thief, searching for her lost father. When Clay delves into the dungeon deeper than any adventurer has ever gone, she is offered a job by the dungeon's caretaker! Now, instead of exploring, Clay must learn how to interview new monsters, set traps and position slimes around the dungeon. Will this new career path bring her any closer to finding her father?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hidamari no Orange
synopsis:
First-year Takatoki Nanami has only one chance left to redeem himself from his poor academic performance. If he fails his supplementary exam, moving on to the next grade will be impossible. A ray of hope shines on him when he makes an awkward first impression on Kei Takanashi—a third-year student who excels at his studies yet appears cold and distant. Blackmailed by Nanami, Takanashi reluctantly agrees to become his tutor.

Nanami's perseverance quickly makes up for his lack of intelligence, and his review sessions with Takanashi slowly break the ice in their relationship. Soon enough, Nanami passes all of the tests; but despite their agreement being fulfilled, Nanami is not yet ready to let go, wishing to learn more about his senior.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Imaginary
synopsis:
Back when Tasuku was a kid, he harbored a secret: he was in love with his friend Maika. But Maika moved away for school before he could gather his courage and confess. Now, as adults, they've reconnected as friends, and being together brings back memories of their shared past. It was so easy to fantasize about wild things when they were children, but what has become of those fantasies now that they've grown up?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Mount Position!
synopsis:
Ichito, a high school teacher, is supposed to be living together with his lover... but he walks in on his boyfriend having an affair! Suddenly, the mysterious man who helped him to his apartment is furious. In fact, the man is Ryuugasaki, the other guy's boyfriend! The stunned Ichito is pushed down by Ryuugasaki who says he must "take responsibility" and then he takes his virginity!!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Niku wo Hagu: Tooda Oto Tanpenshuu
synopsis:
1. Koisuru David (David in Love)
2. Atsui Suika (Hot Watermelon)
3. 2-Page Mangashuu (Two-Page Manga Collection)
4. Niku wo Hagu (To Strip the Flesh)
5. Niku wo Hagu Gojitsudan (To Strip the Flesh, Continued)
6. Jitan wo Maji de Aishiteru (I Just Love My Fave)

title: Spy x Family: Kazoku no Shouzou
synopsis:
In this book of Spy x Family original prose stories, Anya attempts to make friends with her target Damian during an Eden Academy camping trip, Yuri spends his day off babysitting his niece, and Franky seeks Loid's help in winning the heart of a blind opera singer. Then, when the family sits for a portrait painting, Yor is terrified that her secret identity will be blown. And in the final story, the family is scrutinized by a pair of unseen observers... There's never been a family quite like this one!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Ou to Neko no Hihou
titleEnglish: The Treasure of the King and the Cat
synopsis:
One day, a large number of people suddenly disappeared in the royal capital. When young King Castio goes out to investigate this occurrence, he comes across the culprit... but the criminal puts a spell on him! To help him out, the king calls the wizard O'Feuille to his castle, along with Prince Volks and his loyal retainer Nios. Together, they're determined to solve this strange, fluffy mystery full of cats, swords and magic!

(Source: Tokyopop)

Included one-shot: Henkyou no Mahoutsukai (Wizard of the Borderlands)

title: Kyou kara Hajimeru Osananajimi
synopsis:
Yuzuki, a transfer student, is Aida's neighbor, both at home and in the classroom. Aida tries to get friendly with Yuzuki, but their conversations lead nowhere. On the other hand, when it comes to their situation as neighbors, Yuzuki...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Your Forma
synopsis:
In an alternate 2023, the Your Forma, a miraculous "smart thread" technology initially developed to treat a massive outbreak of viral encephalitis, has become an integral part of daily life. But these convenient devices come with an invasive drawback—they record every sight, sound, and even emotion their users experience.

For electronic investigator Echika Hieda, diving into peoples' memories via the Your Forma and hunting for evidence to solve the toughest crimes is all part of a day's work. The problem is, she's so good at what she does that her assistants literally fry their brains trying to keep up with her. After putting one too many aides in the hospital, the top brass finally furnish Echika with a partner on her level, a brilliant yet cheeky android named Harold Lucraft. Does this unlikely duo have what it takes to resolve their mutual suspicions and avert a deadly technological infection from sweeping across the globe before it's too late?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Puchi Love★Kingdom
synopsis:
1. Riko-chan wa Hatsujouki!? (Riko-chan's Going Through a Horny-Phase!?)
2. Riko-chan wa Hankouki!? (Riko-chan's Going Through a Rebellious-Phase!?)
3. Icha Cheer Love! Akira-chan (Flirt-Cheer-Love! Go, Akira-chan)
4. Otona★Game (Adult Game)
5. Oaiko (Draw)
6. Toshokan Ura no Korone-chan
7. Imouto wa Koumonki!? (My Little Sister's in Her Anal Stage!)
8. Ganbare Kanacchi!
9. Ganbare Yuu-chan!

title: Tantan to Tanto
synopsis:
Koutarou and Shunpei were classmates, childhood friends and neighbors. They were almost like brothers, Shunpei even stayed in Koutarou's house while his parents worked.

"But we're not family or brothers, and we haven't been kids for a long time."

(Source: MU)

title: Vivy Prototype
synopsis:
Vivy, the world’s first autonomous AI, sings to bring joy to her audience as a cast member of NiaLand, Japan’s largest theme park. In this world, AIs have become integral to human life and exist to carry out their missions. One day, out of the blue, an AI claiming to be from the future approaches her, revealing that in one hundred years, advanced AIs will turn on the humans they once served, sparking a violent war to annihilate humankind! When he asks for her help in preventing the conflict, Vivy agrees to ditch the stage and take up the century-long mission against her kind in order to save humanity.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Gotou-san wa Ore wo Kaitai
titleEnglish: This Guy Says He'll Pay Me
synopsis:
At a gay bar, a serious-looking businessman who goes by the name of "Gotou" approaches Akira, a high school senior. Clearly not used to this sort of scene, Gotou nervously asks Akira to name his price. The look of anxiety in his eyes perks Akira's interest...A free-spirited high schooler meets a shy and pure businessman in this heart-pounding love story!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kimi no Hitomi ni Ubawaretai
synopsis:
Jun, a photographer, meets Haruka while they were both working at a wedding hall. Haruka's persona for work and his true personality are very different. Enchanted by Haruka's natural smile, Jun blurts out, "Will you be mine?" He was so sure that he scared Haruka away, but he received an unexpected response back.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Seishun Heavy Rotation
synopsis: Nao was nervous on the day of the high school entrance exam, but a handsome boy helped her to stay calm and get through it. On the first day of high school, Nao finds herself seated next to that boy Haruna-kun. It must be fate!

title: Zombieland Saga Gaiden: The First Zombie
synopsis:
Eikichi Hyodo is a second-year high school student, and the eldest son of an onion-growing family. Eikichi withdrew from the Baseball Club due to injury, so he now considers his life to be mediocre and has no encouragement. On the other hand, his twin older sister, Yuuko, is in perfect condition and has the opportunity to take over the family business. However, one day Yuuko disappears without a trace...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Playroom 108
synopsis:
One day, in a family supermarket full of people, Sakuya suddenly told his friend Mitsuki that he thinks he is frigid. After coming back home, the two begin a training to find out if that is really the case.

(Source: MU)

title: Otoshiai
synopsis:
Yahiro is a demon slayer from the East who's wrapping up a mission when he encounters a demon from the West. His blade has no effect against the demon, who claims to actually be an incubus that feeds on human life. Yahiro is immediately possessed and then...?!

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: Ryoushin no Shakkin wo Katagawari shite Morau Jouken wa Nihonichi Kawaii Joshikousei to Issho ni Kurasu Koto deshita.
titleEnglish: I'm Gonna Live with You Not Because My Parents Left Me Their Debt But Because I Like You
synopsis:
The main character, Yuuya Yoshizumi, was being pressured into paying off the debt left by his parents who had fled abroad. It was his classmate, Kaede Hitotsuba, chosen as the cutest schoolgirl in Japan, who saved him from this crisis of life and death. However, there was a catch. The condition required to fulfill in return for taking over his debt was—"In return for the loan, you have to live with me."

"Why did that happen?!" 

Yuuya's daily life collapsed on this day.

"Yuuya-kun. Let's take a bath together. Yuuya-kun, please be my hug pillow."

"That's enough, Hitotsuba-san!"

The slapstick love comedy between the beautiful, but easy-going Kaede Hitotsuba and the serious and hard-headed Yuuya Yoshizumi, starts now!

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Itou Junji Jisen Kessakushuu
synopsis:
1. Chuuko Record (Used Record)
2. Samuke (Shiver)
3. Fashion Model
4. Kubitsuri Kikyuu (Hanging Blimp)
5. Ayatsuri Yashiki (Marionette Mansion)
6. Gaka (Painter)
7. Nagai Yume (The Long Dream)
8. Gosenzo-sama (Honored Ancestors)
9. Glyceride (Greased)
10. Fashion Model: Norowareta Framing (Fashion Model: Cursed Frame)

title: Josou wo Yamerarenaku Naru Otokonoko no Hanashi
synopsis:
Ever since getting into the habit of crossdressing, Kazu has exerted a great deal of time and effort into it. Now that he has achieved his desired looks, he cannot wait to be showered with praise by anyone—well, as long as the compliment is not from someone he knows. He panics at the fact that a familiar person might catch him, and his worst nightmare occurs when his best friend, Masuru, sneaks into his room.

Kazu finds it embarrassing to be discovered in completely different clothing, but Masuru has other thoughts in mind. In truth, Masaru is convinced that Kazu has turned into a girl and thinks he is cute! Kazu is flattered by his words, and from there on, their friendship turns into an unlikely one, centering around the hobby that Kazu likes most.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kondo wa Korosaretakunai Azarashi-san
titleEnglish: Ms. Seal: I Don't Wanna Be Killed Anymore
synopsis:
Mahiru Umino is a 24-year-old office-worker with the unique ability to see people's past selves. The trauma of her own past life haunts her to this day; she was a seal who enjoyed wallowing in the Arctic snow until cruel misfortune befell her, and she was mauled to death by a polar bear.

When Ritsu Kitamura joins Mahiru's office as a new employee, he instantly becomes popular among their co-workers. But the remnant of the seal in Mahiru yelps in horror at the sight of Ritsu's past self: her mortal enemy, a polar bear. While it proves difficult for her to be apprehensive of Ritsu as he behaves more like a puppy than a menacing bear, Mahiru is not one to let her guard down. She is certain that, eventually, Ritsu will let his true self slip—that of a bloodthirsty predator.

In an office full of diverse reincarnations—from a raccoon dog to none other than "Demon King" Nobunaga Oda—Mahiru and Ritsu's spontaneous game of cat and mouse begins!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Gimai Seikatsu
synopsis:
When high schooler Yuuta Asamura learns his father plans to remarry, he's not too bothered by the idea...until he finds out his future stepmom has a daughter! Her name is Saki, and to Yuuta's surprise, she's a beauty who's made a reputation for herself as an unapproachable "bad girl." But as he gets to know her, he realizes she's not the person everyone says she is. Could he be the one she finally opens her heart to?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Moshi Role Playing Game no Sekai ni SNS ga Attara
titleEnglish: If the RPG World Had Social Media
synopsis:
When a fantasy world has fully functioning internet and smartphones (for some reason), it's only natural for its sixteen year-old Hero to declare war on the Demon Lord via text message. But is it natural for that Demon Lord to be an innocent snowflake who hates conflict...!? Take a peek into this unfortunate Hero's chatlog with a...unique group of RPG characters, like an overly pure Demon Lord, her cheerful Generals (who all adore her), and the kidnapped princess who seems to be developing a major crush on her captor!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Wan Zha Chao Huang
synopsis:
In a spacetime called the Second Female Lead System, agent Su Lüxia is one of the most cunning and capable. Her job includes leaping into the different dimensions of romance stories—novels, dramas, or even otome games—and reversing the fates of unfortunate second female leads. As the expendable women grow full of resentment for the male leads and their deceitful mistresses, Su Lüxia takes over their bodies and mercilessly plots to exact a perfect revenge. Whether it be a harem in ancient China, a modern-day entertainment scandal, or a tricky fantasy world, Su Lüxia will make sure that the cheating men and evil women get exactly what they deserve—every single time.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Dekiai Kareshi wa Bucchouzura shite Yattekuru
synopsis:
Unsociable preschool teacher Kaji and salaryman Yura have been living together for half a year, filled with happiness and Kaji's unexpected smiles. But there's been a pleasant miscalculation of Kaji's monster strength when it comes to the bedroom. Yura makes the effort because "I want to satisfy him too!" but is unexpectedly rejected... Maybe he's getting tired of having sex with Yura?! Being happy but sometimes going through a rough patch—a sweet, sweet love story!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Mushishi Bangai Tanpen: Chi Kakeru Kage
synopsis:
Seven years since the rare solar eclipse occurred, Adashino continues to assist those in medical need. After visiting a patient at a beachside home, the tactful doctor notices a shadow resembling a bird. This spontaneous sighting leads Adashino to reminisce about a story Ginko once told him about a Mushi that assumes the same form. Such a revelation, however, may lead to false optimism.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Misumi-san wa Misukasenai
synopsis:
A romantic comedy about Yuri Keito, a boy who has clairvoyance but isn't good at it, and Mitsuhashi Misumi, a girl who likes strange things. One day, looking at Misumi's back, Yuri looks through her jacket and sees the message "Anyone who can read this message, please come to the astronomy club room after school."  When he goes to the club room and explains his ability, Misumi asks, "Why don't you let me study you?"

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Boku no Adelia
synopsis:
I was picked up by a beautiful but shy and useless vampire? Joel, an orphaned boy wandering the forest alone, collapsed and was picked up by the vampire Adelia.  Adelia is a beauty, but she is shy with others and her daily life is completely dysfunctional.  So who is taking care of whom?  

The clumsy communal life of these two awkward lonely people begins.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Spoon ga Magattara
synopsis:
Tomoki Hoshiko is a troubled student who others steer clear of. Hidaka Asai, on the other hand, is the top student in the school, but his quiet bookishness hasn't made him any friends, either... After the two of them get teleported away from school by accident, Hidaka confesses that he has powers to Tomoki. Why did he tell him his secret? Maybe Hidaka is the only one who knows Tomoki's true nature.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shinjiteita Nakama-tachi ni Dungeon Okuchi de Korosarekaketa ga Gift "Mugen Gacha" de Level 9999 no Nakama-tachi wo Te ni Irete Moto Party Member to Sekai ni Fukushuu & "Zamaa!" Shimasu!
titleEnglish: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Party Tried to Kill Me, But Thanks to an Infinite Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out for Revenge
synopsis:
A kid named Light is the only human member of the adventuring party Legion of Races, but humans are by far the weakest race in his world. When his comrades abandon him to the lowest levels of a dungeon, Light resorts to the gift of Infinite Gacha to create a harem of Lvl 9999 allies! With his powerful and beautiful new friends by his side, can Light escape the dungeon and exact vengeance upon the Legion of Races...and the entire world?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sex Sales Driver
synopsis:
Former office worker Isshin quits his office job to do hard physical labor in the delivery business. As the daily grind wears down his body and soul, his only solace is working with his beloved coworker Haze. Haze has it all - good looks and excellent occupational skills. One day, just when Isshin's starting to feel like Haze's titillating presence makes his job worthwhile, he makes a mistake during a delivery and Haze has to pick up after him. On top of that, he gets blackout drunk and makes a total disgrace of himself. When he wakes up, he finds himself with no clothes on, and Haze by his bedside asking if he remembers what happened last night... That one moment of despair might be the catalyst that brings them together...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Iki Dekinai no wa Kimi no Sei
synopsis:
Shizuki is a hedonistic playboy who plays the baritone saxophone in the local council's brass band and he openly dislikes the band's popular and prince-like flutist, Yano. At a glance, it seems like they barely associate with each other during practice. However, due to a shared interest, they now have secret meetings in hotels afterwards...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Unmei no Hito ni Deau Hanashi
synopsis:
Dreams about finding her one true love are all Yuuki Honda has. She has thrown herself into college work but still yearns for a fateful encounter with a man who is just as handsome and charming as her beloved manga characters. Despite her desire to meet new people, she finds herself out of her element in a crowded club. Here she meets Iori Souma, who is drunk, disdainful, and looks down on Yuuki, bluntly saying things too embarrassing to hear.

Although he comes off as impolite and rough, Iori quickly proves that first impressions can be deceiving. When he calls Yuuki to apologize, she confesses her romantic aspirations. Instead of the expected scorn, Iori offers to help Yuuki find her future soulmate. While Iori's cool but selfless nature makes him a great friend, Yuuki can no longer ignore just how fast her heart beats when she is by his side.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai
titleEnglish: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms
synopsis:
To say that Mona Kawai is cute would be an understatement; she is breathtaking in every single way, and she knows it. At school, she is fawned over by boys and girls alike, and she graciously welcomes it all as a natural reaction to her irresistible charm. That is, until she comes across Medaka Kuroiwa, the boy who is seemingly immune to her overwhelming charisma. She goes out of her way to talk to him and even dials her cuteness up a notch, but no matter what she tries, Mona cannot wipe the scowl off Kuroiwa's face.

Backed into a corner, Mona is forced to use the most devastating weapon in her arsenal: her physical allure. Such drastic measures would leave other boys foaming at their mouths, but Kuroiwa remains unfazed by her attempts. Little does Mona know that the only reason Kuroiwa just barely abstains from succumbing to her charms is because he is training to be a monk and thus trying his best not to be held down by worldly pleasures. As Mona goes all out to entice Kuroiwa, she fails to realize that his unintentional chivalry might just make her fall for him instead.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hanasaku Koi ga Futtekuru
synopsis:
One day, Ritsu Nitta - a boy so handsome he could be the hero of a romance manga - comes falling out of the sky. He is saved by Tomoru, who in response to Ritsu's request to pay him back, asks for his help in his after school job...as a professional girls' manga author. Ritsu agrees to act out scenes from Tomoru's manga, but when he learns he is meant to play the rival character instead of the hero, he grabs Tomoru by the collar and forces a kiss on him...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Seikyouiku 120%
synopsis:
While she is just a physical education teacher at Sakuragaoka Girls' High School, 23-year-old Naoko Tsuji has another job to do. With an increasing number of people who are engaging in sexual activities at a very young age, Naoko feels that the stigmatization of sexual education in schools is pushing this problem to its extremes. Vowing to utilize her hobby as a sex education specialist, Naoko is determined to spread proper information on the subject.

With her most responsive students being the fanatic Shun Matsuda, the cautious Hikari Moriya, and the curious Kashiwa, every class is filled with interesting new things to learn as Naoko comes closer to her goal of promoting healthier and more enjoyable high school lives.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isekai Tensei shitara Aiken ga Saikyou ni Narimashita: Silver Fenrir to Ore ga Isekai Kurashi wo Hajimetara the Comic
titleEnglish: Even Dogs Go to Other Worlds: Life in Another World with My Beloved Hound
synopsis:
Takumi is a wage slave who works overtime all the time. Only his little Maltese, Leo, can brighten his day. One day, however, he wakes up to find himself deep in an unknown forest. At his side is his pampered pup...who's now a giant mythical wolf! With his silver fenrir companion and his mysterious new "Herb Cultivation" power, he'll finally have the laid-back life he's always dreamed of!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Class no Daikirai na Joshi to Kekkon suru Koto ni Natta.
titleEnglish: I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class
synopsis:
High school student Saito Houjo has married his classmate, Akane Sakuramori, the girl who is his biggest rival at school. The two can't seem to get along with each other, but their heart-pounding newlywed life is about to begin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Boku no Okusan wa Chotto Kowai
titleEnglish: My Wife Is a Little Intimidating
synopsis:
With how far she's out of his league, Kosuke Shimizu never expected his senpai at work, Natsuna Shirahama, to go on a date with him...much less marry him! But with a wife so perfect, it's no surprise that the timid and indecisive Kosuke feels inadequate...and not just in bed. The truth is, they both have their fair share of flaws (especially when it comes to expressing their love), but working through them together will only strengthen their marriage...right?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Murikon.
synopsis:
Once upon a time, a man and a woman from two feuding villages fell in love. Forbidden to marry, they committed suicide, pledging to marry in the next life. Various disasters began taking place as a result of their unfortunate fates, and the people in the two villages began offering a man and a woman for holy matrimony to comfort the souls of the sad couple. And, thus, they had continued to avoid calamities for generations...

Momoki Shirakawa is told about this unbelievable legend and becomes a bride, expected to marry Chikage Kurotaki from the neighboring village. Both young men give in to their family pressure and have no choice but to start living together despite the awkwardness. Will they never be a match!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Dekiru Neko wa Kyou mo Yuuutsu
titleEnglish: The Masterful Cat Is Depressed Again Today
synopsis:
When Saku took in a stray black cat, she never expected that he would become the equivalent of a housekeeping life partner. But Yukichi, a giant cat who towers over Saku, is not your ordinary feline. He takes great pride in his culinary skills, and a good sale at the supermarket always gets his whiskers twitching. Saku may not have her act together yet, but at least she has Yukichi!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yotaka, Meguru
synopsis:
Yukako, a housewife tired of the pressure put upon her by the people in her life, has an unexpected reunion with a woman from her past. This meeting makes Yukako yearn for the touch of another woman again as she tries to keep her affair a secret from her husband.

(Source: MU)

title: Neko to Bed
synopsis:
In the specialty store "Stray Cat," Haru is a call boy whose personality turns into a super sweet lover type when his switch is turned on. He's called in by Hiroki, someone whose idea of sex is still naïve. He wants to know about good sex, and completely melts under the work of Haru's hands...

(Source: MU)

title: Shishunki Cherry Bullet
synopsis:
"Naive" describes Asahi Unowasa, a student who sits right in front of Azusa Ootani, perfectly. True to the meaning of his name, Asahi is shiny like the sun, and Azusa soon falls for him. Despite logically knowing that he can't be the only person who falls for Asahi, he doesn't like the idea of anyone else liking him either. When Azusa accidentally blurts out his feelings, they go from best friends to boyfriends. Not being able to shake the expression on Asahi's face the first time they did it, Azusa sets out various honeytraps to hopefully see that expression once again.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Lv1 Maou to One Room Yuusha
titleEnglish: Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero
synopsis:
Ten years ago, the hero Max defeated the Demon Lord. In order to regain his power, the Demon Lord went into a deep slumber...but when he awakens, his body is only a chibi version of its fearsome form. Now curious to see what his enemy is up to, the Demon Lord visits Max, only to discover the mighty hero living in a dirty one-room apartment. The Demon Lord decides to move in with Max and help his old enemy become a formidable opponent once more!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hoshoku Taishou Hinadori-kun
synopsis:
Hinata's been in love with Hakuba since he was little, and they used to perform together... Now that they're both grown up though, Hinata is part of the "bad boy" boy band who (for marketing purposes?) hates the pop duo Hakuba is in. Hinata has tried to hide his true feelings for Hakuba, but his group leader, Takaomi, sees right through him. Trying to help Hinata get it together on stage, Takaomi kisses him in front of all their fans during the live battle of the bands!

(Source: Renta!, edited)

title: Mayonaka Driver's High
titleEnglish: Driving Under the Cover of the Night
synopsis:
Conscientious cab driver Taira Tsunayoshi's days have been boring. That is, until one day, when a man gets into his cab soaked with blood and rain and tells him to go to Biei? a town in the northern island of Hokkaido. Though he's taken aback by the bizarre man, Taira sets out on their drive and stops to spend the night at a hotel, where the man suddenly suggests a hookup. This is a story of love and suspense between a serious cab driver and a handsome but mysterious man.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Rokudou Tousouki
synopsis:
En has no prospects as a child of the slums—he ekes out a living by selling the scrap cyborg augmentations he scavenges to anyone who will buy. But when he's forced to go through some unethical experimentation, he transforms—making him eligible to become a fighter in the only thing that matters in this bleak world: The Rokudo Tournament!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Daybreaking Romance
synopsis:
Blacked out from drinking, just what happened with his crush during that time...?!

Dong Saebyeok, a scary-looking but softhearted guy falls for his cool-headed junior, Seo Gwangchae. Watch their cute campus romance unfold because, no matter how bad the day is, the sun always rises!

(Source: MU)

title: Kojiin Tamer
synopsis:
Shu, who died of old age, reincarnated as a baby in a different world where he was picked up by a poor orphanage. He quickly grows up under the watchful eye of the gentle director and staff. With skills received from God, he starts to exert talent... He now lives at his own pace, adventuring with cute monsters and good friends ♪

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Paripi Koumei
synopsis:
General of the Three Kingdoms, Kongming had struggled his whole life, facing countless battles that made him into the accomplished strategist he was. So on his deathbed, he wished only to be reborn into a peaceful world...and was sent straight to modern-day party-central, Tokyo! Can even a brilliant strategist like Kongming adapt to the wild beats and even wilder party people?!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Bokutachi wa Mada Aoku
titleEnglish: We're Still in the Spring of Life.
synopsis:
"Our grade's top scorer, an unapproachable guy, only opens up to me. That's so friggin' adorable!"

Saegusa is utterly bored of his high school life. Along comes Arochi Tooru, a guy with the brightest hair he’s ever seen, who transfers into his class. It's an oddity already, for some guy with outrageous looks and a cold attitude, to transfer into a prep school. So he immediately draws the attention of everyone in his class. What's more, he's apparently a genius who cinches the top spot in their grade on their class exam.

One day, Saegusa uses a common point of interest to approach Arochi, and the two start to become closer. But once they become friends, Arochi is actually really oblivious and cute! Saegusa just can't take his eyes off this cutie!

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Youki ni Naritai Shigure-san
synopsis:
Yoshida (14 years old) is the inkya (not social, dark etc.) of the class. One day, he is seated next to Shigure-san, an inkya girl. After Shigure-san realizes that Yoshida is one of her kind, she starts to call out to him, all of a sudden...! The dark duo engages in a heated battle to become the youkya (happy/sunny person)!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Mo Dao Zu Shi
titleEnglish: Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation: Mo Dao Zu Shi
synopsis:
The mere mention of the Yiling Patriarch strikes fear in those who hear it, even though the man behind the title has been deceased for 13 years. It is said that, as a practitioner of demonic cultivation, he raised the dead to wage war against the great cultivation sects. The true name of the Yiling Patriarch is Wei Ying, courtesy name Wuxian, and he has returned from the dead, summoned into the body of a mad man!

When Wei Wuxian reawakens, he finds himself in Mo Village, which is owned by a branch family of one of the great sects. No sooner does he have time to get his bearings before his world is thrown into disarray again—by a dismembered arm leaking an immense amount of demonic energy. However, the origin of the limb is only the first mystery. Shortly after, the ever-stoic Lan Wangji—someone whom Wei Wuxian believes to harbor great animosity toward him—arrives to sweep Wei Wuxian off his feet!

As Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji seek to unravel the mystery behind the demonic arm, they face both enemies and friends of old, and its link to Wei Wuxian's downfall all those years ago.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isekai Shokudou: Youshoku no Nekoya
synopsis:
There is a secret to Nekoya, a very ordinary Western-style restaurant. It is that every Saturday, when the restaurant is closed, it is overflowing with "special customers." The customers, who are all different from each other in terms of birth, upbringing, and even race, are looking for the most ordinary Western food. But for them, it's a dish they've never seen or heard of before.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: The Stairway of Time
synopsis:
The saying "hindsight is 20/20" could not be more true for Lee Yuna, whose regrets from 13 years ago have irrevocably shaped her current situation. With little money to her name, she is prepared to marry a man she does not love. Yuna does not want anything special, just a comfortable life. But if she could change the past, there is one thing more than any other that she would do—avoid Ryu Jihoon at all costs.

Back in high school, she and Jihoon were the most lovey-dovey couple, well known for bickering one moment and flirting the next. How could a pair so in love break up so bitterly to the point that Yuna will not even mention Jihoon's name even in the present?

While visiting her alma mater one night, Yuna stumbles upon the urban legend "The Stairway of Time" and falls into the past before she ever met Jihoon. She resolves to fix the mistake of ever meeting him, but fate works in mysterious ways. As much as she wants to push him away, Yuna is drawn again to his bright personality. Can she change what has already come to pass?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koishite Kiss shite Kanjaitai
titleEnglish: I Wanna Love You, Kiss You, Bite You
synopsis:
Akihiro, an omega, has suddenly been landed with a fiance! The whole thing was arranged by their parents, so when he's told this guy is going to be his husband, it's all too much to process... But, when he meets his betrothed, Reiya, his terror toward the alpha begins to change into... something else. He wants to do all kinds of naughty things with his beloved Reiya, but he's still in school, and he's worried that any prohibited activities might result in a baby... His mind is now a battlefield between hope and reason! Meanwhile, Reiya, who once found Akihiro timid and boring, finds his curiosity has been piqued. Now, he's fallen hook, line, and sinker. He's ready to go at any time!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin-Chara ni Tensei shita kedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
titleEnglish: Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim
synopsis:
Reincarnated as a character in the legendary erotic game, “Magical Explorer,” it doesn’t take long for our hero to discover that he’s been designated the unlucky side-character rather than the game’s lady-killer protagonist. Not to worry, though! Armed with his vast knowledge of the game (and a few cheats) he’ll do whatever it takes to win the hearts of the game’s heroines and emerge as the most accomplished student at the Sorcerer's Academy!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Double Face ni Kuchizuke
synopsis:
Every Wednesday, quiet, innocent exchange student Kanata has to fend off the advances of young mafia boss Alex, who keeps asking him out for coffee. While he appears to be ever-so-slightly moved by Alex's straightforward, if tacky, affections... It's only a ruse. Secretly, Kanata's the deadly hit man "Black Swan," hired by an enemy family to assassinate Alex. He's been in disguise, waiting for his chance to strike... But Alex won't seem to let his guard down, forcing Kanata to use himself as bait...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Anoyo de Omae ni Suki dato Ieru
titleEnglish: I Can Say "I Love You" in the Afterlife
synopsis:
Unhappy with his life, 29-year-old Kunimi decides to jump in front of a moving train. But when he wakes up, he realizes he has gone back to being a high schooler! With a lapse in his memories, Kunimi meets a super handsome junior named Gaku. While disappointed that even in this after-life, Kunimi is gay, he gets excited at the prospect of his almost 30-year-old self doing it with a high schooler. When Kunimi finds out Gaku has real feelings for him, he feels bad about having a wet dream about Gaku.

As his memories slowly start to come back to him, 29-year-old Kunimi gets a chance to re-do his high school experience with a genuine and super hot high schooler!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Oshi ni wa Zettai Hodasarenai!
titleEnglish: I Might Be Your Fan, but I'll Never Fall for You!
synopsis:
Yuki Miyama is an up-and-coming young star. He has always adored Masataka Kitamura, a modern-day Valentino, and is excited to have the chance to work with the older actor, who ends the session by snorting at his performance. To make matters worse, Yuki gets totally smashed after Masataka toys with him over drinks. The next thing he knows, he's lying in bed... with Masataka!

A love story about a naïve model who is swayed every which way by a hot, mysterious actor!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hirayasumi
synopsis:
Living in Asagaya, 29-year-old Hiroto Ikuta spends his days working at his part-time job and chatting with the locals. He likes visiting Hanae Wada most, a grumpy yet kind elderly woman whom Hiroto calls "Granny." Hiroto's time with Granny is sadly cut short when she passes away from a heart attack. To his surprise, Hiroto inherits Granny's house as she never married or had children.

Three months later, 18-year-old Natsumi Kobayashi moves from her hometown to attend art school. With nowhere else to go, she stays with her cousin Hiroto, whom she has not seen in years. Despite their opposing personalities, the pair begin living under the same roof as they struggle through their seemingly mundane lives.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hone Dragon no Mana Musume
synopsis:
In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out.

After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks...

Hoping to improve Eve's control over her magical abilities before his resurrected body gives out, the skull dragon sets out on an adventure with his reckless human daughter—but who knows what kind of trouble awaits them?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Save Me
synopsis:
As the delicate fiber of time breaks and the clock rewinds, Kim Seokjin is repeatedly thrown back to the fateful date of April 11. Upon returning to Korea after two years of absence, Seokjin is tragically reminded of his once carefree group of high school friends. They were inseparable, the only light in each other's lives—until they went their own sorrowful, separate ways.

Finding Kim Namjoon in prison for assault, Seokjin learns the harrowing truth: Jeon Jungkook and Min Yoongi are dead; Jung Hoseok had a horrible accident; Park Jimin is missing; and soon, Kim Taehyung is found with his father's blood on his hands. But a serendipitous opportunity allows Seokjin to travel back in time and save his friends. Yet each time he takes a leap, reality slightly distorts—and Seokjin wonders if there will ever be a world where the seven of them can be happy together again.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isshiki-san wa Koi wo Shiritai.
synopsis:
A maiden who doesn't know what love is tries her hand at dating as a pseudo-couple!

Inspector Rinna, who is respected by everyone as a hard-working and serious policewoman, seems to be having trouble with her work lately. The reason for this is because she loses focus. It only happens when Meishi, the detective she works with, is around... So, she makes a choice...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: 49-kaime no Kokuhaku
synopsis:
Haruki Takanashi has dyed hair, piercings, and a lackadaisical attitude. He is the exact type of guy that Azuha, the head of the disciplinary committee, would never associate with in life. He has professed his love to Azuha numerous times, but for some reason, she always flatly rejects him. As it approaches his 49th confession, Haruki realizes time is running out...

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Chicken Heart Serenade
synopsis:
Kurahashi and Matsune had a casual relationship as friends with benefits. One day, Matsune and a woman visited the kimono shop where Kurahashi worked. Seeing Matsune's outgoing manner which was completely different from his usual personality, Kurahashi was delighted and made fun of him. Later, Kurahashi found out that the woman was actually Matsune's matchmaking partner. They continued their relationship after that, but...?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Kanashi
synopsis:
Shouma Tsuji was on his way home from work when he finds a drunk man plastered all over a garbage heap. Pitying the man's state, he decided to help and brought the man to his home. He lets the man use his shower, and once the stranger is all sober and cleaned up, Shouma's surprised to find that the man he helped was Kakeru Ashida, a school mate from his middle school days. Kakeru was well-known back then, and his gay reputation didn't exactly endear him to his Shouma's peers.

Now, looking at an adult Kakeru, Shouma is left with mixed feelings. Kakeru reassures him that he doesn't really remember much though he points out that Shouma has a kind nature for taking him in. He also shared that he was drowning his sorrows due to another rejection. Kakeru then takes advantage of Shouma's kindness, which leads to more things than one.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Colorless Girl
synopsis:
Jinah is a girl who's always alone and has a depressed expression. Eunwoo feels uneasy about her behavior and is concerned that she'll commit suicide so he constantly hovers around her. A risky story about teenagers' emotions, a debut work drawn by Lame!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Sensei, Kongetsu Dou desu ka
synopsis:
Murasaki has the power to see the future of the person she touches. As the landlord's daughter, she has to chase after Shijima Banri for rent every month. Every time, the poor author Shijima promises her that he'll pay rent as soon as he gets published and gets paid. Murasaki quietly supports his work, because she can see that Shijima is the person she is fated to marry.

(Source: MU)

title: Tensei shita Akuyaku Reijou wa Fukushuu wo Nozomanai the Comic
synopsis:
Maryrose Hubert, the daughter of a duke, was once engaged to the kingdom's crown prince. However, he fell in love with a lowly maid named Tia, a woman who framed Maryrose for crimes she never committed. Despised by the public, Maryrose is sent to the gallows where she meets an untimely end. After her death, her younger brother swears vengeance and embarks on a decades-long journey to avenge her.

Years later, a countryside baron's daughter named Marie Edigma awakens to memories of her previous life—those of Maryrose. She desires a peaceful life away from those who hurt her in the past, but, against her wishes, Marie is thrust back into palace life when she is invited to work as a maid. This offer reunites her with her former brother, whose lust for revenge has led him astray, and her loyal knight who continues to uphold his oath of fealty to Maryrose. But as fate would have it, she meets her own killers' son—a prince who takes an immediate liking toward Marie.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Imouto no Hadaka wo Mite Koufun Suru nante Hen na Oniichan♥
synopsis:
1. Imouto Summer Vacation
2. Mai-chan to Sentou (Bath-House Bonding With Mai-chan)
3. Natsu no Omoide (Summer Memories)
4. Manami-chan no Sakaagari
5. Imouto no Seiyoku ga Tsuyosugiru
6. Oniichan no Okurimukae
7. Imouto Kokoro to Haru no Sora (Little Sister's Heart and the Spring Sky)
8. Imouto no Asa wa Osoi
9. Imouto wa Mukanshin (My Little Sister is Apathetic)

title: Chitose
synopsis:
It's been three years and Hori still can't pull the trigger and ask out his cute classmate Chitose. He's studied hard to get into the same school; he's taken up the same hobbies; and even gets his hair cut by her, but he can't gain the courage to utter those three little words. After joining the fine arts club at Chitose's request, he meets Mika and her spirited younger brother, Takayuki, who couldn't be more different. What the men do have in common is they both have their eyes on Chitose, and as the siblings start to make their move, will Hori finally reveal his true feelings or will he be left in the dust?

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Dream Life: Yume no Isekai Seikatsu
synopsis:
A middle-aged engineer who was weary of life ended up being reborn into a different world as Zack, the son of a frontier feudal lord. Once there, he received a mission from God. He was told to prepare himself for the task of "guiding the future hero of the world." With that in mind, Zack not only trained himself in swordsmanship and magic but also committed himself towards reforming problems in hygiene and education. After developing a new local product, Zack was reminded of his once forgotten dream: brewing alcohol! As he resurrected his long lost passion, it was the beginning of his "Dream Life."

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: No Love Zone
synopsis:
Lee Eunkyum has always had a knack for falling for the worst men, which he blames on his incorrigible attraction to handsome faces. So, when he meets his strikingly tall and gorgeous new team manager, Han Jihyuk, Eunkyum is certain he has laid eyes on the man of his dreams. However, for whatever reason, Jihyuk has something against Eunkyum. He expects nothing short of perfection, making Eunkyum redo his tasks repeatedly, and never misses a chance to criticize Eunkyum's work.

Despite Jihyuk's questionable hostility, even the slightest hint of kindness from him makes Eunkyum blush like a teenager. But Jihyuk is open about why he seeks revenge, and Eunkyum must find a way to appease his boss, mend past mistakes, and hopefully have his feelings reciprocated.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Nee Ecchi Shichaokka
synopsis:
1. Houkago to Senpai to
2. Love Hotel to Senpai to
3. Imouto to Senpai to
4. Ofuro to Imouto to
5-7. Tensei shitara Shota Harem no Joou tte Maji desu ka!?
8. Futomomo x Tousatsu=Love♡
9. Futomomo ÷ Shitto＝Love Love
10. Futomomo x Seiyoku=Bacouple

title: Tasuketa Yakuza ni Nerawaretemasu!?
synopsis:
Koutarou Tanaka, a taxi driver who works in the countryside, loves his uneventful life more than anything. One day, he ends up saving a yakuza, Hozumi Kurokawa, whose abdomen was bleeding. A few weeks later, under the guise of attempting to return the favour, Hozumi pins Koutarou down... 

"I'll do my best to entertain you."

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Included one-shot: Doutei no Ore wo Oshitaoshita no wa Osananajimi deshita

title: Asagao wa Yoru kara Saku
synopsis:
"The person I love is dead." Yuugen is a sickly, high school boy with zero motivation in life. He avoids interacting with his classmates, and lives an utterly bland and colorless life. However, the cheerful and popular leader of the class, Hideto, calls out to him every single day. Yuugen ends up harboring feelings for this bright individual.

However, one day, Hideto suddenly passes away. While still grappling with the reality of the situation, Yuugen discovers that the ghost of Hideto has appeared before him. Bound to this world by unfinished business, he enlists the help of Yuugen to help him pass on, but... 

A bittersweet love story of a boy overcoming grief and taking the steps into adulthood.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Oishii Kimi no Tsukurikata
titleEnglish: How to Make a Delicious You
synopsis:
Stubborn office worker Seiji Kondou's latest obsession is a new deli that's exactly up his alley. The only catch is that the suspiciously flirty owner, Haruki Kakibaya, keeps calling Seiji "cute." One day, Haruki kisses Seiji out of the blue...!! This is a delicious love story between a flirty cook and a bashful office worker.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hinata to Mikasa
synopsis:
Mikasa Otsuka. Transfer student, only child, and something of a lone wolf. Hinata Yakumo. The liveliest kid in class with a huge family, and a bit of a busybody. This is the story of their excitedly troublesome coming-of-age friendship!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Tensei Babaa wa Misugosenai!: Moto Akutoku Nyotei no Nishuume Life
titleEnglish: Reincarnated Old Hag Can't Leave Things Alone!: Second Life of a Former Unscrupulous Empress
synopsis:
Lauraris Eldanus ruled the country with an iron fist. The end to her reign of terror came by the hand of a hero...or so it should have been. However, three hundred years later, the former empress makes her grand reappearance in the form of a young maiden. And yet, the person inside is the same old granny?! Apparently, God gave her a second chance as thanks for the peace that was brought about by her own death. 

With her second chance, she desires a peaceful life, and yet the world seems to still be filled with one bad apple after another. This is the long-awaited comicalization of the exhilarating fantasy of the strongest girl who can't overlook evil!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: TRPG Player ga Isekai de Saikyou Build wo Mezasu: Henderson-shi no Fukuin wo
titleEnglish: Min-Maxing My TRPG Build in Another World: Preach the Good Word of Mr. Henderson
synopsis:
"Data Munchkin": Oddballs who would merrily attempt killing God if the data showed it to be possible.

Erich, one of these Data Munchkins, a reincarnated boy, schemes to turn himself into an ideal broken character using his character build authority which he was blessed with on the occasion of being reincarnated into a different world. While hanging out with his aggressively seductive childhood friend and taking care of his brocon younger sister, Erich racks his brain as he analyzes data from head to toe, cleverly managing experience points trying to fumble his way onto a heinous broken combo build. But sooner than he thinks the story(session) begins to unfold as Erich throws himself into the fray fighting(rolls dice) to protect those who he holds dear?!

The curtains rise on the adventures of data munchkin of Henderson-scale plot derailment!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Rain: Kokuhaku shitekita no wa Imouto datta
synopsis:
A man's younger sister confesses to him. He responds in kind, however, the only time they can have sex is when the sounds of rain drown out her moans.

(Source: MU)

title: Practiced Liar
synopsis:
"This world is full of noise."

Due to his innate ability to "read minds," Miura is completely distrustful of people because he is constantly exposed to their true feelings. One day, he meets Abe, his junior at a university club, who is twice as quiet and expressionless as anyone else. But it turns out, Abe is a person who will talk non-stop like a machine-gun about his pure love for Miura (*only in his mind)!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Ugetsudou Antique
synopsis:
The seeds of desire sprout in the depths of the body...

At a mysterious antique shop that appears only on rainy days, Sou Hayami finds a keepsake of his grandfather that he should have lost a long time ago. Sou asks the owner, Tsukiji, who has a strange atmosphere about him, to give it to him. However, this store does not deal in money.

With a fearless smile, Tsukiji gives his condition... "Please give birth to my child"?!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Himitsu Sentai Gorenger
synopsis:
An evil secret society called the Black Cross Army threatens world peace, and only an elite task force known as the Earth Guard League (EAGLE) can stop them. After the Black Cross Army destroys EAGLE's headquarters across Japan, only five young recruits survive. Hiding in a secret underground base, they are given enhanced battlesuits that empower them with superhuman abilities, transforming the youths into an unstoppable squad to combat evil.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shiawase ni Michita Yoru no Niwa
synopsis:
Noah is a beautiful Alpha heir of a great company, son of a Beta and an Alpha. His parents cut off all contact with Omegas in order to marry him to an Alpha female and keep the blood pure. What happens when Noah meets Hajime, a male Alpha at a party and starts a relationship?

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot: Nicholas

title: Yuusha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Ita node, Kokuhaku shitemita.
synopsis:
Youki died in a traffic accident and was reborn in a fantasy world! However, instead of being the hero of legends, he ended up reincarnating into an overpowered demon. Having no desires to become the Demon Lord, he sits around in the Demon Lord's castle as a random low rank guardian. One day, the Hero's party comes to attack and on a whim he knocks out the entire hero party. Healing up the Hero party and then preparing to send them back to town, he notices the female priest and falls in love at first sight!

(Source: MU)

title: Kikonsha desu kedo, Nani ka?
titleEnglish: Do You Have Any Problem With Me?
synopsis:
Mikado—gay, once a famous playboy and womanizer—lost his former brilliance and splendor, having a marriage of convenience. However, Mikado, who has cooled to carnal pleasures, meets a new employee—Serizawa, with whom he slowly falls in love. This guy, obsessed with sports and cleanliness, awakens our protagonist's wild fantasies and reignites his long-forgotten desire. The mysterious Serizawa, together with Mikado, who is obsessed with him, they go on a business trip and stay for the night at an onsen, where Mikado discovers an unexpected secret about Serizawa...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Instant Succu
synopsis:
Misuzu the succubus visits Kon almost every week for nourishment. Although he "feeds" her every time, he still seems somewhat reluctant. Just what kind of relationship do these two have?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Hito wo Yosetsukenai Buaisou na Joshi ni Sekkyou shitara, Mechakucha Natsukareta
synopsis:
This guy made my otherwise ordinary days a little more fun!

One day, Naoya Ookusu, the class president, gave a lecture to one of his classmates, Risa Enami about her lackluster attitude. But from that day on, Enami has been trying to go home with him for some reason. Why on earth?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Fushisha no Deshi: Jashin no Fukyou wo Katte Naraku ni Otosareta Ore no Eiyuutan
titleEnglish: Disciple of the Lich: Or How I Was Cursed By the Gods and Dropped into the Abyss
synopsis:
An ordinary teenager is transported to a fantasy world, accidentally gets on the bad side of the gods, and is dumped in the bottom of the world's deepest dungeon with no skills or magic. Ouch! Once there, he meets a mysterious girl...who happens to be undead. But despite her general dislike of humans, she decides to help him out. Can the two of them make it back to the surface? They might just be a more powerful combo than anyone was expecting!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Casino-gui
synopsis:
Gen Suzuki, a young man who grew up in an orphanage, is trying to live an honest life. But when the cruel reality of a 10 million yen debt from his sister hits him, he decides to rob a Dark Casino. What awaits him is a baptism from the underworld.

(Source: MU)

title: Spica wo Tsukamaete
synopsis:
Serina Nekozuka is a serious third-year high school student who's studying hard to qualify for a scholarship. Her cute and stylish looks, however, don't exactly meet the school dress code—which Reiko Tachibana, a member of the disciplinary committee, is always on her case about. Plus, no matter how much Serina tries, Reiko always bests her in grades and athletics. One day, however, Serina spots Reiko meeting with an unknown woman after school...and going to a love hotel! What will happen between Serina and Reiko now that they share a secret?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kyou wa Kanojo ga Inai kara
synopsis:
Yuni Asahina is lonely—she has a girlfriend, but it feels like they're barely dating. Pent up, Asahina vents her secret frustrations on an anonymous social media account. One day after class, Asahina is doomscrolling on her phone when she's swept up in conversation with the striking, outgoing Taki. Taki peppers her with personal questions until she reveals that she's been following Asahina's supposedly secret social media. Taki insists that she only wants to talk, and the more time they spend together, the more Asahina can feel herself opening up...until Taki shows her true colors, threatening to blackmail Asahina to get more time alone with her! What will Asahina do once she's caught in an erotic web of secrets and lies?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kuroneko wa Ookami Ouji no Yume wo Miru ka
titleEnglish: Do Black Cats Dream of Wolf Princes?
synopsis:
In a world where canines and felines exist as potential partners, Aoi Natsuyama is a house cat who has always carried a childhood fantasy: to meet his charming and gentle prince. Though such a character only exists in fairy tales, he finds himself enchanted by the porn actor Yukio, an attractive wolf who resembles the prince of Aoi's dreams. Intent on getting close to him, he lands a job as an assistant director in the sex industry.

When the original pornstar ditches the filming set, Aoi is forced to act as a substitute instead. Terrified that he will engage in sexual activities with a stranger, he is saved in time by a very familiar wolf—the incomparable Yukio, replacing the other actor for the scene.

Yukio's endearing presence and erotic voice bewitch Aoi, preparing both of them to perform the dirty deed. However, while he is skilled in bed, real-life Yukio has a completely different story and a side to him that Aoi is only just about to delve into.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Best Served Cold
synopsis:
Minjoo's lonely. She keeps herself busy with social media, but that doesn't help the fact that her husband's distant and she's virtually friendless. Nothing changes until she runs into Seo Jia, a handsome girl who's just moved in downstairs. Minjoo's never met anyone like Jia before, and can't help but fall for Jia's charms. But little does Minjoo know that their meeting wasn't exactly serendipitous; in fact, every one of Jia's moves is carefully calculated...so that she can get her revenge!

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Yuri SM de Futari no Kimochi wa Tsunagarimasu ka?
titleEnglish: Hearts of Two Girls Will Be Connect, Only by Their Painful Acts.
synopsis:
Mio has to temporarily live with her former childhood friend Sarasa for a couple of weeks. When she opened their living room door, she saw...

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Ishura
synopsis:
In a world where the Demon King has died, a host of demigods capable of felling him have inherited the world. A master fencer who can figure out how to take out their opponents with a single glance; a lancer so swift they can break the sound barrier; a wyvern rogue who fights with three legendary weapons at once; an all-powerful wizard who can speak thoughts into being; an angelic assassin who deals instant death. Eager to attain the title of "True Hero," these champions each pursue challenges against formidable foes and spark conflicts among themselves. The battle to determine the mightiest of the mighty begins.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Isekai ni Teni shitara Yama no Naka datta. Handou de Tsuyosa yori mo Kaitekisa wo Erabimashita.
synopsis:
One summer day, Jin Konohana, a boy conscripted by his insolent sister to carry her belongings to a fireworks show, suddenly notices he is on a strange mountain. Alone in the mountains, Jin begins a life of survival. He wants to discard all troublesome things and live in peace and comfort.

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title: Ochite Oborete
synopsis:
Honatsu just started her second year of high school, and already rumors are floating around that she's dating her childhood friend, Touma. While Honatsu isn't totally opposed to the idea, she's not sure what she feels for Touma can really be called love. But when aloof transfer student Shun Tachibana appears, the waters get even muddier... How does Shun connect to the past she can't remember? And can Honatsu decide what she truly wants, when her head and her heart are pulling her two different ways?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Kuso Anti Love Destroy
synopsis:
1. Kuso Anti Off Pako Enjou
2. Kuso Anti Love Destroy
3. Kuso Anti Violence
4. Tokyo M Mesu Hard-Boiled
5. Moratorium Accident
6. Shasei Kanri Dou deshou
7. Sadomasochism Communication

title: Hana wa Saku, Shura no Gotoku
synopsis:
Hana, who lives on the small island of Tonakijima with a population of 600, loves to read to the children of the island. Mizuki, the president of the broadcasting club at school, recognizes Hana's ability to engage with people through her reading, and invites her to join the club.

"Tell me what you really want, and I will make it come true."
"I want to join the broadcasting club."

Hana decides to join the club, and as she experiences many "firsts" with the members of the broadcasting club, she begins to deepen her love of reading...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Zense wa Kentei. Konjou Kuzu Ouji
titleEnglish: Sword Emperor Previous Life, Prince Trash This Life.
synopsis:
Once upon a time, there was a swordsman who wielded the sword, lived by the sword, and died by the sword. After days and months of battle, the swordsman chose death by his own free will, but was reborn as Fay Hanse Diestburg, the third prince of the kingdom of Diestburg. Wanting to distance himself from his past life where he lived as if possessed by the sword, Fay decided to just lead a life of a wastrel, earning the nickname Trash Prince. However one day, because of a pact with the neighboring kingdom's Afillis royal house, Fay is sent to war, leading reinforcement troops. On the battlefield, Fay witnesses a scene of despair, as the "Hero," an existence possessing power rivaling tens of thousands, ravaged the battlefield. Fay considered returning to the kingdom, but a certain knight's death manages to shake his heart, thus he decided to wield the sword once again. The legend of the strongest lazy prince begins!

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite
titleEnglish: Orb: On the Movements of the Earth
synopsis:
In fifteenth-century Europe, heretics are being burned at the stake. Rafal, a brilliant young man, is expected to enter university at an early age and study the era's most important field, theology. But Rafal values Reason above all else, which leads him both to the shocking conclusion that the Earth orbits the Sun, and into the hands of the Inquisition!

A decade later, two members of the Watch Guild, the dour young Oczy and the cynical Gras, find a hidden stone chest that details the secrets of the universe Rafal left behind. Dare they try to change their own stars by selling the heretical texts, or would that only lead to the stake and the fire?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hatsujou Relationship
synopsis:
Second year high schooler, Hajime Nakamura, on his first day at his new school runs into a gang of delinquents and gets into serious trouble! What saves him from this mess is a cool, strong and handsome Yankee, Tani Reiji. So he asks if he can be his underling, only to be rejected without a second thought. However, he can't give up his desire to get closer, and when he stubbornly follows him, Reiji gives in and offers him an unexpected proposal: "I could be your friend"...! As a result of getting closer and closer to the beautiful and sexy Reiji, Hajime's horny and naughty fantasies go out of control!

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

title: Gishi Sanjin Den
synopsis:
1. Nichiyou wa Mizu no Machi ni
2. Ningyo Kawa no Tenkei
3. Ningen no You ni Tatsu
4. Ane no Kao no Neko
5. Gendai Rojou Shinwa
6. Gishi Sanjin Den
7. Sonzaishuu

title: Hikari no Hako
synopsis:
A quiet convenience store hovers on the boundary between life and death. Its faint glow in the darkness draws people toward it, pushing them closer to the final purchase they'll ever make...and is that a monster in the magazine aisle?! Prepare for spooky creatures, cryptic employees, and an air of delightful dread in this supernatural mystery.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Evangelion: 3.0 (-120min.)
synopsis: A prequel manga that takes place 120 minutes before Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo which was included in Eva-Extra-Extra, a booklet distributed at the theatrical release of Evangelion: 3.0+1.01 Thrice Upon a Time.

title: Senpai wa Otokonoko
titleEnglish: Senpai Is an Otokonoko: My Crossdressing Classmate
synopsis:
Makoto Hanaoka, a womanly second-year student, easily attracts other people's attention. First-year student Saki Aoi is no exception, and she falls in love with Makoto at first sight. Having a vibrant and vigorous personality, she does not hesitate to confess her feelings to her senior. However, Makoto differs significantly from the person Saki perceives: Makoto is not a girl, but rather a cross-dressing boy!

After revealing his well-known secret to Saki, Makoto expects her to be disgusted. Surprisingly, she is instead captivated by this revelation. Nonetheless, he still rejects her, but Saki's determination does not stop her from declaring that she will become his first love. With Saki and his childhood friend at his side, Makoto's world brightens, giving him strength amid his struggle between his interests and the expectations placed on him.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Boku no Noroi no Kyuuketsuki
synopsis:
The world is full of vampires, supernatural creatures who drain the blood from humans without mercy. Fighting such beings is the foundation of Isuzu Osaka’s life, but with humanity losing the war, desperate times call for desperate measures. To protect his friends, Isuzu sets out to strike a deal with Baroque—a powerful vampiress whose beauty is said to drive all who gaze upon her mad…

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Slow Jet Coaster
synopsis:
Hiyori Honda is a closet fujoshi who fantasizes about her two schoolmates, the cool and stoic Rui Yamaguchi and the bright and cheerful Ibuki Niwa, having a romantic relationship with each other. Day in and day out, she watches the two and posts her fantasies about them as BL manga on social media. However, the more she spends time with her bias, Rui, the more she finds herself slowly falling for him...

(Source: MU)

title: Inu to Kuzu
synopsis:
Haruma Sakuraba's childhood friend Shuuji Inukai was a cut above him in every way imaginable, living out the glamorous life bestowed upon him. Haruma, an unassuming salaryman, has lived his every day clutching onto his inferiority complex, existing only in Shuuji's shadow. One day, Haruma coincidentally meets Shuuji's wife, Reika Sumi, who Haruma has always secretly admired since his high school days. With feelings of envy, jealousy, and more, a "secret" is born from Haruma's repetitive days.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!)
synopsis:
A boy and a girl pledge lifelong friendship in a small town junior high school. The relationship between the two, who are destined to share a common dream, has passed two years without any particular development.

Himari Inuzuka, a bubbly girl who has yet to find her first love, and Yuu Natsume, a plant-loving boy who enjoys flowers, still spend their days peacefully as best friends in the gardening club in the second year of high school.

"If Yuu can't get married, I have to take responsibility."
"I'm having trouble now because after Himari said that, your brother began calling me 'My brother-in-law!'"

However, when Yuu reunites with his first crush, the gears of their relationship suddenly go out of sync! Will Himari be able to escape her "ideal friend" now that she has found love?

(Source: MAL News)

title: Tobioriyou to Shiteiru Joshikousei wo Tasuketara Dou Naru no ka?
synopsis:
The start of a happy life together with a high school girl who has fallen into the bottom of despair.

One day, Yuusuke Yuuki, who spent his high school life only in studying and working part-time in order to maintain his scholarship, found himself strongly wishing for a girlfriend. On the way home, feeling lonely from such thought, he casually looked up into the sky and saw a girl who was about to throw herself off the rooftop of an abandoned building.

"Why the hell are doing something like this!" "Because I...don't have any...reason to live..." "Wait. It'd be a shame for a beauty to die" "....?" "Rather than dying, be my girlfriend" "Eeh?"

Thus, a new love story and daily life with a mysterious girl, Kotori Hatsushiro, which all started from a strange encounter, begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Oresama na Douki ni Yoru no Shigoto ga Baremashita.
titleEnglish: He Knows What I Do After Dark
synopsis:
Mizuto Kusaka is a serious and diligent office worker... by day. At night, however, he works as a rent-boy! One day, he heads to the club after work as usual, but the client who's waiting for him is, unbelievably, his obnoxious, accomplished coworker Shinichi Takasugi! Shinichi gently caresses Mizuto, who can't help finding it... irresistible... An arrogant hotshot and a goody-goody with a wild side get down 'n' dirty in this steamy office romance!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Souzou Renkinjutsushi wa Jiyuu wo Ouka suru: Kokyou wo Tsuihou saretara, Maou no Ohizamoto de Chouzetsu Kouka no Magic Item Tsukuri-houdai ni Narimashita
synopsis:
The story centers around a bureaucrat named Thor, whose alchemy skills go unappreciated in his line of work. When he is expelled to the demon lord's domain, his life takes a huge turn. With his ability to create powerful magic items, he turns the kingdom around, alongside the company of a beautiful maid.

(Source: ANN)

title: Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon
synopsis:
Ever since her mother's death, Miyo Saimori has had little other than her memories to remind her of happiness. Being talentless herself, Miyo has grown up in the shadow of her gifted stepsister and faced every snide remark thrown her way without complaint. Her stepmother's loathing for her is evident in the way she treats Miyo: devoid of any scrap of pity or concern. Miyo accepts that her fate is to slave away for her uncaring family—until her father arranges for her to be wed to Kiyoka Kudou, a revered man with a military background.

The rumors about Kudou are grim, and he is infamous for having been incredibly unkind to all his prospective brides in the past. When Miyo, armed with the barest of essentials for a new life, arrives at her betrothed's residence, she is bewildered to find that not all hearsay about Kudou is true. As she begins to separate fact from fiction, Miyo hopes that her marriage will finally give her the happiness she desires.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Okuretekita Haru wa.
synopsis:
Hisanori Nouchi is a 38-year-old virgin. It's not that he's uninterested in women; it's just that he hasn't had many successful opportunities to meet them. While he works for an ordinary company during the day, at night, he's actually a successful erotic novelist. One day after work, he happens to help a pretty lady named Chika who invites him to a meal as thanks. However, there's no way that Chika is actually a young man dressed as a woman is there?

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

title: Guild no Uketsukejou desu ga, Zangyou wa Iya nanode Boss wo Solo Toubatsu Shiyou to Omoimasu
titleEnglish: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
synopsis:
Alina Clover signed up to be a receptionist for the Adventurers Guild thinking it would be her ticket to the good life—stable pay, regular hours, and safe workplace conditions. Unfortunately, her dream gig turns into a nightmare of endless paper work and overtime whenever the adventurers she helps coordinate get stuck clearing a dungeon. But people aren't made to grind forever, so Alina sneaks off at night to give the monsters holding things up a beatdown, courtesy of her massive war hammer. Keeping this all under wraps to avoid violating her office's ban on second jobs is difficult, especially when the tales of her exploits start to spread, but Alina somehow manages to keep her identity safe...until the leader of the strongest party in the guild catches her defeating a boss one fateful night! Does Alina have what it takes to stop her life from going topsy-turvy?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Guild no Uketsukejou desu ga, Zangyou wa Iya nanode Boss wo Solo Toubatsu Shiyou to Omoimasu
titleEnglish: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
synopsis:
Alina Clover thought being a receptionist for the Adventurers Guild would be her ticket to the good life...but her dream gig turns into an overtime nightmare whenever adventurers get stuck clearing a dungeon. To save herself from paperwork, Alina turns to the simplest solution at hand—beating down the monsters herself! A mysterious adventurer showing up out of nowhere, soloing the boss, then disappearing without taking credit is bound to create rumors, and Alina's treasured job forbids side hustles. So there might be trouble when the leader of the Silver Sword party discovers her secret...!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: JK Haru wa Isekai de Shoufu ni Natta
titleEnglish: JK Haru Is a Sex Worker in Another World
synopsis:
The high school student Haru Koyama and her classmate Seiji Chiba are killed in a traffic accident and are teleported to another world together. While Chiba becomes an adventurer and goes out to slay monsters, Haru discovers that women are not allowed to have special powers in the new world, so she decides to make a living as a sex worker.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Konna no Unmei ja Nai kara Kanchigai shinaide: Shinkon-hen
titleEnglish: There's No Way This Is Fate.: Newlyweds Arc
synopsis:
Welcome to the start of a blissful and loving life as newlyweds! Yuuzen is now wife to Kouetsu and Ginga. Their infatuation with him is never-ending, and the trio live happily together... However, sometimes a heaping helping of love can turn the tiniest of misunderstandings into full-blown fights! A simple visit to the park has Yuuzen doubting Ginga's loyalty! Is it time to panic!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka: Familia Chronicle - Episode Freya
titleEnglish: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Familia Chronicle: Episode Freya
synopsis:
The search for love is on!

A fey mood strikes Freya, sparking a new quest to find her Odr, the one destined to stand forever by her side. Naturally, her followers are against it. They remember all too well the disaster that her last adventure turned out to be. Unfortunately for them, such a minor setback has never been enough to stop the goddess of beauty from following wherever her heart leads-which, this time, happens to be the sandy dunes of Kaios. Freya is eager to spread her wings to see what discoveries this new land has to offer, even as her familia frantically searches for her, no matter the cost...!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Broken Melody
synopsis:
Minhee used to be a world-famous piano prodigy until one mistake sent her life spiraling. Her confidence shaken, her family broken and her life in ruins, all she can do is hope for a chance to make things better. That's when she meets Eun Hyun, the neighborhood piano teacher whose life has been filled with tragedies of his own. The world breaks everyone, it's up to us to pick up the pieces and glue ourselves back together.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Ookami Buka-kun to Hitsuji Joushi-san
titleEnglish: I'm a Wolf, but My Boss Is a Sheep!
synopsis:
Wolf-man Oogami is a salaryman at a mattress and bedding company whose coworkers are all sheep. Normally, this lone wolf keeps to himself, but his job in this new department is both a blessing and a curse. Oogami has a crush on an adorable sheep-lady supervisor and it appears to be more than just a case of mere puppy-love...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu.
titleEnglish: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
synopsis:
