title: Kanashiki Ningyo
synopsis:
Umi's life has been filled with nothing but misery since he was born. Due to a hideous birthmark caused by a mermaid's curse, his family disowns him and he is treated like a monster. Everything changes when he meets Naosuke—a tattoo artist who covers his birthmark with a tattoo resembling the sea and raises him as his own child. After Naosuke's death, Umi inherits his trade, but due to his appearance, he lives secluded from everyone—his only company being his spirit guardians, the goldfish Kuro and carp Nishiki.

Mikagi makes a living as a so-called medium. In reality, he is a swindler—although he can see small spirits, he is incapable of exorcising them. When he spies Umi walking through the streets with Kuro and Nishiki, Mikagi thinks he has found a potential customer; he approaches with the promise of exorcising the fish spirits and even compliments Umi's looks. However, the flustered Umi runs away, leaving Mikagi extremely confused.

The encounter leaves the two men curious about each other, which creates an opportunity for them to overcome their pasts and find happiness together.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu - Shitsui no Majutsushi-hen
synopsis:
After separating from Eris, Rudeus falls into the depths of depression. He travels to Rozenberg, the second city of the Principality of Basherant, to search for his missing mother, Zenith. Desperate, Rudeus tries to accept a high-ranking quest alone in order to make a name for himself. However, by chance, he ends up working with a party of B-rank adventurers called the Counter Arrow. One of the party members is a girl named Sara, who reminds him of Eris...!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Kimi ga Kemono ni Naru Mae ni
synopsis:
Hajime leads an unremarkable life as an undertaker, but he likes his job and has no reason to complain. Nor can he complain of being always called "onii-san" by one of the top star actresses in the country, Kotone Kidou, a childhood friend. Their relationship has always had a touch of awkwardness due to the parents of both having died violent deaths, but nothing could have prepared Hajime—or Japan—to the deed Kotone decides to perpetrate seemingly out of the blue.

(Source: Death Toll Scans)

title: Amai Koe wa Saidai Volume de
synopsis:
Yuuta Mogami, a junior in his high school club, is a handsome and friendly guy. Every single day, he comes onto his senpai, Daichi Seto, who goes to a neighboring university, libidinously, saying, "I masturbated to senpai's voice" without giving up despite getting brushed off each time.

Even though Daichi should be fed up with Mogami, his direct "suki suki attack" throws him off his pace. In the end, when he sees Mogami chatting happily with his friends, he gets jealous...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Ore no Saioshi wo Kimi ni Sasagu!
titleEnglish: I'll Make You My Number One Idol!
synopsis:
Chihiro, a freeter, went into a crossdressing maid café as the penalty to a punishment game. The maid serving him was a tall, buff, scary-faced dude, Mako!! Though Chihiro was surprised when a maid who was completely different from his imagination stepped in, Mako's angelic smile made him melt in a heartbeat. Just like that, he quickly dived into otaku life being Mako's hardcore fan!! Thanks to all his efforts, they developed mutual feelings... but Mako's workplace forbids dating!!

Now these two lovebirds have to keep their romance a secret in the café?! Chihiro's super-duper, ultra happy "He's got muscles and is tall, but that's what makes him!! The cutest thing!! Ever!!!" world revolving around Mako will melt weary hearts in the wink of an eye.

(Source: Home-sha, translated)

title: Tottemo Kawaii Watashi to Tsukiatte yo!
synopsis:
The most popular girl in class, Yuzu, confessed her feelings to me. Well, it was more along the lines of: "Please pretend to be my boyfriend so I can help sort out the love triangle among the group of normies!" Yuzu always seemed so sweet and innocent during class, but in front of me, she showed her true, self-absorbed and narcissistic side. I should have found it annoying, but somehow...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Dinosan
synopsis:
With their fossils being all that remained, dinosaurs were believed to be extinct due to a meteor striking the Earth long before humanity existed. But in 1946, the secluded Barakan Island was discovered to be home to a few remaining species of these prehistoric beasts. With successful research in genetic manipulation, dinosaurs were brought back to life, bringing about dinomania around the world. However, excitement quickly dwindled following an incident that led to a person's death.

Despite the rise and fall of the public's interest over the years, 24-year-old Suzume Suma has always wished to interact with and take care of dinosaurs—an aspiration that allows her to land her dream job as a dinosaur keeper at Enoshima Dinoland. As a result of the incident, the dinosaur reserve is barely managing to keep regular visitors with its low staffing and funding. In addition, Suzume can hardly keep up with her coworkers Karin Kirishima and Kaidou. Regardless of the challenges, Suzume stays determined to bring dinomania back in full force!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Oshi ga Ani ni Narimashita
synopsis:
When my mom announced her remarriage, I knew I would be getting a stepbrother. But to my surprise, it was my idol, the super famous model Noa! He has made a name for himself with his cold attitude, but for some reason, he is extremely nice to me! The number one model waking me up in the mornings, helping me with my homework... and even giving me the occasional hug?! What other wholesome antics can we expect from this mysterious idol?!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Goukon ni Ittara Onna ga Inakatta Hanashi
titleEnglish: How I Attended an All-Guy's Mixer
synopsis:
College student Tokiwa gets invited to a mixer by his female classmate Suo. But when he arrives with his friends, they’re greeted by three dazzlingly handsome men?!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Yuujin ni 500-en Kashitara Shakkin no Kata ni Imouto wo Yokoshitekita no dakeredo, Ore wa Ittai Dousureba Ii n darou
titleEnglish: I Lent 500 Yen to a Friend. His Sister Came to My House Instead of Borrowing. What Should I Do?
synopsis:
"I'm here as the collateral for my brother's debt. I will be in your care from now on."

Akari Miyamae suddenly came barging in into Motomu Shiragi's apartment. Giving off the impression of a good girl who cares for her brother, and a beautiful girl who would be gossiped about throughout the school, Akari suddenly offers herself as collateral for her brother's loan. And that's just for 500 yen.

"Until my brother pays off his loan, I will gladly be your possession, senpai!" she declared happily, for some reason.

Motomu was bewildered by the overly wild development, but Akari pushily cajoles him and steadily goes forward with the preparation to freeload. And of course, this whole "collateral" thing has another motive―it's the start of a single-room cohabitation with a beautiful proactive girl!

(Source: NU)

title: Inkya no Boku ni Batsu Game de Kokuhaku shitekita Hazu no Gal ga, Dou Mitemo Boku ni Betabore desu
titleEnglish: An Introvert's Hookup Hiccups: This Gyaru Is Head Over Heels for Me!
synopsis:
When the gorgeous Nanami Barato confesses to Yoshin Misumai, it seems too good to be true! Only, it is—and Yoshin knows it. How's an introverted guy like him supposed to keep his cool when he knows this is all just a dare? Even more puzzling, despite her gaudy appearance, this supposed gyaru isn't actually all that good with guys! Perhaps this is the perfect chance for this shy guy to pluck up his own courage and say yes to the guy-shy girl. So begins their new cushy life of morning meet-ups and handmade lunches. The thing is, judging by the way she's acting, Nanami has fallen head over heels for him! From dares and dating to downright disasters, can these two first-timers figure out their feelings and maybe even fall in love—for real, this time?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Zeikin de Katta Hon
synopsis:
Ishidaira is a delinquent who visited the library for the first time since elementary school. He discovered that he still hadn't returned a book he borrowed 10 years ago. He ended up having to work part-time at the library to pay for it. This is the beginning of a manga that makes you want to go to the library after you read it.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onnanoko to Tomodachi ni Natta
titleEnglish: I Became Friends with the Second Cutest Girl in the Class.
synopsis:
I, Maehara Maki, someone who couldn't make any acquaintances or friends in high school, finally had someone to hang out with outside of school. A girl. Her name was Asanagi-san. The boys in my class called her "the class' second cutest girl" behind her back. On Fridays, she would refuse her best friend, Amami, "the cutest girl in class" invitation just to hang out in my house with me. Together, we played games, watched some movies, read some manga while eating junk foods like pizza and hamburgers, and chugging cola without a care in the world. To others, we may seem sloppy, but it was a precious, secret time together for Asanagi-san and myself.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: No Game No Life: Dai-2 Shou - Toubu Rengou-hen
titleEnglish: No Game No Life Chapter 2: Eastern Union Arc
synopsis:
Summoned by a boy who calls himself God in a world where games decide everything, the prodigy gamer siblings Sora and Shiro quickly rise to the top of human society. Having secured a future for the nation of Elkia and humankind in this world, the siblings set their sights on a new prize—the Eastern Union. It's finally time to challenge the other races! 

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sumiiri Osananajimi no Sokubaku ga Tsurai
synopsis:
Nanase, in her first year of working, is troubled by her childhood friend Rui; a tattoo artist who is very restraining. He's worrisome, overprotective... and just plain restrictive! The two have been living together for five years, but they are not lovers. Nanase loves Rui, but for some reason, she can't tell him how she really feels. One day, Nanase learns that the manager of the shop where Rui works, whom she respects, is a woman. She decides to visit her at work, out of curiosity, but...?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Kanojo ni Uwaki Sareteita Ore ga, Koakuma na Kouhai ni Natsukareteimasu
titleEnglish: My Coquettish Junior Attaches Herself to Me!
synopsis:
Christmas season. Yuuta Hasegawa found himself single after breaking up last month when his girlfriend had cheated on him. And it was only a few days until Christmas! After an everyday conversation with his female friend, Ayaka Mino, Yuuta meets a beautiful girl clad in a Santa suit—in a lane full of couples no less! Her name is Mayu Shinohara. Will this encounter with Shinohara turn out to be the Christmas present for Yuuta?

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Mukuchi na Koushaku Reijou to Reitetsu na Koutei: Zensei Hirotta Kodomo ga Koutei ni Natteimashita
titleEnglish: The Boy I Loved Became the Jaded Emperor
synopsis:
As a young boy, Prince Alexei was rescued from certain death by a strange woman with the appearance of a monster. The two of them spent blissful years in the forest , but tragedy struck after his former life caught up with him. Now a young man, Alexei has taken the throne, becoming a cold-hearted emperor intent with no interest in finding love.

Little does he know, the person who saved him has been reborn as the daughter of a duke—a taciturn young lady named Eleonora. Soon enough, fate throws them together at the imperial court, but can Alexei overcome his jaded past to see what is right in front of him?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Korogaru Kyoudai
synopsis:
Usami Minato is a high school girl with a new little brother from her father's remarriage. Having high expectations after being told that her new brother is an adorable little boy, Koushirou—said little brother—turns out to be a little different than she imagined.

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: Kappa no Yomeiri
synopsis:
On his way to work at his flower shop, Ryuuto came across Kikujirou who had collapsed on the side of the road due to heatstroke. After his recuperation, Kikujirou suddenly proposes to Ryuuto! It seems Kikujirou is actually a Kappa, and it is his family's tradition to marry the man who saved his life.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Shinobi SS
synopsis:
In a world where ninjas are still active behind the scenes, the heirs of the Kouga and Iga ninja clans attend the same high school as regular students. But after an incident, each of them began to suspect the other is actually a ninja. And a fierce secret battle breaks out between them trying to reveal each other's hidden identity.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Isekai Saikou no Kizoku, Harem wo Fuyasu hodo Tsuyokunaru
synopsis:
Yuuto is suddenly reincarnated into the other world in a smartphone game and becomes the third son of a noble family. "Skills" exist in that world, and Yuuto was reincarnated with "Noblesse Oblige." When Yuuto, who has become an adult, sleeps with a woman as a rite of passage, Noblesse Oblige is activated. It is a rare skill that lets him copy the skills of the women he sleeps with! Yuuto sleeps with women possessing skills one after another, becoming the strongest with the skills he acquires, and building a harem of women who fall in love with him. Furthermore, it was discovered that Noblesse Oblige can awaken skills and evolve skills, and the cheating keeps on coming! All the women and skills I want are mine! The strongest cheat harem begins here!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Giant Ojousama
synopsis:
Oriko Fujidou is the buxom young head of the Fujidou Zaibatsu, a group that has a monopoly on Japan's vending machine industry. And serving at her side is her personal butler, the eccentric Dr. Sebastion. When a monster suddenly attacks the city, Dr. Sebastion slips his ojou-sama an experimental energy drink his team in R&D has been developing. As a result, she quickly finds herself growing into a giantess, matching the attacking kaiju in size! Will she be able to stop his rampage, or at the very least, keep her dignity intact?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: The Fable: The Second Contact
synopsis:
The story is set about one year after the ending to The Fable. Akira and Youko are forced to abort their latest mission due to the Covid-19 pandemic and return to Osaka to continue their quiet life as regular civilians, but the peace is not to last.

(Source: MU)

title: Toumei Otoko to Ningen Onna: Sonouchi Fuufu ni Naru Futari
titleEnglish: The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife
synopsis:
Yakou, a gentle human woman, works at a detective agency. Tounome is a smart and gentle invisible man. The invisible man's ability is perfect for detective work. However, the blind Yakou can still figure out where Tounome is, even if he disappears. Before they know it, the two become attracted to each other...?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kiss de Egaku Ittousei
synopsis:
Chitose can't take his eyes off the guy from the class next door, dozing off in class by the window. Each time Chitose leans out the window to sneak a look at him, he's always there, dozing off as expected. His name: Seno. He's a year older, but according to rumors, he was absent for a year because he was involved in a fight. Chitose is a friendly and sweet-hearted high-schooler and Seno is a mysterious guy. The two polar opposites gradually open their hearts to each other... A chaotic and heartwarming school-love between a cheery puppy and a questionable grade repeater.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Aishiteru Game wo Owarasetai
titleEnglish: I Want to End This Love Game
synopsis:
In sixth grade, childhood friends Yukiya Asagi and Miku Sakura created a game with the objective to embarrass the other person by taking turns saying "I love you." Four years later, even as they are entering high school, the two are still trying to one-up the other and claim victory. However, as tender feelings begin to bloom in their hearts, the simple phrase has taken on new meaning beyond the rules of their game.

With the passing of each day, the urge to become more than childhood friends grows—but both Yukiya and Miku resist making the first move, hesitant about what is in store once the game finally ends.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Torotoro Hitou de Koi, Hajimaru.
titleEnglish: A Steamy Romance Blossoms at the Secret Springs
synopsis:
Iharu is a university student looking for ways to kill time over spring break. In passing, he meets an attractive young man named Shin who invites him on a trip to the hot springs. He accepts Shin's offer and finds himself at an elegant inn with outdoor baths and hidden springs—not to mention luxurious meals and amazing sake... Lost in his happiness, he decides to enter the hot springs with Shin. But when he looks at the young man undressing, he can't believe his eyes... "Even his dick is gorgeous! His butt is so shapely!" Even after Iharu turns in for the night, he can't stop thinking about Shin's amazing body... and growing increasingly horny.

(Source: Torico)

title: Shima-chan Chi no Tsugai Jijou
synopsis:
Shima really adores her parents, the loud-spoken alpha Akane Kuroga and the collected omega Aoi Shirosaki. However, despite the loving relationship these men have today, they were once just brash students who were bound to butt heads due to the rivalry between their schools. The two should have hated each other immediately, but instead, they felt an instant connection. From prospective rivals to lovers, the men tell their daughter the story of how they met, fell in love, and had her—creating a warm and tender family of their own.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Zaidu Yu Ni
synopsis:
Xun An thought she had missed her chance with Yang Muli back in school. Maybe it was that regret that caused her to work for her old high school as a PE teacher after college. Whatever the reason may be, she'll need to come to terms with her feelings fast! It turns out fate also had plans for Yang Muli to be pulled back to their alma mater as their newest math teacher!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Uwasa no Saeki wa Kare to Koi ga Shitai
titleEnglish: The Scandalous Saeki Wants to Fall in Love with Him
synopsis:
"I don't know what to do. I've never loved someone this much before." Class President Yuzuki Tachibana strives to be well-liked by the entire school. So when his teacher asks him to look after problem child Kei Saeki, who's in danger of failing due to low attendance, Yuzuki is more than ready to take on the challenge. But he doesn't know about the rumors that surround the legendary playboy and knows even less about how to respond to his affections... Don't miss this sweet opposites-attract love story!

(Source: Animate International)

title: Hallelujah Baby
synopsis:
The successor of a yakuza family and his bodyguard who's head over heels in love with him—the only pacifist in the wild and violent Ousaki Group is its successor, Touka. His bodyguard-slash-friend, Miyako, has dedicated his entire being to protecting him, but it seems he's a tad bit overprotective...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Re Cervin
synopsis:
After a powerful dragon attacked her country, Princess Arsinoe Grancamano of the Kingdom of Helentar was forced to create a pact with Sent Fauna, a powerful deity of Paradise, to drive it away. In order to do so, Arsinoe sacrificed one of her most precious memories and subsequently fell into a coma.

A month later, she wakes to find herself hidden away from the world in the care of a nearby village and discovers that her mother died in the attack on Helentar. While she is overcome with grief, Arsinoe meets King Cervin, a mysterious man claiming to be her father. However, Arsinoe has no recollection of him ever being involved in her life—as her memories of her father are what she offered to Sent Fauna.

Despite their uncertain past, the pair decide to travel together and endeavor to achieve Asinoe's goal: to exact revenge on Contrano, the one who summoned the dragon that killed her mother and destroyed her kingdom.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shoujo-tachi no Kizuato ni Kuchizuke wo
titleEnglish: Kiss the Scars of the Girls
synopsis:
"I'm sure someday, I'll get you to look my way." Danger and uncertainty are common for a young vampire, which is why Emille will be assigned a "Big Sister" on her fourteenth birthday, like all the girls at her school. Deep within a secluded forest, her sister will teach her how to hunt and safely feed on humans. Learning to rely on each other for survival cultivates a deep relationship comparable to that between family-but does theirs have the potential to evolve into something more?"

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Light of My Life
synopsis:
Back in high school, best friends Aki and Minagi were inseparable. Aki dreamed of becoming a professional football player, while Minagi was seen as a "genius" who was eager to chase his dream of working in medicine. Years later, Aki has taken over his grandfather's hair salon, and Minagi set his interest in medicine aside to work in a host club. Despite the growing tension between them following their high school fallout, Minagi shows up at Aki's apartment one day asking for a place to stay. Can the two men confront their past in order to repair their future?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Derail
synopsis:
Best friends Hikaru and Haru have always been close enough. Close enough to be each other's number one. Close enough to live together and sleep in the same bed. When Hikaru brings someone over, Haru decides he's no longer content with "close enough." But is he the only one?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Shimotsuki-san wa Mob ga Suki
titleEnglish: She is in Love with the Mob!
synopsis:
Only you are special.

After school, Koutarou Nakayama returns to school to pick up something he forgot and finds Shiho Shimotsuki asleep in an empty classroom. Shiho is rumored to be Ryouma Ryuuzaki's crush, a popular boy who has formed a harem in his class, but she is always expressionless and no one has ever seen her smile.

But now, her fair skin is holding Koutarou's hand...?! The "secret relationship" between the heroine and the mob begins!

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Debu to Love to Ayamachi to!
synopsis:
"This is the punishment for a fat, ugly girl like me falling in love with someone as beautiful as you..." Yumeko had a mountain of complexes about herself. Then, a terrible accident befalls her. Though somehow saved from the brink of death, Yumeko wakes up a completely different person. "This is...me...?! I'm SO cute!!" Those around her can't hide their surprise and wonderment at this 180°change... But, Yumeko's new hyper-positive attitude starts to change her surroundings, too. Worries and complexes can affect anyone, and Yumeko will chop right through those of her various supporting characters!! In love, work, friendship... And an attempted murder case?! This frenzied romantic comedy will leave you bubbling with energy!

(Source: Solmare Publishing)

title: Ami-chan no Nikki
synopsis:
"On June X, we changed our uniform to short sleeves."

Ami is a beautiful girl who is looked back at by both boys and girls. She is the most beautiful girl in Tsubaki High School, but she has a secret that she can't tell anyone. That's because this diary is...

(Source: Galette Works, translated)

title: Ashita, Kimi no Mono ni Shite
synopsis:
Yuki is a quiet, average boy who falls head over heels for the confident and cool Hayato in his new high school class. The two hit it off with an easygoing friendship, but when Yuki realizes that a female classmate has a crush on his friend, he tries to put some distance between them. As his feelings come to a head, he finally confesses to Hayato... who confesses right back!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Shikabane to Hanayome
synopsis:
They were the only two brothers in a sprawling family mansion. At the end of a gruesome battle for succession, the younger brother, now head of the family, held a solemn wedding. The bride's face remained hidden from everyone behind a thick veil, and she became rumored as "the faceless wife." But in the bridal chamber on their wedding night, the face revealed is that of his elder brother, who was supposed to be dead.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: My Only Doggy
synopsis:
Kobayashi may not know how to deal with people, but he does know how to sell sweets; and as the best salesman in sweets company Inujirushi, his talent could be the biggest help to their slowly dying pet food subsidiary. He may have a childhood fear of dogs, but that's definitely not going to get in the way of his work...right?!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shot: With My Doggy

title: Project Sekai Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku: Comic Anthology
synopsis: An anthology of stories set in the world of Sega and Colorful Palette's game Project Sekai Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku, released for iOS and Android on September 30, 2020.

title: Shoukan suru Sekai
synopsis:
When creatures, items, and even space itself can be summoned from other worlds, no one should want for anything...right? Tokoyo, a boy who was abandoned to live with the Summoned in the Fantasy District aims to become a summoner to help all his Summoned friends. When he arrives in Tokyo to attend the Summoning Academy, he's told he'll never make it by the first summoner he meets! Tokoyo realizes he has a lot left to learn...and finds a new dream: to become the bridge between humanity and the Summoned!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Metsuki Warui Ko Kawaii Ko
titleEnglish: A Cute Girl with Nasty Look
synopsis:
Tanaka is a high school student who believes that scary girls are actually cute. He secretly wants to become friends with Mizuno-san, a delinquent who sits next to him. She has a "nasty look," creating rumors about her and making her feared by her classmates! At first, she shuns Tanaka, but gradually, she opens up to his fierce attacks. Tanaka plans to make her fit in with their class, but on the day of the school festival, a big incident breaks out.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kemono Joushi ni Jitsu wa Mitomerareteita Hanashi
synopsis:
In a world where humans are thought to be inferior to beastfolk, human office worker Saki Oki endures a constant stream of ridicule and scorn from her beastfolk colleagues and superiors. So when she gets called into the CEO's office, she's prepared for the worst—but instead of firing Saki, the CEO acknowledges her hard work and makes her his private secretary! With all eyes in the office on her, Saki struggles to get used to her new position, not to mention her boss's intimidating—yet oddly charming—aura...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sotozura Danshi no Shimizu-kun
titleEnglish: Shimizu Is Just a Tad Two-Faced
synopsis:
Awkward high school student Koharu Minami is in love with Shimizu, the popular boy in her class. So she's shocked when she inadvertently discovers that his friendly demeanor is all an act. Or is it? The more time they spend time together, the more Koharu notices the kindness hidden behind the constant teasing and disgruntled comments. Could finding out about "the real Shimizu" actually end up bringing the two closer together?!

(Source: Shodensha)

title: Kedamono Arashi: Hold Me Baby!
synopsis:
In this world, there are humans without beast ears, and humans with beast ears called Bestia. After the ordeal with Sougo's father, Akira and Sougo are spending one happy day at a time with their son, Shouta. A relaxing vacation in Hawaii brings them closer than ever, and it seems Shouta will soon be a big brother! On another note, Sougo's father, Soushi, is reunited with his first love: Yuu Ohara, one of Shouta's daycare teachers. Memories between the two resurface, and they are still drawn to each other, just like the day they first met. Can the two of them finally have their happily ever after?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Isekai Neko to Fukigen na Majo
titleEnglish: A Cat from Our World and the Forgotten Witch
synopsis:
In her youth, Jeanne was a powerful witch who vanquished the evil Demon King and saved the world–but over time, the people she rescued have forgotten about her and her noble deeds. Now she is a short-spoken old woman, living by herself in a secluded forest...until she summons a cat from Earth to her home. The former city kitty is now the size of a giant, and must acclimate to this new world at Jeanne's side. Through eating the food Jeanne prepares, and offering a head for pats, can this furry feline soothe the loneliness of the forgotten witch?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi
titleEnglish: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked
synopsis:
Miya is the illegitimate child of a certain prominent family. When her mother dies, she's convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters! Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being...sweet?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hiroware Koneko to Moto Yakuza
synopsis:
After being abandoned in the cold rain, tiny kitten Sabu should have been grateful to find a new home. But when he's rescued by Jin, whose every atom screams "yakuza," Sabu suspects he's out of the frying pan and into the fire! Yet Jin's scarred hands and face hide a sweet man beneath...a man who pampers kitties with baths and bottle-feedings!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Oshi ga Tonari de Jugyou ni Shuuchuu Dekinai!
titleEnglish: My Idol Sits the Next Desk Over!
synopsis:
Chiro-chan is a world-class idol...at least, to Sakiko Manaka, your run-of-the-mill hard-core idol fan. So when Chiro—real name Chihiro—ends up sitting next to her in school, Sakiko's world is turned upside-down, and all her brain cells vanish. After all, how can she concentrate when her absolute fav is just inches away?! But she needs to be on her A-game, because she may not be the only one who is totally gaga for Chihiro...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Ookami-sama no Koiwazurai
synopsis:
Thousands of years ago, numerous experiments to combine human and animal DNA resulted in the creation of beastmen—beings with human-like appearances and animal characteristics. Nowadays, they live regular lives and often intermingle with humans.

Wolf-type beastman Haine Touya has been looking forward to scouting interesting freshmen at his university. After spotting rabbit beastman Mizuki, Haine approaches and flirts with him, but he is soon stopped by Natsuo Taira—the childhood human friend of Mizuki with an emotionless face. By accident, Haine scratches Natsuo; as an apology, he lets the other touch his ears. Strangely entranced by Natsuo, Haine kisses him and leaves the scene—unable to comprehend why he feels such emotions for a mere human.

Haine realizes that, for the first time, he has seriously fallen in love with someone. Resolved to make Natsuo his partner, Haine must sweep him off his feet and demonstrate commitment in the daring pursuit for his affection.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Horeta Otoko wa Shinyuu de
synopsis:
"Is this how you always get? I had no idea." Yoichi and Shige have been best friends since elementary school. Yoichi used to be in love with Shige, but in order to stay friends, he was supposed to have thrown those feelings away... However, Shige suddenly flips their relationship on its head when he suddenly asks, "Hey, Yoichi. Let me eat your dick." In just an instant, Yoichi suddenly has his dick in Shige's mouth...!! Yoichi was supposed to have given up on Shige, but Shige's passionate blowjob backs Yoichi's heart and body into a corner... And the moan he accidently lets slip from his mouth only eggs Shige on, leading the situation to escalate! A forgotten love is rekindled in this possessively passionate love-story between two friends!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Lost in the Cloud
synopsis:
Skylar has a secret hobby—taking photos of his crush, Chan-il. But when Cirrus stumbles upon Skylar's cloud storage with its impressive collection of Chan-il's photos, things escalate pretty quickly. At first confident his secret is safe with Cirrus, Skylar continuously finds himself in compromising situations, making him question Cirrus' true motives.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Kiss mo Mada na Watashi desu.
synopsis:
Fukase is a high school gyaru who is so experienced in love, or at least that's what everyone around her thinks. What happens when her classmate, Takamiya discovers that she wrote how she wanted to have her first kiss...?

(Source: MU)

title: Yosame Hakuro wa Korosenai
synopsis:
Asagami, a professional assassin is headed to complete her first mission, but discovers that her target, Hakuro Yosame, is immortal. In exchange for working for him as a maid, she can try to kill him as much as she wants.

(Source: MU)

title: Among Us
synopsis:
Inside a spaceship, a group of five crewmates—Tamago, King, Megane, Yankee, and Cap—has gathered to play a game of Among Us. They all have victory in mind, but only one person plans to win at the others' expense: the impostor, Tamago. With Tamago aiming to eliminate everyone but himself, the other crewmates must suss him out as quickly as possible. However, their absurd deductive skills prove ineffective in spotting the suspect amid the crew, as they poorly attempt to identify the impostor among them.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Aekanaru
synopsis:
The manga's story centers on Sadai, a person who heads into the mountains with the intent of taking his own life, but instead encounters a mysterious gentle girl.

(Source: ANN)

title: Sensei Shokushin shite Kudasai!
synopsis:
A construction worker, Saeki is very interested in anything that has to do with sexual pleasure. When his coworker tells him about the red-light district where a man plays with his butt, he instantly denies the sexual hobby but cannot resist trying it later at his home. He tries to find the erogenous zone and happens to push a buttery deeper. He cannot take out the battery. So, he meets Dr. Kirishima, a handsome male gastroenterologist with long hair, for the treatment and dares to ask the whereabouts of his prostate. The doctor technically indicates the place. But the feelings are so good for Saeki that, to his surprise, he asks Kirishima, "Could you put your dick in...?"

(Source: Takeshobo)

title: Watashi no Okaasama wa Tsuihou sareta Moto Akuyaku Reijou deshita: Heimin Busu Megane no Gekokujou
titleEnglish: The Ex-Villainess's Unsightly Daughter: A Beady-Eyed Commoner's Journey to the Top
synopsis:
"Your identity must never be revealed. Your eyes and your hair would inconvenience both your mother and the people of the kingdom..."

The mother of Ashley, who is a fifteen-year-old girl, was called a villainess, got prosecuted, and then kidnapped. As result, she has conceived a child, Ashley, who was later told that she shared the same eye and hair color as the man who had kidnapped her mother. She wears glasses and an Alice band that use the power of magic to make her look disagreeable in others' eyes, and thus gets called an "ugly four-eyes." Unable to make any friends, Ashley used to lead an academy life of loneliness and solitude...

However, after her encounter with a mysterious creature, the crown prince grows interested in her...?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Binbou Reijou no Kanchigai Seijo-den: Okane no Tame ni Doryoku shitetara, Ouzoku Harem ga Dekiteimashita!?
synopsis:
Sophia became an adventurer because of hardships, even though she was a baron. But one day, she died in a dungeon, and before she knew it, she went back to when she was a baby!

"And from then on, I did my best while training hard."

A glittering smile and highly accurate magic and you have a perfect Sophia! But when she turned 15, her father told her that he had an illness and she ended up becoming an adventurer to earn money for his medical expenses.

"Since this happened, I will make use of my memories and experiences from my previous life, earn money with haste and retire quickly!"

But while I was adventuring, the princes somehow gathered and everyone started treating me like a saint. And in the end, I ended up fighting a nasty person doing something illegal?

(Source: MU)

title: Aku no Hanamichi wo Ikimashou
titleEnglish: Let's Go on the Evil Runway.
synopsis:
Celestine, who has been married to an ugly middle-aged man after bullying the heroine, suddenly regains her memory of her previous life. "Huh... What? This person isn't that bad... In fact, isn't he kinda cute...?" As a villainess and fan of older men, Celestine walks down a flowery path of evil!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Hakushaku Reijou wa Kenen no Naka no Elite Kishi to Kyouseiteki ni Tsugai ni Saserareru
synopsis:
The almighty Skinia empire invaded the principality of Arita, taking it under its dominion. The imperial educational system imposes on the children of the fallen country's aristocracy to pair with a partner decided by the empire and conceive a child in the spring of their 18th year.

The count's daughter Tiana is to be paired with Adel, the elite knight she quarrels with since forever. Their first night passed without any romanticism while the two exchanged verbal blows.

Tiana thought that it would be only for one night, but Adel called for her many times after, in the name of their duty?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Ryuukishi no Okiniiri
synopsis:
A young woman begins a new life as a dragon master for a handsome earl in this tale of high fantasy romance.

Melissa is a maid-in-training at the royal castle, where her greatest joy is caring for the majestic steeds of the royal Dragon Knights. Her coming-of-age ceremony is fast approaching, and with it comes the need to decide what path her future will take. Melissa shares a special bond of friendship with Commander Hubert, the handsome knight who rides the mightiest of dragons, but their relationship is about to get complicated. Newly returned from a dangerous mission, Hubert makes a shocking request: Would Melissa pretend to be his lover, and move to his country estate, where wild dragons roam?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yowaki Max Reijou nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
synopsis:
I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game.

After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum, and then become a curator.

So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son.

But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?

(Source: MU)

title: Kiss de Tokashita Sono Ato ni
synopsis:
By the decision of his parents, university student Hiro Aise is currently freeloading at the house of his friend's older brother, Mizuki Onosawa. Mizuki is a handsome accountant and the ideal husband and Hiro is basking in his good looks. At first glance, their life together is pleasant, with Hiro making meals and waking Mizuki in the mornings. But there's a problem: Hiro is romantically interested in men, and Mizuki is his first love! One day, while feeling horny, the worst happens when Mizuki sees Hiro masturbating. Even worse, everything is discovered, including his posts on social media that he's "taking applications for a boyfriend" and that he was provoked by an erotic message. However, Mizuki says something completely unexpected: "If you're that frustrated, why not have a fake romance with me?"

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Teihen Boukensha dakedo Mahou wo Kiwametemiru Koto ni Shita: Munou Skill kara Kami Skill ni Shinka shita "Mahou Souzou" to "Item Sakusei" de Musou suru
synopsis:
Loa is a bottom tier adventurer who is regarded by everyone as "incompetent." The only skill he possesses is "Create Item," which is the ability to create an item in exchange for your levels. Because of this skill, Loa is still weak for his level when compared to others. However, Loa continued to raise his level without using the Item Creation ability in order to improve his ability as much as possible. He has been hunting low-level monsters such as slimes and goblins for a year.

When Loa finally reached Level 50, an extraordinary change happens to him. "'Item Creation' has evolved into 'Magic Creation.'" The Magic Creation skill allows you to create a new magic in exchange for levels. The more levels you sacrifice, the more powerful magic you can create. Furthermore, by using the Item Creation ability, you can supplement your status with powerful equipment, create high-value items, and it's super convenient!

Item Creation and Magic Creation—the two skills have a synergistic effect, and Loa achieves tremendous growth.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Isekai Kokka Alchimaira: Saijaku no Ou to Musou no Gunzei
titleEnglish: Different World Alchimaira: The Weakest King and Matchless Army
synopsis:
The VR game "Tactics Chronicle" is a state-management game. One day, Helian, a player who has reached the top of the game and become the king of a land of demons, is suddenly transported to another world, his own country in the game. What he saw there was a character from the game acting with his own ego...!

(Source: MU)

title: Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon
titleEnglish: The Vexations of a Shut-in Vampire Princess
synopsis:
Three years into her life as a shut-in, vampire Terakomari Gandesblood (Komari for short), awakens to find she's been appointed as a commander in the Mulnite Imperial Army! The thing is, her new unit consists solely of belligerent ruffians who revolt against their superiors at the slightest hint of weakness. Although Komari hails from a line of vampires as powerful as they are prestigious, her refusal to drink blood has made her the picture of mediocrity—scrawny, un-coordinated, and inept at magic. With the odds stacked against her, will the help of her trusty (and slightly infatuated) maid Vill be enough for this recluse to blunder her way to success? Or will Komari rue the day she ever left the safety of her room?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
synopsis:
In the web novel Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse, people are forced to fight monsters and each other for coins, food, and—ultimately—survival. While mysterious "Constellations" watch the unwilling participants for their own entertainment, one man emerges as the protagonist: Yoo Joonghyuk, who repeatedly lives and dies in an endless struggle to close the book on this indiscriminate torture.

Kim Dokja has lived a challenging and action-packed life through Joonghyuk for over a decade. While other readers abandoned the story early on, Dokja has remained its sole reader until the very last chapter. At that time, he receives a puzzling message from the author, and the novel's inhumane world suddenly becomes reality.

As the only person aware of what lies ahead, Dokja realizes that he must utilize his omniscience to navigate the deadly scenarios and stay alive. Dokja was never meant to play a main part, but in defiance of those who wish to spell his fate, he might just have to take the lead in writing his own conclusion.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kokou Kemono to Obaka Yankee
synopsis:
One morning, high schooler Inoda Nagi saves a kitten beastman from being bullied at the park, even though he loses the fight. Later, Mikejima Mao transfers into Nagi’s school, and he turns out to be the older brother of the kid Nagi saved. But instead of being grateful, Mikejima makes enemies of Nagi and everyone else in the class. Will these two ever stop fighting?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Included one-shot: Kokou Kemono to Obaka Yankee: Dachi-hen

title: Omiai Shitakunakatta node, Murinandai na Jouken wo Tsuketara Doukyuusei ga Kita Ken ni Tsuite
synopsis:
One day, Yuzuru Takasegawa—a first-year high school student—is urged by his grandfather to go to an arranged marriage meeting, insisting that he wants to see his great-grandson before he dies.

However, not wanting to bear the weight of a fiancée at the tender age of a freshman in high school, Yuzuru tries to avoid the arranged marriage meeting by imposing an irrational condition. "If she is blonde-haired, blue-eyed, fair-skinned, etc, only then I will think about the marriage."

But somehow, he finds the girl who meets the conditions that Yuzuru has put out, and he reluctantly ends up going to matchmaking only once. And on the day of matchmaking, Arisa Yukishiro, a beautiful girl with reputation at school, shows up on the scene. Upon hearing her story, it seems she was also reluctantly made to go on matchmaking. Therefore, the two of them try to prevent themselves from further marriage proposals with their false "engagement." And so, as they play the role of fake lovers, they find themselves in love with each other and become real lovers.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Soredemo Kimi wo Shiawase ni Shitai
titleEnglish: Still, I Want to Make You Happy
synopsis:
Kouya is reunited with Manaki, a girl he used to play with when they were little, for the first time in nine years. Even though they've lived far apart, Kouya's feelings for her have been growing through their social media exchanges, and he decided to take the opportunity of their reunion to reveal his feelings to her! But she has a secret...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival @comic
titleEnglish: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
synopsis:
Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she's determined to carve her own path.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Henyoku no Drops
synopsis:
The year is 3015, the ocean covers 90% of the planet, and it is normal for humans to fly in the sky. People who cannot fly are called "Drops" (the old generation), and Tsubasa is one of them. She lives in a world where there are almost no stairs or ladders, even though the buildings and space between floors is getting higher and farther.

On her first day of the high school she chose (because it had stairs), Tsubasa Fukami jumps off a landing to see if she can fly, and collides with Ren Takatsuki who was also using the stairs...

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

titleEnglish: Otherworldly Maidens: Monster Girls from Another World
synopsis:
1. Itoshi no Orc-sama♥ (My Beloved Mr Orc ♥ )
2. Boukensha no Koiji wa Kemonomichi (The Adventure's Path to Love is an Animal Trail)
3. Akuma no Hanayome Shugyou (The Demon's Bridal Training)

7. Isekai Renai (Love in Another World) 
8. Hebi na Otome wa Juusha wo Nomu After

title: Ore no Kanojo ga Mangaka ni Naru
synopsis:
The main character, Mizuno-kun, knows a lot about manga. As his classmate and aspiring mangaka Kanzaki-san asks him for romantic comedy advice, he gradually gets more and more interested in her...!? A love comedy that is 100% pure and precious starts here!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Sakura wa Watashi wo Sukisugiru
synopsis:
Sawa just got out of a relationship with her cheating boyfriend, and is on the lookout for an honest guy. But when her classmate Sakura confesses, she rejects him, as he's not her type. But then he confesses again, and again, and again?! What's a girl to do in the face of such honest dedication?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Undead Pappy
synopsis:
The vampire population once flourished the country, but they ended up in persecution due to the human uprising. Mikhail is the last surviving vampire, who is eccentric and loves humans. He had been living an eternity in solitude, until he came across a dying child soldier, Johann, and decided to raise him as his own son. For 16 years, Mikhail and Johann traveled the world together and now Johann is all grown up! Mikhail wants to marry him off, but Johann has a mind of his own...

(Source: BL Tsundoku Scans, edited)

title: Matenai Inu no Shitsukekata
titleEnglish: How to Train an Impatient Dog
synopsis:
1-2. Matenai Inu no Shitsukekata (How to Train an Impatient Dog)
3. Fukurami ni Yuragu (Trembling in Your Softness)
4. Sekai no Owari mo Warukunai (The End of the World's Not So Bad)
5. 50-sai, Saisho no Koi no Hajimekata. (How to Start Your First Love at 50)
6. Untitled

title: Kamisama Gakkou no Ochikobore
synopsis:
Modern life means modern solutions—even to supernatural problems. So of course the government would have a classification system, special schools, and licenses for people with mysterious powers. Any manifestation of a miracle is enough to be called a Himiko, but only those with full certification may use the title of god. And high schooler Nagi is in serious need of a god! The death of her grandmother has left her family shrine devoid of the necessary divinity, and her hopelessly shut-in Himiko brother isn't looking promising. But if Nagi isn't careful, her search for a god might end with her finding more than she bargained for...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yoarashi ni Warau
synopsis:
A timid idealistic teacher is bullied by her class. The only happiness left are the lies she keeps writing to an absent student. Once this student returns, the time of cruel revenge has begun.

(Source: MU)

title: Inran Joushi no Private Porno
synopsis:
Sakai is an office worker who has arranged to meet his favorite male "pet" he found on a dating app. He's looking forward to the night with the sexy guy who keeps showing off his risque underwear and anal plugs, but today's the one day that he's stuck working late...! While he's having a smoke to get away from his boss, Yashima, who's giving him a hard time, he gets an extra sexy selfie from his pet! He's so turned on that he runs to the restroom, where he finds Yashima in an indecent state...!?

An erotic love story between two sexually insatiable men: a dominant subordinate who wants to get laid, and a filthy, depraved boss!

(Source: Funguild/Mobile Media Research)

title: Bitter Cigar
synopsis:
Go to work, go home. Go to work, go home. That's the daily routine of 26-year-old Wataru Toyohashi. One night, he heard a terrible groan coming from next door, so he rushed over, only to find his neighbor, Takatsuki, on the verge of tears and slumped on the floor. The reason? Hunger. Takatsuki said he forgets to eat when he gets caught up in his work, which he does from home. Toyohashi, unable to ignore the situation, decided to treat Takatsuki to dinner since he was in the middle of cooking anyway. Overjoyed by the simple home-cooked meal, Takatsuki exclaimed, "I want to eat this every day!" And that's how their weekly weekend dinner parties started. At the small dining table with Takatsuki and his own two cats, Toyohashi's days change bit by bit...

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Yoichi to Tsugumo
synopsis:
In the protected forest of the guardian deity, Yoichi the tanuki, arises a new guardian deity, Tsugumo. After dying as a fox cub, he was reborn for the sake of becoming a god and is still yet at a very tender age. While he is taught about the laws of life and the usage of divine forces, he innocently takes to Yoichi. "I love you, Yoichi. I want to be by your side forever and ever." To Yoichi who has continued protecting the forest heftily in solitude, Tsugumo revives his long ceased feelings back, however...

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title: Natsu no Teppen ni Saku
synopsis:
"If only I could be Yousuke's boyfriend."

I've known Yousuke since I was young, he's my best friend and we've always been together. Every summer, Yousuke and our group of friends would hit the beach, watch fireworks, go to festivals... That's how I thought we'd be spending our days this summer, until that one day when Yousuke got a girlfriend.

Seeing Yousuke's girlfriend by his side made my chest ache. Seeing Yousuke fully devoting himself to his part-time job just to go on a date with his girlfriend bothered me. It didn't take long before I realised that this was the very definition of "jealousy." My feelings for Yousuke grew with each passing day, until one day, my feelings overflowed...

(Source: Comic Shuppan, translated)

title: My Gently Raised Beast
synopsis:
Blondina's greatest desire is to escape the hellish life she has been enduring since her mother's death. In order to avoid being sold off to a sadistic nobleman, Blondina must trade her mother's memento—a sparkling ring that belonged to her father she never met—to earn some money. Unexpectedly, her plan leads to her estranged father, the emperor of Ates; discovering her existence, he formally names her a princess.

However, Blondina's new life is not all roses. Between being forced to hide her humble origins and tolerating the disparaging behavior of her half-siblings, Blondina feels as lonely as she was before. When she meets an injured talking kitten, she is happy to finally have found someone to befriend. However, the animal is no ordinary creature; his real identity is Amon Akin—the most powerful member of the Great Divine Leopard clan.

With the peace treaty between humans and leopards hanging by a thread, will their blossoming relationship change things for the better—or for the worse?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Soulless Duchess
synopsis:
The naïve Yvona is ready to do anything for her amazing fiancé! Summon magical beasts and let him take the glory? Sure! Wreck her body for a powerful spell and die for him? Yes! Watch him secretly embrace her trusted cousin Tristan with passion and deride her openly? Oka— wait. What? Just then, Yvona dies... and wakes up a year in the past with a burdened heart. Armed with her knowledge, Yvona's ready to fight for herself. And hmm, maybe form an alliance with the coldhearted Duke of Azentine...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei: Hoshiwatashi-hen
synopsis:
In the first year of Reiwa, Keitarou Maebara moves from Tokyo to Hinamizawa. He is excited about his new life in Hinamizawa as he gets to know the children of the former club members. Then one day, he meets a mysterious girl named Inori, and another girl who calls herself Kururu contacts Keitarou... Oyashiro-sama's curse transcends time and generations, and will happen again in the world of Reiwa...?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei: Oniokoshi-hen
synopsis:
As the era changes from Showa, to Heisei, and now Reiwa, the curtain rises once again on a tragedy for the steadily declining population of Hinamizawa. This year, again, one will die and one will go missing on the night of the Watanagashi festival...

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Uchi no Futeki na Gangster
synopsis:
Ranko Hanazame, the daughter of a yakuza, yearns for "normal love." However, she is always getting disturbed by Sumikawa, a young leader of their gang. Sumikawa is said to be the most vicious person in the underworld, and just looking at him makes others run away screaming! And yet… Why does he always stick so close?! If she ever fell in love with him… Ranko would have to say goodbye to her dream of a normal romance! A heroine that tries hard not to fall in love with the wrong person, and the gangster that loves to tease her begins here!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Obey Me! The Comic
synopsis:
Diavolo, the prince of the Devildom, harbors an unlikely dream—he wants angels, demons, and humans to live in harmony. For a start, he would like to see members of all three races learning alongside each other at the Royal Academy of Diavolo and practicing coexistence. However, the human he meant to summon to take part in the exchange program unexpectedly materializes as a fluffy pink sheep with no memories!

Christened "Ibuki" by the seven demon brothers who are tasked with taking care of them, this poor little lost lamb must carefully navigate the turbulent relationships of the ultimate dysfunctional family. While they should merely hope to survive until they regain their original appearance and identity, perhaps Ibuki might find a space to belong that suits them just as they are now.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mahoroba Eden
synopsis:
When Master spoke about his former disciple Ittetsu, he always praised his great talent. But when Yamato comes to Ittetsu's village to bring him back to the Tenroku Monastery, he's met with a monk who sleeps in, doesn't read Sutra, can't keep quiet during Zazen, and... drinks ALCOHOL?! Just what kind of trick has been played on Yamato?! Where is the talented Buddhist monk Master speaks so highly of, and who is this fake Ittetsu in front of him? That's it. Yamato has had enough and decides he must whip Ittestu into shape during their journey together. Maybe he used to be a great monk, but surely he has since been corrupted by wickedness! Will Yamato be able to tame the carefree monk? Just what about him makes Master think he is so great?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shot: Awairo Emaki: Tokubetsu Yomikiri

4. Futagomori
5. Suteneko Kanojo

title: Kamidanomi Konkatsu
synopsis:
Natsuki has struck out at speed dating a bunch of times and doesn't know what to do to improve her luck with men. Then, one day, as she's walking home drunk, Natsuki visits a shrine she used to play at as a kid and prays to the spirit there for a boyfriend... When she does, a hot and wild-looking guy in a kimono suddenly appears before her and unexpectedly says, "I'll be your boyfriend if you'll have me!" Since she's drunk and the guy's also her type, Natsuki doesn't hesitate to accept his offer... but then they're suddenly in her bed at home and he starts taking her clothes off!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Saikyou Onmyouji no Isekai Tenseiki: Geboku no Youkai-domo ni Kurabete Monster ga Yowasugirun da ga
titleEnglish: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World: Monsters Can't Match my Youkai!
synopsis:
Betrayed by his allies and on the verge of death, the strongest exorcist, Haruyoshi Kuga, desired only one thing—to be happy in his next life. Using the secret art of reincarnation, he was transported to another world. Reborn as Seika Lamprogue, third son of a distinguished family of magic scholars, he's found to have no magical power whatsoever, which is an unacceptable shame in a family of mages. However, he soon comes to realize that his new world's magic is nothing compared to the sorcery he mastered as an exorcist. With his control over divination, curses, and legions of youkai who serve him, his life in this new world should be a breeze! The only question is: how can he make use of those powers while laying low to avoid another untimely demise?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Shunrai to Mitsu
synopsis:
Yuen was abandoned by his parents and taken to an orphanage. His only support was Yan, who was like an older brother. Yan also cherished Yuen like his younger brother, but one night, a cruel incident that separates them occurs. A few years later Yan, who became a yakuza and lived as Aoyagi, visited the facility again. However, Yuen, whom he reunited with, is different from the boy in his memory. He was a bewitching young man filled with allure...

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Itadakimasu, Ookami-san.
synopsis:
In a world where beastkin evolved from different species of animals and now coexist, Natsuki, who stands out even among the dominant wolves, is traumatized by a heat he experienced to the point that he can never tell anyone about it. One day, while showing Hakuto, an inferior rabbit transfer student around school he was suddenly taken to an empty classroom. Natsuki tried to escape as Hakuto whispered, "I missed your pheromones..." Then suddenly Natsuki went into heat...?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Naka made Aishite
titleEnglish: I Want You to Love Me to the Inside.
synopsis:
Yuzuriha has a feminine face that can beat most girls' and he is fed up with people who only care about the other person's looks. Sitting next to him in class is Tokiwa, the very personification of the type of person he hates. One night, Yuzuriha was about to enter a hotel with a man he had met on a dating app but unfortunately for him, he was seen by Tokiwa. To make things worse, Tokiwa thought that Yuzuriha is used to doing it with men so, he went crazy inside Yuzuriha when actually it was his first time!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Sexual Exploits
synopsis:
Ever dreamed about your friend's wife? How about a charming masseur, or a MILF who's hired you as a tutor? In Sexual Exploits, an array of characters share their juiciest sexual experiences. Toeing the line between reality and fantasy, these stories will pull you in real, real close...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Kimi no Sekai ni Koi wa Nai
synopsis:
Chika Hanai cannot fathom the concept of romance. During high school, she was uncomfortable with being touched by her former boyfriend, and things did not work out with the next guy her friends introduced her to, either. Clueless about the social cues around dating, she feels alienated from the rest of the world, wondering if something is wrong with her.

In hopes of figuring herself out, Chika enrolls in a college in Tokyo where a psychology professor she greatly admires teaches. By pure chance, Chika meets the professor, Shinobu Ishii, who—instead of advising her how to be "normal"—gives Chika the words she needed the most: she does not have to fall in love. Meeting peers who also feel differently about affection and receiving Professor Ishii's advice, Chika comes to understand that she is not alone in this confusing world and that love might not be the answer to everything.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Romantic Lament
synopsis:
In a world where people can be alphas, betas, or omegas, Asahi doesn't want to be with an alpha. But one drunken night, he stumbles into a one-night stand with an alpha who looks just like his ex. Of course, Asahi runs off the morning after—but what can he do when familiar-faced Akiomi asks him to be his pretend boyfriend?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Tonari no Kuuderella wo Amayakashitara, Uchi no Aikagi wo Watasu Koto ni Natta
titleEnglish: I Spoiled "Quderella" Next Door and I'm Going to Give Her a Key to My House
synopsis:
Katagiri Natsuomi, a high school student living alone for two years, has a beautiful black-haired, blue-eyed girl move into the next room. The girl, Yui, seems to be a real noblewoman, and her nickname is "Kuudere-lla" because of her indifferent reaction at school. When Natsuomi finds out that Yui doesn't want to rely on others, but is actually quite naive, he decides to help her out.

"Tonight's dinner is... chicken karaage?"

"Chicken was cheap."

"I love your fried chicken, so I'm really looking forward to it."

This is the beginning of a sweet and tantalizing relationship between two neighbors.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Aioi Focus
synopsis:
Arima, a two-faced honor student, was asked by a teacher to help Mizutani, a delinquent student with poor grades study. However, Mizutani seems disinterested in school, which only agitates Arima. Finally, in a fit of anger Arima reveals his true self. A love story that begins after school hours!

(Source: Shishokan, translated)

title: Kyou mo E ni Kaita Mochi ga Umai @comic
synopsis:
Apparently, in this world, what I draw in my drawings materializes.

If that's the case, I will live an enjoyable slow life in another world. Why don't I just draw as many pictures as I want and have fun?

This is a story about a high school boy who just wants to draw pictures in a different world, but because of that, he is mistaken for a spirit. Then an extinct dragon reappears, and a fortified city deep in the forest appears.

At any rate, the mochi in my drawings are delicious today.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Gotsugou Simulation
synopsis:
Riku Chitose has a boyfriend. Yaichi Kaga. He is comfortable in social situations and having girls around him dress him up and play with his hair. But Riku knows a side of Yaichi that nobody else has seen: his cool side. Coincidentally, Yaichi Kaga has a boyfriend, too. Riku Chitose. He is always so cool and composed. But Yaichi knows a side of Riku that nobody else has seen: his adorable side. Yaichi and Riku go on dates, hug, and kiss. Yaichi and Riku are merrily in love with their boyfriends. Who knows, maybe one day they'll finally be able to talk to each other.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Boku wa Kimi dake no Mono
synopsis:
Ryouhei and Yuuma finally got together and it's been half a year since they've started dating. Yuuma has made a new friend, and seems to have gotten close with him. Ryouhei has become jealous of this. He can't help but think that Yuuma, who tries his best to convey his unwavering feelings with his whole body, is cute. Ryouhei, who should have been a playboy, finally comes to the realization that he can't let go of Yuuma anymore.

(Source: BL Tsundoku Scans)

title: Hatsukoi Note
synopsis:
Shouya, a teenager with no knowledge of love, accidentally stumbles upon the blog of a gay teen while browsing the web. But surprise surprise, he discovers that the author of that blog is a loner in his class called Tsubame Sanjou! It's a story of first crushes with a puppy-like guy and a delinquent.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Kinyoubi no Baby Violet
synopsis:
Ms. Sumire Mizuno, an efficient office worker has a secret hobby... She wears cute and very erotic lingerie and posts sexy selfies on social media! To relieve the stress of everyday work, she does it on her secret account. But one day, Murasaki, a designer of the company's supplier has identified her by chance. In exchange for keeping it a secret, he makes an unexpectedly serious proposal. He wants Sumire to model the lingerie he designs so he can get feedback and test the texture and functionality of the product in real situations. Puzzled as she has imagined much worse, but mixed with such shame and confusion, she spontaneously asks him to "Have sex with me"!!!

(Source: Takeshobo)

title: Ookisugite Gomennasai!
titleEnglish: Sorry If I'm Too Big For You!
synopsis:
Yuta Sato is a good Samaritan college student who offers a helping hand to Sei Tsutsui. He's stunned when Sei suddenly asks him to marry him. At first, Yuta thinks he's kidding, but the handsome quarter-Russian persists until Yuta gives in and starts dating him. After that, everything seems fine-until they decide to deepen their relationship, and Yuta realizes just how big Sei really is.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Sonna Kao Shitemo Kiss wa Dame
synopsis:
"I got a perfect boyfriend that looks like my favorite character!" Tanaka is a college student and an otaku. Suzuki is a guy who's got it all, and is Tanaka's classmate. One day, Suzuki steals Tanaka's first kiss and asks him out. While Tanaka has always secretly admired Suzuki, the pressure from the sudden confession puts him in a panic, and he turns down Suzuki. But Suzuki continues to steal kisses, and it gets Tanaka flustered every time. Tanaka tries to run away from the kisses, but then Suzuki tells him he'll stop trying to kiss him if he starts dating him?!

(Source: Frontier Works)

title: Dull & Sweet
synopsis:
Naoto Sewa works at a marketing company during the day and at a gay bar at night. During a gay matching party at the bar, Nibu Kazuma, who's straight, mistakes it for a marriage matching party... Sewa saves Nibu from some unwanted attention and sends the man on his way. However, unexpectedly the next day, they meet again at the marketing company where they turn out to be colleagues. While spending time together as colleagues, Sewa can't help but be attracted to Nibu's kindness and sincerity. But Sewa swore that he would never fall in love with a straight man again!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Ako to Bambi
synopsis:
Horror writer Yuu "Bambi" Kojika has just moved into a new apartment. While the apartment is comfortable, conveniently located, and affordable on his terrible salary, there is a catch: the previous tenant committed suicide in the unit. Despite being a horror writer—or perhaps because of that—Bambi never believed in the supernatural and is completely unfazed by this revelation.

Following the cancellation of his serialization, Bambi's editor suggests that Bambi try writing a supernatural story based on his own experiences for a change. The only issue with this request is that Bambi has never had any other-worldly encounters before. However, just as he begins to lose hope, he notices the elusive spirit of a high school-aged girl appearing in his apartment at night.

The spirit known as Ako is more than willing to give her story to Bambi to write about. At the same time, local high school student Ako Yamashiro has been dreaming about an apartment inhabited by a man who looks awfully similar to the struggling writer. As Bambi delves deeper into Ako's story, the two phenomena may be more closely related than either of them realize.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shitsukete Tokashite Abaite Medete
titleEnglish: Discipline, Melt, Disclose and Love Me, Please.
synopsis:
"Senpai, I'll dominate you to the marrow of your bones."

Sumio Tachibana, an orthopedic surgeon (a resident), has spent his days as a Sub controlling his desires to be dominated and controlled. However, he doesn't have a designated Dom, and remaining in this state will damage him both mentally and physically. Because of this, Sumio decides to visit a Sub-only club... There he meets his old high school kouhai, now a yakuza, Itsumi Wanizuka (Dom). Since he doesn't have a designated Dom, Itsumi urges, "Let me become senpai's dom." A trying story of a jealous young yakuza and a surgeon who really just wants to be spoiled?!

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: Majo to Kishi wa Ikinokoru
titleEnglish: The Witch and the Knight Will Survive
synopsis:
Agredios, the son of a local landowner, arrives home from a long hunt...only to find his village silent and devoid of its usual laughter and commotion. What he discovers is an unimaginable agony that sparks a desire to avenge his fallen people by slaying the witch of the forbidden woods. But is the witch truly as vile as rumors say? A new quest begins: to discover the truth, save lives, and survive.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shirouto nanoni Hameraremashita
synopsis:
Due to certain circumstances, office worker Hajime ends up working part-time on an adult film set. After making a mistake that ruins the film, he gets put into debt! He's saved from this predicament by the number one actor Yuu, who suggests that he pay back his debt by appearing in a gay adult film. With no other choice, Hajime accepts the conditions, and takes a test in order to appear in an adult film! Even though it's Hajime's first time, Yuu uses his pro techniques to fuck him silly, and even cums inside him.

"This is only the beginning, you know?"

The lovey-dovey, super sadistic sex lessons continue...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Yankee Ω wa Juuou-sama no Mono!
titleEnglish: Delinquent Omega Belongs to the Beast King!
synopsis:
"I can't believe I wanna be messed up even more... This can't be my body!!" In an unexpected turn of events, a delinquent named Rintarou is transported to another world. Then, all of a sudden, his body starts burning up inside...!? Rintarou is bewildered when Varuna, a beastman with piercing eyes, appears before him. "I'm going to help your body relax." The hands stroking his burning skin are gentle, but the kiss that entwines their tongues is so tantalizing that there's no way he can resist...!! The Alpha beast king who's in love and the stupid yet straightforward delinquent Omega, the king's adoration doesn't stop! An Omegaverse BL story about being reborn in a different world.

(Source: Funguild/Mobile Media Research)

title: Oyaku ni Tatsu node Chi wo Kudasai
titleEnglish: Please Give Me Your Blood, I Will Serve You in Gratitude.
synopsis:
A young man picked up a vampire girl who collapsed in the street. Although she tries to serve him wholeheartedly to repay him for his blood, she is too clumsy to succeed. A warm slife-of-life interspecies vampire comedy where nobody is left behind or abandoned!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Futari Switch
synopsis:
Shinichi and Ichigo are childhood friends in their first year of high school. Both have someone that they're interested in but can't seem to find a way to get closer to that special person. However, everything changes one summer day, when the power of...a (magical?!) bitter melon switches their bodies!! The two aren't complaining, though, because this is their chance to get closer to their crushes. Just how will the wacky duo manage to do so?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Nurarihyon no Hanayome
synopsis:
Nurarihyon no Hanayome is a Japanese-style fantasy romance featuring Tsukiyo, a lonely girl who works in the red-light district. She has a burn scar on her face which she covers with a mask. Holding dear the memories of her late mother, she has soldiered on, facing each day after another.

One day, a mysterious man suddenly chooses Tsukiyo. He is a youkai king named Oboro, who says he is looking for a stone to become a complete youkai. Oboro seems to think that Tsukiyo may have the stone...

"Be my wife and stay by my side."

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Moto Juui no Reijou wa Konyaku Haki saremashita ga, Mofumofu-tachi ni Daininki desu!
titleEnglish: Former Vet Lady Has Had Her Engagement Called Off, but Is Very Popular with the Fluffies!
synopsis:
Shiori, a former veterinarian, died in a car accident and reincarnated as a duke's daughter named Luna. She discovers that unknown creatures from her former world exist in the place where she was reincarnated, and happily lives her life in the hope of meeting them. But one day, her engagement was called off! Even though she was banished from her country, the prospect of embarking on a journey to meet new fluffies made her heart race! Wait for me, my lovely fluffies! Luna's affection for the fluffies is uncontrollable! This is a heartwarming fantasy about Luna and her adorable fluffy companions!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Ore no Koibito no Hanbun wa Junjou de Dekiteiru
titleEnglish: Half of My Lover is Made of Purity of Heart.
synopsis:
This is the story of the relationship between college students, Yoshiyuki who is living with his tsundere Lover, Yuzu. Yoshiyuki wants to take it a step further with Yuzu, but due to Yuzu's naive personality, one simple kiss makes him look like a boiled octopus. With dreams of days filled with naughty things, Yuzu makes a "certain promise" with Yoshiyuki during their first month of dating.

(Source: Solmare Henshuubu, translated)

title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival
titleEnglish: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
synopsis:
Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she's determined to carve her own path.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Fake Fact Lips
synopsis:
Ryou and Zen are two men who hate to lose—especially to each other. From high school rivals to rival co-workers, these two men have always been locked in fierce competition. They've competed over grades, sports, and even the number of Valentine's chocolates received! And now that they're salesmen at the same company, their rivalry has reignited. One night, while out for drinks, the two begin arguing about who's more experienced in love. Suddenly, their newest competition is set: the winner is whoever makes the other fall in love with them first! But will this competition of hearts really lead to a win or something far more complicated?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Melon no Aji
synopsis:
Nakajou works at a live music club, and Kiuchi is a regular. They came to live together out of nowhere. Kiuchi had just broken up with his girlfriend and was looking for a place to crash. He says that he wants to sleep together because he can't sleep without someone else's warmth. Nakajou was going to reveal he was gay and tell him no, but he just can't say it...

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Hatsukoi no Kaeru Shima
synopsis:
Tatsunoshin, an aspiring cook, and Nanami, a diver, are close childhood friends who, before they knew what happened, were even masturbating together. For the sake of changing how he's always doting on Nanami, Tatsunoshin decides to leave the island. But Nanami won't give him up, saying "Leaving the island won't change that I'm the most important person to you."

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Omega no Mukotori
synopsis:
Yoshiharu, an high-ranking Omega yakuza, is ordered by the head of the group to have a marriage interview with an Alpha from another group. But the Alpha, losing his patience with the wild Yoshiharu, forces him into heat with drugs. He's saved by his attendant Makoto, who he finds out is his fated partner.  Yoshiharu is relieved that he's fated to the man who he trusts, but Makoto refuses to pair up with him?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nibi to Kuroba
synopsis:
One day, Nibi, who runs a detective business, ends up interrupting Kuro, a rent boy, at the location where he's on watch. Because of Nibi, Kuro's customer ran away, so he starts clinging to Nibi instead, complaining loudly and causing Nibi to carelessly injure himself.
