Having one misfortune after another, he was close to giving up on this commission, but Kuro's quick decision saved the day. When he thought it all apparently was settled, Kuro, who seemed to have special circumstances, asked to stay at his house... Under the same roof, Nibi starts living with a rent boy of unknown identity.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kimetsu no Yaiba Koushiki Fanbook: Kisatsutai Kenbunroku
titleEnglish: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Corps Records
synopsis:
Volume 1
1. Chuukou Ikkan!! Kimetsu Gakuen Monogatari (Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story)

Volume 2
1. Jigoku no Oni Shuzai: Sanzu no Kawa wo Koete (Interview with the Demons in Hell: Crossing the River to the Underworld)
2. Rengoku Zero-wa (Rengoku Chapter 0)
3. Tanjirou no Kinkyou Houkokusho (An Update from Tanjiro)
4. Micchaku! "Kimetsu Gakuen" ni Kayou Tanjirou no 1-nichi (New-Year Bonus Manga)
5. Kimetsu no Dodai (Kimetsu: Behind the Scenes)

title: Koi ga Michitara
synopsis:
From a chance encounter due to fallen underwear, Ise and Hishimoto are now dating. Since moving in together, both work and private lives are being lived to the fullest. However, Hishimoto starts to get busy at work, and opportunities to spend leisure time with his lover gradually start to disappear...! From the wildly popular Koi ga Ochitara comes the long-awaited sequel!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Perfect Pink Lover
synopsis:
Narumi, a university student, starts a part-time job as a callout escort with intercourse as an option in order to meet someone who has his ideal nipples. One evening, he is sent to a client who happens to have his dream nipples... the color, the shape... everything is perfect. However, the customer Reiji, an office worker, is dead drunk. Narumi leaves the place without doing anything, but he finds it impossible to forget about Reiji's nipples. He ends up visiting him again, and eventually they spend the night together. The more Narumi knows about Reiji, the more he wants to have closer relationship with him, not as an escort and his client. However Reiji isn't willing to go deeper, and he has a reason not to...

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Yamada to Kase-san.
synopsis:
Yamada is in heaven at her school's horticulture department, and Kase-san is training hard at the sports university. With classes and a long train ride to keep them apart, hanging out together is tough. Can they beat their busy schedules and find time for one another?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: After God
synopsis:
Desperate for answers about her friend's disappearance, Waka breaches the Tokyo danger zone in search of clues. Instead, she finds Tokinaga, a researcher with the Anti-God Scientific Research Institute. While Waka tries to decide if she should trust Tokinaga, he quickly realizes Waka is hiding a dangerous secret of her own—one that may just be the key to killing off the gods once and for all.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Kemono wa Oku made Nakasaretai
synopsis:
Azuki, a rare kitty half-beast, is sold off at an auction. He's taken to a land far far away and finds that the only reason is to be eaten?! Azuki bolts and as he plans his escape, he bumps into the castle owner Kirito. The only way to survive now is to have sex with Kirito, but Kirito declares that he will never hold a rare species... As the days pass, Azuki starts to feel a tingling in his heart for the gentle Kirito. "What are these feelings?" Why won't Kirito touch him?

(Source: BL Tsundoku Scans)

title: Arima-san wa Omega ni Naritai
synopsis:
Arima Nijou is an Alpha who works at a first-class company who is only able to love other Alphas. At night, he pretends to be an omega and works as a call boy for Alphas. He wants to be an omega at least for a moment. One day, when he has no outlet for his sexual desire after a client suddenly cancels, he meets Mitsuki Izumi, an Alpha whose just his type. Izumi, a famous student entrepreneur, was arrogant, but his words struck a chord, and he was good at sex. It was a one night stand, but he was the ideal Alpha Arima was always searching for. Three years later, Arima goes to see Izumi with their child that he gave birth to?! Arima, who had an abnormal condition, presses Izumi to take responsibility, but it's not so straightforward.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Kawaii kara Giri Yuruseru
titleEnglish: I'm Cute Enough to Get Away with It!
synopsis:
16-year-old shut-in Yoruhiko's twin sister, Akane, ends up in a coma after getting into an accident. Not wanting to ruin her perfect attendance, Yoruhiko decides to continue her record by going to school in her place. But, in order to do so, he must disguise himself as her and attend an all-girls boarding school! How will former recluse Yoruhiko keep up his act when surrounded by his sister's friends and roommate?

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Kimi no Ashimoto de Ai wo Shiru
titleEnglish: Learning to Love at Your Feet
synopsis:
In this world, in addition to being male or female, people are divided into two "dynamics": those who yearn to control and those who yearn to be controlled. Kippei's a regular office worker who's always hated being the latter. But, suppressing his desire has stressed him out to the point of making him sick. Finally, he goes to the doctor, who tells him the last thing he wants to hear: he needs to find a partner and get some release! Kippei signs up for a matchmaking program, only to get paired with a guy who happens to be his hot coworker Sota Otomo.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kimi no Yoru ni Fureru
synopsis:
Chinatsu and his older brother, Fuyuki, have been trained by their father to become professional assassins for their whole lives. However, Fuyuki is slain as a result of Chinatsu failing at his first job. Chinatsu is discovered by a blind boy who lends him a shoulder to cry on.

The trauma still haunts Chinatsu five years later, and he is unable to kill any of his targets as a result. While waiting around the streets, he recovers a stolen object owned by Kasumi, the blind boy he had met back then. As a token of gratitude, Kasumi invites the assassin to his home that is located in a traditional Japanese inn. Chinatsu learns that the boy sees himself as a burden to his family due to his disability.

Despite being complete strangers, Kasumi feels a connection with Chinatsu and asks him to be his friend, to which the assassin readily agrees. But Chinatsu discovers more from being around Kasumi's kindhearted nature, and he realizes he may have found a way through the darkness of his life: a light worth protecting amidst the abyss.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Pink to Habanero
synopsis:
She wants a boyfriend—anyone but him. He wants girls to buzz off. Sucks for them 'cos he's paid to please princesses! High school freshman Mugi can barely muster the confidence to talk to a boy, much less to take one on a date. Plus, the first time she meets Kei Kurose, the wrong sort of sparks fly—even if Kei is head-turningly hot, who could put up with the way he treats girls like trash? Mugi has no patience for his rude attitude, but when she just so happens to discover the scandalous secret of his part-time job, she might have to learn to keep his trust!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tonari no Stella
titleEnglish: Gazing at the Star Next Door
synopsis:
Chiaki is a pretty normal teenage girl. Since they were kids, she's had a thing for her best friend Subaru—who's fast becoming the hottest young actor in Japan! With Subaru threatening to slip away, Chiaki has a decision to make: Will she finally take her shot, or give Subaru up to his adoring public?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Tiger & Dragon: Osananajimi 3-nin no Otawamure Biyori
synopsis:
When Konomi was five years old, her best friend and neighbor Kagetora moved away. After ten years with no communication, Konomi decides it's time to finally move on from her childhood crush. Luckily, with her other childhood friend Tatsuomi waiting in the wings, it looks like romance is right around the corner. That is, until Kagetora suddenly reappears, and Konomi's love life is thrown into chaos!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Make Heroine wo Katasetai!!
synopsis:
In romcoms, the generic main character and the obvious tsundere heroine always end up together but what about loser heroine? This is the story of a losing heroine trying to break that very cliche!

(Source: MU)

title: Akane-banashi
synopsis:
Rakugo, a traditional form of storytelling, takes years for any apprentice to master and ascend to the top rank of shinuchi. Ever since she could remember, Akane Ousaki has been mesmerized by her father Tooru's rakugo performances. Peeking in behind a sliding door, she would spend hours watching and mimicking his work.

For Tooru, the only thing separating him from that coveted rank is a promotion test in front of an audience and a senior rakugo master, Issho Arakawa. Despite his passionate performance, Tooru finds himself expelled from the rakugo school following the exam. This makes him give up on rakugo entirely and settle for a regular job, breaking his daughter's heart.

Filled with grief and anger, Akane now seeks vengeance on the man who refuses to see the genius behind her father's rakugo style. She begs Tooru's former rakugo master, Shiguma Arakawa, to take her under his wing. But Shiguma feels unworthy of taking on another pupil after what happened to her father six years prior. In order to see if she has what it takes to enter the rakugo world, Shiguma urges Akane to test her resolve by performing in front of an audience.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isekai Arigatou
synopsis:
Chiba and Sheina, a pair of single, otaku males in their 30s that met during a highschool reunion! Shortly after hitting it off with each other, they're thrown into one misfortune after another, and before they know it... They got reincarnated in an Isekai as pretty babes!

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Houkago no Kuroi-san
synopsis:
Kuroi-san's always doing something all by herself after class. And even though she makes sure no one bothers her, one day, a certain person happens to find out what it is she's up to... and next thing he knows, he's declared her accomplice?!

(Source: MU)

title: Shikisaki Shimai wa Abakaretai
synopsis:
One day, Tarou Yamada, who runs a detective business, slips on a banana peel and is reincarnated as Tsukushi Shikisaki, who is the younger brother of three beautiful sisters and who died on the same day. He ends up spending his time surrounded by three beautiful sisters, but he realizes that Tsukushi Shikizaki was killed by one of his three sisters...?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: When the Day Comes
synopsis:
Norang and Paran are known at school to be the perfect couple—minus the fact that they've already broken up. But unable to back out of a promise to participate in their school's dance festival as their class's representative couple, they decide to keep their split a secret, just until the competition is over. As the day of the festival—and their "official" break-up—approaches, the two begin to realize that ending their relationship may not be as simple as they thought.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Te wo Nobashitara, Tsubasa
synopsis:
Chikara is a university student working hard on his research for his childhood dream, hoping to someday achieve flight. One night, he witnesses the secret on the back of Satomi, a transfer student with a perfect body and face. The two quickly grow closer, but there is a side to Satomi that Chikara does not know.

(Source: Denpa)

title: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time
titleEnglish: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time
synopsis:
The day 18-year-old Laliette Isabelle De Bellua died is forever etched in her mind. Her entire family already six feet under on false charges of treason, she is sent to the gallows with her sentence being handed down by the tyrannical Emperor Rupert Edgar Laspe Vellelum. In contrast to his ethereal beauty, he has bathed himself in blood; not even his wife was free from the carnage, falling victim to his hand on their wedding night.

After meeting her end, Laliette awakens in the past on her 12th birthday. Despite having knowledge of the grim future, the only way she can think of to save her beloved family is to endear herself to the bloodthirsty Rupert before his rise to power. There is only one problem: Rupert is currently living as a woman—the oft-forgotten "Princess Rapertte," whom no one wants to serve. With little in her pocket, Laliette runs away from home to pledge herself to Rapertte, hoping to one day earn the princess's trust and save the people she treasures.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: A DeadbEAT's Meal
synopsis:
What's better than a good meal? My name's Jaeho and I love food. While some may call me a deadbEAT because I don't have a job at the moment, I'm just your normal happy guy who loves eating and my girlfriend of 7 years... That is until I got a breakup text yesterday... Where did things go wrong? I keep trying to look back through the years, but I just can't figure it out...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ouchi ni Kaerou
synopsis:
Mei, who lives in Kyoto, is a big fan of Iori Tachibana, a very successful author who's also a university student! When she comes to Tokyo to work as a live-in housekeeper, she finds out that Iori is in reality... a man?! Furthermore, his language is bad and he has a cold demeanor... the exact opposite of the image of a person who writes gentle and heart-touching novels. The exciting life in a share house is about to begin...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Osananajimi ja Gaman Dekinai
titleEnglish: I Can't Stand Being Your Childhood Friend
synopsis:
Aoi and Ryouta have been friends for as long as they can remember, so when it comes time to head off to college, it only makes sense for them to room together! Practically joined at the hip, they are convinced that their relationship will stay the same forever...until one day, Aoi wakes up to find Ryouta leaning in to kiss him! Now Aoi must unpack this bewildering development, but he just can't seem to forget Ryouta's touch...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Minus Skill Mochi Yonin ga Atsumattara, nanka Synergy Hakki shite Saikyou Party ga Dekita Ken
titleEnglish: How Four Negative Skills = Unrivaled Synergy
synopsis:
Minus Skill. A negative debuff possessed by a select few since birth. A swordsman who has one such skill is once again in the throes of being thrown out of another party. Despite his abilities, that single skill had a huge downside, which would make him a burden to any would-be adventuring partners. 

Sick and tired of the never-ending cycle, he has taken it upon himself to challenge a dungeon that may possess an item that could remove a skill of his. There, he meets a girl with the Priestess class who also has a Minus Skill but...

"Eh? Aren't our skills synergistic? Negatives coming together to form a positive!"

This is the story of people exiled from parties, who possess Minus Skills, banding together to eventually become the strongest party.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Pian Pian
synopsis:
In the world of Pian Pian, people are born with the initials of their soulmates on their bodies. The location of these "imprints" is unique to the individual, but the meaning behind the letters is the same. Suha's happens to be located in a—ahem —very private location. The chances of actually uniting with one's soulmates is rather slim, but that hasn't stopped Suha. Not only does he believe he will find his soulmate, but he also refuses to date anyone until then. But lately, his handsome boss, Chef Calix, has had him feeling some feels "down there..." He thought he was alone in these feelings, but the chef has suddenly started showing interest in him. Could the tides be finally changing for innocent Suha?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Maou to Yuri
synopsis:
Princess knight, hero, priestess, witch, and maid. If you had to choose one to be your queen, who would it be?

The war between humans and demons has just ended, but the world is still frightened by the thought of more conflict. The only way to assure peace is for the Demon Lord (female) to take a human queen!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!?
titleEnglish: Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
synopsis:
Meet Takuya Seo, an otaku who sits behind the popular gals in class, Ijichi and Amane. Since they're people from different "castes," you wouldn't expect them to have much in common. But when their worlds collide over a borrowed eraser, Takuya slips up about his favorite anime, and Amane...is rather quick to correct him. She says she's not a fan, but her familiarity with the series suggests otherwise. Could she be...a fellow geek?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Dame Skill "Auto Mode" ga Kakusei shimashita: Are, Guild no Scout no Minasan, Ore wo "Iranai" tte Ittemasen deshita?
synopsis:
Young Claus has been gifted with a skill called Auto Mode. It is an extremely rare skill, and he was so pleased when first received it... Yet, the skill's abilities [Auto Return] for "only to go home" and [Auto Travel] for "only to go to places that have been visited" are completely useless abilities for both combat and making money! However... the now leveled-up Claus has come to know the true nature of Auto Mode! This is a turnabout story from the bottom!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hanasaku Bokura no Koiwazurai
synopsis:
In middle school, when Outa had to move schools, he told his best friend, Tomoaki, but all that Tomoaki had to say were the cold words, "It can't be helped." Outa was expecting him to say that he would miss him, and he was so shocked that he ended up moving schools without even saying goodbye. Time has passed since then, and Outa is now in college and determined to enjoy his student life on his own. One day, he ran into Tomoaki, whom he did not want to meet again. Outa found it awkward, and tried to put some distance between them, but Tomoaki kept talking to him for some reason!

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Gachiakuta
synopsis:
Living in the slums of a wealthy town, Rudo and his foster father Regto try to coexist with the rest of the town's residents, but Rudo despises the wastefulness of the upper class. Ignoring the warnings from those around him, Rudo regularly rummages through the town's garbage in search of anything useful or valuable to save from the "Abyss"—a massive hole where anything considered trash is dumped, including people. Rudo's biological father was one such person, having been thrown into the Abyss after he was accused of murder.

One day, after running into a mysterious figure on the way home, Rudo returns to find Regto's dying body on the floor. He is immediately found at the scene by the authorities and is charged with murder. No one believes his claims of innocence, and he is thrown into the Abyss. Instead of dying, however, he finds himself in a strange, foul-smelling place surrounded by monsters made out of trash.

When Rudo is attacked by said monsters, he is saved by a man named Enjin, who reveals himself to be a "Cleaner"—someone who uses special weapons called Vital Instruments to combat these creatures. In order to get his revenge on the one who killed Regto, Rudo reluctantl…

title: Aki wa Haru to Gohan wo Tabetai
titleEnglish: Let's Eat Together, Aki and Haru
synopsis:
Join Aki and Haru as they tackle one of the most perilous tasks two college roommates can face — feeding themselves! Easygoing Aki has mastered the art of affordable home-cooking to keep his good friend Haru upbeat and motivated throughout the school year. From homemade ramen to fried chicken to plum liqueur, each season offers a whole new menu! Chewing their way through life's ups and downs, the boys and their friends share in the simple joys of food and youth. Take a hearty bite out of this sweet and refreshing slice of life story!  

(Source: Tokyopop)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Otsukaresama desu Nakamura-san

title: [Rouhou] Ore no Iinazuke ni Natta Jimiko, Ie dewa Kawaii shika Nai.
titleEnglish: My Plain-looking Fiance Is Secretly Sweet with Me.
synopsis:
Despite only being in high school, I am being forced to get married due to my parents' circumstances. However, it turns out my partner is the voice actress of my favorite character! A cohabitation story with a voice actress! A new life of just the two of us, it can only be sweet and cute?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nigoru Hitomi de Nani wo Negau: Highserk Senki
synopsis:
Raizou Takakura, who died of a heart attack, was reborn in another world as the third son of a penurious farmer. He is known as Walm in his second life and he has been living as a soldier for the Highserk Empire, a small country currently being invaded by the surrounding large countries.

To survive, Walm was forced to spend his days killing people left and right. The Highserk empire decided to point their fangs toward their enemy and plotted a great invasion battle against the principality of Myard as well as the Ferrius Kingdom. This led to Walm being covered in blood and witnessing the dying breaths of comrades and enemies alike, as well as learning of the fine line between life and death.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ore to Joushi no Kakushigoto: Tsuzuki no Hanashi
titleEnglish: The Secret of Me and My Boss Sequel
synopsis:
It's been a month since Mikado, an idol otaku worked to the bone by the design company he's employed at, has started dating his superior Anezaki. Even though they've finally gotten consecutive days off, since it feels like they're sex friends as they've just been holed up having sex, he wants to go on a date like normal lovers! Anezaki seems dissatisfied, but then he and Mikado go on a hot springs trip together.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Jigoku no Sata mo Yokume Shidai
titleEnglish: Hell Is in the Eye of the Beholder
synopsis:
At the boys' dormitory at Hadoma High School, Yohei Goshi is a problem child and a constant source of headache for the teachers. Itsuki Ashiba, the new junior captain of the Judo team and dorm leader, is trusted by everyone at school. Yohei tries to break the rules, but Itsuki always outsmarts him and makes things difficult. When Yohei concocts a plan to get dirt on Itsuki to blackmail him into backing off, things don't go quite as planned. Instead, he finds him in an unexpected situation!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku
titleEnglish: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity
synopsis:
Despite being adjacent to one another, Chidori Public High School and the all-girls Kikyo Private Academy seem to exist in two different worlds. While the latter boasts an immaculate reputation and favors students from wealthy backgrounds, the former is a nest for dim-witted delinquents. Everyone at Kikyo harbors a deep hatred for their Chidori neighbors.

Sixteen-year-old Rintarou Tsumugi is a student at Chidori whose intimidating face leads people to avoid him. Rintarou pays no mind to this, as he is content with his group of friends. However, there is something he has not told them yet: sometimes, he helps out at his family's cake shop.

One day at work, Rintarou sees a customer at a table, but she runs off before he can talk to her. The next day, he receives an apology from the girl, Kaoruko Waguri, who explains that she did not run away because of his appearance and that she believes Rintarou is a kind-hearted person. Although he is not used to Kaoruko's bright personality, Rintarou looks forward to forming a friendship with her. There is just one obstacle that stands in his way: Kaoruko is a Kikyo student!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Amagami wo Kimi ni
synopsis:
In the present day where humans and werebeast are living in harmony, there is something that has been bothering Matsumoto, a Kishu weredog, who actually likes cats. It a about a male calico cat that kept appearing when he was feeding the cats near the school as part of his daily routine. And... there's also the fact that he finds Sasaki, a student from the same seminar, to be cute. One day, he found out that Sasaki is a werecat as well as that calico cat. And from then on, he can cuddle and pet Sasaki's cat form all he wants! But the more time they spend together, the more Matsumoto's feelings for Sasaki go in a direction other than friendship... This is a fluffy sweet werebeast love story between a quiet Kishu weredog who likes to take care of others and an honestly sweet werecat who start out as friends.

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Bad Girl
synopsis:
What does one do when you have a crush on the president of the public morals club? Well, if you're first-year high school student Yuu, the answer is turning to a life of delinquency! In a bid for the president's heart, Yuu becomes a self described "bad girl" hoping to thrill and excite her crush. But Yuu's adorableness (despite her best efforts) outshines any attempts to come off otherwise—and the president can't see past that tiny, adorable exterior. What's a girl got to do to get in trouble around here?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Boku no Barber e Youkoso
synopsis:
On the wedding day of the best friend he's always been in love with, Iga decided to go to a barber shop to get a long overdue hair cut. A story about a barber and a salaryman with no confidence.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Our Beloved Summer
synopsis:
Guk Yeonsu and Choi Wung are like oil and water—they simply do not mix. While Yeonsu's humble origins motivate her to tolerate no distractions from her studies, Wung was born with a silver spoon in his mouth and favors his peace of mind over any genuine effort. When they are paired up as subjects of a documentary that chronicles a month in the lives of two students—one at the top of the academic ranks and the other at the bottom—the filmmakers face challenges from the beginning. Wung embodies everything that Yeonsu loathes, and a middle ground seems unreachable. However, as they engage reluctantly for the cameras, they discover warm sides of one another that may bridge the bitter distance between them.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Zense de Koroshita Aite no Tantou Henshuu ni Narimashita
titleEnglish: I Became the Editor in Charge of the Person I Killed in the Previous Life
synopsis:
Miharuta Saionji has just been assigned as the new editor for the hot-selling novelist, Jin Shinonome. Shinonome is an author who's veiled in mystery and has never shown his face to the public. So, when Saionji went for their first meeting, he was shocked to find himself in his current life's greatest crisis!!

Was this reunion a fated one, or was it predestined?!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Kimi e Musubu Happy End
synopsis:
Miyano is a corporate drone whose both mind and body are now exhausted from being overworked by his black company. One day, Q, a beautiful and mysterious young man who claimed to be the Cupid, suddenly appeared in front of him. Apparently, Q has been observing and taking note of how hard Miyano has been working without even so much as a complaint. After explaining that he can make Miyano's love come true, he asks Miyano who is the person he'd like to have fall in love with him. To that, Miyano says, "I want to be in love with you." However, Q's true motive is to make sure that his future parents' love comes to fruition!

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: Otome Yankee wa Unmei no Hito wo Matsu.
synopsis:
Kijima, the school's most feared Yankee, has a secret. He believes in such things like "fortune-telling" and "fate"—that is to say, he has a maiden's heart. One day, Kijima met with his admired fortune-teller and was told that he would soon meet his destined partner. To his surprise, the one who appears before him is his classmate, Kousaka, who has always been friendly towards him. "It can't be! This guy is my destined partner?!" From then, he realized that for some reason, the time that they spend together kept increasing. Not only that, but Kousaka's advances on him are also getting more and more intense as the days go by.

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: The Red Thread
synopsis:
Pharm is a skittish but friendly young man who is excited to start his new life as a college student. He'll make friends, join a club... and maybe figure out why he's always sensed that there's a certain someone he's fated to meet. The moment he locks eyes with Dean, the captain of the swimming club, he's attracted to him in a way he's never experienced before. Is this who he's been looking for all this time? Does Dean feel the same way about him? Perhaps the answers lie in past lives they have yet to remember...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Akuyuu no Ore ga Ponkotsu Kishi wo Miterarenai nda ga, Dou Sewa wo Yakya Ii?: Madome Gaiden
titleEnglish: An Archdemon's (Friend's) Dilemma: How to Babysit a Crybaby Knight
synopsis:
Archdemon Zagan hires his unsavory friend, the sorcerer known as Purgatory Barbatos, to guard Archangel Chastille Lillqvist from the shadows. Barbatos takes to watching over the girl—which really means watching her constantly screw things up, trust people she shouldn’t, and inevitably bawl her eyes out. But something about Chastille and her waterworks may just have a special effect on the sourpuss sorcerer... The tale of this odd couple begins after the seventh volume of Maou no Ore ga Dorei Elf wo Yome ni Shitanda ga, Dou Medereba Ii?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Cutover Criteria
synopsis:
Recent graduate Jin has been assigned to help out his upperclassman Seto, a highly competent but somewhat standoffish systems engineer. Though Jin is good at his job, he does seem to have his head in the clouds more often than not... and Seto's eyes always seem to linger on him more than they should!

A fresh new boys' love office romance in which opposites attract!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Oniisan no Koto, Suki nano?
synopsis:
"Please be my boyfriend!!!"
"Huh? No."

Arai's attempt to court his savior, the bar manager Okabe, is relentless. It all began the day when Okabe saved him from a tangle with a hoodlum. Despite his flirty reputation, Arai was in fact an absolute beginner in love. Okabe kept refusing his advances until he finally suggested a one-night stand with the university student. A sensual, yet lovely story between a frivolous-looking student who's seriously in love, and a well-built, older bartender!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!: Fantastic Days
titleEnglish: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! Fantastic Days
synopsis:
Follow Kazuma and his party as they help a team of aspiring dancers, fight a former general of the Demon King, and more in a series of adventures based on the Fantastic Days game, along with new, unique content!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tsumugu to Koi ni Naru Futari
synopsis:
The manga centers on Tsumugi, who isn't good at socializing with others, when suddenly she moves and ends up becoming a freeloader at the house of a manga artist named Ryoutarou.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kagami no Kojou
synopsis:
In a tranquil neighborhood of Tokyo, seven teenagers wake to find their bedroom mirrors are shining. At a single touch, they are pulled from their lonely lives to a wondrous castle filled with winding stairways, watchful portraits and twinkling chandeliers. In this new sanctuary, they are confronted with a set of clues leading to a hidden room where one of them will be granted a wish. But there's a catch: if they don't leave the castle by five o'clock, they will be punished. As time passes, a devastating truth emerges: only those brave enough to share their stories will be saved.

(Source: Doubleday)

title: Kimidori
synopsis:
"Will you take pictures of ghosts for me?" Shouma, whose hobby is photography, meets a person while searching for a photography subject after school. The person, Akira Uguhara, with tears in his beautiful yellow-green eyes, was drawing a picture of someone without a face. Shouma, who couldn't forget him, visits his class the next day and asks him to become his model. He refuses bluntly, but Shouma, who can't give up, persistently tries to find out more about Akira...? A curious and lively photographer and a hazel-eyed boy with a closed-off heart... The clumsy and conflicted youth of immature high school boys.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Dekiai nante Mitomemasen!
synopsis:
It's been half a year since Naoto and his best friend, Toudou, became lovers. After many twists and turns, their relationship is going so well that Naoto stays at Toudou's house every weekend!!! Although their relationship is out in the open, the two decide to have a proper talk with Naoto's mother. However, the situation rolls in an unexpected direction...

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Included one-shot: Uchi no Tama wa Challenger

title: Kimi Gazer
synopsis:
Working in a bento shop, Arata cannot help but be curious about Shun, a young boy who regularly comes to buy food. However, he stops appearing all of sudden. One day, Arata awakes in the other world after saving a dog from drowning in a river. He has to stay in a hotel before passing on—and out of all places, that is where he meets Shun again! A heartfelt love story about a lethargic guy and a straightforward delinquent that unfolds in the afterlife.

(Source: Home-sha, translated)

title: Boku ga Shiranai Kimi no Kao
synopsis:
Aoba, a third-year university student, is living with his childhood friend Shou, who is one year younger than him. Except for the small apartment they share, their life together was quite comfortable, but one rainy day, Shou came home soaking wet and crying, and ever since then, Aoba can't get that crying face out of his head.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Happy Parasite
synopsis:
One night, Kazuhisa, a company employee who doesn't like getting involved with others, meets Haru, a backpacker lying down on the street. Surprised and annoyed by his decision, Kazuhisa decided to let Haru, who had trouble sleeping, stay with him. Kazuhisa is swayed by the brazenness and energy of Haru, while he tries to take care of him the best he can. To top it all off, Haru tries to repay Kazuhisa with his body...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Included one-shot: Kotae no Kazu dake

title: Hetare to Bakatare
synopsis:
Yoshiro has had hidden, unrequited feelings for his childhood friend, Dai, for several years. He constantly turns down cute girls when they ask him out. Oblivious to Yoshiro's feelings, Dai envies Yoshiro's popularity with girls, and always makes a fuss about wanting a girlfriend. Yoshiro has no intention of ever telling his airheaded friend the truth and resigns himself to a life of fluxing between appreciation for their friendship and sorrow that they can't be more. That is, until one day when the two are invited to a mixer, where Yoshiro somehow ends up dragging Dai to a motel and tries pushing him down on the bed...! This is a tantalizing love story about how a loser with unrequited feelings and his airheaded childhood friend become a couple.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hinata no Blue
synopsis:
The story starts with Hinata Naru entering the first year of high school. She had always been a quiet girl who would only hang out with her childhood friends You-chan and Micchan, but decided to change her ways after entering high school. She wanted to make many new friends, but had been having a hard time doing so due to her shyness; her life takes a turn for the better, though, after she meets the student council president Natsuno Sora and he becomes her first friend! And also... maybe something more?

(Source: MU)

title: A Villainess for the Tyrant
synopsis:
The beautiful illegitimate daughter of the Navitan Kingdom's royal family, Cecile Franvier, has been selected as the bride of the Arkia Empire's notorious Emperor Estian. He is a heartless despot who possesses inhuman strength, and all surrounding countries live in constant fear of his savage conquests. Everyone treats Cecile as if marrying Estian means she is certain to die soon—and she refuses to go down without a fight.

Cecile pretends to be a wretched woman who will never tremble before the tyrannical Estian. She demands that he carry her to the altar, and she is not sure which is more surprising—that the emperor complies or how handsome he is. As the new empress, Cecile becomes an immediate target of various assassins. However, Estian takes a liking to her, revealing one way she can survive: she must become a villainess infamous enough to outshine even him!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ooyukiumi no Kaina
titleEnglish: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea
synopsis:
A world blanketed in an endless and ever-growing ocean of snow. The people eke out a living, either huddled around the roots of enormous trees dotting the surface, or high in the canopy, which spreads over the planet's atmosphere.

A chance meeting between Kaina, a youth from the canopy, and Liliha, a young woman from the surface, sets off a chain of events that will change the fate of the world.

(Source: Polygon Pictures)

title: Keikenzumi na Kimi to, Keiken Zero na Ore ga, Otsukiai suru Hanashi.
titleEnglish: You Were Experienced, I Was Not: Our Dating Story
synopsis:
Ryuuto Kashima is a gloomy high-schooler who quietly spends his days watching his crush, the beautiful Runa Shirakawa, from afar. She rules the school and has had no shortage of boyfriends. Although Ryuuto is fully convinced she'd never accept him, fate leads him to confess his feelings to her anyway. To his astonishment, she accepts—simply because she's "available" at the time—but the surprises don't end there. She immediately invites him over as if it's the most natural thing in the world! This odd couple is different in just about every way—the friends they keep, their hobbies, their love lives—but with every passing day, they grow a little bit closer. This may not be Runa's first relationship, but their dating story is going to be full of firsts for them both!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Watashi no Keiyaku Kekkon ni wa Uso ga Aru.
titleEnglish: There is a Lie in My Contract Marriage
synopsis:
Ugly, penniless, and unloved, 18-year-old Youko Moji is ready to end it all. But as she takes the final leap, a pair of arms drag her back. Youko's savior is Kagami Kirihara, a handsome young man who lives in an expensive highrise apartment. He offers her a strange proposition: enter a contract marriage with him, with the only stipulation being that she must get cosmetic surgery to reflect his ideal partner's face.

Youko takes him up on the offer, and, six months later, she is happily married. However, on the news one evening, she learns of an unsolved murder case from 10 years ago—and the victim has the exact same face as Youko, right down to the mole under her eye. Kagami claims that the victim was his first love, and Youko wants to believe him. But could there be a lie hiding within their contract marriage?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Psychedelia
synopsis:
Shouhei Mizoshiri has just been assigned to the organized crime division and has already developed a crush on his senpai, experienced detective Toranosuke Hino. But when Hino gets shot, Mizo feels responsible and decides to take drastic measures.

(Source: MU)

title: Konya Bed de Matteiro
synopsis:
Childhood friends Kagetora and Haruta are a super lovey-dovey high-school couple! After finally going steady with Haruta, who he has always liked, Kagetora is on cloud nine!!! ...or he should be, but for some reason, he keeps desperately avoiding all of Haruta's "invitations." The reason is because Kagetora's *beep* is *beep*?! It's the battle of love between an offensive uke who wants to become one with the one he loves, and a defensive seme who doesn't want to lay hands on the one he loves!

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Chounin A wa Akuyaku Reijou wo Doushitemo Sukuitai: Dobu to Sora to Koori no Himegimi
synopsis:
Allen, an eight-year-old boy from a poor family in the royal capital, is living a poor but happy life together with his mother. One day, however, memories of his previous life suddenly come back to him and he remembers that he is in an dating sim game and that the capital will be destroyed by war if he doesn't do something about it. If this continues, both he and his mother will be killed!

With a sense of urgency, he decides to rise to the occasion in order to save his precious mother's life and save his favorite character, the villainous young lady Anastasia, the only girl he liked in the game, from her all too tragic and ruinous end.

This is the story of a man who isn't even a character in the game, but who strives with his steely determination and uses all the knowledge he has to turn overcome fate!

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Tameiki no Haru ni Koi no Natsu
titleEnglish: A Sigh in Spring, a Love in Summer
synopsis:
Kuniharu Nishio had been in love with his friend ever since high school. He followed his dream of being a stylist, never letting go of these feelings, and while the nature of his work was very accepting when it came to same-sex relationships, he spent his days feeling somewhat gloomy and depressed. That is, until one day, when a new camera assistant named Ruka Nakamine showed up and suddenly confessed his love for Kuniharu. Ruka was very aggressive and annoying to the point that Kuniharu felt that kissing him was the only way to shut him up...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Reisougyou no Arai-kun
synopsis:
Arai, being a college dropout, could not find a proper job, so he ended up working as a driver and assistant for a high school Ghost Sweeper, Haraizawa. Little did he know, his next job would be coming from the hospital where his old friend is working at... A supernatural action oneshot where horror and stagnation of life intersect.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Honya no Yagi-kun
synopsis:
Yagi is a rare sort of goat—one who loves reading books just as much as eating them! With his special talent to taste feelings contained upon paper, he's always dreamed of becoming a bookseller. Unfortunately, paper-munching goats aren't exactly welcome in bookstores, even in a world where all different animals live in peaceful coexistence. Eventually, Yagi is able to persuade Ookami, the strict wolf manager, into giving him a job at his bookshop... but can a goat surrounded by books resist his natural instincts? And what about the instincts of a wolf, who's been charmed by a sweet and tender goat?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: A Wicked Tale of Cinderella's Stepmom
titleEnglish: A Wicked Tale of Cinderella's Stepmom
synopsis:
Many reincarnated women end up living the dream as one of the younger characters from a novel—but not Mildred Vans, the newly widowed 37-year-old mother of three. She appears to be none other than the wicked stepmother from the famous Cinderella tale, an irredeemable and despised villain. With no servants to speak of and a shoestring budget, all Mildred wishes is for her three daughters—Iris, Lily, and the future princess Ashley—to marry well and live comfortably.

As the fateful ball approaches, Mildred plans to ensure her adorable Ashley meets the prince and to find adequate husbands for her strong-willed Iris and creative Lily. By chance, Mildred encounters Daniel Wilford, a mysterious young baron oddly fond of Mildred and kind to her daughters. Although Mildred is decidedly done with romance and preoccupied with her children, Daniel never fails to extend a helping hand, patiently waiting for the day she will be ready to love again.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Merit Aikyuu God
synopsis:
Despite being very much alive, Merit finds herself lost in the Realm of the Dead! To get back home, she'll need help from the god Anubis. Only one problem...he's been cursed and wants nothing to do with humans or his job anymore. But the handsome, good-for-nothing god may care more than he lets on, and Merit is no quitter!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Man's Games
synopsis:
The man who loves Yeena Yoon the most in the world, Gunho Yoo. The girl who's scared of Gunho Yoo the most in the world, Yeena Yoon. Why did the love letter meant for his brother Juhyung Yoo end up into the hands of the scary Gunho?! Before she could even correct the situation, he replies, "I accept... your confession."

(Source: Copin Communications)

title: Neko to Sugar Pot
synopsis:
1. Neko ni Rijin (Watchful Cat)
2. Neko to Saezuri (Crying of the Cat)
3. Neko ni Denwa (The Phone and the Cat)
4. Sugar Pot to Kowarenai (Unbreakable Sugar Bowl)
5. Tsurutsuru (Silky)
6. Watashi no Osananajimi wa.... (My Childhood Friend)
7. Gozen 1-ji no Coin Laundry (One AM at the Laundromat)
8. Chouchou no Himatsubushi (Killing Time of the Butterfly)
9. Oni to Yamagami (The Ogre and the Mountain God)

title: One Week Family
synopsis:
On the outside, Ren Fujimaru seems like the perfect actor—except for one flaw: he cannot handle working with children due to a past incident. For this reason, his manager proposes that he should live with his young costar Yuu Kusaka, his boss' son, for a week. Ren initially treats the idea as a joke, but he is shocked to discover that his manager is being serious: Yuu must stay with him in his apartment to improve their relationship. Having never lived with kids, Ren finds it difficult to strike up a conversation with Yuu.

Aid comes in the form of Yuu's manager Kei Haruo—a former child actor whom Ren admired as a kid. With his long-time idol so close, Ren cannot help but ask Kei about his sudden disappearance from the spotlight, but Kei refuses to give him any explanation.

Can the lives of these three people, each carrying their own burden, change in the spurt of just one week?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Anata no Mama ni Naritakute
titleEnglish: I want to be your real mom.
synopsis:
1-4. Anata no Mama ni Naritakute
5. Boku to Mama no Josou Koukai Pakohame Nama Sex
6. Oni Seme! Goumou Motoyan Do S Mama no Itazura Musuko Choukyou
7. Reiwa no ChinTra!: Dosukebe Hentai Mama to Muchi na Boku
8. ChinTrai Quest V: Boku to Inma to Chijo-tachi to Orowareshi Himegimi

title: Blue Lock: Episode Nagi
synopsis:
Second-year high school student Reo Mikage wants nothing more than to escape his illustrious family's shadow by becoming a soccer star and winning the World Cup. The only thing that's missing is a talented diamond in the rough who can help him achieve his dream. That's when he sets his sights on Seishiro Nagi, a notorious slacker whose quick reflexes are the only hint of athletic ability. Can Reo find the switch to awaken the beast inside Nagi?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Included one-shot:
Volume 6: Letter

title: Ryuuko Aiutsu
synopsis:
One night, brash blonde high school student Toraji went to a party with his childhood best friend, Ryuunosuke. At the party, they both got lucky and ended up having a threesome with a cute girl. However, in the heat of the moment, Ryuunosuke leaned over the girl's shoulder and kissed Toraji deeply! What's a yankee boy to do when he realizes his best friend is in love with him?!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Dungeon Busters: Chuunen Otoko desu ga Niwa ni Dungeon ga Shutsugen shita node Sekai wo Sukuimasu
titleEnglish: Dungeon Busters: I Am Just Middle-Aged Man, But I Save the World Because of Appeared the Dungeon in My Home Garden.
synopsis:
Clear all the dungeons! There are 666 of them and 10 years to do it. If not, the only thing that awaits...is total annihilation. Kazuhiko Ezoe suddenly finds a mysterious underground space in his yard. When he steps into what turns out to be the very first dungeon in this world, he ends up activating the Dungeon System and learns from the mysterious beauty who appears to him, Akane, that the world is doomed to destruction if the 666 total dungeons that will be appearing in this world are not all cleared within 10 years. As countries begin taking measures in response to the dungeons appearing all over the world, Ezoe seeks out companions together with whom he establishes Dungeon Busters Inc., a company dedicated to clearing all the dungeons in the world! The curtains rise on this dungeon-delving epic with overwhelming realism!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Moratte Kudasai
synopsis:
Kisuke has a dream of dating a girl, but the super sensual boy, Naka-chan (an uke), stands in his way with his overwhelming love and temptation! Can Kisuke overcome the pleasure of having his cock sucked by him?!

(Source: Akaneshinsha, translated)

title: Ookami-sama no Ichizu na Bouai
titleEnglish: Mr. Wolf Is Violently Smothering Me with Love
synopsis:
"It's my first time with a man or a human, but... Like this, the only way we'll be able to calm down is to fuck each other."While relationships between humans and beastmen are still rare, an omega with a beastman fetish, Sakutaro, spends his days taking his suppressants and dreaming of beastmen. However, one day, Sakutarou suddenly goes into heat in the middle of the street. Then, he's saved by a beastman he's never seen before...!? With such an excellent man in front of him, he can't stop himself from obscenely connecting their scorching bodies together...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Summer Ghost
synopsis:
Aoi Harukawa, Tomoya Sugisaki, and Ryou Kobayashi are three teenagers brought together by the prospect of meeting the Summer Ghost. The urban legend states that the spirit of a black-clad young woman with long hair will appear in an abandoned airfield when fireworks are lit.

During their search, the three are bearing the weight of the world on their shoulders. Relentlessly bullied at school, Aoi does not see a point in continuing to live. Tomoya is forbidden from having a creative outlet for his stress due to fears that it will affect his grades. Ryou quits his basketball team despite still feeling passion for the sport.

Each teen has their own reason for wanting to meet the spirit who died by suicide, but it seems as if something else draws Aoi, Tomoya, and Ryou together. As their summer comes to an end, the trio begins to wonder if the ghost will be able to provide answers to their lingering, morbid questions about death.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kuroneko to Majo no Kyoushitsu
titleEnglish: The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch
synopsis:
The Royal Diana Academy is a prestigious school that accepts individuals with adept magical abilities. Upon graduation, these students find themselves at the top of their field or employed by the royal family. Spica Virgo dreams of studying at the academy, aiming to be a top-rate sorceress like her idol Claude Sirius. Claude is a world-renowned sorcerer who became the institution's youngest instructor, but mysteriously disappeared soon after.

Lacking the experience and connections required for admission, Spica finds herself unable to make meaningful progress with her training. One day, however, she meets a talking black cat with magical abilities. Hoping to change the situation for the better, she begs the animal to take her as his apprentice and teach her the magic she needs to attend the academy. The cat accepts the deal on one condition—she must find a way to reverse his feline curse. Despite the arduous challenges ahead of her, Spica is determined to prove herself as a student worthy of the cat's mentorship.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Dokuzetsu Shoujo no Tame ni Kitakubu Yamemashita
synopsis:
Sui Sakaki, a second year high school student who self-proclaims himself as a professional member of the going-home club, holds his afterschool days that he can freely use for anything as something of utmost importance. With no need for an entry form, or a withdrawal form, it is definitely a pure form of club activities, the going-home club. While having the greatest pride as a member, he was given a mission by a beautiful teacher during the fall of his second year.

"The problem child, Arina Hiwa, cure her venomous tongue."

The Arina Hiwa, who was was only scored full points in appearance, who trampled over the confessions and courtship of many guys. That day, he was asked to cure the girl who was given the nickname of "The Venomous Tongued Rose." For him, as a member of the world's best club, the act of staying after school was a contradiction. However, he couldn't refuse a request from his beautiful teacher, and is now forced to spend his after school time at school.

The beautiful young girl that used her venomous tongue for seemingly violent acts.

The going-home club member that can only speak in jokes.

The crazy school life of two people filled with the chaos of abuse and…

title: Summer Ghost
synopsis:
"Have you heard of Summer Ghosts?" Tomoya, Aoi, and Ryo are high school students who met through the Internet. The urban legend of the Summer Ghost is that it is a ghost of a young woman who appears when fireworks are lit. Tomoya is unable to step out into the life he wants. Aoi is unable to find her place in the world. Ryo's bright future is suddenly closed to him. Each of them has their own reasons for meeting the Summer Ghost. On a summer night when life and death intersect, where will each of their thoughts go to?

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

title: Batsu Hare
synopsis:
The story begins with the protagonist, Ichiro Wakou, who decides to return home early from work to celebrate his second anniversary with his wife. But, when he opens the door of his house.... He finds his wife cheating on him! Although the marriage was short-lived, his life changes again when suddenly, a certain woman appears in front of him? 

Thus begins a new story, a new erotic comedy!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Doukyonin no Sano-kun wa Tada no Yuunou na Tantou Henshuu desu
titleEnglish: My Housemate Sano-kun Is Just My Editor!
synopsis:
Teiichiro Shinomiya is a prolific, workaholic novelist who is too consumed with writing to take care of himself. To prevent him from neglecting his well-being, his editor, Satoru Sano, moves in with him. But when the calm and collected Shinomiya finds himself flustered by Sano's constant presence and good looks, he begins to question their relationship. After all, Sano is just his editor, isn't he?!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: 200m Saki no Netsu
synopsis:
Tsumugu Kikka (28 years old) lives alone on the 2nd floor of an apartment building. Kikka, who works as a "wasai" (traditional Japanese clothing manufacturer) at home, is a job given by Mashimo, her ex-boyfriend from high school. One day Kikka was selected to be a board member of the apartment complex lives at and met with a man named Hirara...!? Mashimo lives 200 meters away from Kikka's house and Hirara lives 200m above. The vertical and horizontal romance triangle has begun!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kagaku-bu no Megane
synopsis:
Two members of the chemistry club promised each other that they would go from friends to lovers at the summer's end of their sophomore year. Akui is not quite sure what a "boyfriend" is, while Sako seems cheerful, even though he insists it's just an experiment. The four-eyes of the chemistry club are clumsy but sincere in their first experience of experimenting with love.

(Source: Akaneshinsha, translated)

title: Meisou Senshi Nagata Kabi
synopsis:
After attending a friend’s wedding, Nagata Kabi decides she wants one of her own. That’s not the only thing she wants—she longs to love and be loved. But she has three major problems: she has no partner, no dating experience, and her only sexual encounters are limited to a lesbian escort service. With the help of a photoshoot, a dating app, and more, the author embarks on a journey to seek the love and happiness she so desperately desires.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Mushoku Tensei: Eris wa Honki de Kiba wo Togu
titleEnglish: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation - Eris Sharpens Her Fangs
synopsis:
After facing a devastating defeat at the hands of Dragon God Orsted at the Red Wyrm's Lower Jaw mountain range, Eris parts ways with Rudeus and makes her way to the Sword Sanctum in order to rectify her own inexperience as a swordsman. As the "Mad Dog" continues to hone her sword skills under the tutelage of the Sword God, her fangs continue to grow stronger and sharper!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Ii kedo, Naisho ne.
synopsis:
1. Futari no Iinari
2. Black Strawberry
3. Hikage no Sono e Youkoso
4. Aru Kizoku no Shiawase
5. Push Up Sisters
6. Love Story
7. Taken!!!!
8. Iinari no Susume (Henpecked Encouragement)
9. Keraku no Yume (A Dream of Pleasure Corruption)
10. Bukiyou na Arbeit
11. Active Girl
12. Futari wa Nakayoshi
13. ●REC Secret Sisters
14. Hitohada to Yukidoke

title: Onna dakara, to Party wo Tsuihou sareta node Densetsu no Majo to Saikyou Tag wo Kumimashita
titleEnglish: Exiled Woman, Form the Strongest Tag Team with Legendary Witch.
synopsis:
Tanya Artemiciov is a talented Mage-class adventurer who just got kicked out of her party by a sexist scumbag. So what's a girl to do? Go to the wasteland and blow stuff up of course! One small problem though: she inadvertently frees a mythical Sorceress named Laplace who was sealed away for the past 300 years... Surprise! Turns out this so-called "wicked" Sorceress is actually pretty cool. Laplace wants to start a party of her own, Tanya wants revenge, and the solution is obvious: team up. It's time to kick ass, kiss girls, and dismantle the patriarchy!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tsukushitagari na Uchi no Yome ni Tsuite Deretemo Ii ka?
titleEnglish: We Started a So Sweet Newlywed Life.
synopsis:
There's the flower of Takamine High, Hanae Riko, whom every boy admires. Then, there's the plain boy, Niiyama Minato, who got proposed to by that most beautiful girl in school. Without knowing what's happening, the curtains on their newlywed life rises! For some reason, my bride, who's too cute and happily follows me around everywhere, refuses to leave my side...

(Source: MU)

title: Jibun no Karada wo Yurusu made
titleEnglish: Until I Love Myself: The Journey of a Nonbinary Manga Artist
synopsis:
Though they were assigned female at birth, manga artist Poppy Pesuyama feels like anything but a girl. Struggling to come to terms with who they are in a binary world, Poppy finds themself becoming an assistant for the famous manga artist X. Not only is Poppy nervous working with such an influential industry figure, but also X's less-than-appropriate behavior exacerbates their gender dysphoria, leading to something much worse.

Years later, the non-binary manga artist is still tortured by the abuse and ridicule they faced working under X, never receiving the closure they needed to move on. Angered by it all, Poppy recounts their experiences and life up to that point. Through their journey of self-acceptance, gender identity, and society, Poppy discovers what they have been desperately looking for.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: D Genesis: Dungeon ga Dekite 3-nen
titleEnglish: D-Genesis: Three Years after the Dungeons Appeared
synopsis:
Three years ago, dungeons suddenly appeared on Earth after an experiment in Area 51 went awry. Now everyone—from average citizens to soldiers—explores these monster-filled labyrinths in search of wealth, power, and magic. Keigo Yoshimura is an office worker with no sense of adventure, who dreams of quitting his job to live the easy life. While out on a business call, he stumbles on the birth of a new dungeon and accidentally gains a magical skill that turns subterranean exploration into an RPG. Things spiral out of control and Keigo winds up as the world's top explorer. With help from Azusa Miyoshi, his mathematically gifted colleague and new business partner in dungeon diving, he might be able to turn the status screens he sees into piles of cash. Unfortunately, Keigo ends up under the scrutiny of the military, government agencies, and even more sinister forces. What happened to his dream of taking it easy?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tsugi wa Ii yo ne, Senpai
synopsis:
Mao, who had repeated a year for some reason, decides to start over in the second year of high school. Hachiya, a junior high school boy in the soccer club, is now in the same class as Mao. Even though he is in the same grade as her, he doesn't stop using honorifics, which Mao finds difficult, but...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Shachiku OL to Akuma Shota
synopsis:
After coming home from her black company—one that exploits its employees—an office lady makes a desperate attempt to escape her grueling working conditions by summoning a demon, hoping that it could destroy her workplace. But while she succeeds in her endeavor, the demon that emerges is completely different from her expectations!

The invoked young boy immediately asks the office lady for her wish. However, her exhaustion and despair lead her to simply request a tasty meal. With a pure smile on his face, the demon—whom the woman later names Kuroha—begins taking care of the chores around her home. No matter how hard life at a black company may be, being looked after by the innocent Kuroha always heals the tired office lady, becoming the light in her draining life.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Sukeban to Tenkousei
titleEnglish: The Delinquent and the Transfer Student
synopsis:
Riri is a transfer student with a unique fascination—she wants the school delinquent, Atsuko, to say adorable things! Despite her fearful reputation, Atsuko goes along with it, thinking Riri is just a harmless weirdo. However, she soon finds herself getting increasingly flustered every time she reads one of Riri's lists of cute words. And she's not the only one whose heart races after each interaction! Will this game bring them closer together and lead to an entirely new relationship?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Saikyou no Maou ni Kitaerareta Yuusha, Isekai Kikansha-tachi no Gakuen de Musou suru
synopsis:
Kyouya Kujou is a boy who was unable to save the world because he does not possess the unique abilities that are the blessings of a goddess. In another world where returned heroes who have saved many worlds gather, he is a boy who could not save the world. In the academy, he was ridiculed as a "Failure Hero." However, he is the most powerful and unique hero who trained for 30,000 years in another world with Felice, the most evil demon king who has destroyed 3,000 worlds!

Kyouya's latent ability is so powerful that even the strongest heroes cannot compete with him...? The tale of a boy trained by the most powerful demon king is about to begin!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Kanojo Shoukan shimashita!?
synopsis:
Yuuta Agatsuma is a high school student who has no romantic experience. He doesn't know what true love is like, but he finds his classmate Nodoka Kanzaki interesting. Is this love!? Meanwhile, his younger sister Yoru, who dreams of summoning demons, is performing summoning rituals again. This time, the summoning circle suddenly starts to glow, and a girl descends from above. She is Lars, a demon from the underworld, and she offers Yuuta a contract!? A thrilling seven-way love comedy begins, where cheating = the end of the world!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai
titleEnglish: You Can't Be in a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends!
synopsis:
Hero, your average high school boy, has a problem: Shio and Akari, his two female childhood friends, go to the same school as him, and they're way too cute! He's certain they don't see him as more than a friend, though, and would be mortified if they learned how he feels. Meanwhile, the girls have their own secrets... Enjoy a sweet and vexing love triangle as longtime friends struggle to be more honest with each other!

(Source: K Manga)

title: Hoshizora wo Mitsumeta Sono Ato de
titleEnglish: After We Gazed at the Starry Sky
synopsis:
Graphic designer Subaru Miyazawa has always loved the stars and dreams of traveling to Lake Tekapo, New Zealand, to view its breathtaking night sky. However, due to his physical disability, he instead lives his dream vicariously through the astrophotography work of Tougo Amase. While he reluctantly accepts his reality, Subaru receives a design opportunity from his close friend Akari Tsurikane that propels him in the direction of the photographer he has always admired.

As they meet and start growing closer, Tougo becomes enamored with Subaru's determination and ability to triumph over adversity. One day, he invites Subaru on a stargazing trip he has planned in Okinawa. Scared of being a burden and his budding feelings for Tougo, Subaru initially rejects the offer, but Tougo convinces him he has no reason to hold back. Despite his initial hesitation, once he sees the beauty of the starry sky in person, his love for Tougo blossoms.

However, Tougo's professional obligations pull him all around the world for projects. His overwhelming popularity separates the two, making Subaru's attempts to chase after him harder. Even if he has been shown to overcome a lot of physical challenges, t…

title: Succubus to Hajimeru Shinken Kousai
synopsis:
Tsuyoshi is the captain of a club that prohibits romance. A devil (succubus) who can seduce men appears under him. How much can he endure in front of a girl who is sexy but far from neat and clean? How far can you go through a pure and uninterrupted love affair?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Silent Witch: Chinmoku no Majo no Kakushigoto
synopsis:
Monica Everett is the Silent Witch, the only mage in the world who has mastered the art of unchanted mage craft. But Monica hides a secret: The reason she learned to use magic without speaking is merely because of her extreme shyness. Until now, she's been content living a peaceful life hidden away in the mountains, but an unexpected visit from a colleague brings her a task more daunting than any other. Now, it's up to the world's shiest mage to infiltrate an academy and protect the second prince from danger...without letting her fears get to her!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Bonkotsu Shinpei no Monster Life @comic
titleEnglish: The Monster Life of the Freshly Drafted: The Comic
synopsis:
The protagonist is an ordinary soldier from an empire at war who gets used as a guinea pig for genetic engineering experiments, turned into a monster and put into cryosleep.

Two hundred years later, he wakes up in a world of swords and sorcery. The empire is gone and he has to survive alone in the body of a monster whom everybody wants to kill on sight. Meanwhile, he encounters various pretty ladies (and elves) in need of rescue.

(Source: MU)

title: Imaizumin Chi wa Douyara Gal no Tamariba ni Natteru Rashii: Deep
titleEnglish: Imaizumi Brings All the Gals to His House
synopsis:
Imaizumi lives a life that most high school boys could only dream of! During the day, he attends his classes like any dutiful student, only to return each evening to a home full of hotties! It seems his home has become the go-to hangout for the coolest gyarus in town. From endless gossip fests to snack binges to getting downright physical with his three new housemates, his once-quiet abode is now buzzing with non-stop energy and exciting escapades. Can Imaizumi keep up with the lively antics of his lusty gal pals?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shippo no Koi
synopsis:
Salaryman Ryou Inukai dreams of leaving his high-stress job and finding a career that gives him enough free time to care for a dog of his own. Until that becomes possible, he relieves stress by visiting a pet store and spending time with puppies and his favorite clerk, Teruaki Hoshi. These visits give him the motivation to make his dream a reality, eventually adopting a puppy he calls Wataame.

With Wataame waiting for him at home, Inukai's days are more pleasant than ever. Still, he stays in touch with Hoshi so he can share cute moments with the small dog. One day, the two meet in a park, where Hoshi shares that he was a dog in his past life, and he believes it was Inukai who saved him. Inukai questions this but does not stop Hoshi from paying back his debt the best way a former dog can: by ensuring that Wataame receives the best care possible—even if that means living in Inukai's home.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Love Comedy Manga ni Haitteshimatta node, Oshi no Make Heroine wo Zenryoku de Shiawase ni Suru
synopsis:
I love romantic comedy manga. However, my favorite heroine is a sub-heroine, a loser heroine who will never be able to connect with the protagonist. One day I was hit by a truck and woke up to find myself playing the role of the hero's best friend in a romantic comedy manga. Yeah, this is probably a dream. I'm dreaming about being hit by a truck.

In the scene where the hero's best friend is talking alone with my favorite heroine, I possessed that best friend. In the classroom alone with my favorite heroine, all I have to do is to say it.

"I like you."
"What? What are you suddenly saying...?!"
"I'll make you happy. I want you to go out with me."
"Huh?!"

Because I was dreaming, I casually told her. If this wakes me up from my dream, I won't have any regrets.

...Hey, I can't wake up from my dream? It's usually the next day, you know? What, am I reincarnated as this character by any chance? This is the story of how I make sure my favorite heroine is happy.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Kimi ja Nakya Dame na Dorei Shoujo
synopsis: Hiroto Takasaki, a typical Japanese high school boy who lives alone for unspecified reasons, discovers a silver-haired isekai slave girl lying on the floor in the entryway of his apartment.

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!: Fantastic Days
synopsis:
Follow Kazuma and his party as they help a team of aspiring dancers, fight a former general of the Demon King, and more in a series of adventures based on the Fantastic Days game, along with new, unique content!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Murai no Koi
synopsis:
The story tells a romantic comedy between Tanaka, a high school teacher who loves otome games, and Murai, a high school boy who is in love with Tanaka. Tanaka, who has never been involved in a real-life romance, is confessed to by Murai but rejects his confession. On the next day, Murai transforms himself into the exact likeness of Tanaka's favorite character from her favorite otome game.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Kishi-sama (Ikuseichuu) to Doukyo shimasu
synopsis:
Ares the knight, with red-eyed gaze fixed upon me, was my favorite "game character" that I casually created based on what came to my mind. He should be a 2D character I jokingly flirt with, and yet that "Ares" flew out of the screen and right into my room!
He kissed my hand, and then as his face drew near, my heart began to flutter... and that just can't be helped! He's the perfect character I created, you know!!!

I'm falling in love with this handsome knight who is exactly my type... but is this the time to do it?! He's a knight who you can rely on to destroy monsters in the game world! A beginner, never-kissed-before knight in this modern world?! My pounding heart is in training too.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru: Tada no Inaka no Kenjutsu Shihan Datta noni, Taisei shita Deshi-tachi ga Ore wo Houttekurenai Ken
titleEnglish: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: My Hotshot Disciples Are All Grown Up Now, and They Won't Leave Me Alone
synopsis:
Beryl Gardinant, a self-proclaimed "humble old man," is a sword instructor at his dojo in a rural, backwater village. In his younger years, he dreamed of glory as a master swordsman, but those days are long behind him. Out of the blue, he receives a visit from a famous former pupil who brings him world-shattering news—he's been appointed as a special instructor for the knights of the Liberion Order! With his life now turned upside down, Beryl travels to the capital and reunites with some of his former students: elite knights, an ace wizard, and even an adventurer who's attained the highest guild rank possible. But why do they all want his tutelage?! As far as he's concerned, they clearly don't need him anymore. Can Beryl live up to his new position? And will he ever get a moment's peace away from his adoring students?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Okiku-san wa Ichatsukitai
synopsis:
The centuries-old evil spirit Okiku has decided to return with one objective: flirting as much as possible with Hijiri Ryouyou—the most powerful and beautiful exorcist of modern times.

(Source: MU)

title: Yuki no Yousei
synopsis:
Haruki Homura lives in solitude in the snowy countryside of Hokkaido. Hiding all his emotions in his lonely heart, he can not help but detest the bleak, colorless world around him.

One day, Haruki meets the outgoing photographer Akihito Narumi, who came from Tokyo to capture the elusive snow fairies with his camera. With no place to stay amidst the snowy conditions, Haruki decides to let Narumi stay at his house for the winter. As the affable photographer cracks open his host's frozen heart, Haruki slowly warms up to the beauty of the world around him. Gradually developing a close bond, these polar opposites begin to dread the arrival of spring, as their time together will come to an end once the cold winter passes.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Hokori)! @comic
titleEnglish: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
synopsis:
"I will become the world's most wonderful maid!" With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count's family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic.

Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Seiso Kanojo, Ochiru.
synopsis:
Even though it's against the school rules for students to date, Tsukimi and Takagi have been going steady in secret for a whole 6 months. On a date at the amusement park, they finally share their first kiss, only for it to be caught on camera by an interloper. When the would-be paparazzo threatens to show the faculty, Tsukimi, being the good girl she is, goes along with his demands in order to preserve her and her boyfriend's academic standing.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Seasons of Blossom
synopsis:
Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter—love blossoms in all seasons.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Maigo ni Natteita Youjo wo Tasuketara, Otonari ni Sumu Bishoujo Ryuugakusei ga Ie ni Asobi ni Kuru you ni Natta Ken ni Tsuite
synopsis:
One day, Charlotte Bennett comes to study abroad in Akihito Aoyagi's class.

All of his classmates are attracted to Charlotte's innocent, elegant behavior and cute appearance, but Akihito calmly feels that she lives in a different world and takes a step back. However, when he helps Charlotte's younger sister, Emma, who was lost, Akihito's daily life changes drastically. After finding out that the Bennett sisters live in the next room of the apartment building, and also that Emma has grown fond of Akihito, the Bennett sisters come to visit his room every day. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table, and go out together. As they spend time together, Akihito and Charlotte grow closer, despite their clumsiness―a sweet and enticing love comedy next door begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Alien in My Wardrobe
synopsis:
"Hey you, Livestock, I need a subject for my alien probe" are not words Haesung expected to ever hear. He spends his days spacing out, hopelessly fantasizing about being tied up by his office crush, Shiwon. But his secret BDSM fantasies come to life as a brutally sexy alien crash-lands on Earth and ropes in Haesung as his research subject (and roommate). Things heat up when Haesung submits to the experiment—in exchange for sexual favors that are out of this world!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Villain Duke's Precious One
synopsis:
Dietrich Lagrange is destined to become the story's most evil villain, in a family where everyone cruelly vies to claim their place as its head. But somehow, Anissa is worming her way into his cold, shut-off heart. Little does he know that she's actually a reader reborn as his baby sister. No matter what happens, she plans to survive the story rather than live out her character's original deadly fate! Can she remain by Dietrich's side as he rises in power within the dangerous Lagrange family?

(Source: Tapas)

title: I Became the Villain's Mother
synopsis:
Summoned into her favorite novel as the infamous Duchess Roselia Chade, Haena is bathed in riches, power, and a family of her own. Life couldn't be better, save for the small detail that her beloved stepson, Einspanner Chade, is also the evil mastermind destined to kill her. At this point in the story Ein is still just an adorable child yet to reach his cruel awakening, and so Roselia is determined to stop him from becoming a ruthless killer. But with the duke getting in her way and trying to poison his own son, safely raising a child that was primed for villainy may prove harder than she originally thought. The survival of both mother and child depends on whether Roselia can successfully rewrite their tragic ending!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Unintentional Love Story
synopsis:
When Ji Wonyoung's superior is fired in a corruption scandal, the young man finds himself caught up in the mess and is unjustly suspended from the company. Seeking a breath of fresh air, he decides to stay in a remote town until he can clear his name.

As Wonyoung wanders around, he meets the chairman's favorite artist, Yoon Taejun, who disappeared from the public eye two years prior. Determined to win the chairman's favor, Wonyoung befriends Taejun, lying and hiding his true intentions in the process. Living under an alias, Taejun wants to put his past behind him, but Wonyoung must dig up the artist's hidden history to regain his post. As Wonyoung infiltrates Taejun's wary heart, he begins to lose sight of his initial objective and worry for the future, as a relationship built on lies is bound to crumble.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Again My Life
synopsis:
A righteous prosecutor, life reset, punish the villain!

A hot-blooded prosecutor, Kim Hee-wu was murdered, cast into the ocean while chasing the tyrant who controlled Korea. But, Kim Hee-wu meets a grim reaper who gives him a second chance and sends him back to when he was 18 years old. As a high schooler, Kim Hee-wu prepares to punish the tyrant Jo Tae-seop.

"To catch the devil, you must become one."

(Source: Kakao, translated)

title: Ayaka-chan wa Hiroko-senpai ni Koishiteru
titleEnglish: Ayaka is in Love with Hiroko!
synopsis:
