After he makes up his mind and summons it, a warrior maiden with unparalleled beauty appears. Rise above being just a mob explorer Kaito! A modern battle fantasy story has begun!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: The Count's Youngest Son Is a Gamer
titleEnglish: The Count's Youngest Son Is a Gamer
synopsis:
Dohyeon is a top-ranking gamer in Connect, an immersive VR game that is overrun by corrupt guilds. After being murdered for discovering a mythical item, he wakes up as Lord Raul Ashton, an NPC in a closed beta version of Connect. Now the sole player in this realm, he decides to use his knowledge from his past life to prevent the downfall of House Ashton and unlock unprecedented powers. For Dohyeon, Connect is no longer just a game—it's now his reality. Join him as he embarks on a thrilling quest to reshape his fate!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Genius Assassin Who Takes It All
titleEnglish: The Genius Assassin Who Takes It All
synopsis:
He is a successful writer who has created a fantasy world in his novel. But he made a terrible mistake in the end, causing the protagonist to reveal himself as a traitor and the world to be dominated by the demon king. He received the wrath of readers and regretted his choice.

Then he woke up in his own novel, in the body of the villain Shin Kang Ho, a ruthless killer who works for the demon king. He is five years before the disastrous ending, and has the chance to change the fate of the world. But Kang Ho has no intention of being a hero. He knows the world is cruel and full of greed. So he decide to use his talent and knowledge to achieve everything you can, without caring about others.

Kang Ho will devour all the resources, rewards, skills and treasures he finds on his way. He will become the strongest and richest of all.

(Source: MU)

title: I Killed the Main Player
synopsis:
Being a character of your favorite game is great! Sure, he's just a minor NPC, but Corin knows this game like the back of his hand. With his knowledge and the main player Sihu's abilities, everything's going smoothly—until Corin discovers Sihu's been murdering innocent NPCs and stealing their items. Horrified but powerless to stop him, Corin awaits the end of the game—only for Sihu to mysteriously fail at the last mission. Instantly, Corin travels three years back in time. Now, he's determined to kill Sihu and take on his role—defeat the final boss and save the world.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Genius Corpse-Collecting Warrior
synopsis:
It has already been two years since I possessed a character in this insanely difficult game. In order to go back to Earth, I have no choice but to stop the downfall of this world and reach the ending of this game. [You have collected the body of a "pathetic soldier." Inheriting abilities.] [Inherited rewards: Stamina +1, Proficiency +1, Dehaman's Armored Combat (D)] I will see through to the end of this game no matter what!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Apothecary Prince
synopsis:
In a twist of fate, the life of a doctor of Korean medicine flips upside down in a single night. Doctor Han Lee is reborn as Lachiel, the sickly Crown Prince of the Empire of Magentano. Han is now armed with medical knowledge and skills found nowhere else in this new world—but can he heal an empire and mend his own body at the same time? Witness his journey of self-exploration and resilience as he maps destiny's meridian, in pursuit of the acupoint that can reverse his fate.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Outcast Is a Fighter
synopsis:
Cha Moo-gyeol, a mixed martial artist, falls into a vegetative state while engaging in martial arts in a no-weight class after being tricked by Chairman Jang. Afterwards, Cha Moo-gyeol is used to renew Chairman Chang's image. Eventually, he dies and is possesses the body of Cha Mu-gyeol, a high school student with the same name. A solid body with S-class durability. A status window ability that can upgrade martial arts abilities. It's different this time. With the unfulfilled dream of the strongest man, the fight to get revenge on Chairman Chang begins.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Let Me Die in Peace!
synopsis:
By the time Princess Ophelia Lidania's fourth death rolls around, she's gotten pretty sick of dying painfully. However, she seems unable to avoid her fate of being killed by her half-brother Ewout Lidania. She's tried being nice to him, locking him up, and having him killed, but it always ends the same way. So, her goal for her fifth life is to just die painlessly. To this end, she hires the elite assassin Nau to stay by her side. But will this be enough to overturn her fate and bring her peace?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: This Life Starts as a Child Actor
synopsis:
Was this life a failure? On the contrary, he liked it! Kang Su-hyun has failed in everything he has done in life for four years. He finally found his calling as an actor and thought he was seeing the light, but he collided with a truck coming from the opposite side and despaired as death approached...

"Wait a minute, didn't I die?"

When he regained consciousness, his appearance reflected in the mirror was the cutest version of himself from when he was five years old? Yes, in this life he resolves to be a child actor.

Kang Su-hyun's acting career begins!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Shuumatsu, Kimi to
synopsis:
Gourmet BL. Two people peacefully enjoying meals together against the backdrop of a mysterious zombie outbreak. Shuuhei is consumed by the promise he made with Tomoya back in middle school. "Would you eat me?"

(Source: MU)

title: Being Loved for the First Time
titleEnglish: Being Loved for the First Time
synopsis:
After sacrificing herself to save the world over 99 different lifetimes, Anastasia Enderblanc starts her 100th life with frustrated resignation. Born as the youngest child of House Enderblanc, she expects another abusive family that fears her power, but is confused when they shower her with love instead. Their genuine affection surprises her, but she keeps waiting for the other shoe to drop. Can Anastasia accept the Enderblancs' love, or will she be disappointed and betrayed once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Believe My Sign
synopsis:
Soo-jeong is always getting on the self-absorbed Eunchan's nerves since he first appeared before him out of the blue. Soo-jeong feels the same way towards the socially inept Eunchan, who is often harsh towards him. Their ironic relationship develops as they try to survive together, even though they don't trust one another. What should you trust? Your past experiences and memories, or intuition?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Genkai Dungeon no Hanshoku Jijou
synopsis:
Egin is the boss of a dungeon where heroes have hunted out all the monsters. In order to revive the dungeon, where there is now a 100% chance of reaching the boss's room, Egin and Saille (a virgin unicorn and his second in command) tackle trying to breed more monsters. But the dungeon's monsters are hard to deal with... such as complicated slimes that have fallen in love with humans, and a shy Dullahan. Will Egin really ever be able to revive the dungeon?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kaisha to Shiseikatsu: On to Off
synopsis:
Meet two office workers whose professional lives "on" the clock and private lives when they're "off" couldn't be more different. He dresses like a lolita. She dresses like a punk. When their contrasting "on" and "off" modes collide, it inevitably leads to heart-pounding antics!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Nebula's Civilization
synopsis:
Seong-un Choi is the top-ranked player in the game "Lost World," being the only player to have completed all its achievements. However, his triumph is short-lived as a mysterious message transports him to the real "Lost World," transforming him from a mere gamer to a contender for godhood. Amidst others vying for divinity, will Seong-un be able to achieve true godhood and reign supreme in this new realm?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sekai de Ichiban "Kawaii" Amamiya-san, Nibanme wa Ore. The Comic
titleEnglish: The Cutest Is Amamiya, the Second Is Me.
synopsis:
Hikari, a highly popular model hailed as the "Cutest Girl in the World"... The mysterious model turned out to be an ordinary high school student named Kouki Harema! Kouki is troubled by the fact that he feels he's too cute when cross-dressing and can't find other girls cute... But by a twist of fate, he realizes that his classmate, Amamiya-san, is much cuter than him!? An overly confident cross-dressing boy and a diligent girl who shines when polished, a youth romantic comedy overflowing with "cuteness!"

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: My Evil Husband Is Obsessed With the Wrong Person
titleEnglish: My Evil Husband Is Obsessed With the Wrong Person
synopsis:
Getting reincarnated into the world of a novel is never easy, but possessing a doomed bride on her way down the aisle to marry a murderous emperor is just unfair! Now, the newly reincarnated Angelica has no choice but to learn to survive the whims of her new husband, Emperor Ranielo... Well, at least until he falls for his fated love interest and she can slip away unnoticed. But as the days pass, Ranielo's interest in her only grows. Can this tyrant be tamed, or will Angelica find that some destinies can't be unwritten?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Koutsugou Semi-Friend
synopsis:
"What if we became friends with benefits...?"

Suuna, a gloomy high school student, leaves home to live in a dorm. But when she nervously enters her room, she finds her roommate, Ruka, feeling up another girl! She finds out Ruka needs a "friend with benefits," so Suuna takes charge and proposes they form a "(semi) friends with benefits" contract...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Secretly More Powerful than the Hero
titleEnglish: Secretly More Powerful than the Hero
synopsis:
From a young age, I've always dreamed of being that "unassuming hero," appearing ordinary but possessing unmatched strength. But one day, fate took a turn when I was hit by an eight-ton truck, and suddenly, reincarnation was on the table! "What would you like to be in your next life?" asked the goddess of reincarnation. Eagerly, I replied, "I wish to become a wimp, but secretly OP!" She granted my wish, but with an unexpected twist: if anyone ever uncovers my true abilities, my heart will explode! This isn't quite the "secretly-OP-wimp-life" I had in mind...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Josou Danshi wa Skirt wo Nugitai!
synopsis:
Uichirou, a junior high school boy, harbors a secret he cannot share with his childhood friend, Tama-chan. He has been cross-dressing for her because she has a phobia of men. This is a thrilling yet agonizing comedy about a boy who cross-dresses for the girl he loves!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: What the Evil Dragon Lives For
titleEnglish: What the Evil Dragon Lives For
synopsis:
Unwanted from birth, illegitimate child Elaine Newt knows better than anyone that life's not fair—especially when she's chosen as a human sacrifice to appease the wrath of evil dragon Rabeth, who's sworn vengeance on the empire for sealing him away for 500 years. But to her surprise, Rabeth grants her three wishes for waking him up from his slumber. When Elaine uses her first wish to stop Rabeth from destroying the empire, she finds herself transported back to the past with a chance to live her life all over again... but this time, with a dragon by her side!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Boku no Risou no Isekai Seikatsu: Tensei shitara Kemomimi Musume darake no Sekai de Harem ni
synopsis:
Our protagonist is a 40 year old male virgin. Normally, he masturbates up to 10 times while looking at photos from the idol meet and greet events he goes to but upon the 12th time he dies of a technobreak and finds himself reincarnated in another world.

In this new world, the gender ratio skews heavily towards females to the point that they make up most of the workforce. Not to mention everyone has animal ears! Another interesting fact is that males only go into heat once a year but Norun, as our protagonist is known as, carries a gift that allows him to go into heat at will. With this discovery, what adventures (and pleasures) will Norun experience in this new world?

(Source: Denpasoft)

title: Me no Mae no Kamisama
synopsis:
Lately, Odachi has been struggling with a lack of confidence in his play. Since his debut match, where he faced off against the "God" of shogi, something has changed within him. Will the day come when he can surpass the God of his generation? A tale of a self-proclaimed average shogi player, his friends, peers, and rivals, and the God before him.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ignat no Hanayome
synopsis:
"If life is meaningless no matter where you are..." Rita, a lonely boy, is chosen as the "Dragon's Bride" by the village custom. The ancient legend of the "Snowy Mountain Dragon" is now nothing more than a legend, but Rita, unable to find his role in the village, accepts the sacrifice while realizing that it is to reduce the number of mouths to feed. Rita, who was left alone and freezing in the snowstorm, is saved by Ignat, a beautiful dragon in human form. Rita's eyes sparkle because the dragon really exists, and he is able to fulfill his role as a "bride," but Ignat rejects him, saying "I don't need a bride." Still, Rita cannot give up, and he learns the secret of the ritual to turn humans into "dragons." A silent dragon x a fearless sacrifice. A fantasy BL story of a non-human marriage that will heal your frozen heart!

(Source: Penguin Random House)

title: I'm a Villainess with a Handsome Husband
titleEnglish: I'm a Villainess with a Handsome Husband
synopsis:
Lamaine Rogers finds it terribly unfitting that she is a villainess, as she was a kind doctor who always went above and beyond for her patients in her previous life. In the world of a novel she now inhabits, there is no love lost between Lamaine and her husband, Cedric, the second male lead. He is enamored with his brother's wife, Elena, which turns Lamaine into a jealous woman desperate for his attention.

Feeling like a cursed prisoner, the new Lamaine comes to a mutually beneficial agreement with Cedric. While they play smitten spouses, Cedric will strive to become the next duke, and once he succeeds, Lamaine will receive a sizable payment upon their divorce. However, it appears there is more to the villainess Lamaine and her past than the story portrays. As she attempts to understand her body's previous owner, Lamaine unknowingly begins to untangle a dangerous web of secrets.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ougon no Keikenchi
synopsis:
The conquest story of the final boss protagonist begins here!

"Boot Hour, Shoot Curse" is a VRMMORPG that has no concept of levels or professions. Instead, players must farm experience points to gain new skills and increase their status. Rare, a girl who participated in the closed beta test, has acquired the hidden skill "Subordinate", which allows her to turn NPCs into her subordinates. The skill also transfers the experience points gained by the subordinates to Rare. She used the skill to gradually add new NPCs she encountered to her party. As a result of the unprecedented amount of experience gained from her minions, she was able to evolve into a Demon Lord.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken: After the Rain
titleEnglish: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten: After the Rain
synopsis:
Highschooler Amane Fujimiya just started living alone but already has a strange neighbor. Right next door to him lives the most beautiful girl at school, the "Angel" known as Mahiru Shiina. Their curious relationship blossomed when Amane lends Mahiru an umbrella on a fateful rainy day. Once complete strangers, now neighbors, these teens find themselves gradually drawn to each other.

A collection of sweet, impatient moments of everyday life between a blunt boy and his cute neighbor.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Motokare to wa Dekinakatta Sex Shitemo Ii desu ka?
synopsis:
True gamers masturbate to their buds on cam. Especially when that "bud" is actually a hot girl who's horny after breaking up with her boyfriend. These two online friends are about to go from sex-less to sex-overload!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Gokugoku Futsuu no Fuufu no Hanashi: Matome
synopsis:
After successfully graduating and finding jobs, Haru Hanasaki and Aki Hojo are a married couple living their ordinary lives—though the flirting has not stopped for the pair! Now comfortable with their feelings for each other, they are not afraid to show their affection, whether that be Haru surprising Aki with a kiss while he works from home or an intense hugging session upon arriving home from work. With each passing day, the young lovebirds find sweet ways to express their love for one another!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isekai de Pension Hajimemashita. Sekai de Yuiitsu no Kuromajo desu ga, Kono Chikara wa Okyakusama no Tame ni Tsukaimasu.
titleEnglish: The Black Witch Runs Her Own Boarding House in Another World.
synopsis:
"There was still so much I wanted to do..."

A young woman dies in a fire at work and is reborn in another world as a black witch. Her new master, a talking black cat, tells her that black witches have powers capable of changing the world. But this witch has her own dream—to operate a boarding house that welcomes any and all kinds of guests!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Slime Seijo
synopsis:
When a curious slime monster comes across a fresh corpse, an opportunity presents itself: take over the body and become a human. Easy, right? Except, the body that the slime took belongs to Lady Jelly, a heinous, unhinged young noblewoman whose villainous personality may be the reason why her corpse ended up in the forest. There's no turning back for this slime—the only thing she can do is turn this villainess into a beloved saint! But if her true nature as a slime is discovered, this dream will be over before it even starts. Can a simple slime change Lady Jelly's reputation and keep herself alive in order to become a beloved saintess? Or is this weak creature doomed to stay at the bottom of the food chain forever?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Oresama na Doukyuusei no Kenzoku ni Narimashita
synopsis:
In a world where human and non-human entities coexist, Rio is a high school student of vampire descent. Because of his lineage many of his classmates fear and avoid him so he always tries to keep a low profile. But his classmate Kairi, always pesters him.

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Oni Gal-kun no Hara no Naka
synopsis:
Ritsu Kamishiro, a highschool student with a height complex, is working hard to rebuild his father's rundown kendo dojo. Then all of a sudden one day a long-haired boy in a bizarre outfit appears in front of Ritsu and says "I'm an oni! I've come to retrieve the Mallet of Fortune from you, the descendant of Issun-Boushi!"

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

title: Okuremashite Seishun
synopsis:
On a Halloween night, a boy and a girl wearing high school uniforms meet, facing a similar predicament: they feel as if the magic of high school days has slipped through their fingers. Kayano Wakaba was preoccupied with studying, while Tachibana Fumito regrets devoting his teenage years solely to basketball. Having never experienced movie-like dates, they agree to indulge themselves for this one night.

However, neither Wakaba nor Fumito are high school students—they are both 20-year-olds lamenting the lost time. They continue meeting, always in their uniforms, trying to live out for the youth that escaped them and realizing that a belated romance can be just as sweet.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Archmage's Restaurant
synopsis:
A man who was reincarnated in another world as a 9th class wizard and retired after saving the continent from a dragon war. He decides to open a small restaurant in the countryside, but his routine is anything but ordinary. On the second floor of his restaurant, there lives a black dragon who has transformed into a woman, named Rurin. She is greedy, cute and loyal to him, but also ignorant and clueless about the human world. They live a fun and warm life, serving customers, solving problems and growing violets in the garden.

(Source: JR Management, translated)

title: Watashi no Blue Garnet
synopsis:
Inami Kon, age 24, has been job hunting for the past 4 months. However, she is having trouble being "normal". One day, she meets Ai, a woman whose personality is the complete opposite of her own. Is this encounter just coincidence or is it fate?

The curtain rises on a mature yuri story about love that she has mixed feelings about.

(Source: MU)

title: Tonari no Neko to Koi Shirazu
titleEnglish: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate
synopsis:
Minato Seno's high school life had just begun when his homeroom teacher requested his help with Nekozane, the cat-like chronic napper who sits next to him in class. Timid and socially anxious, Minato has never talked to her or even seen her face. But when he finally musters up the courage to wake Nekozane, she unexpectedly hugs him on the spot! Thus begins a sweet tale of two teens awkwardly stumbling into a new friendship, unaware that their feelings are slowly turning into something more!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Mousou-sensei
synopsis:
The beautiful English teacher Momoko Irosaki receives what she thinks are the lustful gazes of her male students every day... or so she misunderstands!? What goes on in the school life of a teacher who inadvertently indulges in fantasies full of allure...?

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: No Office Romance!
synopsis:
Are first loves overrated, or can a reunion as adults bring back emotions of the past? Yunji and Saebom share a first love story left unfinished, abruptly interrupted by ten years of being apart. Now, as adults, both seem to have moved on from that unfinished chapter of their lives and agree to remain friends and coworkers. However, the surface is not everything there is to be seen, as an unspoken tension lingers between them. Will they merely stay friends, or does destiny have other plans for them?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hardcore Leveling Warrior: Earth Game
synopsis:
I'm... back! After a comet collides on Earth, a gaming world filled with monsters and dungeons becomes a reality. Amidst the chaos, Ethan wakes up as Hardcore Leveling Warrior, an almighty game character with exceptional luck and power. Once again, he will embark on a journey to become the strongest... but this time, on Earth!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kaijuu 8-gou: Side B
synopsis:
In this first of two volumes, Hoshina's backstory comes to light. The harsh words of his father could have hobbled Hoshina for life, but Hoshina's not your average kaiju fighter. Armed with his signature swords, he shakes free of the doubts of the past, determined to take down kaiju and make a name for himself!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Furoufushi Shoujo no Naedoko Ryokouki
titleEnglish: The Nursery Travel Report by a Immortality Girl.
synopsis:
A story of a genius girl brimming with curiosity who attains immortality and sets out on a journey to become a seedbed for different species.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: An Extra Stole the Male Leads
titleEnglish: An Extra Stole the Male Leads
synopsis:
Reborn as Selonia Bessin, the heroine of a romance fantasy novel, a girl is thrust into a demon-slaying mission with the novel's three male leads. They successfully defeat the demon lord, but Selonia falls unconscious for three months on the journey back. Upon awakening, she discovers the trio is now enamored with Grace Benet, an unknown extra. Moreover, the supposedly defeated demon lord is back in hot human form! Why has he returned, and who is this mysterious Grace stealing the limelight?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Obsidian Bride
synopsis:
Among the nobles yearning for true love, a select few are fortunate to receive an invitation to join the Jewel Box. In a secret magical place, noble men and women take on new appearances and don the names of jewels corresponding to their personalities. They can get to know one another and compete for time alone with the participants who have struck their fancy. However, they must not reveal their true identities until they have found their perfect match.

The recently wed Lueri Lyza detests her arranged marriage to an unkind husband. When she is unexpectedly invited to the Jewel Box despite her marital status, a mysterious man going by "Moon Owl" asks her to take the place of Marianne Farie Sieris—a free-spirited former participant who once captivated the audience. Marianne was hoping to find love again in the Jewel Box after her husband's death, but she has suddenly vanished, and the show's broadcast must go on without the public finding out.

As the ultimate game of delicate deception and high-stakes dalliance begins to unravel, Lueri puts on her best Marianne act under the alias "Obsidian"—but she might still fall for a gentleman ready to love her true self.

[Written by MAL Re…

title: Houkago Kitaku Biyori
synopsis:
Shun is invited to join the Going-Home Club by Naoki Satou (aka Naoki-chan). Despite trying to refuse, he is strong-armed into accepting the invitation! This is a romantic comedy about a girl who can't help but take detours and a boy looking for purpose in life.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Raising My Fiancé With Money
synopsis:
Money can't buy her love, but it can help her get sweet, sweet revenge. Take a seat at Lady Ilya Bloden's table and watch Ilya charm her way out of a loveless engagement, help the "Bloodthirsty Butcher of the Battlefield'' find the courage to speak to the manager, and single-handedly destroy one of the most influential families in the Ishtar Empire. Tea and crumpets will be served!

(Source: Tapas Media)

Forced to live as a high school student due to his stepfather's gambling debt, Hui-jae Jeong flees to a remote island to live with his grandmother so he can escape the pursuit of loan sharks. But just when he thinks he's safe, Hui-Jae runs into trouble in the form of the local gangster squad: Bowlcut, Hatchet, and Beomjoon Cha. But when Hui-jae becomes Beomjoon's errand boy, the two find themselves stuck not only on the island, but in a complicated love affair that leaves them both stranded in love...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Houkago wa Kenka Saikyou no Gal ni Tsurekomareru Seikatsu: Kanojo-tachi ni Sukarete, Boku mo Saikyou ni!?
titleEnglish: From Bullied to Brawler: My After-Hours Education with the School's Tough Girls
synopsis:
Strong & beautiful girls will teach you how to fight! A high-school boy who was bullied by the delinquents became friends with the strongest girls in his school... A comedy full of battles and love!

Shiki entered St. Lukeman's Academy, a high school with a bad reputation. There are too many delinquents, and Shiki, who is shy and good at studying, got targeted by one of those groups. He had to obey orders made by Kawatou, the leader of the group but he thought it's better than being kicked and punched.

One Saturday, Shiki helped a girl who was trying to get away from Kawatou's group. When he was beaten up, someone came to save him. It was Karin, the "Empress," the strongest and the most beautiful girl in his high school. The girl he helped was her friend! Karin told Shiki that she'll teach him how to fight. In return, he'll teach her how to study. Her lessons made Shiki stronger... Will he become the strongest in the school someday?

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Isso Anata ga Todome wo Sashite
titleEnglish: You Might as Well Be the One
synopsis:
Due to her height and flashy style, university student Ichika Nakajou is often misunderstood. Her beauty and confidence can be intimidating, but contrary to what most would assume, she longs for a normal, loving relationship. That is why she feels out of place at a mixer, where the men solely care about her physical appearance. However, a fellow student named Kousei Sanari notices her discomfort, and, thanks to his genuine and easy-going demeanor, they immediately hit it off.

After the gathering, their friendship begins to blossom. But Ichika finds Kousei handsome, and his ease around her only deepens her feelings for him. Although his mixed signals leave her uncertain, Ichika considers confessing and learns that Kousei has no interest in a serious relationship. Now, Ichika must decide whether to simply maintain their effortless friendship or try to turn her one-sided love into something more.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: I Will Live the Life of a Villainess
titleEnglish: I Will Live the Life of a Villainess
synopsis:
After a fatal car crash, Yuna Jeong awakens in the body of Elena Rosaria, a character in the novel she read in her previous life. But there's a twist—Elena is no ordinary character. She's a notorious villainess who meets a grim end. Now, Yuna must alter her destiny in a chaotic world and find her way in this new life. Can she rewrite her destiny amidst the surrounding chaos?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Koukousei Web Sakka no Mote Seikatsu "Anta ga Kami Sakka na Wakenai desho" to Boku wo Futta Osananajimi ga Koukai shiteru kedo Mou Osoi
titleEnglish: The Teen Web Novelist Is a Girl Magnet: Now My Crush Feels Bad for Rejecting Me!
synopsis:
Yuuta Agematsu is the author of the most popular web novel of the century—and he's only in high school! With such a huge hit under his name, he finds himself the target of affection from people like a beautiful editor, an idol singer, and a popular voice actor! However, Yuuta's main goal is to win over his childhood friend through a heartfelt confession...and things take a very unexpected turn!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Futsuu no Keion-bu
synopsis:
With a passion for richly textured Japanese rock, first-year high school student Chihiro Hatono steps into the world of the light music club, new guitar in tow. But what awaits her behind those doors...? A drama of unfiltered youth and musical ambition takes the stage!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ponta ga Hito ni Narimashite.
synopsis: A slapstick comedy that involves a town and its neighbors where dogs suddenly become human beings. The story follows the life of dog owner Saki and Ponta, her dog.

title: How to Snag an Alpha
synopsis:
Born into a family of handsome, wealthy, and well-educated alphas, Wooyoung always expected he would be the same. Come to find out, he was the odd man out as the lone omega, and not even a perfect one at that. To compensate, Wooyoung goes through life pretending to be a beta, but when he begins to experience hormone imbalances, irregular heat cycles, and a distinct lack of control over his impulses, his lowly recessive omega status becomes impossible to ignore.

That's when he meets Kyungju, a powerful and successful dominant alpha who can turn him into a true omega, and also makes him weak in the knees. Now, Wooyoung must use every tactic there is to court Kyungju and make the brooding alpha his very own.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Akuyaku Onzoushi no Kanchigai Seija Seikatsu: Nidome no Jinsei wa Yaritai Houdaishitai dake nanoni
synopsis:
Intending to Live a Carefree Life as a Villainous Heir, But Inadvertently Declared a Saint!?

"My path to domination starts here!"

Ouga Vellet, the eldest son of the infamous corrupt lordly Vellet family, is a reincarnated individual. Having been taken advantage of due to his kindness in his past life, he now revels in the life of a mischievous villainous heir. From then on, Ouga spared no compromise, pushing the limits of "tyranny" to achieve his ambitions.

He wanted power. He decided to deceive the expelled female knight captain and recruit her as a pawn. He desired a harem. He believed that by helping the oppressed commoner girls, they would readily accept him. He even saw potential in operating within the underworld. His plan was to start by squeezing the bad guys. Connections were also crucial. He aimed to excel in the Magic Academy. Thus, he envisioned his days as a carefree ruler (+effort) under the authority of his family... But things took an unexpected turn.

"Wow, Ouga-sama, you're amazing!"

...Just for "arrogant behavior," why does his reputation keep soaring without his control?

However, Ouga remains unaware. He doesn't yet know that this evaluation will become so…

title: Orcsen Oukokushi: Yaban na Orc no Kuni wa, Ikani Shite Heiwa na Elf no Kuni wo Yakiharau ni Itatta ka
titleEnglish: History of the Kingdom of Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
synopsis:
Gone are the days of swordsmanship and chivalry. Now is the age of gunpowder and war.

Our story has two players. The first is Orcsen, a unified nation with many demonic races, led by the oft-reviled orcs. And the second is Elfind, the kingdom ruled by the beautiful yet vainglorious elves.

Dineru, chieftain of the dark elves, has been forced to flee her homeland from enemies she had once trusted as friends. In the midst of their forced diaspora, she has a fated encounter with the leader of Orcsen, the orc king Gustav...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Shinyuu no "Dousei shite" ni "Un" te Iu made
synopsis:
Meet Wataru, an open book who wears his heart on his sleeve, and Minato, a man who always comes across as cool, calm, and collected. Though they're polar opposites, their shared love of photography brings them together in high school, and they become such good friends that they decide to rent a place together in college.

It's only when Minato moves across the country for work after graduation that Wataru realizes he's been harboring romantic feelings for the stoic gentleman this whole time. So when they reunite three years later, Wataru hopes they'll be able to reconnect as friends... but now it's Minato who seems to have his sights set on romance!

Friends or lovers—which will they choose? The countdown to their final decision is on!

(Source: Animate International)

title: Koi Dekinai no wa Kimi no Sei
synopsis:
Reiichi Miyoshi is a professional jazz musician who has a policy of never having a serious boyfriend or girlfriend. He prefers to keep his love life casual with a revolving door of hedonistic one-night stands.

When he swoops in to rescue what appears to be a damsel in distress from a group of rowdy men one day, he soon finds out that his latest paramour is no damsel at all, but the crossdresser Sara Aogiri. Sara is determined to have the egotistical Miyoshi all to himself, but Miyoshi isn't going to date anyone seriously without some extreme convincing.

(Source: Animate International)

title: I Became the Tyrant's Dishonest Adviser
titleEnglish: I Became the Tyrant's Dishonest Adviser
synopsis:
Suddenly thrust into a novel she used to read, the newly transmigrated Duchess Erina Valois finds herself with a lot on her plate. In her previous life, she was a simple call center employee, and now, she must take on the role of an adviser to the tyrannical emperor of the Heathronia Empire, Cardan Zeon. To Erina, Cardan is all too similar to the infuriated customers she's used to. Their grievances pale in comparison to Cardan's wrath, however, as he is notorious for beheading his subjects over just about anything.

To complicate things further, the novel seemingly left out the details of her and Cardan's relationship; Erina quickly realizes that she is no mere adviser. She and Cardan are supposedly bound by a contract, with Cardan compelled to do her bidding in exchange for something she owns. Knowing that one wrong step could result in her execution, Erina must tread carefully around Cardan and use her experience dealing with complaining customers to ensure his satisfaction, all while attempting to find what exactly in her possession Cardan so desperately wants.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Rearing Rebecca
synopsis:
After dying in an accident, Leona wakes up in a novel as the third stepmother of the story's future villainess, Rebecca Petry. As Duke Ian Petry's only child, Rebecca is resentful, rowdy, and rebellious, terrorizing those around her. The duke orders Leona to raise his daughter, and she rises to the challenge, but the little girl is a formidable foe. To preserve the family's peace, Leona uses childrearing knowledge from her past life, but will she be able to turn this rugrat into a little lady?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Became the Mother of the Evil Male Lead
titleEnglish: I Became the Mother of the Evil Male Lead
synopsis:
The newly reincarnated Sheriel learns she has become the mother of Karthizel Roperam, the male lead of a dark romance fantasy novel. All the neglect Karthizel faces as a child leads him to become a crazy and obsessive man who's willing to kill anyone to get what he wants, even his own mother! Then the only way for Sheriel to keep herself alive in this timeline is to have him be raised right under loving parents, which means she'll also need to make amends with her cold, estranged husband. Will Sheriel be able to save herself and this broken family?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Peony: Dreaming of the Dangerous Grand Duke
titleEnglish: Peony: Dreaming of the Dangerous Grand Duke
synopsis:
Rejected by her family, Princess Peony is sent to marry Grand Duke Ernst Eques, known as the cruelest man in the empire. No one realizes that's exactly what she wants! Peony's possessed by Gabriella Nasirette, Ernst's beloved wife who was murdered by his enemies. Cursed to keep her identity secret, she sets out to protect Ernst and make him fall for her again... Only he still loves Gabriella! Can Peony make this marriage a lifelong love? Or will her dreams be dashed by the coldness of the duke?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Low Tide in Twilight
synopsis:
Burdened with a seemingly insurmountable debt incurred by his absentee father, Kim Euihyun knows that for an omega—a secondary sex capable of bearing children—like him, only a painful fate awaits. Clinging to his younger brother, Euiyoung, whom he has been responsible for since his birth, Euihyun walks into the ocean to drown together and escape their wretched life. However, one of his creditors, the imposing Yeo Taeju, interrupts him, leaving Euihyun certain that a future of misery is set in stone.

Taeju, who is blessed with the superior characteristics of an alpha, finds Euihyun's pheromones captivating and wants to keep the omega under his thumb. Offering Euihyun more options than he typically would give a debtor, Taeju hopes Euihyun will live to serve him and him alone. Though Euihyun does not trust the gangster, he has little choice but to cooperate if he wishes to provide Euiyoung with a better life.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Saigo no Elf
synopsis:
In a world where steam and steel are rapidly replacing ancient magic, Aharu, the last surviving elf, embarks on a journey across a war-scarred land. With her loyal owl companion Glyph at her side, she seeks out the forgotten spirits who once fought alongside her people, offering them one final chance to return to their realm. But there are those who would see this last elf erased from history, just like the spirits she seeks to set free.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Isekai Yururi Camp
synopsis:
Ueki Hashira worked himself to death and died falling down the stairs. As a child, he had fixed the shrine of the plant deity, so as thanks, the god granted his wish to "live a laid-back life in a natural, rural area like where he used to live." However...he was reincarnated in the middle of a vast natural wilderness surrounded by trees!

(Source: MU)

title: The Villainess Empress's Attendant
synopsis:
Though the empress of the Rantias Empire has no equal in beauty and grace, she rarely leaves her palace, feeding the rumors of her cruelty and ill manners. All of the servants fear her, and not a single aide stays for long. That is, until Paresa Menzel is appointed the empress' personal attendant. Unlike those who came before her, Paresa speaks her mind and completes her duties with astonishing skill and composure, quickly earning the empress' favor.

Paresa's competence is unmistakable, but her past is full of mystery—a combination that raises many questions about her origins and circumstances. Nevertheless, despite all of Paresa's secrets, one thing is certain: no matter what, she will do everything in her power to protect the villainous empress.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Love Bullet
synopsis:
One fateful day, Koharu is saved from an untimely end and reborn as a Cupid. Her mission: bring love to humans and earn a second chance at life. But modern problems call for modern solutions, and the Cupids of today have traded in their outdated bows and arrows for high-velocity firearms! Koharu's happy to dutifully help others find love, but her eccentric mentors don't play by the book and will happily turn an argument over a love triangle into a battlefield of tactical matchmaking action!!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Heisei Haizanhei Sumire-chan
synopsis:
"Sumire-chan," age 31, is a former unsuccessful idol now living as a NEET. After being defeated in the cutthroat entertainment industry, both physically and mentally battered, she spends her days lazing around in a run-down apartment. Her high school freshman cousin, Yuusei, notices her situation and approaches her with a money-making proposition: "You've got a nice body, so why don't we publish an independent gravure photobook?" Can Sumire-chan stage her comeback in the Reiwa era? Stay tuned!

(Source: MU)

title: Kyougane-ke no Hanayome
synopsis:
For the past millennium, the Kyougane Clan has stood as an infamous bloodline of fiend-slaying exorcists. In the present day, it's led by the sharp-tongued and unyielding head, Kurou Kyougane. One day, a stunning young bride is brought before him—but beneath her beauty lies a hidden, dangerous secret.

Determined to stand by her side, Kurou must now sever the shackles of fate to protect their bond—no matter the cost.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster
titleEnglish: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster
synopsis:
After waking up in the body of Giselle Rozevin, possibly the worst character from the novel, "The Poisoned Apple," our protagonist has one goal: escape the original Giselle's miserable fate of being poisoned to death by assassins while trapped in a prison cell. Thankfully and strangely, she finds out that poison is ineffective on her and that she can distinguish them by taste. Thus, having fallen out of favor with the good guys, Giselle uses her new unique skill to appeal to the villains. However, is joining hands with the villains really the right choice?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Wreck My Bias
synopsis:
Sungjun has a secret. Try as he might, he can only gain sexual satisfaction through a fancam of former idol Minyoung. But on a night out with friends, the unthinkable happens. After sharing his first kiss with the inexperienced and innocent Geumji, he decides it's best to take her home. There he meets Geumji's mother, who is the woman of his dreams...literally. After dropping Geumji off, Sungjun goes home only to have a wet dream about her mom later that night! Shocked by this new revelation, Sungjun is left with unanswered questions: Who is Geumji's mother? Why is he able to get off to her? And how can he meet her again?! Deciding to take matters—and hopefully mothers—into his own hands, Sungjun just might get what he's after...and more!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: E, Shanai System Subete Wanope Shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka?
titleEnglish: Fired? But I Maintain All the Software!
synopsis:
Ai Satou is the sole engineer maintaining her company's internal systems. It's too bad being the linchpin who keeps it all running won't protect her from sudden layoffs. Apparently, the new CEO doesn't approve of cosplaying at work.

Depressed and jobless, Ai unexpectedly reunites with her childhood friend, Kenta Suzuki, who makes her an offer. His startup, True Coding School, provides personalized lessons to people struggling under the stress of modern society, and he wants her to join his team.

With every passionate—and sometimes unconventional—lecture, Ai finds herself giving her students a renewed sense of purpose. Who knew that coding lessons could change so many lives?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kabukichou Cat Honey
synopsis:
Haru, a super popular "top" among the gay nightlife crowd, gets dragged to a host club after work by one of his regulars. There, he meets the overfamiliar (and super hot) Number 2 host, Shinya, who's exactly his type. He's super aggressive, even though he's straight! Fearing he might fall in love with the silver-tongued playboy, Haru tries to get out of there as soon as he can, but ends up forgetting his cell phone at the club! Is this for real, or is Haru just getting fooled by this smooth-talking hottie?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi
synopsis:
Young Paracelsus was never a fighter, so when he's transported to another world, there's only one path for him to make a living—alchemy. The problem is, he's cheating his way through it! Can Paracelsus and his newfound companion, Nora, thrive in this strange new world?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Villainess's Blind Date Is Too Perfect
titleEnglish: The Villainess's Blind Date Is Too Perfect
synopsis:
An overworked girl strikes gold, waking up as wealthy noblewoman Yvonne Argentrose in a novel. Once a jealous villainess one-sidedly obsessed with the crown prince, now all she wants is a peaceful and opulent life. Still unconvinced of her transformation, her family tries to set her up with the empire's perfect man, Duke Ehels. But when the once uninterested crown prince catches wind of this, he becomes jealous, and drama ensues! Can Yvonne escape the drama and enjoy her new life in peace?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Following Eunju
synopsis:
Minjun sets up a fake profile to get Eunju, his crush, to accept his follow request on social media. Now, with her daily activities and whereabouts available at his fingertips, he uses this information to move in as her next-door neighbor. But little did Minjun know, that Eunju's life isn't anything like what she posts online–this sends him down an unexpected path, where he learns that following Eunju turns out to have its consequences.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: My Dear Aster
synopsis:
Lehanne Copland led an ordinary life as a wife and a mother before a carriage accident cut her life short. In the next moment, she finds herself in the extraordinary situation of being 19 once more! Ecstatic at this second chance but reluctant to let go of her old life, Lehanne decides to do just one thing differently: confess to Schudermel Laft, her first love. But when she succeeds in asking him to be her partner for a party, Lehanne discovers he is not quite like what she had imagined...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko
titleEnglish: The Strongest Man, Born from Misfortune
synopsis:
"Fortune and Misfortune are two sides of the same coin?! Reverse any adversary and cease redemption!!" Siegbert is reborn after an unfortunate accident in his previous life. His new family is warm and welcoming... so much so it seems as though he may no longer be an unlucky person. In this world, he can finally live a quiet, peaceful life... or so he thought. It seems that he actually holds an insanely high luck stat in this new world...? "Every chance is a manifestation of good fortune. If you can cease the chances, your wishes shall be granted..." Conquering each "chance" granted by his good fortune, will he now cease redemption on the generational legacy this family has yet to fulfill?!

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: My Fantasies Are Cumming to Life?!
titleEnglish: My Fantasies Are Cumming to Life?!
synopsis:
Park Seojin is the first one to arrive at the office every day, upholding her image as a dependable and thriving young woman. What her coworkers do not know is that Seojin uses their absence to catch up on reading and even writing erotic fiction! Having always admired the dreamy male leads, she sees little point in giving a chance to real-life men. However, the handsome and possessive men from her daydreams have lately started to take the form of Yoon Taehyun, Seojin's young boss.

Taehyun is the ideal man—attractive, rich, and assertive—but Seojin would never dare to make a move on him. When an email containing Seojin's fanfiction of Taehyun mistakenly lands in his inbox, she is certain she must now bid farewell to her career. However, Taehyun seems extremely intrigued—enough to even help bring her fantasies to life.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: My Little Sister Is the Demon Lord!
titleEnglish: My Little Sister Is the Demon Lord!
synopsis:
After their parents' sudden passing, Gyeonwoo finds himself in the role of caregiver to his younger sister, who harbors a startling secret—she's the Demon Lord with plans for world domination! Undeterred, Gyeonwoo is committed to nurturing his sister with love and guidance. Join them in this unique tale as they navigate everyday life amid their extraordinary circumstances.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: My Life as a Loser 2
synopsis:
This isn't the life I wanted!!! After reliving high school as Jinu, the boy he once bullied, Ancheol is now a new person. But his new life takes an unexpected turn. Once again, he is sent back in time to live as Jinu. But this time, Jinu is also back... as Ancheol!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Majo to Youhei
synopsis:
Zig—a tall, broad-shouldered mercenary—participates in a witch hunt. Following a fierce duel with the deadly witch, he becomes privy to her desire. "I want you to protect me," she requests, tired of having her life trivialized. Seeking a place to survive, the witch and the mercenary set their sights on an unknown continent!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Anatatachi Soredemo Sensei desu ka!
synopsis:
One day, school teachers come as freeloaders to the inn run by his parents!? Hiro Kazami, a high school boy, decides to take care of the inn and his future!? Under one roof, the forbidden harem romantic comedy begins!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Koishita Hito wa, Imouto no Kawari ni Shindekure to Itta. Imouto to Kekkon shita Kataomoi Aite ga Naze Imasara Watashi no Moto ni? To Omottara @comic
titleEnglish: The Person I Loved Asked Me to Die in My Sister's Stead
synopsis:
The noble lady Wisteria was in love with Bright, the beautiful and kind son of a duke. She was determined to become engaged to him and made every effort to do so, despite her bad reputation. However, it was her adoptive younger sister who Bright opened his heart to. One day, her sister was chosen to be a sacrifice. As Wisteria devoted herself to helping her avoid her fate, she discovered Bright's feelings. Eventually, Wisteria was told the decisive words, and she was sacrificed in place of her sister. She should have lost her life there, but...

This is the story of a wounded and lonely former noble lady and a young man who was blessed with everything and had no attachments.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Haruiro Kanojo
synopsis:
1. Omoi Omoware (Love Me)
2. Shirotaegiku (Dusty Miller)
3. Dusty Miller
4. Linaria
5. Yoi no Hana (Drunken Flower)
6. Te to Te wo Toreba (When You Take My Hand in Yours)
7. Karakawanaide Tachibana-san (Please don't tease me, Tachibana-san)
8. Yuuki wo Dashite (Be Brave)

title: Kegareboshi no Kakera-tachi
synopsis:
1. Netokano
2. Netokano: After Party
3. Netosis: Haruno Kasumi
4. Netosis: After Syndrome
5. Kegareboshi: Ao
6. Kegareboshi: Aka
7. Kegareboshi: Murasaki - Jo
8. Kegareboshi: Kuro
9. Kakioroshi

title: Shy na Ano Ko ni Natsukaretai
synopsis:
"My seatmate, Shiraishi-san, is just too cute—and it's driving me crazy!"

They know each other, but they're not exactly friends. Ayame Akaogi and Konomi Shiraishi are classmates—nothing more, nothing less. Ayame is strikingly beautiful, a standout athlete, and popular in class, whilst Konomi is shy, introverted, and has only one friend. They should've had no reason to interact... so how did things end up this way? What started as a small, trivial incident caused Ayame's hidden feelings to overflow, now she can't stop thinking about her!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Bitch Girl♥Chitai Haishin!
synopsis:
1. Chuubou no Hito
2. Maguro Onna no Shitataka na Yuuwaku♡
3. Henai Dousoukai Gho-st-alker
4. Tsun Mitai de Tsundenai Sukoshi Dere na Shinnyuu Shain
5. Haishin Kanojo (Broadcast Girlfriend)

title: Abu-normal
synopsis:
Eiko Abu, 29 years old and single. She divides everything in the world into two categories: "normal" or "not normal." In her quest for normalcy, her obsession slowly destroys the relationships she had built. What is normal? What is abnormal? Logic is questioned and normalcy challenged in this psychological suspense.

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Junjou de Nani ga Warui
synopsis:
"What's Wrong with Being Innocent?" 

I want to be sweetly embraced like a cherished treasure for my first time. That's when I thought to call a male escort service and make my dreams come true. What I got was a nightmare instead! Ryota would be the call boy who took my virginity, full throttle and nothing like how I wanted my first time to be. To make matters worse, turns out he's a student at my university. Wanting to try my luck again, I call the same escort service only to be sent Ryota a second time. Somehow he manages to make up for the last time and gives me the "sweet lover's special" I've always wanted...?! Love grows in between the lines of aloofness and passion on this clumsy heart-throbbing pendulum.

(Source: Shodensha)

title: Byakuda no Hanamuko
synopsis:
A white snake who is a divine messenger and a childhood friend with a mystery. Entangled obsessions in a Japanese-style fantasy. Tsubaki, a high school student with a predisposition for bad luck, has a one-sided love for his childhood friend Sakuyo, who is both beautiful and talented. Then, one day while leaving school, they are randomly attacked on the street. In the ancient capital Kyoto, a love story defying fate unfolds.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Kakuriyo no Sennichi Hina
synopsis:
It was summer in the 19th year of the Meiji era.

Child demon Torasuke (along with his pal Ushimatsu) gathered souls of humans whose lifespan had come to an end. Although supposed to be invisible to humans, one day, Torasuke is accosted by a human named Souma. Torasuke, who has never been involved with the people of the earthly realm, is asked by Souma to help exorcise a ghost...?

A touching and mysterious Meiji-era tale of the lives of this world and the afterlife.

(Source: Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha, translated)

title: Akuma de JK!
synopsis:
1-4. Akuma de JK!
5. Himekawa-san wa Chikamichi shitai
6. Onegaigaeshi (Returning the Favor)
7. Saimin App (Hypnosis App)
8. Sokuhame! Oneechan's (Instant Sex! Oneechan's!)

title: Mad Miniscape
synopsis:
Asahi is an ordinary girl who shares a small apartment with the boy she grew up with, Minoru. Which wouldn't be all that strange, except...Minoru died four years ago. The "thing" that occupies Asahi's apartment is nothing like her childhood friend—it's inhuman and grotesque, and it keeps demanding Asahi's life at every opportunity. But Asahi doesn't mind. As long as Minoru is there with her, absolutely nothing else matters...right?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Star Ginseng Store
synopsis:
The main character, Ji Suwon, is an ordinary teenager with no special characteristics other than being good at drawing. One day, while attending an academy, he fell in love for the first time when he saw Kim Harang, the female student sitting next to him. However, upon finding out she already had a boyfriend, Suwon fell into despair and swore to live an ordinary high school life. However, one day, while walking down the school hallway, he meets Seol Hyorim, the school's beauty, and falls in love once again...

(Source: Namu wiki, translated)

title: The Extra's Academy Survival Guide
synopsis:
Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Astro Baby
synopsis:
The remote town of North Hill has been quarantined to prevent the spread of the mysterious Couper disease that is turning people into cannibals. Young soldier Billy returns to his hometown for the first time in six years for the woman he loves, but what horrors will be awaiting him...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Melting Slowly
synopsis:
Yeomin Chae has been living in the shadow of her stepsister, Nari Chae, ever since they were kids. One day, Seungjae, Yeomin's ex-boyfriend, tells her that he's marrying Nari out of the blue. After being betrayed by the person she trusted most, she runs into Hwan Yun, who is the grandson of Taeju Group's chairman. Frustrated with her life, she suggests to Hwan that he marry her. As the two decide to get married, what exciting events and struggles will they encounter?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: One Step Closer to the Demon King
titleEnglish: One Step Closer to the Demon King
synopsis:
When the infamy of the Demon King echoes to the ocean's depths, Yuria, the king of the sea, decides to venture onto land and challenge them. However, the very act of gaining two legs robs her of all her power, transforming her into a helpless child. Now faced with this unexpected twist of fate, can Yuria rise above this setback and defeat the Demon King to claim her place as the most powerful being in the world?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Until the Tragic Male Lead Walks Again
titleEnglish: Until the Tragic Male Lead Walks Again
synopsis:
Countless marriage proposal rejections are nothing for Lamille Claude, a newly reincarnated character in the dark fantasy novel "The Broken Sword." Her mission is to prevent the male lead, Roel Arnen, from succumbing to all his misery and becoming the story's villain. To do so, she'll need to bring him under her protection as her husband until he regains the ability to use his legs and reclaims his former glory. But it isn't easy considering Roel's reluctance to accept Lamille's confessions of love. Will Lamille be able to win Roel's heart in time to save him from his tragic fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Zoku Thermae Romae
synopsis:
The year is 158 AD, and the Roman Empire thrives under the 20th year of Emperor Antoninus Pius’s reign. Lucius, a Roman bathhouse architect, is now sixty years old and plagued with back pain. His wife Satsuki has mysteriously disappeared, his son, Marius, is beyond comprehension...and to top it off, he still has the Roman bathhouses to worry about!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Brother From Another
synopsis:
Lim Shinyoon has been living a lie. A strange man is at the family dinner and reveals that Shinyoon is not actually a "Lim" but a "Nam." This, of course, means that he is not blood-related to any of his sisters...and this man also confesses that he is actually his real father?! And with a dying wish to have Shinyoon give him a grandchild before he leaves this earth?! Well, there are four highly suitable options sitting right there next to Shinyoon... No, these are his sisters! But well, now that he's a brother from another...everything could change!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Pool
synopsis:
Twenty years ago, a wormhole suddenly appeared above Earth's orbit and opened a passageway to an alien planet full of untapped resources and mysterious life forms. Two decades later, Team Sierra, a small military squad of security specialists working for the Tiberius Coke Corporation, are thirty miles away from home base on that planet when their leader, Chief Yugi Oishi, spots an SOS flare coming from a theoretically abandoned mine. Despite the danger, she leads her four-man team to the facility to see who'd called for help, only for it to be attacked by a horde of powerful creatures almost as soon as the doors close behind them. Now, she and the stranded exploratory excavation crew Team Sierra finds inside must traverse the treacherous mine to reach the only vehicle that could get them to safety—without waking the terrifying monster that's been picking off the researchers one by one...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: 1F no Kishi
synopsis:
"Fencing and fighting games are kind of alike, aren't they?" You use your head! You "read" your opponent! A fighting gamer takes on the challenge, this is the tale of an "unorthodox" knight's path!! Izumi Ichidou was devoted to fighting games, unexpectedly, he joins his high school's fencing club. "Fencing" and "gaming" are two seemingly unrelated sports, but when they are brought together, the curtain rises on a new kind of sports manga...!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Kesa mo Yuraretemasu ​
titleEnglish: They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning
synopsis:
Every morning at 6:58, commuters hurry onto the train at Sakuranomiya Station. For the past few months, a tentative romance has been brewing between two students from different schools. The young man is easily flustered, always stealing a glance at the young woman, but never making a move—much to the disappointment of the other passengers, who have been cheering them on in secret. Will this budding love story ever blossom?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kiyota-san wa Yogosaretai!?
synopsis:
Sumiko Kiyota is a plain, ordinary girl with a serious demeanor. While eating lunch alone as usual, Yuki Shirakawa, the most beautiful and popular girl in class, calls out to her...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Robou no Fujii
synopsis:
Is he an eccentric or a sage? Does the seemingly unremarkable company employee, Fujii, redefine the definition of "happiness?"

In the workplace, he's a plain middle-aged man who doesn't stand out. While he does his job properly, he's not one to waste words. Come quitting time, he disappears like a ghost. He's not the type to be invited to after-work drinks in the first place. More like, he's the guy who's thought of as "I wouldn't want to end up like that..." by his juniors.

Yet, he piques the curiosity of others... "I wonder how he was raised?" "Does he have friends or a girlfriend?" "What does he do on weekends?" Suddenly, you realize you've become captivated by Fujii... This elusive emotion that's hard to put into words is vividly captured by the author of Reborn no Kishi in this bewitching life drama!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Torano Tantei Jimusho e Youkoso
synopsis:
Due to a string of bad luck, Yano Kaisei is without a home, a job, or money. He happens to stumble upon a job posting for a live-in position at a detective agency, but the employer is Torano Jiu, a mighty tiger beastman! After Yano Kaisei starts working at the detective agency, his day-to-day includes juggling work duties and taking care of Torano's niece, Yui... A romantic comedy between a Beastman x Human!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tensei shitara Joban de Shinu Chuu-Boss Datta: Heroine Kenzoku-ka de Ikinokoru
titleEnglish: I Got Reincarnated as a Mid-Boss Who Dies at the Start of a Game.
synopsis:
When I woke up after an accident, I was reincarnated as a mid-boss destined to die in the early stages of the game! In order to avoid being killed by the hero who should come attacking soon, I will fight and make the women my subordinates to increase my allies! An exhilarating fantasy of survival in another world!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Nan Hong
synopsis:
When Wen Yifan returned to her hometown for work, she unexpectedly ran into the rumored "First-Class Handsome Guy" at a bar. However, she soon discovered that he was Sang Yan, someone she had hurt and rejected in high school. In a twist of fate, these two individuals who could never get along found themselves constantly crossing paths. They even ended up renting the same unit by chance and becoming housemates. With unspoken feelings buried deep within, strong emotions begin to stir...

Let's see how Sang Yan, the "Peak Ideal Boyfriend," interprets and expresses his profound affection and sweet love!

(Source: INKR)

title: Garan no Hime
synopsis:
A world where machine civilization has perished and immortal monsters called "Monotsuki" are rampant. Isana, a girl born in a remote village, meets a mechanical person who lost her memories and looks exactly like her sister, who should have disappeared in the ruins she wandered into. Convinced that "My sister is alive," Isana gives the mechanical person the name "Hime" (princess) and together they set out on a journey to find her sister.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Lost End
synopsis:
Challenge it. As many times as it takes until your spirit breaks. In order to rekindle the life that has been extinguished, in the harsh and merciless mountains of the underworld... A staggering dark survival epic depicted with overwhelming artistic skill.

(Source: Cygames, translated)

title: Surviving a Harem
synopsis:
Jun Yu, a WBA lightweight champion, gets dumped by his girlfriend, then gets hit by a car... and wakes up in a dating simulation game as Yujun Russell, the adopted DAUGHTER of a noble family! The game tells Jun that he can be reincarnated, but only after playing to win over the love of his target characters. Determined to see his ex-girlfriend again, he eagerly accepts the challenge. Will Jun be successful in winning the hearts of his suitors, and manage to return to the world he came from?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tensei Daiseijo no Isekai Nonbiri Kikou
titleEnglish: The Casual Chronicles of a Great Saint
synopsis:
In her previous life, Hirune Hanamaki worked herself to death at an extremely exploitative and inhumane company. Taking pity on her struggles, a goddess allows Hirune to be reincarnated in a fantasy world called Eversophia. Immediately upon waking up, Hirune finds herself in a church, where an archbishop named Zecytus takes her under his wing as an apprentice saint who is to put her divine powers to good use.

As a daunting list of tasks lies before her, Hirune worries that her past will repeat itself. However, she discovers that by becoming a great saint, she would have her own church and the freedom to relax and sleep to her heart's content. With this goal in mind, Hirune—together with her new friends Jeanne and Holly—begins working toward a peaceful life of leisure.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hitoner
synopsis:
An Earthling lands on a planet of beastkin, who are shocked to see a "human" for the very first time! The beastkins' observation of the "human" begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Wakeari Shinrei Mansion
synopsis:
Kaoru Shinonome, who had been living as a freelancer, invests her inheritance in property and buys a vast old condominium. Her dream life as a wealthy landlord is about to begin—but there are no living tenants, only spirits, and her new property is a rollercoaster ride of psychic phenomena. Kaoru embraces her new specter-filled life as the owner of Ghost Mansion and starts recruiting for new non-living residents!

(Source: Titan Comics)

title: Kaifukushoku no Akuyaku Reijou
titleEnglish: From Villainess to Healer: I Know the Cheat to Change My Fate
synopsis:
In the world of "Reas Love," a spinoff otome game, the villainess Charlotte Cocoriara's engagement to the prince of Farblume Kingdom is suddenly broken off. The reason? The Prince finds her job as Dark Mage ill-suited for his future queen. He'd rather be with a Healer, and there is no such thing as a job change. But Charlotte has a secret...memories of her past life playing "Reas Life Online," the original MMORPG! Armed with her cheat knowledge, Charlotte immediately takes off to the Sacred Land of Erenzi where she uses information no one else in "Reas Love" knows to change her job—to a Healer! Except she has no intention of going back to the Prince. What she really wants is to see the world and live a life full of adventure!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Boku no Manamusume
synopsis:
Sami's just a sweet little girl...who happens to have demonic powers. Her mom? A demon queen. Her dad? A totally normal human guy just trying not to get murdered by his in-laws.

Raising a half-devil daughter isn't easy—especially when her horns grow or she happens to summon demons. But the real challenge? Keeping her smiling at all costs...because if she ever feels lonely, Mama's coming back from the underworld—and Papa's toast!

A devilishly cute family comedy packed with mischief, magic, and heartwarming chaos.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kizumono no Hanayome: Shiitagerareta Watashi ga, Koukoku no Kijin ni Misomerareta Riyuu
synopsis:
When Nanao was a mere child, she was kidnapped by an Ayakashi. Since then, because of the spirit seal the Ayakashi carved on her body, Nanao has been oppressed by the people in her own clan as the "tainted one." Nanao was supposed to get married to the young master of the Byakurenji family, but her cousin Akemi stole her position as his bride, and she was forced to wear a monkey mask in order to hide the spirit seal, living a miserable life. Then one day, she meets Yako, the young head of the Benitsubaki clan. Due to an unforeseen event, Nanao's mask comes off and her face gets exposed, but that only causes Yako to become bewitched by her beauty and high spiritual power...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Undercover at Chaebol High
synopsis:
Dakyung, who was an active member of a corporate criminal organization, belatedly learns of the death of her boss, whom she cared for like a father. Later, she discovers the culprit is Chairman Lee, so she sets out on her path for revenge. However, approaching him is no simple matter. That's when she gets a clue related to Chairman Lee's son. For the final mission with her life on the line, Dakyung will have to infiltrate a high school for society's elite.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Insector
synopsis:
Humans are no longer at the top of the food chain. The creatures known as "Insectors" hide amongst us, using their supernatural insectile powers to prey upon humans. Miseong, a seemingly ordinary high school student, is also secretly an Insector. But unlike others of his kin, he directs his powers not at humans, but at Insectors instead. Will he maintain control over his abilities and use them for the good of mankind, or will he succumb to the monster within him?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The S-Class Lady
synopsis:
I'm done with romance, so send me home!

Kim Yi-young was just an ordinary civil service exam candidate in South Korea. After studying for more than four and a half years, she finally passed, a truly ordinary person with nothing but reading novels here and there as a hobby. However, on the day she went out for a celebratory meal after passing the exam, she got into a traffic accident and died, only to find herself reincarnated into the fantasy hunter novel she was reading.

To her, the "System" offered a way back home. Determined solely to return home and cuddle her warm cat and adorable Maltese, Cerberus, she gained strength through dozens of regressions. Signing contracts with the constellations of the original work and dying multiple times, she eventually succeeded in conquering the "Tower" of the original work and defeating the owner of the tower on the final floor.

Now, all that's left is to go home...

Or so she thought!

[Due to an error, instead of returning to the original world, we will reincarnate you into the author's new work!]

I don't need that! All I wanted was my sweet home! Is that so difficult?! I even got rid of the Tower!?!?! Moreover, romance fantasy?! Even…

title: Return of the Hound
synopsis:
After being brainwashed by the emperor, Yahn has served him as his loyal puppet. Upon finding out that he has been played by the emperor, Yahn vows vengeance, but he falls to the mighty emperor's powers. However, instead of dying, Yahn opens his eyes to find that he has gone back in time, to when he used to be a soldier in training. Will he now seek vengeance on the emperor, or will he go look for his family? The choice is now in his hands.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Silent Warrior
synopsis:
"Face your destiny." In the alternate realm of the Otherworld—filled with creatures and Earth's catastrophes—an ancient warrior, a human summoned long ago into the realm, is determined to bring it all to an end. Fueled by the resentment of an unknown past, this journey unravels hidden identities, embarks on undercover missions, faces death trials, navigates through betrayals, and wades through bloodbaths. What do the shadows conceal, and what destiny awaits in the heart of the unknown?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Juuou to Yakusou
titleEnglish: The Beast King: Master of Medicines
synopsis:
Tina, an adventurer, is gravely wounded while dungeon diving, and who should come across her but Garon—not just a monster, but the Beast King himself. In exchange for saving her life, Garon demands that Tina help him treat wounded monsters. It's the beginning of a fantasy story of humans, monsters, and medicine!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu: Dai-5 Shou - Mizu no Miyako to Eiyuu no Uta
synopsis:
One year after the events at the Sanctuary, Subaru Natsuki trains hard to better face future challenges. The peaceful days come to an end when Emilia receives an invitation to a meeting in the Watergate City of Priestella from none other than Anastasia Hoshin, one of her rivals in the royal selection. Considering the meeting's significance and the potential dangers Emilia could face, Subaru and his friends accompany her.

However, as Subaru reconnects with old associates and companions in Priestella, new formidable foes emerge. Driven by fanatical motivations and engaging in ruthless methods to achieve their ambitions, the new enemy targets Emilia and threaten the very existence of the city. Rallying his allies, Subaru must give his all once more to stop their nefarious goals from becoming a concrete reality.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: SKK: Shoujo-tachi no Sekai
synopsis:
In a mysterious world devoid of humans, Katana, Saya, and Kodachi are three inseparable friends. Their days are filled with laughter and games in the eerie quiet. But beneath this calm, an obscure presence lurks in the shadows...?! From the creator of Muto to Satou, Akatsuka-sensei, comes a new, uncharted adventure—innocence meets mystery in a world unknown!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: All Football Talents Are Mine
synopsis:
Ho-yeong dreamed of becoming a professional football player. But God didn't give him the talent, and he died by a lightning strike without achieving his dream. Then, the demon Mammon appeared and gave him the ability to steal the talent of other players.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Boukensha Zettai Korosu Dungeon
synopsis:
Dungeons—marvelous labyrinths packed full of dreams where heroes gather in search of fame and fortune. Unfortunately, Eine and Nacht can't say they feel the same. While all the other reincarnated earthlings get to live out awesome isekai fantasies, the two of them are stuck slaving away as dungeon staff! And whether those inconsiderate adventurers win or lose, a messy pile of corpses will need tidying up. But if the two are disposing of bodies anyway...then what's a few more? Why not make their workplace a terrifying deathtrap from which none ever return? Maybe then they'd finally have some peace and quiet!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sokuochi Lolibabaa
synopsis:
1. Jiangshi Meifei
2. Kyouju to Bakeneko (The Professor and the Bakeneko)
3. Yakkai Fan Elf
4. Anata no Sei desu yo (It's all your fault)
5. Oyasumi Grenadine (Sweet Dreams Grenadine)
6. Sokuochi Lolibabaa (Instant Loss Lolibabaa)

title: My Beloved Oppressor
synopsis:
When the hand that used to so lovingly hold Annette Rozenberg ends up being the one that causes the downfall of her family, Annette demands that Heiner Waldemar give her a divorce. But Heiner refuses, stating that he must see her miserable by his side, no matter what. At odds, the two continue a precarious relationship, only to be met with wounds of the past that bring them tragically together.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Haikei Mishiranu Dannasama, Rikon shite Itadakimasu
titleEnglish: To Sir, without Love: I'm Divorcing You
synopsis:
Byletta, daughter of a viscount who has talents for swords and business, has been married to Arnald, son of a count, for eight years...however, he was away at war, and they hadn't met even once. When the war ended, she decides to ask for divorce even before she sees his face. She writes Arnald a letter saying "Dear Sir, I would like to ask for divorce." Arnald, handsome but had never loved someone, and Byletta, who was rumored to be a villainess, meet for the first time in their bedroom. He asks for a wager, and guarantees her that he will divorce if Byletta wins. If he wins, they will stay married forever. "If I can get you with child in a month, I win." Arnald says. That was something Byletta could never imagine.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Damekko Mii-chan
synopsis:
Mii-chan is no good. She can't do what everyone else can do. At school, her friend Akemi-chan always throws buckets of water on her. Then one day, she meets Mike-kun, who is playing a game on the rooftop...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kowamote no Rinjin ga Ω datta Toki no Taishohou
titleEnglish: How to Deal When Your Intimidating Neighbor Is Actually an Omega
synopsis:
College student Kouta Enatsu is somewhat strange compared to his fellow alpha peers. Despite having many of the superior characteristics typical of the secondary sex, he is unable to smell pheromones and does not understand why all of his friends are obsessed with omegas—people whose secondary sex causes them to go into heats, which make them irresistible to alphas. Kouta instead longs for the days when they could just talk about baseball. But all of this changes when he smells incredibly intense pheromones on the other side of his apartment wall.

Thinking his tough-looking neighbor brought an omega home, Kouta leaves the area to give them some alone time. However, he is shocked when he discovers that despite his tough looks, his neighbor is an omega who is dealing with a powerful heat. Kouta steps up and does what he can to help but is left wondering how their relationship will evolve afterward.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Risou no Kanojo
synopsis:
Saeki is an ordinary high school boy with a girlfriend, Sara, who is the heiress of the Saionji Group, and whose beauty and intelligence are the envy of everyone.
