Sara seems like a prim and proper young lady to other people, but the two share a secret! Because of the secret, Saeki can't fully commit, but Sara prepares lunch for him, she hugs him to deepen their relationship, and she acts like she's trying to seduce Saeki to corrupt him!!!?

What is the secret of their relationship and what is Sara's true purpose...!!? A love comedy about a young lady disguising herself, and a boy in an enviable situation!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Reborn Young Lord Is an Assassin
titleEnglish: The Reborn Young Lord Is an Assassin
synopsis:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Act Like a Boss Monster, Mr. Swallow!
titleEnglish: Act Like a Boss Monster, Mr. Swallow!
synopsis:
The Primordial Core's an unconquerable dungeon, the lair of the most powerful monster ever to exist, the Original Monster, the incarnation of evil—Swallow... who happens to be a lazy boss monster who just wants to sleep. Taking care of this lazy bum is Renee, a homunculus maid whose obsession with Swallow knows no bounds. At this point, the only one keeping the dungeon running is Patrick, the last brain cell of the bunch—and he's a skeleton! Will Mr. Swallow get any rest amid all this chaos?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Married to a Duke Called Beast
titleEnglish: Married to a Duke Called Beast
synopsis:
Nadia Lancaster is the youngest daughter of a humble baron, and a proposal from the infamous Duke Staton was the last thing she was expecting. Afraid to refuse such a powerful man in the empire, she is forced to accept despite the chilling rumors that swirl around him. Before she knows it, it's their wedding night and her mind is filled with nothing but anxiety. Will Nadia be able to look past the rumors and give her new husband a chance, or does she found out that he really is a bloodthirsty beast and live out the rest of her marriage life in constant fear?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kimi wa Kawaii Reptile
synopsis:
Itsuki, twenty-seven years old, owns a reptile shop. He enjoyed life, surrounded by many kinds of lizards. Taking care of them is what makes him happy. He had no interest in human girls...he never had a girlfriend in his life. However...his favorite lizard, Fuu (Central Bearded Dragon), turned into a human girl! Now Itsuki has to feed her, bathe her, and help her with molting! A love comedy of a shy boy and lizard-girls!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Sensei! Bokutachi ga Sekai wo Horoboshimasu.
titleEnglish: Teacher, We Will Destroy the World!
synopsis:
Teachers are entrusted with the sacred duty of guiding and protecting their students—but not undercover assassin Mr. Solo. In a world where magic users and non-users coexist, he walks a solitary path as the wizard hitman "Number Zero." His latest mission: pose as a magic instructor for the unruly, bottom-tier, second-year students of Class D. To complicate things, he's saddled with a new partner—a transfer student with the same deadly assignment. As they pursue dangerous student targets, unexpected twists arise in this exciting magic school fantasy!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Demihuman Share House
synopsis:
When Kei Satou, a corporate slave with low communication skills, applies to live in a share house, he thinks that it'll be a good way for him to make friends. But the other three occupants of this house seem a little different...almost monstrous even? Can Kei overcome his introversion and become friends with these supernatural girls!?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Choudokyuu Cheat Akuyaku Reijou no Karei naru Fukushuutan
titleEnglish: The Remarkable Revenge of a Vindictive Villainess
synopsis:
The protagonist awakens to find herself reincarnated as Lunaria il von Solfege, her beloved villainess from her favorite game. However, along with this new identity come Lunaria's tragic memories—public condemnation, complete abandonment, and ultimately, a desperate attempt to take her own life with a dagger. "You can leave everything to me, Lunaria. Now that I am you, I will never let them get away with this," she vows. The remarkable revenge of a villainess fighting for the sake of love starts here.

(Source: K Manga)

title: Kurage no Uta
synopsis:
When 18-year-old Kazuma Inoue is introduced to fellow student Otoha Mizuki's trending music, he is left unsatisfied, as he would rather maintain his focus on practicing for his upcoming track and field competition. One evening while on a run, Kazuma happens to run into Otoha, and her in-person singing captures him in a way her recordings failed to. After revealing his feelings, Kazuma is surprised to learn that Otoha shares his opinion in disliking the music she records. His interest now piqued, Kazuma begins to regularly seek out Otoha and learn more about her. As the two observe their respective interests and confide in each other, Kazuma and Otoha find themselves growing more confident in their abilities and more motivated to achieve their goals.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isekai Teni shite Kyoushi ni Natta ga, Majo to Osorerareteiru Ken: Aoi-sensei no Gakuen Funtou Nisshi
titleEnglish: The Fearsome Witch Teaches in Another World: Ms. Aoi's Lesson Plans
synopsis:
Stripped of her life for reasons unknown, Aoi Konominato wakes up as a child in an unfamiliar world, still haunted by regret and goals left unfulfilled. After twelve years of learning under the tutelage of an elven sage named Owain, she's mastered the art of sorcery and is sent by her wise—if eccentric—mentor to the renowned Fiddich Academy to serve as an instructor and further her studies.

Bitter memories of her past life as a fledgling teacher still nip at her heels, yet despite her initial reluctance, Aoi knows that this is her chance to do things better. Determination won't be enough, though. Between misbehaving students of noble birth and elitist instructors, Aoi may have bitten off more than she can chew...or she might just be the missing ingredient the academy needs to become a paragon of educational equality and discipline.

Class is in session, and the fearsome witch of Fiddich Academy has come prepared to teach them all a lesson they won't soon forget.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Price Is Your Everything
synopsis:
Transported back to her first academy days, Nerys Truydd revisits a life marred by betrayal and torment. Exploited and poisoned by her own family and husband, her demise was met with a vow to curse those who wronged her. Now granted a second chance, Nerys vows to rewrite her fate. As she navigates her past, memories of those who hurt her flood back. Determined and fueled by retribution, she seeks to reclaim all she lost. Can she overturn her tragic past and emerge victorious from the shadows of her betrayal?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Xiao Mogu
synopsis:
In the year 2020, Earth's magnetic poles disappeared and humankind was nearly wiped out by cosmic radiation. Within the span of a hundred years, living creatures began to mutate and devour each other while the remaining humans, numbering in the tens of thousands, struggled bitterly in their man-made bases.

In the Abyss, home to the mutated xenogenics, there lived a sentient little mushroom. Because it had been nourished by the blood and flesh of the deceased human An Ze, not only did it take on a similar-looking human form, but a similar name as well: An Zhe.

An Zhe is determined to go to the human base to search for his spore, which had been harvested by humans. Once there, however, he faces the omnipresent risk of discovery and certain death as he tries to keep his non-human nature hidden from the Judges, whose responsibility is to inspect for and eliminate xenogenics like himself. And of all the Judges, Colonel Lu Feng is the most perceptive and merciless—as soon as he determines that someone is a xenogenic, he will execute that person on the spot.

But An Zhe's mutation goes undetected by Lu Feng's eyes, and so a tale of humans and xenogenics unfolds...

(Source: Peach Flowe…

title: Zai Jian, Wo de Guo Wang
synopsis:
When Zhang Li left for a trip to the Ebiz ruins, he didn't expect to bring back company, especially not a man made of stone! Though Li grows fond of the living statue, their time together doesn't last long, as "Rocky" soon crumbles before Li's eyes. Wishing for a miracle, Li suddenly finds himself in Ebiz far back in the past and reunites with Rocky. However, his companion is no longer a statue but rather the nation's king, who doesn't recognize Li at all and imprisons him! How will Li escape this predicament and get his beloved back?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hottarakashi Meshi
synopsis:
At 25, Fuuko's true love isn't romance; it's food. Her path to cooking begins with a lucky bingo win—a nifty rice cooker! But with her kitchen occupied by her pet hermit crab, Hikki, Fuko has to get creative... Cooking with only a rice cooker?! Challenge accepted! Join Fuuko as she steams ahead in this lazy gourmet adventure!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Gal Maid to Akuyaku Reijou: Ojousama no Happy End shika Katan!
synopsis:
Celina, a gal, has been reincarnated into the world of an otome game that her otaku friend had been strongly suggesting she play. Celina, who has been reincarnated as merely a mob character, decides to become a maid for the villainess Almeria, but...

A fantasy yuri love comedy about a maid (former life: gal) who devotes herself to making the villainess happy!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Unemployed Gye Baek-soon
synopsis:
"I have nothing saved up, my qualifications are average, and my bank balance is always below ten thousand won." Can Gye Baek-soon, who is described as a 'spine breaker,' really escape being unemployed?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: No Man's Land
synopsis:
It was on a fateful day when ordinary guy, Lee Seon-woong, found himself transported to a mysterious new world. Initially excited to make his fantasy adventure debut, his hopes are quickly dashed when he discovers he was granted no special powers or blessings. Although Seon-woong is devastated by the news that he'll have to navigate this no man's land without any cheat codes, he soon realizes the term "no man's land" means something more literal around these parts, and he has something special attached to him that no other inhabitant does...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Log in to Lust-a-land
synopsis:
Nothing out of the ordinary has ever happened to Namjoo, that is, until the day he picks up a mislaid USB on the street. Curiosity gets the better of him and when he takes a look inside, he finds a steamy VR game that's still in the works. To Namjoo, the game looks ready for release, but little does he know about the bug that's affecting all of the NPCs and making all of them super horny. Meanwhile, Hye-na's panicking about her lost USB and is determined to get it back before more people find out about the game's fatal flaw. Join Namjoo and Hye-na on their journey to Lust-a-land, a world that isn't for the faint of heart...or the low of libido.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Foam of the Sea
synopsis:
Despite the war raging between the North and South, Margaret is a northerner who holds an unwavering love for her southern lover, Squall... until he cruelly betrays her and pushes her off a seaside cliff.

Just when she's about to drown, the voice of a mysterious witch offers her a second chance at life. However, this chance only comes to her seven years later, when she rises from the ocean in a new body without a voice. Although Margaret receives help from a local apothecary named Jack, the other southern villagers aren't as eager to let an outsider into their fold...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Otameshi to wa Ie, Sukisugiru
synopsis:
Hiroki Oogami, a drugstore employee, enjoys chatting with Shintaro Takimoto, a customer who always visits the drugstore just before closing time. In a strange turn of events, Shintaro confesses to him and they decide to try a relationship. As they go on dates, Hiroki sees new unexpected sides of Shintaro, but...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Shibatte Mitsumete
titleEnglish: Tie Me Up, Stare Me Down.
synopsis:
Sawada is the manager of the sales promotion department at the headquarters of a food supermarket. He is caught between his superiors and subordinates, and his struggles are endless. One day after working overtime, while looking for a place to have a drink, he sees a sign that says "Fetish Bar." When he opens the door, he is greeted by women dressed in fishnet stockings and bondage gear!? After experiencing bondage by Nana, the most popular queen, Sawada experiences pleasure and a sense of freedom he has never felt before...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Memorial
synopsis:
In a future where the world has been devastated by a deadly gas called Izpo, Minhui and his friends find themselves embroiled in a thick conspiracy—where the stakes are high, and bets are made with one’s life. Only the Memorial Chips guard humanity against the lethal gas that permeates the atmosphere. But are these electronic securities truly built to guard us—or watch us? Follow Minhui as he examines what reality is, and comes face-to-face with the truth that will change him forever.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Child Who Looks Like Me
titleEnglish: A Child Who Looks Like Me
synopsis:
A surprise pregnancy sends Jeong-o, a college junior, into a panic. Her supportive boyfriend Jiheon plans a loving proposal, but a car accident erases his recent memories, including their romance. Seven years later, they reunite unexpectedly—but Jiheon has no recollection of Jeong-o or the fact that they share a precious daughter between them.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Astral Online: Maou no Noroi de Saikyou Bishoujo ni Natta Ore, Saijakushoku da ga Cheat Skill de Chou Seichou shite Musou suru
titleEnglish: Astral Online: I, Who Became the Strongest Beautiful Girl Due to the Demon King's Curse, Have the Weakest Job, But I Grow Up Super Fast With My Cheat Skills and Become a Warrior.
synopsis:
Sora Kamijou, a high school boy who is addicted to VR games, starts playing Astral Online, a VRMMO that has been talked about as a god game, and suddenly finds himself fighting against the Demon King, the last boss. In addition to the sudden battle, the Demon King casts a curse on him and transforms him into a beautiful silver-haired girl...? A new VRMMO fantasy involving both the game and reality begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Darenimo Ienai
synopsis:
Chiaki is handsome, academically gifted, athletic, and born into a wealthy family with a beautiful sister. Despite his seemingly perfect life, he faces a persistent problem: he's never been lucky in love and struggles to capture the attention of girls. Determined to turn things around in high school, he wakes up one morning to a surprising transformation—he has turned into a girl!

He is shocked to find out that he has lost the appearance he was so proud of, but when he looks in the mirror, he sees a very cute girl in the reflection. He immediately goes to show it off to his twin sister Kaede, who happens to be very popular with the girls, but there is also something very strange happening to her...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kiraware Majo to Karada ga Irekawatta keredo, Watashi wa Kyou mo Genki ni Kurashiteimasu!
synopsis:
A happy slow life begins with a switch! Marietta, princess of the snow country of Snewe, is trapped in a magic tower because she can't use magic. Eight years later, on her wedding day with the prince of the silver country, she thought she had succeeded in summoning a holy beast, but then... What appeared was...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Dekkawaii
synopsis:
Ever since a girl rejected him due to his height, Amane Komi had long abandoned the hope of anything exciting in his school life. However, after meeting his tall classmate Asumi Obinata, his heart has begun to flutter once more.

Obinata is not only the tallest person in the class, but she also practices martial arts and possesses extraordinary strength. Contrasting her appearance, she is always bubbly and caring about the people around her, which has captured Komi's heart.

Having mustered enough courage, Komi reveals his romantic feelings to Obinata. Although taken aback, she gladly accepts his heartfelt confession. As the unique couple spends more time together, their bond blossoms into a tender romance.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Spicy Milk Candy
synopsis:
Aki Izumi, the student council president, is a serious and honest young man. He has a secret boyfriend who possesses the gentle smile of a prince, someone he always feels proud of. He immersed himself in the love that his boyfriend Iichi gave him, enjoying the sweet aftertaste that love life brings. Because of a certain incident, Izumi was forced by Iichi to participate in "Punishment Play," something that had never happened before...!

“You have to apologize properly, can you do that?”

He couldn't move his arms and the words were harsh and sounded like scolding. Izumi panicked because he couldn't believe that the guilty feeling of being scolded made him feel pleasure...?!

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: I Listened to My Husband and Brought In a Lover
titleEnglish: I Listened to My Husband and Brought In a Lover
synopsis:
Louise wants nothing more than to live a happy life with her husband, Reyard. She loves her husband so much even though he has never been faithful to her. She had to watch him bring home mistresses and pretend like she wasn't bothered by it. After all, Reyard was never deceitful about his wishes. He told her that if she were to object to his lovers, then their marriage would be over. Louise feels lower than low, so when Reyard insists that she take on a lover of her own... she does just that.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Oshi to no Yuri wa Arienai!
synopsis:
An Tsukamoto, the too-perfect class president, is worried that Kaoru Kenzaki, a gal in her class, is so stupid that she's at risk of repeating the year...! An, who can't tolerate anything but perfection, struggles to correct Kaoru...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: I Swear We're Just Friends
synopsis:
Karcion Liciantus is a celebrity at the prestigious Alena Academy. He wields magic with unprecedented ease and, owing to his noble background, rarely refrains from harming others. To minimize contact with his admirers, Karcion decides to create a private after-school club with one friend he tolerates, but there is a small issue: they need a third member to officially start the club.

Enter Rienne, a stunning commoner and transfer student who has already set hearts aflutter around the academy. As the only person who has yet to get on Karcion's bad side, Rienne receives an invitation to join his club. Contrary to Karcion's initial fears, Rienne is indifferent to his looks and power, but something about her nonchalance and flirty remarks completely enamors him. However, the discrepancy in their social status makes romance impossible, and Rienne must resist Karcion's affection to convince all the envious students—and herself—that they are nothing more than friends.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Escape From the Daytime Drama
synopsis:
An unknown actress's life is ruined when she wakes up as Cha Yeryeon, the villainess of a daytime drama. Determined to avoid an antagonist's fate, Yeryeon works to nudge the story toward a different ending. But as her actions threaten to upend the lives of other characters, Yeryeon has to figure out how to get her satisfying story while also protecting the people she cares for. Will Yeryeon flip the script and change the drama for the better? Or will she be stuck playing the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Potion Witch
synopsis:
In Blalock City, every criminal fears the mysterious vigilante Witch Raven. When night falls, even the shadiest wrongdoers all fall victim to the witch's curse, which leaves them with physical alterations they cannot conceal nor cure. However, during the day, Witch Raven is just an ordinary pharmacist named Vanna Spalding.

Vanna proudly runs her humble little herbs and potions shop, but beneath her innocent store actually lies a hidden basement full of illegal potions and evidence of her nighttime identity. Vanna is confident no one will ever discover her secret, until one day when she finds a police officer, Sion Crawford, standing in the middle of her hideout. The police are after Witch Raven, but Sion seems disinterested in arresting her. Instead, when one of Vanna's experimental potions causes a small accident, Sion enlists her help in investigating a case that may soon prove to be far more serious than either of them are prepared for.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Oui ni Tsuita Ken
synopsis:
"Eat Or Die!" The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he's searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, "You have promise. Become my apprentice." How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there's a secret that only she knows, and that he's stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn't end things; no, it's only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Gakeppuchi Reijou wa Kurokishi-sama wo Horesasetai!
titleEnglish: Marrying the Dark Knight (For Her Money)
synopsis:
Clarice's younger sister is her whole world. In a world of monsters, born into a noble family that's gone broke, there's nothing Clarice wouldn't do for her. So when she gets sick, and there's only one way to save her, Clarice doesn't blink! She agrees to an arranged marriage with the Dark Knight, a ferocious warrior who goes everywhere in magical armor—even their wedding! Afterward, Clarice is ready to consummate the marriage and charm her new spouse into paying to save her sister's life. There's just one problem: The Dark Knight won't let her into the bedroom! And Clarice finally finds out why...she's secretly a woman! With female knights forbidden, the Knight seriously lacking in social graces, a household full of servants scared out of their wits, and monster fights breaking out constantly, Clarice realizes that this wedding of convenience is going to be more inconvenient than she bargained for!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Koibito Tutorial
synopsis:
The prince-like girl, Asahi, and supposedly normal (but of course handsome and earnest) guy Kuro are in the same club. They agree to pretend to date as a "Boyfriend/Girlfriend Tutorial."

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Childhood Friend Complex
synopsis:
Ha-neul and Mincheol have been childhood friends for all of their lives, but their relationship takes on a whole new dynamic when they undergo a series of unexpected events. Although they vowed that they'd never be romantically attracted to each other, they just might be proven wrong... especially when things start to escalate and neither can predict where they'll end up.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mitsuba Monogatari: Noroi no Shoujo to Shi no Rondo
synopsis:
Awakening from a prolonged slumber with a mysterious sense of omnipotence, the girl Mitsuba finds herself far from welcomed by her stepmother. Through the stepmother's scheming, Mitsuba not only loses her noble title but is also forced to enroll in a military academy. However, Mitsuba harbors vague memories of another world and unwittingly possesses the power of a curse. This is the tale of a girl who, despite being feared by those around her, forges her own path with extraordinary abilities—a unique narrative of conquest in a different world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Grand Duke's Fox Princess
synopsis:
Help, I'm stuck as a fox and can't turn back into a human! I, Princess Eristella Leonalph, am the greatest magician in the empire, but I've been cursed to be hated by everyone. I was chasing after dark magicians when I became stuck like this! How am I supposed to break the curse? Maybe my fiancé, Grand Duke Heinlesione, can help, but our relationship is rocky... Well, even if I become a palace pet, I can't give up! After all, some things are easier when you're an adorable little fox.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Princess Maid
synopsis:
Princess Siana quietly endured her parents' abuse for years, but when Crown Prince Rashid of the nearby empire conquers her kingdom and kills her entire family, she refuses to die without standing up for herself. Siana begs for her life, and Rashid allows her to be a maid at the palace, where she thrives in her simple life of service... until that new life is threatened by Rashid's interest in her. Can Siana finally enjoy the peace she deserves, or will Rashid's fascination disrupt it all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Afterglow
synopsis:
Higuchi Kiyotaka has hit rock bottom. Once a promising doctor on his way to becoming a cardiovascular surgeon, a traumatic incident has forced him to relocate to a rural town in Kyushu where he's relegated to practicing general medicine. Each day is a struggle to communicate with his heavily accented patients and overcome his intense feelings of guilt and depression. After an evening spent drinking himself into a stupor, he has a fateful encounter with a mysterious yakuza named Tenju, who promises to help the young doctor forget all his troubles for a night. As Higuchi finds himself drowning in unknown pleasures, he can't help but wonder—just who exactly is Tenju? And what does he want from him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: It's Just Business
synopsis:
"A love life? Give me a break." A complete non-believer when it comes to romance, Eunho is focused on climbing the ladder at work. Smart with excellent social skills to boot, both her bosses and clients love her. But when a new hire suddenly appears in front of her and an old first love start to shake things up again, she can't help but waver.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Merciless
synopsis:
Do Janggon is a human weapon and former special forces spy against North Korea. When both of his arms got injured he was caught and brought to the Daesan Welfare Center, that abuses human rights and exploits labor. The doctor said it would take him a month to fully recover. So he has to hold out in the welfare center until his arms are healed.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Matte, Suki.
synopsis:
Haruto Shinozaki is a successful Tokyo stylist and the boyfriend of up-and-coming actor Aoi Kuga. In spite of their busy schedules, they do their best to make time for each other. When Aoi shares that he's been cast as the star in an upcoming movie being filmed in Hokkaido, Haruto is thrilled for his lover, yet sad at the prospect of spending three months apart. Only minutes after hearing the news, though, Haruto receives his own offer to fill-in as a hair and make-up artist for the same movie Aoi is starring in! Will they be able to keep their relationship a secret? Or will working in such close proximity expose their love to the world?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Koi ni Koisuru Koibito Kankei
synopsis:
Asako Ichijou, the student council president at a prestigious girls' high school, has been racking her brain about the ladykiller Nagi Tenma. That's the sort of person Asako is, but Nagi discovers Asako has broken school rules by bringing a shoujo manga to school...

Asako pleads with Nagi to keep it a secret, and Nagi reveals her condition: "Become my lover."

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Goze Hotaru
synopsis:
After losing her mother early on, Hotaru, a girl surrounded by warmth and tranquility, finds her life taking a dramatic turn. An unexpected event draws her into the world of "Goze," setting her on a path through unknown lands with music as her guide. Armed with her talent and a heart full of questions, she embarks on a quest, seeking her missing father and her true calling...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Degree of Love
synopsis:
Yejin, a smart girl from a poor family who gets into a top university, has zero dating experience. Now that she's in college, she wants to find love, so she puts herself out there, but... Enter Hyeon, an elite Taekwondo athlete, her only guy friend from childhood, who masquerades as her "bestie," but is he really? Yejin is determined to support her family through academic achievement, but she also wants love. Can she have both? How will Yejin navigate the journey of having it all?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Family with Benefits
synopsis:
Some things are thicker than water. Kwak Jahyung lives his life surrounded by hot women—too bad they just happen to be his sisters, as his playboy father has more children than he can count. But boys will be boys, and Jahyung is no exception. After his older sister Hanna gives him a potion meant to screw him over, the two find themselves in a sticky situation that goes to show family can be closer than you'd ever imagine...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Senpai, Chotto Ii desu ka?
synopsis:
A super-sheltered girl, Rei Shiranui, has a lot of things she doesn’t know! She asks her questions to her senpai, who is also a library committee member. But sometimes, her questions are hard to answer...!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Trapped With the Male Lead in a Horror Game
titleEnglish: Trapped With the Male Lead in a Horror Game
synopsis:
I became a maid inside of a horror game. Penalties were given to the male lead, who was trying to escape being locked up in a large mansion, and I acted as a guide. I was going to fulfill my duties until the male lead's play ends.

"When I get out, I'll lock you up exactly the same way."

The male lead is so noisy. If it's going to be like this, I'll just help him escape faster.

"Let's eat, Dietrich."
"This is a potion, it'll help you recover faster if you take it."
"The hint to escape is over there..."

I fed him well to prepare for the next play, and when the male lead got hurt, I gave him a potion so he could quickly play the next game,
I even gave him a hint for the problem. You'll be able to get out now, right? However...

"I don't really know the answer."

What's the meaning of this? Aren't you supposed to be smart? ...The male lead doesn't think about leaving the mansion at all.

"If you won't get out, I will," I shouted in anger because I was so sick of the thought of having to see the face of someone I don't want to keep seeing.

"Is it possible for you to get out of here?" His eyes sank bitterly. "Let me tell you this, I have no intention of leaving this place."
"What?"…

title: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
titleEnglish: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
synopsis:
When I transmigrated into a novel, I did what anyone would do—propose to my favorite character, Grand Duke Reigrein. I mean, he's the perfect man, so who wouldn't want to marry him? As Schueur, I was supposed to be the villainess, but I'd rather save my honey! His Highness's special ability consumes his emotions every time he uses it, so my goal is to awaken feelings in him. So far, I've only caused him irritation and annoyance, but one day I'll make him notice me!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ghost Fixers
synopsis:
Following a certain event, Mikurigaoka New Town transformed into a crucible of supernatural phenomena known as GHOSTS! In said town lives Hifumi, a middle school boy, who one day encounters a girl who just moved in...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: End Roll no Ato ni wa Saikou no Tabi wo
titleEnglish: Have a Great Trip After the End Credits
synopsis:
Aino the Hero and Iro the Mage. After defeating the Demon King, the two women embark on a journey around the world to fulfill a promise they made long ago. This is their story after the end credits roll—the greatest adventure dedicated to each other. A heartrending, radiant road trip fantasy.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Busa Neko ni Kaerareta Kiyowa Reijou desu ga, Saikyou no Gunjin Koushaku ni Hirowarete Kizetsu Sunzen desu
titleEnglish: A Timid Lady Was Turned into an Ugly Cat, but on the Verge of Fainting Is Picked Up by the Most Fearsome Military Duke
synopsis:
Marie's life as a viscount's daughter is snatched away when her own sister curses her to become a cat...and then steals her betrothed! Forsaken, she collapses from hunger, when tender hands reach out—and on the other side is the undefeated duke with a reputation for being cruel and unfeeling?! Marie's turn from misfortune to a comfortable cat life begins here!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Gobbling the Goblin
synopsis:
A most loutish goblin named Heuk-ran is the master of Goblin Mountain. He's a powerful creature who enjoys tormenting humans as if they were his personal playthings. The people tried all that they could to appease him but even the great shaman couldn't get through to him. But as he finds his next victim to satisfy his whims, will he finally be outfoxed by the clever little Yeon?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kizu darake Seijo yori Houfuku wo Komete
titleEnglish: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess
synopsis:
Lua is a saintess candidate who possesses the power of healing. But her ability had one flaw: she could only heal others by transferring their wounds onto herself. Because of this, others bullied her, calling her the "Fallen Saintess." But it didn't bother Lua because her best friend Arianne always stood up for her.

One day, Lua's crush, Commander Garrett, was on the brink of death from a beast attack. Lua healed him, which left her on the verge of death. When she woke up, she learned that all the credit was given to Arianne, and she finally saw her best friend's true color. Devastated, Lua is lost and helpless when the second prince appears in front of her with a tempting offer. What would happen to Lua as she begins her new life as a villainess?

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Tensei Akuma no Saikyou Yuusha Ikusei Keikaku
titleEnglish: Reincarnated Devil's Plan for Raising the Strongest Hero
synopsis:
Kakyu, a former Japanese who was reincarnated as a low-level demon in hell, has acquired unparalleled strength over two thousand years. However, unexpectedly, he is exiled to another "different world," liberated from the harsh underworld. Kakyu, who was enjoying his dream slow life, witnesses the village he owes everything to being attacked. Despite rushing to the scene, the village is annihilated. Picking up the only surviving baby, Alus, Kakyu resolves to raise Alus to become the happiest person in the world to repay the debt...!?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Adopted by a Murderous Duke Family
titleEnglish: Adopted by a Murderous Duke Family
synopsis:
After ten years of being exploited by Duke Gerwehr for her healing powers, Agnes meets her death in a dungeon. When she wakes up, she finds herself in her uncle's house before she was sold to Duke Gerwehr in the slave market. Desperate for her past life not to repeat itself, she lets Duke Rodwick adopt her and starts her new life with a new name, Tuariche Rodwick. Will she be able to keep her healing powers secret in this notorious family of assassins and find true happiness and love in her new life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Utsuranain desu
synopsis:
A lonely high school boy suffers from seeing creepy things that shouldn't exist. He encounters an enthusiastic girl from the school's occult research club who would die to see ghosts herself. Used to dealing with the burden of the supernatural all by himself, the boy might have finally found an unexpected ally in her. And possibly... a friend?

(Source: Manga Mogura RE)

title: Tameshi ni Command Ittemita
synopsis:
"Masa, Sit."

Masa, the owner of a boutique clothing store, is best friends with the heartthrob fashion model, Oto. Together, they turn heads wherever they go. Both are also high-level Doms. However, Oto struggles with the strength of his commands, making him too intense for any sub partners he's had so far. Masa, on the other hand, has three regular partners. Seeking advice, Oto invites Masa out for dinner, where he playfully gives Masa a command, and then...?!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: The Villain's Daughter Plans to Run Away
titleEnglish: The Villain's Daughter Plans to Run Away
synopsis:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!

I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?

(Source: Manta)

title: Yume to Koi dewa Tsuriawanai
synopsis:
Hikaru Kurata has fallen in love with her classmate Kairi Kira at first sight. Now, she's too lovestruck to concentrate on her studies. Her plan? Get Kairi to reject her so she can focus again.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life
titleEnglish: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life
synopsis:
In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she's the strongest hunter in the world. But when a time traveling stranger warns her of humanity's bleak future, will Jio finally take action? And what enemies are waiting for her to reveal her true identity?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Curious Case of Chronicle
synopsis:
In a world where magic co-exists with the rule of nobles, Adrian Lawrence seemed to have gotten lucky in life as the second son of a viscount. Despite this, Adrian is an outcast in a home controlled by his scheming stepmother and half-brother, who are set on ousting him. Little do they know that Adrian plays the game Chronicle Online, where he possesses great powers that can also be used in reality! With heirship to the viscounty up for grabs, can Adrian use his powers to level up his real life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Naisho no Stalker-san
synopsis:
Kadoya is a resilient, hardworking, and gentle person, so he's often pushed to do a lot of work. He has this certain "secret." He is living strangely with someone he can't see. When he comes home completely exhausted, there's a hot bath and meal prepared for him. And at night... "He" comes to his side and holds him.

Kadoya feels so perfectly supported in everything, from housework to letting out sexual frustrations that it feels like he can't live without "him" anymore...!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: The Last Adventurer
synopsis:
In the Era of Adventure kickstarted by the spawning of Gates, marked by absolute hopelessness, destitute, desperation, and despair, everyone had given up their hope and lost their courage to continue fighting—except one adventurer that refused to go down until his last breath. "You are the only one left, Last Adventurer Elpam." As the history of adventurers was forced to come to an end, the Last Adventurer returned to where this story all began.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mizudako-chan kara wa Nigerarenai!
synopsis:
Kanisuke Akigai is just your average high school student, but when a demi-human girl named Yuuko Mizuda (nicknamed Mizudako-chan) transfers into his class, his life is turned upside down! She's cute, mysterious...and a little scary? The pressure is on as Kanisuke tries to understand his strange new classmate!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Akuyaku Reijou ga Sei Heroine wo Kudoki Otosu Hanashi.
titleEnglish: When the Villainess Seduces the Main Heroine
synopsis:
When the crown prince announces he's breaking off his engagement to the infamous Akuya, his spurned fiancée wastes no time in turning her seductive words of passion to her actual target—Sei, a commoner who worked her way up through the ranks with her wit and charm alone...and is also the very girl the prince dumped Akuya for! Sei's about to get a taste of what a real lover's like in this steamy tale of two girls who traded in their Prince Charming for each other instead!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ashita Ai Kamoshirenai
synopsis:
Art university student Nagi Kitagawa is hopelessly in love with Yuu Yamasaki, his senpai in the folk song club who also happens to be his next door neighbor. Yuu seems to have it all—good looks, a great personality, and he's also super popular—so Nagi can't help but think he'd never fall for a shy, innocent country bumpkin like him. One night, after drinking too much at one of their club get-togethers, Nagi helps a drunk Yuu get home safe—but before he can go back to his own apartment, Yuu wraps Nagi in his arms and falls asleep, trapping Nagi in his embrace. Nagi sneaks out the next morning, careful to not wake Yuu up, and vows to keep the incident a secret. But when Nagi finds himself growing closer and closer to Yuu, his unrequited feelings only grow stronger... And could it be that his love isn't as one-sided as he thinks it is...?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Yankee to Caraméliser
synopsis:
Take one influencer and one bad boy extraordinaire, whisk in a sprinkling of sweets, a scoop of social media, and you get...? Maki and Akito's love story, hot out of the oven! After all, even though Maki might have a bit of a bad rep, the guy must be just as gooey on the inside as the glorious goodies he posts all over social media. So when Akito gets a taste of how dangerously delicious his desserts are, he can't help wanting a taste of the man himself...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Executioner
synopsis:
A hero should never kill anyone, not even the worst of villains. Gangyu could never understand why his team of heroes lived by those words, but he tried his best to do the same... until the villain who wiped out his squad killed his brother in prison. Gangyu breaks his vow and enters Ruculus with permission to kill as the prison's executioner. Now, he must fight his way through the villains to kill the worst of them all. 

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Drama na Koi wa Kihon kara
titleEnglish: Dramatic Love Starts from the Basics
synopsis:
Yuuki Shinji is an ordinary businessman, 35 years old, single, no girlfriend, living at home. He is worried about his future as a single man, but he has little experience in love and is afraid of marriage activity. But when he meets a female doctor, he falls in "love beyond his imagination," a love that turns his life upside down!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Monster Princess of the Snowy Mountain
titleEnglish: Monster Princess of the Snowy Mountain
synopsis:
Valerie Beloff, a princess in exile, decides to take her own life on her 19th birthday. Abused by her own mother and exiled for her mother's crimes, she had to live in the freezing Makleroad palace by herself, and she somehow acquired the powers of an ancient monster—the power to freeze things. Hopeless, she seeks an escape in death... only to find herself before her cruel mother, yelling at her once again. Is she dead? Is she reliving a memory? When her mother strikes her, the throbbing pain lets her know that this is neither a dream nor a memory!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Koi no Chishiryou
synopsis:
He'll never forget him—his ex-classmate Yuu, that is. College student Ryousuke was absolutely devastated when Yuu confessed his feelings and then promptly disappeared from his life without waiting for a reply. After desperately searching for years, Ryousuke is overjoyed when they suddenly meet by chance. His happiness is soon eclipsed by the fact that Yuu walks off into the arms of another man...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Black and White Martial Emperor
synopsis:
The great house of the Azure Mountain Yeon clan was annihilated by forces that conspired against them. The only survivor was Yeon Hojung. Left alone in the uncaring expanse of the central plains, Hojung turned to the path of darkness for survival and ruthlessly chased power to become the Dark Emperor. After a long, bloody battle that ended in his demise, Hojung reawakens to find himself 26 years in the past with his beloved Yeon Clan and a second chance at life.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Reincarnated King of Fists
synopsis:
In a world where humans enslave non-human species, the powerful wizard Leppenhardt creates an empire to safeguard these beings. However, his reign ends when he's defeated by the brutally strong Tesron, the "King of Fists." But death isn't the end, because Leppenhardt awakens in Tesron's young body! Now armed with incredible strength and a new identity, he sets off to free the non-human races again. Can the new King of Fists reshape the world for all, or will his second chance slip away?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Wail of a Dragon's Rage
synopsis:
Ananta, a descendant of one of the First Six Incarnates, can transform into an unstoppable brawling dragon whenever anything stands in his way. And it's a power he'll need in his quest to exact revenge against the Wings Incarnate, a power-hungry deceiver that resembles a heavenly angel only in appearance.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Knight With a Time Limit
titleEnglish: A Knight With a Time Limit
synopsis:
Leaving behind his miserable life and untimely death, Luis Cloyde is reborn into a new world filled with fantastical beasts and adventure. The catch? He must continue killing other living beings to extend his own life. But given a second chance at life, Luis Cloyde is willing to do just about anything to survive.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Myst, Might, Mayhem
synopsis:
Jeong, the Slaughtering Scythe Demon, feels joy in killing others. He happens to look just like Mok Gyeongwoon, the third young master of the Mok Sword Manor...

"Be my substitute, and I'll let you out of prison."
"That opportunity. Will you give it to me?"
Crack!!!

He kills the Third Young Master and decides to become the real one. Can the fake Mok Gyeongwoon survive as the real one? The serial killer begins his new life as the Third Young Master of the Great Mok Sword Manor.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Reincarnated Murim Lord
synopsis:
Regret is the bane of old men. When aging Alliance Lord Hajin Cheon of the Grand Martial Alliance reflects on his immense legacy, he finds that he recalls little of his deeds or even the lives of his closest advisors. Stricken by a mysterious ailment, Hajin suddenly passes away only to wake up in the body of Ridan Byeok, heir to the Byeok Clan of swordsmen. The only problem is, Ridan is a well-known wastrel, the polar opposite of the virtuous and stern Hajin. Righting the wrongs of his predecessor, Hajin begins to uncover the truth behind his death...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Futsuu to Bakemono
synopsis:
Itou, a socially awkward teenager, finds herself jealous of her classmate Takahashi, who seems to get along with everyone. However, one day, she witnesses Takahashi...eat someone whole!? That's amazing! A monster who knows how to blend right in with humans? Itou definitely needs to be her friend now!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sketch: Season 1
synopsis:
First impressions are everything, right? But it doesn't seem that way when Yikyung comes across Joobin. When they first meet, Joobin is just a handsome stranger with an exciting air of mystery. Yikyung itches to draw him, to sketch out his beauty on paper like the artist he is... But at their next encounter, Joobin is a completely different person. Sensitive, outspoken, and passionate about his own work as a photographer, he proposes that Yikyung become his model. And drawn to this other side of his, Yikyung says yes. Between lens and paper, who'll be the first to sketch out the other to perfection?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Raul to Kyuuketsuki
synopsis:
As a young orphan, Raul was adopted and saved by the effeminate, eternally youthful vampire Rose. Since then, he's wanted nothing more than to help and protect his vampiric savior. His conviction—and training—has helped him grow into a strong, muscular young man. However, no matter how much Raul grows, Rose can't help seeing him as that little orphan boy...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Reincarnator
synopsis:
God created the Abyss to escape his boredom. Trapped in the hellish Abyss, humanity was on the path to the apocalypse...

"Is it over for us... now..."

On the brink of humanity's annihilation, the four strongest survivors tried to prevent it by traveling back in time to the point just before humanity was pulled into the Abyss. But only one of them could go back to the past.

“What's there to think about? Isn't it already decided who's going? The strongest among us, Kang Hansoo."

This is the story of the life of the legendary powerhouse, Kang Hansoo, who returned to save humanity from its doom. Will he be able to save everyone?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Akumade Amai Watashi no Kanojo
synopsis:
Mai Amatsuka, a girl who loves sweets, is heartbroken after being dumped by her girlfriend. One day, she falls in love at first sight with Riri Kurosaki, a beautiful girl who has just arrived as a new waitress at the café she works at. However, Riri turns out to be a demon called a succubus? Mai shouldn't fall in love with her, but she can't forget her super sweet kiss! A cute and devilish girls' love comedy begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Centuria
synopsis:
Stowing himself away on a slave ship, Julian sets sail for the great continent with a hundred slaves, all yearning for freedom, until...?! Embark on a groundbreaking journey through this action-packed dark fantasy saga!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Share House with Terminator
synopsis:
The year is 20xx. Machine and Man have been waging a war with no end in sight. Amidst all the violence, the machine army decided the leader of humanity, Ootani Akira, ought to be erased from existence, so they send an assassin back in time to eliminate him!

However, the Ootani Akira of the past was nothing but an incompetent human being, and what's more... every other character is even more incompetent?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Yurameku Aki no Koigokoro
synopsis:
I want you to hold me just once... I promise I won't tell you I love you.

Igarashi, a photographer, is friends with benefits with Shida, a popular stylist who only ever touches him when he's drunk.

The truth is, I've had an unrequited love for Shida ever since high school...but I'd rather settle for holding him in my arms than confessing my feelings and not be able to be by his side anymore. Yet, Shida always carelessly whispers things like "I love you" and "you're cute..."

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

title: Fallen to Paradise
synopsis:
Ange, the daughter of Duke Glaster, believes her life is all planned out as she is set to marry Philip Cardiner, the rightful heir to the throne. However, her plans are disrupted when Philip's brother, William Cardiner, schemes against him and removes him from the line of succession. In order to secure his power, William forces Ange to marry Aiden Fitzroy, an illegitimate child born between the emperor and a commoner. Will Ange learn to love the humble stranger she was forced to marry?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Oboro to Machi
synopsis:
From Miyagi to the bustling life of a Tokyo high school, Machi Nishina wanted anything but the ordinary. Her wish is granted in the most unexpected way when she encounters Oboro Kasumi, a classmate harboring a secret, who ends up following her home...?! A new era of friendship and youthful comedy unfolds!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Unrivaled Villain
synopsis:
Heli Yun, notorious degenerate, shocks everyone by suddenly turning from his lowlife ways. No one realizes he's been possessed by Lee Siwoon, the author of Heli's story! Trapped in the martial arts novel he wrote, Heli knows that unless he gains power, he's headed for a villain's death. Armed with knowledge about the novel's world, Heli sets out on a quest to gather friends and past enemies to create a martial arts force strong enough to defy the fate he was given... or literally die trying.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Onna Maou-sama wa Yuusha-kun wo Taosenai.
synopsis:
Abyss, the female demon king, is troubled by her inability to defeat the hero, the nemesis of the demon races. This hero is an inexperienced boy, still a long ways off. Defeating him should be easy!... and yet... The trouble is he doesn't know Abyss's true identity and gets attached to her as her adoring "disciple"...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Misaki-kun wa Kouryaku Chara ja Nai
synopsis:
This is the world of gal games. The mission of the best friend character, Misaki Izumi, is to support the main character, Kihara Haruta, in conquering the heroine... but for some reason, Kihara himself is planning to conquer Misaki himself! "Become the heroine while remaining a boy!" Friendship? Love? A happy, heart-pounding comedy about a boyish girl!!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Shousetsu Sousou no Frieren: Zensou
synopsis:
After the legendary elf mage Frieren is forced to confront the cruel passage of time, she sets out on a journey to fulfill the last wishes of her friends and get to know the world a little better. Under the supervision of Kanehito Yamada, writer of the original manga, comes five original short stories! Join Frieren, Fern, Stark, Lawine, Kanne, and Aura in brand new adventures!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Dawn of the Dragon
synopsis:
As the heir to the Yooshin corporation, Yoo Taehyuk is living his best life. However, everything changes when he's informed that the dragon, the patron deity of the Yoo family, wants to forsake them to be with his mate. When his sister is asked to take the fall for the family and announce herself as the dragon's mate, Taehyuk steps up instead. He agrees to meet the dragon in the hopes that he can convince him to stay. But will Taehyuk succeed in slithering into the impervious dragon's good graces or get under his scales?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love Plan
synopsis:
"Why am I naked in bed with another man...?" Jaewoo reluctantly attends his high school reunion and he can't wait to leave. But after seeing someone he thought he'd never meet again, he ends up drinking himself into a stupor. The next day, Jaewoo wakes up next to Siyeon, the boy that was pining after him throughout high school. This is Siyeon's chance to pounce! He offers Jaewoo a deal, one month of dating, after which things can end amicably, no questions asked. But as rumors start spreading about the circumstances surrounding the reunion, Jaewoo starts becoming suspicious of Siyeon's true intentions...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Divine Delivery
synopsis:
Enter the world of Hajun Lee, just your average delivery guy trying to make ends meet. But when he's summoned to Olympus for a special delivery, his life takes an unexpected turn. Suddenly, he's the personal delivery man for the gods, earning big bucks and upgrading his gear with each risky delivery. Follow his daring escapades through dungeons and battles with monsters as he learns to outsmart them all. From one divine job to the next, Hajun faces it all with wit and guts. But can he keep up the hustle of being a regular delivery guy while also serving the mighty gods?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Duchess's Lo-Fi Coffeehouse
synopsis:
Loanna was raised in neglect and isolation as an illegitimate child of the Count Louis family. She gets married off to Duke Bruggen, who orders her to keep quiet and out of the way. Free from all expectations or responsibilities, she roams around the castle and runs into a coffee bush. A passionate barista in her past life, Loanna remembers exactly how to brew a perfect cup of Joe. The trouble is, no one in this realm seems to know what "coffee" is, nor its wonderful benefits. As a matter of fact, coffee fruits are regarded as "evil." As a coffee aficionado, Loanna is determined to turn this reputation around.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: Koibami Shoujo
synopsis:
Afraid of women, high school student, Kyou Ooishi. Five girls suddenly confessed to him. Among them, four are creatures called "Koibami" that devour human romantic feelings. If he has his romantic feelings eaten by these girls, he will never be able to love again. However, he cannot abandon the feelings of the one who confessed to him for real, Kyou decides to find the one he truly loves among the five! A brain-shaking romantic comedy suspense begins.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Enomoto-senpai wa Tenshi nanka ja Nai
titleEnglish: He Is Far From Being an Angel.
synopsis:
In Hagino's room is the ghost (?) of a man who was supposed to have died in an accident, Enomoto. Enomoto is a bold man with a mean look in his eyes and is the best friend of Hagino's crush. Like the Grim Reaper, Enomoto declares, "If I can take my best friend's life within 49 days, I can come back to life in his place."

(Source: Shu-cream, translated)

title: Inaho-kun wa Nise Kanojo no Hazu nanoni
titleEnglish: Inaho-kun Is Supposed to Be a Fake Sweetheart
synopsis:
Shintarou Mori, a high school freshman, is teased by those around him for wanting to spend his youth getting a girlfriend and having a sparkly high school experience. His classmate Inaho Sawatari is at the top of the class and regarded as a peerless beauty. The two of them shouldn't even be interacting, but when they're inadvertently mistaken for a couple, Inaho proposes: "How about we pretend we're really dating?" They publicly become lovers, but it turns out the most beautiful girl in the school was really an overly cute boy...!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title: My Villainous Family Won't Let Me Be
titleEnglish: My Villainous Family Won't Let Me Be
synopsis:
A distant echo from a life long-forgotten; shattered shards of an ominous future. When her late mother's heirloom pendant is broken, Elodie Perdia regains the memories of Ga-eul Yun, a girl from our world who realizes she's landed in the body of a villainess from a fantasy novel. In the story, Elodie serves as the dark foil to the virtuous heroine and is destined for an early grave—a dark fate that can perhaps be avoided with Ga-eul's knowledge of future events!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Marriage Situation
synopsis:
Kim Yooyoung is sick of playing the nice, boring lawyer and daughter. So when her overbearing mother books her a hotel room the night before an arranged blind date, she steps out of character and spends the night with a seductive stranger from the hotel bar. Only this stranger turns out to be none other than Cha Jihoon, her blind date and the hotel's high-class owner! Yooyoung will do anything to keep their "bad deed" a secret... but can she really marry her first one-night stand?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kono Tabi Osananajimi to Karikon Shimasu
synopsis:
Taichi, who has been freeloading off his girlfriend, gets dumped and has no choice but to go back to his parents' house. The person who knocks on his door is his childhood friend, Ryousuke, who grew up to be a handsome man.

After they met again for the first time in years, Ryousuke suddenly proposes to Taichi. Confessing that he has always loved Taichi since they were kids, he requests that they apply for Provisional Marriage—a system where couples can try being married for a maximum of six months. Despite being overwhelmed by Ryousuke's intense feelings, the words "you don't have to do anything, so just be with me" lure him in. Taichi agrees to the provisional marriage like he's just agreeing to be roommates, but then...?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: The Dragon's Guide to Defying Death
titleEnglish: The Dragon's Guide to Defying Death
synopsis:
After suffering from an illness that cut his life short, Royce wakes up to find himself as a character from the story he read until his last moments. As a dragon hatchling, he believes his long life is just beginning. That is, until Royce realizes he's the son of the dragon who goes berserk due to his untimely death! Now, Royce is looking to race against the clock, even if his every move leads to a near-death experience. Will he be able to change his fate, or will he get stopped in his tracks?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Gardener in a Hunter World
titleEnglish: The Gardener in a Hunter World
synopsis:
Jiha is living a relatively quiet life, gathering resources after raids and selling potions from his general store as a worker-class hunter. Little did he know, taking a nap on top of an ancient text would completely change his life. He is transported to a magical forest, where he gathers rare ingredients to create never-before-seen potions and meets mythical creatures that help him on his adventures. Soon, he starts to build up his abilities to become a skilled alchemist, and high-level hunters start to see him in a different light. How will Jiha make use of his newly acquired skills?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mob Kousei no Ore demo Boukensha ni Nareba Riajuu ni Naremasu ka?
synopsis:
It has been decades since labyrinths first appeared in the modern world of Japan, bringing with them monsters and related catastrophes. With this brought many changes; the biggest one being a new profession called "Adventurer" and the monster cards they use to summon their own monsters to fight and conquer labyrinths with. Utamaro Kitagawa, nicknamed Maro, is a mob high schooler who becomes an adventurer after seeing a former friend of his having sudden social success among their peers simply by becoming an adventurer himself. However, things aren't quite as easy for Maro. Just becoming an adventurer in name only isn't enough for him to gain his spotlight, giving him no recourse but to actually tackle labyrinths with the peculiar and not very versatile monster cards that he barely manages to scrape up.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: One Husband Is Enough
synopsis:
A girl who has been alone her whole life stumbles upon a VR fantasy dating simulator that allows her to be who she always wanted to be—someone loved by everyone. She chooses a character named Crocetta Gaetani, who grew up neglected by others just like her. Now she's stuck permanently in the video game world until she can win over one of the game's male leads and beat the game. Will Crocetta be able to marry one of the male leads and finally return to her reality, or will she be stuck in this VR nightmare forever?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Peaceful Camping Life in Another World
titleEnglish: Peaceful Camping Life in Another World
synopsis:
Star chef Ganghyeon Lee, who has lost his sense of taste, retreats to a peaceful countryside to escape the public eye. In his grandfather's rural home, he stumbles upon a portal to another world. Taking advantage of his escape, he decides to enjoy a relaxed camping life in this new world. However, the inhabitants of this world keep showing interest in him. Will Ganghyeon be able to live a peaceful life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Chimera 51
synopsis:
A world where "humans" and "monsters" exist. This a love story between chimera twins created by combining humans and monsters. Though they look and act completely differently, they dream of going outside someday. A dark fantasy one-shot brought to you by the genius Shida!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: My Second Life Is a Healing Life?
titleEnglish: My Second Life Is a Healing Life?
synopsis:
Eugene Pellivia, the youngest son of a legendary warrior family, is on the brink of death—until he's visited by Pellin, the fabled Mage of Creation, and given a second chance at life. Determined to follow in the footsteps of the one who saved him, Eugene sets out to become a great mage and use his powers for good. But fate has other plans, and before long, he's drawn into the shadows of a darker world...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Scent and Sensibility
synopsis:
"Become his therapist, and you'll earn 500,000 a year!" When Dobin Moon, a dominant omega, goes for a job interview, he's baffled by the CEO's proposal: have sex with her son as a form of therapy. His client? Tae-oh Seo, a dominant alpha who can't sense pheromones. Dobin has worked hard to protect his virginity, but for that salary... anything goes! So, Dobin leads a secret double life as Tae-oh's secretary by day and his therapist by night. As the two spend more time together, something is in the air—and not just pheromones!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Basashi ga Tabetai
titleEnglish: I'm So Hungry I Could Eat Basashi
synopsis:
Kaede, a high school student, has won first place in an art contest with a painting of her favorite food, basashi. The painting was hung up at her school, making her instantly become the talk of the town. Even the scary-looking boy, Satomi, has taken notice of her work. Satomi actually has a secret he can't tell anyone…! Could basashi really be the thing that brings these two together?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Past Life Regressor
synopsis:
[Would you like to reverse time?]
[All stats will be reset]
[Please pick a date.]

"February 28th, 1985. The day I was born."

Wealth, I will seize all the money in the world. Monopoly, I will seize all the dungeons in the world. At this time, while the world is still peaceful.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kaijuu 8-gou: Relax
synopsis:
Join the top troops of the Third Division of the Japan Defense Force, a military organization tasked with the neutralization of kaiju, on their days off! Kafka Hibino attempts to bare his soul in meditation, only to end up baring something else. Then, an off-duty Captain Mina Ashiro blows off steam at the arcade, Reno Ichikawa confronts his fear of ghosts, a curious cadet sets out to glimpse Vice-Captain Hoshina's eyes and uncovers a sweet surprise, and Kikoru Shinomiya finally spends time with her friends.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: A Flame Reborn
synopsis:
Logan MacLine, a middle-aged knight fighting for the independence army, is intent on getting revenge against the empire which took over the kingdom and executed his brother when he ends up dying in battle. But when he wakes, he is a young man again, and has yet to be disowned for his terrible behavior. Using his experience and knowledge from his past life, Logan recruits a few talented individuals to develop new weapons, build an army, and make enough money to fund it all. But will he be able to make amends with his family and stop the empire's march?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Genius Archer's Livestreaming
synopsis:
Former archery prodigy Yoo Sanghyun was destined for greatness until an injury forced him to quit. Though his coach helped him secure a stable job, he never felt like he belonged. Frustrated, he leaves it all behind to pursue game streaming. Leveraging his incredible archery skills and the charm of his noob character, he quickly rises to fame as "Almond." Now, he's determined to dominate the gaming world, but will his virtual success translate into something greater in real life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Gyakuten Isekai de Ikiokure S-Rank Onna Boukensha-tachi ni Semarareteimasu
synopsis:
As a reward for saving a mysterious fairy, Ryou has been transferred to a parallel world where the values of beauty and ugliness are reversed!? In a world where the gender ratio is overwhelmingly more women than men, he is relentlessly pursued by beautiful women and girls. A tale of erotic harem life with exquisite adventurers.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Pan wo Nameruna!
synopsis:
Nineteen-year-old Muyu Uchiki has been a shut-in since dropping out of a prestigious high school two years ago. Still, she has a modest source of income as a remote graphics designer for Renard du Tibet, her aunt's bakery in Kamakura. However, when her aunt gets pregnant and her uncle ends up in a wheelchair, Muyu is chosen to become the shop's temporary manager—a nightmarish position for introverts like her.

Deciding this may be an opportunity to change her life for the better, Muyu reluctantly accepts despite having to leave her hometown. It turns out that Muyu has become quite a celebrity in Kamakura; her designs garner widespread attention from the locals—especially the mascot she drew for her aunt's business. This unanticipated popularity worsens her social anxiety, but Muyu soon proves to have a knack for customer service. All she needs to do next is to bond with the employees under her management to ensure smooth teamwork and preserve the bakeshop's reputation.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Perfect Addiction
synopsis:
Akihito, a loud and popular college student, can't stand Sae, who has a beautiful face and a calm demeanor. When he realizes that the girl he was eyeing at the group date is going for Sae, his frustration reaches its peak. At that time, Akihito came across Sae arguing with a man in front of a hotel, and found out Sae is actually gay and a bottom. Sae reveals his troubles about not being able to feel good during sex, which is completely different from his usual life. Akihito, who was stirred up, forcibly pushes down Sae, but can Sae hold himself back anymore...?!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Kawaii Koi wa Kikazaranai
titleEnglish: Don't Dress up My Sweet Sweet Love!
synopsis:
Emi Amano is a girl who likes wearing cute clothes. One day, she gets into an argument with a guy who's hitting on her and almost gets a drink poured on her, when an unfamiliar boy intervenes and saves her... That was the beginning of her regular encounters with Yuusei, the boy who saved her. Emi is incapable of hiding her bewilderment at the feelings she's having for the first time...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Villain Classroom
synopsis:
As a meek high school student, Heo Jeong-woo is used to incessant bullying. No different from his middle school, all sorts of violent people and dangerous cliques prey on the weak. However, a sudden shift in power comes with a new transfer student, Han Bora. Unbothered by the remarks about an unsightly birthmark on her leg, Bora assaults her would-be bullies with shocking force and cruelty, requesting one thing: the identities of those who know a girl named Han Sena.

Jeong-woo attended the same middle school as Sena, so he remembers her story—she was nearly killed by bullies and has disappeared since. Desperate to escape his daily hell, Jeong-woo gives up the names of the four students who terrorized Sena. But he must be careful not to stand in Bora's way, as she is unpredictable and incredibly brutal, and all she wants is bloody revenge.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mou Sawarenai Kimi
synopsis:
I used to have a classmate with a shaved head. I was always touching it and teasing him. Now, years later, my classmate grew his hair out and became a celebrity that I see on TV and in magazines...

(Source: MU)

title: Overgeared
synopsis:
Shin Youngwoo, in massive debt, scrapes by as a construction worker doing hard labor everyday. In his spare time he is a low-ranking player in Satisfy, a VR game with the potential to make you rich—if you are blessed with gaming talent.

But one day Shin Youngwoo glitches a quest and gains access to the inheritance of a legendary smith, and the unprecedented ability to create endgame-level legendary weapons, years before any player is supposed to be able to access them.

All eyes fall on him as he breaks the game's balance. He may now be a wealthy, powerful myth-in-the-making, but will he be able to survive the consequences of his success?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Becoming a Legendary Ace Employee
synopsis:
Kim Tae-seok, a former construction worker, receives a notification that he has passed the document screening for a major corporation called El Sung. Soon after, a system message pops up before him. "You have gained access to the tutorial for 'The Path of a Regular Employee.' Would you like to proceed with the tutorial?" Follow Kim Tae-seok's struggles and adventures in his quest to become the legendary ace employee at the company!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Remote Jugyou ni Nattara Class 1 no Bishoujo to Doukyo suru Koto ni Natta
titleEnglish: Lockdown Life with the Class Beauty
synopsis:
When an infectious epidemic spreads and the student dorms are closed, dejected high schooler Kanata Yoshino is left with nowhere to go. That's when he meets Haruka Hoshikawa, the class's top beauty, waving her phone around in the dead of night at the park... Claiming she's 'hopeless with technology' and doesn't know how to connect to the internet, Hoshikawa begs Yoshino for help and invites him to her house—but the truth is, she has an ulterior motive! A girl with a knack for persuasion sets off a flirty and sweet romantic comedy!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: The Fish I Loved
synopsis:
Yana Jeong, a typical girl, runs into a strange man who's out of breath during one of her part-time jobs. Little did she know that this was Kai Shim, the son of the CEO of a large jewelry corporation called Inoroo, who also happens to be a merman. Yana coincidentally runs in Kai again when she ends up working as a waitress at his birthday party, where a series of accidents lead to the two of them meeting each other again. Will Yana be able to keep up with these unexpected events happening one after another?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Chirijiri Yuku no
synopsis:
Shio Kuno, who is half human and half alien, has a "glitch" that causes his body to turn into a gel-like mass when he gets lustful. He enjoys attracting girls who gather because of his novelty, but one day, his parents are worried about Shio, who is only interested in splattering, and transfer him to a boarding school for boys. At the moment when Minato Souma, the class representative who was assigned to take care of Shio, hugs him, Shio somehow splatters...!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage
titleEnglish: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage
synopsis:
The warrior Lista heard the rumors about the great magician Rin, hailed as a genius for becoming the youngest 4-star mage. Lista recruited him to join her party to fight the forces of the void but, right before the final battle, Rin's body succumbed to the void's dark poison. As he drew his last breath, Rin cast an immortality spell, encasing his body in ice and promising Lista that he would return. Rin kept his promise and returned after 300 years—but reborn in the body of a noble boy.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kuni wo Owareta Ryuushi-san, Hirowareta Ringoku de Ukkari Musou Shiteshimau. Jakushou Kokka ga Tairiku Saikyou no Ryuu no Rakuen ni Naru made
synopsis:
The series is about the old man Breed, who is fired from his job and exiled from his country. His dragons follow him, however, and so begins his journey to reclaim his glory.

(Source: ANN)

title: Wasureenu Majo no Monogatari
synopsis:
Only I remember that there were three entrance ceremonies this year. Only I remember the unchosen days. The world, repeating "todays" like a broken record...

"My name is Michiru Inaba. Nice to meet you."

A story about her, who befriended me the following day as well. About my first human relationship, about the gradually shrinking distance between us, and my quietly changing feelings...

A slightly strange story about a friendless, loveless me, and her, and our clumsy feelings.

(Source: SB Creative Corp., translated)

title: My Comeback as the Youngest Member
titleEnglish: My Comeback as the Youngest Member
synopsis:
After being disqualified from the famous boy group survival reality show Stardust Project, Seohan finds himself stuck in a mundane life of part-time work, unable to achieve his dreams of debuting. But then, an unexpected twist of fate catapults him eight years back in time, just before the inception of the show. Now equipped with years of experience, Seohan is determined to rewrite his story and fulfill his dreams with this second chance. With the many challenges and dark sides of the music industry, will he finally succeed in debuting as a member of a boy band this time?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Housekeeper of the Dungeon
synopsis:
Tired, overworked Heena thinks dungeons and Hunters have nothing to do with her until she's suddenly gifted with a Hunter's abilities. Now she has to navigate her game-like reality with the skills and stats of... a Homemaker?! With this class, Heena becomes the ultimate cook, custodian, and caretaker, which lands her a seemingly harmless job in a Hunter guild. But will this organization help Heena bring the Hunters a revolution of rest or force her into dangers she'd never dreamed of?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: [Oshi no Ko]: Ichibanboshi no Spica
titleEnglish: [Oshi No Ko] Spica the First Star
synopsis:
Ai Hoshino, the permanent center of B Komachi, suddenly tells President Saitou that she is quitting the idol business. Although the group appears to be thriving, there is serious discord between Ai and the other members. Saitou knows nothing he can say will change her mind, so he asks Ai to accompany him on one last job… Meanwhile, the fates of Gorou Amamiya and Sarina Tendouji intertwine as they meet, grow closer, and eventually part. Little do they know this bond will carry them from one life into another!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Demon King's Warrior Daughter
synopsis:
Nobody said being a parent was easy. It's especially hard for Belphegor Verscios, the adoptive father of an exceptionally gifted human girl who insists on becoming a warrior someday and defeating the Demon King—who, unbeknownst to her, happens to be him. But when you're a doting father like Belphegor, what else can you do but try to support her dreams while simultaneously making sure she never reaches her goal? It's a fine line to walk, but he must succeed at any cost, or suffer the worst fate he could ever imagine... disappointing his daughter.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Using My Cooking Skills in a Murim World
synopsis:
With a dream to become the ultimate Chinese cuisine chef, our protagonist finds himself inexplicably transported to the Song Dynasty in China! However, upon awakening, he discovers that he possesses no martial arts skills whatsoever. All that remains are the culinary techniques he mastered in his previous life.
