Surprisingly, these dishes... receive an overwhelmingly positive response! Can he, with a single bowl of jjajangmyeon, truly conquer the martial world? Will he be able to captivate the Central Plains with his jjajangmyeon and lead a successful second life in this era?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Otsukaresama, Kurose-kun
synopsis:
I feel like I forgot about someone important... 

Plagued by nightmares of his old hometown, Yuuma Kurose, a lonely boy with the ability to see ghosts, feels inexplicably drawn back to the place from his dreams. There, he stumbles upon Kaito Kiriyama, a boy shrouded by terrifying spirits. With a serious look in his eyes, Kaito vows he'll protect Yuuma. But the moment their skin makes contact, the spirits surrounding Kaito started to possess Yuuma!

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Uesugi-kun wa Onnanoko wo Yametai
titleEnglish: Uesugi-kun Wants to Quit Being a Girl
synopsis:
In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally!

Keisuke Uesugi has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Maigo ni Natteita Youjo wo Tasuketara, Otonari ni Sumu Bishoujo Ryuugakusei ga Ie ni Asobi ni Kuru you ni Natta Ken ni Tsuite
synopsis:
One day, Charlotte Bennett comes to study abroad in Akihito Aoyagi's class.

All of his classmates are attracted to Charlotte's innocent, elegant behavior and cute appearance, but Akihito calmly feels that she lives in a different world and takes a step back. However, when he helps Charlotte's younger sister, Emma, who was lost, Akihito's daily life changes drastically. After finding out that the Bennett sisters live in the next room of the apartment building, and also that Emma has grown fond of Akihito, the Bennett sisters come to visit his room every day. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table, and go out together. As they spend time together, Akihito and Charlotte grow closer, despite their clumsiness―a sweet and enticing love comedy next door begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Isekai Fall of the Hero
synopsis:
"Fuck the hero."
"Of course... Wait, what?"

A normal(?) office worker who's fine after jacking off fifteen times in a row was summoned to another world. Who he met up with was not a goddess, but a demon lord? Plus, if he wants to return to his original world, he has to make the hero fall, something even the demon lord couldn't do?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: For the Musical Genius
synopsis:
Kang Hyeon, who was ashamed of his poor family, cut off ties with those around him and studied desperately to achieve success, but eventually he realized that his ideals were wrong. To make matters worse, Hyeon, who has cancer, gets run over while trying to save someone who fell on the subway tracks, and returns to the past while listening to the melody of a symphony. Hyeon, who was determined not to live the same life as before, realizes that he has tremendous musical talent...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Kimi no Zetsumetsu suru Mae ni
synopsis:
A darkly comic look at the meaning and meaninglessness of life, through the eyes of various adorable and occasionally psychopathic species facing extinction.

A humble rock is at the center of this transmigratory tale of two souls who take the form of penguins, otters, crows, and more as they learn about the the value of culture, the beauty of play in the face of capitalist pressure to produce and reproduce, and the power of love in the face of total annihilation.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Rii-chan
synopsis:
After returning to his hometown, Tatsu meets Ri-chan, his neighbor who he played with during his childhood. Ri-chan used to love playing the piano and laugh a lot. However, with her blonde hair and piercings, she looks like a completely different person. Although Ri-chan is shy, Tatsu's kindness is unchanged, with the two gradually becoming closer.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Return of the Genius Player
synopsis:
The Hunters League is a sport where only those with supernatural powers may compete, promising fame, glory, and incredible prizes. Changhyeon Lee had it all, but faces an abrupt downfall during his slump. Cast aside by even his own team, his world crumbles... but fate deals him an unexpected hand when a fatal encounter with a 10-ton truck ends his life, only to send him back in time to the day he discovered his powers. Armed with a second chance, Changhyeon is determined to reclaim and transcend his former glory in the Hunters League.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: You Can't Kill Me: The Secret Bride of the Black Wolf
titleEnglish: You Can't Kill Me: The Secret Bride of the Black Wolf
synopsis:
Yeonwu Chae, a talented yet lonely composer from Korea, finds herself and her family trapped in the underworld after a car crash. In her first life, she marries Hyojo, who ultimately kills her. In her second life, she takes revenge by taking her own life in front of him. But despite her desperate wish for an end, she's given another chance at life. However, this time, instead of encountering Hyojo, she is discovered by Hwita, a mysterious man with a black wolf as his guardian spirit. Can Yeonwu break the cycle and find true safety in this treacherous underworld?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Rekkyou Sensen
synopsis:
In the year 2206, planet Earth is on the brink of destruction. Due to pollution and a shortage of resources, scientists estimate that the planet will become unable to sustain life within the next hundred years. To resolve the issue of scarcity, the world's leaders have come together and decided on a desperate solution—the National Extinction Tournament. Gathering those with powers beyond human comprehension, these boys and girls will compete for the sake of their nations...and their own survival! Win and become a hero. Lose and death awaits not only you but everyone you love...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Skool of Street
synopsis:
DJ, drop the beat! When 18-year-old K-pop stan Suhyeon gets his heart broken, he turns to his actual true love, girl group sensation MainTainA—especially his bias, the group's main dancer, Hailey. Leaving his bittersweet first relationship behind to transfer to Seoul, Suhyeon finds not only a spitting image of his bias in the school dance club member Hye-eun, who is supposedly Hailey's younger sister, but also a new love in the most unexpected of places: the art of street dance! While helping Hye-eun overcome her stage fright, Suhyeon finds there may be more to life than love!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Futari no Kokuhaku
synopsis:
The story follows the life of Chiharu, a 31-year-old woman struggling with her job, her sick mother, and the pain of ending up being a burden to her lover after being diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer disease.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Legend of Dangun
synopsis:
There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence... A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action.

Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Tsugihagi darake no Saikyou Yuusha
synopsis:
Ougi Arikawa, 16 years old, suddenly found himself reincarnated as a zombie?! Embarking on a journey to subjugate the Demon Lord as a zombie hero, but the use of "power" requires a "price"...? A dark fantasy in another world.

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Aura of a Genius Actor
synopsis:
Shin Yoomyeong is an unknown actor who kept on chasing his dream despite playing minor roles for 15 years because of his weak presence. One day, he meets the Acting Spirit, Yeonghwi, who he signs a contract with, and begins to shine in his career. In fact, he was always an acting genius, but he was overshadowed by his weak presence. He creates a perfect character for every work he takes and slowly raises to stardom. However, Yeonghwi, who he saw as his benefactor, starts to seem suspicious...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: You're My Flame
synopsis:
After being reborn as a desolate fire witch and villain destined to die a tragic death, Chersinia creates a plan to avoid her fate by gambling at a casino to become a wealthy recluse. The only problem? She somehow ends up with a slave boy named Ben instead of the money she needs! But much to her surprise, she starts to warm up to Ben, who provides the perfect joy and comfort in her lonely life. Little does she know that Ben has a dark secret that will change her life forever...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Unintentional Villainess
synopsis:
After being reborn in a novel, Renee Blair is determined to transform her reputation as "the villainess of the century," which will prevent her death at the hands of Sir Dywen the dragon slayer! But then she learns that the original Renee had been controlled by a pop-up game system of daily missions that forced her to either commit evil deeds or face painful penalties for declining. With this system continuing to affect her as well, can the new Renee outsmart the game and reset her evil legacy?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Knight Only Lives Today
synopsis:
"You're a genius." Those words he heard as a child were poison. Encrid dreamed of becoming a knight, but he soon realized it was futile. "You want to live by the sword with that level of skill?" Some laughed at him. "Just give up." Some advised him against it. Despite that, his dream remained steadfast. He slept less, ran more, and trained harder. One day, he died, having been stabbed in the neck. Encrid opened his eyes again to "today's" morning.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Selfish Romance
synopsis:
Hyeondo and Yumin, an ordinary man and woman in their 30s, break up with their respective partners for different reasons despite still being in love with them. Selfishly hoping to get their old flames back, the two form a plan. They pretend to date each other in hopes of provoking their former lovers. Will their selfish and foolish plan really work?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sea Witch
synopsis:
Having capsized every ship that has ever passed by, the octopus sea witch Nakika has run out of food, for no ship would now dare approach. With little choice left, Nakika decides to turn herself into a human in order to infiltrate their society and gain sustenance. Unfortunately, her brilliant plan hits a snag the minute she reaches the shoreline, and it all seems to stem from an encounter with a young boy named Nagisa.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kodoku no Kochou wa Donna Yume wo Miru no ka?
synopsis:
This world has been invaded by bugs.

With the appearance of the "Armored Bugs," mutating insect monsters that can overcome all modern weapons, humanity has been robbed of much of its living space. The only ones who can stand against such adversaries are the "Noble Butterflies," girls who harbor "Insects" that have gone through evolutions differing from the armored bugs.

One of the candidates to become a Noble Butterfly, Odamaki Ayumi, still suffers from the fact that she is unable to become one. Her best friend, who was supposed to be with her and was her object of admiration, has left her and no longer seeks her company.

Those days of despair came to an end when she was on the verge of death in a battle with armored bugs.
"Don't think that I... will die without doing anything!"

With the end near, the girl's body transformed into a butterfly one. And the flapping of her wings will bring about a revolution in the world...!

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kunigei: Ookuni Daigaku Geijutsu Gakubu Eiga Gakka
titleEnglish: Kunigei: Okuni University Art Department Film Program
synopsis:
Daisuke Kagami has sported a passion for movies ever since he can remember. Driven by this ambition and a film festival award he won in high school, Daisuke feels spurred to enroll in a film program as an aspiring director. Surprisingly, he gets shut down immediately and receives disheartening feedback on an assignment he thought he would breeze through.

Meanwhile, Kado Osawa, a fellow freshman and equally an award winner in high school, delivers a shocking project unexpectedly well-received by their professors. Already disillusioned by this strange turn of events, Daisuke falls into torment after Kado bluntly criticizes his work.

As Daisuke grapples with the difference between his and Kado's creations, he realizes a high disparity in the level of effort the two of them put into their respective projects. Understanding why Kado had been able to move his audience, Daisuke resolves to throw everything he has into his own filmmaking.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shout Loud My Heart
synopsis:
College student Gen, a guitarist for the rock band Eve, meets a man named Mike while playing at one of his gigs. Mike's the kind of person who has no trouble saying what's on his mind, and Gen soon finds himself captivated by the smooth talker's voice. The next day, the two meet again when they realize they go to the same college. Be it on stage or just during casual conversation, Gen finds himself more and more captivated by Mike's voice, and the more time the two spend together, the more Gen realizes it's more than just Mike's voice he's attracted to...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Toru ni Taranai
synopsis:
Nikawa (senpai♀) and Sudou (kouhai♂) plan to put an end to their lives of poverty by making money streaming adult videos, but...!? A fetish comedy about two people short of money.

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Miyu-chan wa Zutto Tomodachi
synopsis:
In the summer of his second year of high school, the protagonist, Yuushin Tahara, finds that his childhood friend, Miyu Fukagawa, who had moved away, has returned to the house next door. Although Miyu has grown up to be quite cute, there's something a little strange about her... This is a fresh and suspenseful romantic comedy about the gentle protagonist and his cute but rather quirky childhood friend, along with their friends and the adventures they get into!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Lily
synopsis:
Prim and proper honors student Fan Yilin and the mysterious and charismatic Lan Ruoxi met through a stroke of fate and a misunderstanding, and only got further involved with each other from that point on. The more they came to know each other, the more something different started blooming between the two. "I like you, only because it's you."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Kataware Reijou ga Dansou suru Riyuu
titleEnglish: The Reason for the Twin Lady's Disguise
synopsis:
The Lowreis family was wrongly sentenced to execution for attempting to murder the royal family. As Linali Lowreis, the daughter of the family, is on the brink of death, she fervently prays for a second chance. Miraculously, she wakes up three years in the past, reuniting with her deceased family members. However, tragedy looms as her brother, Liam, is poised to attend the School of Poltis, the reason for the family's tragedy. She begs her father to send her instead of her brother, as she is better at sword fighting. Now, faced with a new identity and unexpected challenges, Linali must attend the School of Poltis in her brother's place.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Orc no Shuhai ni Shukufuku wo
titleEnglish: The Half-Blood Orc in the Blended World
synopsis:
In this hard-boiled isekai fantasy set in "Blended World," where alcohol is the source of magical power, Elpis, a half-orc, and Margit, the daughter of a corrupt aristocrat, adventure in search of whisky, a spirit bequeathed by the transmigrator Tanaka.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind
titleEnglish: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind
synopsis:
Zich Moore, the fearsome Demon Lord, is struck down by the hero Glen Zenard. As he dies, he hears Glen's request: for him to be a good person if he is ever reborn. Miraculously, Zich awakens in the body of his younger self and resolves to be a better individual. But the problem is... he has no idea what it means to be good! Can the former Demon Lord truly learn what it means to be kind? Or will his old habits and misconceptions about virtue and goodness make redemption difficult?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Main Characters That Only I Know
synopsis:
"If I were given another chance..." Ten years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene... Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called "Teller," but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years! "Now that it has come to this, I'll live my best life this time!" Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
titleEnglish: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
synopsis:
15 days until the apocalypse happens. That's what Hoyeong Lee, a 29-year-old office worker, learns when he takes the mysterious medicine he got for saving a goblin from a bear trap. As it turns out, it allows him to level up more easily and provides him with a strategy guide! Everyone in the world is forced into groups to conquer the mysterious Apocalypse Tower, and Hoyeong has to find a way to work with his teammates so that everyone makes it to the top alive. Will his ability give him an advantage, or will it end up spelling out his doom?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Harem Ou no Isekai Press Manyuuki: Saikyou Musou no Ojisan wa Arayuru Shuzoku wo Yome ni Suru
synopsis:
"Turn me into a fat insemination ojisan.'"
"...Eh?"

The protagonist, who asked for such a perverted wish literally right before the goddess, was a man who lived an honest life of solitude. He died alone at the end of his life. Thus, he made a wish: in his next life, he wanted to be surrounded by many kind people who loved him. He wanted to create a big harem. Thus, he was sent to a world of sword and magic.

In this way, he became the mating uncle, Genji, a kindhearted old man with a milf fetish accompanied by the goddess-turned-fat-bird (tsukkomi) Pinoko!

Thus, he weaves the heroic tale of saving the weak, crushing the strong, and turning the women he likes into milfs.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Kaijin Fugeki
synopsis:
Two youths—Jin and Gao—lead a seemingly placid existence in the Japanese countryside along with their friends...but in fact they are holy warriors on the frontlines of the battle against armageddon. The coming of the nigh-unstoppable embodiments of catastrophe known as "Night" has imperiled the entire human race, and only Jin and Gao's ancient ability to call on the power of the gods through dance can stem the tide of destruction.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: The Genius Murim Fitness Trainer
synopsis:
During the great pandemic, my gym went under. While desperately trying to make ends meet, I possessed a character in Murim. I was excited to see that I was in the Shaolin Temple, but what the hell? Everyone's bodies are wrecked from working out the wrong way! How can I just sit back and watch when I used to be a personal trainer?! I'll teach you the correct, modern exercise methods and heal you all with low-frequency treatment and infrared therapy using inner energy! X Days until the Shaolin Gym opens.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: 7th
synopsis:
In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres's monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Bad Son
synopsis:
Blood ties bind, but vengeance severs, and in the heart of a heartless man, a fire ignites. Pildu Kang, a prosecutor born into a legacy of corruption, uncovers his family's harrowing involvement in his mother's murder. Now, a chilling vendetta awakens the monster within, drawing out the primordial urge he has long sought to contain. Will he rely on the law to be his ally on this treacherous path, or will he become the judge, jury, and executioner?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: King of the Arena
synopsis:
Lee Gilsoo moved schools in order to avoid the hell-like organizational bullying. At the new school, there are no bullies or bullying, but there is school violence?! A world of fair violence among students, the "Fighting Arena." Within the Fighting Arena, students fight and enjoy violence. Can Lee Gilsoo, who has only ever lived getting beaten up, adjust to this fierce world of violence? This is the bloody school action growth story of the loner bully victim, Lee Gilsoo!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Sugar Girl Drip
synopsis:
Marie, a sparkling university student and influencer with an overflowing psychological need for approval, gets a part-time job at a diner-concept cafe for the sake of getting to wear the uniform. There, she meets Aki, a so-called "minefield kid." A major life-changing incident occurs, and they end up spending time together as accomplices...!? So begins an overdose of desire in the neon-lit city that never sleeps!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Miyaou Tarou ga Neko wo Kau Nante
titleEnglish: Taro Miyao Becomes a Cat Parent?!
synopsis:
Tarou Miyaou is a renowned novelist and ardent admirer of Niccolò Machiavelli. Use whatever means necessary to achieve a goal...Tarou has modeled his life after his beloved Renaissance philosopher. One day, he is struck by an epiphany: having a cat around would cure his stiff shoulders! Lo and behold, Tarou becomes a proud cat owner but it's not all kittens and rainbows...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Want to See My Cat?
synopsis:
Chayeong Mun had the perfect life—a peaceful life in the countryside with a loving husband, three cats who run the house, and two dogs who think they're cats. One day, she goes into the city to meet her friends and dies while saving a student from being hit by a truck. The god in the afterlife gives her the incredibly rare chance to go back to her wonderful life, but only under the condition of going back 10 years in time. Given the second chance, Will she be able to marry her husband again and rebuild that perfect life she knew?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor
titleEnglish: Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor
synopsis:
Betrayed and on the brink of death, Ian Verocian, a mage and the emperor of the Variel Empire, is sent a hundred years back in time by a forbidden spell. He wakes up as Ian Vratz, a margrave's illegitimate son, and soon learns he's about to be sent off to a desert tribe as part of a political treaty. Now, Ian must use his wits and powerful magic to gather allies and figure out the plots lurking around him. The question is... can this young mage change his fate before time runs out once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Surviving the Apocalypse
synopsis:
A boy was locked in a basement and trained his entire life. His deranged father, the one who confined him, declared, "The Apocalypse is coming." Now, armed with the training and survival skills he had honed over years of practice, he must survive the impending apocalypse.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Genius Spirited Streamer
synopsis:
Gyeongbok Lee possesses a gift that grants him a sixth sense and supernatural foresight—however, this ability comes at a steep price, debilitating him each time it is used. But when Gyeongbok tries virtual reality gaming for the first time, he makes a startling discovery: not only could he leverage his psychic ability to gain a significant advantage in the virtual world, but he was also entirely free from its afflictions. Seizing this opportunity, Gyeongbok sets out to become a legendary video game streamer, turning his curse into his greatest asset.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Baby Prisoner of the Winter Castle
titleEnglish: Baby Prisoner of the Winter Castle
synopsis:
The last survivor of the Grezekaiah royal family is biding her time as a prisoner waiting to die... too bad everyone finds her absolutely adorable. When Clarisse became the youngest prisoner of Duke Maximilian Sheridan, she never expected her captors to be the family she'd always wished for. With an execution date set for her eighteenth birthday, will her emerging powers, bubbly personality, and cute face save her from her fate?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hiding Out in an Apocalypse
synopsis:
Gyu Park is a survivor who predicted and prepared for the coming apocalypse. In this ruined world, he is willing to do anything and everything he can to protect the comforts of his bomb shelter.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tsuitenai Game Jikkyousha wa Akogare no Hito ni Kakin sareru
titleEnglish: The Unlucky Game Streamer Is Charged by the Person of Her Dream.
synopsis:
Hasumi, a university student who meets with misfortune whenever she does anything, is interested in Oikawa, who helped her out at the entrance ceremony. However, when she steels herself to talk to him, he doesn't even remember her... Then, at the suggestion of her older brother, who noticed how amusing Hasumi's game-playing was, she decides to livestream a let's play. The video unexpectedly goes viral, and Oikawa has found it too...? Gaming livestreamer x unlaughing guy—who will be the one to get hooked?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Himokuzu Hana-kun wa Shinitagari
synopsis:
"I'll die with you. Promise."

In her second year since she started working, Kaede Yoshino has hit her limit, feeling completely burned out from working every day. Then, on the worst day of her life, under a beautiful moonlit sky, a totally wasted Kaede picks up a warm, black haired, fluffy...boy who's like a cat?! As "Hana-kun" claims he has no home to go back to, they end up living together on a temporary basis. However, in doing so, Kaede starts to realize how it warms her heart to live with someone. Then, a certain event leads to a shocking revelation of who Hana-kun really is...?!

A clingy, good-for-nothing boy meets a tender-hearted overworked girl in this deadly romance?!

(Source: K Manga)

title: FlashLight
synopsis:
Aaron Hunter's got it all. Looks, talent, and he just won the award for best actor. He does have one issue though: trouble sleeping. The only thing that'll get him to fall asleep is a certain song by a certain someone. And when they finally meet, this is Aaron's chance to get him to write a new song. But will the mysterious singer accept this deal? And will past traumas become illuminated by their newfound relationship...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shinketsu no Kyuuseishu: 0.00000001% wo Hikiate Saikyou e
synopsis:
Subaru is an average guy—a loser, in fact. Becoming a Player who enters mysterious gates and slays creatures to defend humanity is a far-fetched dream. But after several years of constant bullying and abuse, a Door of Trials appears before him, and he finally becomes a Player. But his brother is out to get him, and Subaru is completely outmatched. Furthermore, the Sky Clock is ticking down, which could mean the end of the world when it hits zero.

Can Subaru overcome his brother and uncover the truth behind the gates that plague the world?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Became the Youngest Prince in the Novel
titleEnglish: I Became the Youngest Prince in the Novel
synopsis:
The novel "Chronicles of the Hero of Frosimar" is a story about the failures of the protagonist, not the successes.

"This is terrible."

The First Emperor, who conquered the whole world, closed his eyes with a brief appreciation (after reading the novel). But the moment he opened his eyes again, there were only a few lines about him in the "Chronicles of the Hero of Frosimar." This was because he became an imprisoned prince who met death with his first appearance (in the novel).

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Villainess Just Wants to Live in Peace!
titleEnglish: The Villainess Just Wants to Live in Peace!
synopsis:
I transmigrated as the villainess of a novel. I wanted to get rid of my death flag and live in peace, but apparently, I've already been whipping and tormenting the final villain. I wasn't the one who did it, but since I still felt responsible for it, I've been taking care of him, and the villain's loyalty toward me keeps increasing. I just want to enjoy my wealth and honor in peace. I don't know why the story keeps going astray!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: In Between
synopsis:
Eunseo Lee and Sihwa Kang have been friends all their lives. One day, Eunseo shatters their comfortable relationship by asking Sihwa out, and Sihwa moves away soon afterward. Eunseo tries her best to forget him until they meet in a college class six years later. He seems to know about her unrequited love for him, and to make matters worse, he moves in with her family after running away from his hostile home environment. Can Eunseo cope with his sudden reappearance in her life? And is it possible that Sihwa loves her back?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Doomed House's Contract Daughter
synopsis:
I thought I had regressed from this ragged life, but why has my time-limited life remained the same? I'm ruined... is this how I should live my life...? "This time, I'll get adopted by a normal family, and live in comfort for the rest of my life!" Step by step, I'm going to take revenge against the one behind my death, and I'll protect what's left of my small and precious life! However, did I put in too much effort? "Anisha, you're perfect." "I'm going to make this child a future professor."

All I wanted was to survive... "Well, somehow, you’ve passed. I'll have to adopt this brat." I ended up with a tycoon I didn't expect. One whose household will be massacred in a few years! How do I know that? Me too! I didn't want to! Know that! But what can I do? The milk has already been spilt. I'll just live in bliss while acting as the real daughter during my five-year contract, then I'll leave! However... "...I happened to pick this up on the way home." "Father, you're the best!" "I know." ...Something's wrong. "I checked this out 'myself,' and inspected it 'in person.' There's nothing to be grateful for." "Father, you're a genius!" "I know this too." No, well, something's REALLY wrong.…

title: I Became the Tyrant's Chambermaid
synopsis:
When Lee Chaerin kicks the bucket, she's whisked into a dark fantasy novel as Rose Estania, a chambermaid at the mercy of the tyrant crown prince, Kalix Forsman. Armed with nothing but her real-world hotelier skills and a diary from the real Rose full of cryptic hints but no escape route, she's forced to navigate a dangerous world teeming with Kalix's enemies. Can she keep his wrath in check, evade death, and find her way back to reality before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: A Life-Changing Turn
synopsis:
"Did I hit a man?" With a mayor father, and one foot in Hankuk University, high school student Cho Soo is living the high life. One mistake leads to a hit-and-run. "It's okay because no one saw it," she thinks. But her life is slowly cracking down when the messages of M, an eyewitness who seemed to know everything, flying towards her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: My Numbered Days of Happiness
synopsis:
For a child born with the Narvidal's brand, life past the age of 21 is impossible. That is the unfortunate fate of Isabelle Bilothian, the first princess in five hundred years to be born into the Bilothian royal family. However, Isabelle is special: she remembers her past life in South Korea, where she was an orphan who battled an illness before dying at a young age. Moreover, she knows exactly who she has been reborn as—a villainess from her favorite novel.

Given her knowledge of key characters and future events, Isabelle quickly avoids her first close encounter with death and wins the favor of her family. Surrounded by the warmth of familial love and loyal subjects, Isabelle uses everything at her disposal to help the world around her and make the most out of her numbered days of happiness.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: My Lord Was Already Into Me When I Noticed
titleEnglish: My Lord Was Already Into Me When I Noticed
synopsis:
Ten-year-old Celine Mars dreams of becoming a great knight escort just like her father. She's set to serve under Damien Willow, the heir of a powerful Duke. There's only one problem—he's a total weakling, or so she thinks. Celine vows to train the poor, defenseless Damien to stand up for himself, completely unaware of his real strength. Meanwhile, Damien instantly takes a liking to Celine, finding her cluelessness and pure intentions both amusing and endearing. When will Celine finally realize she's got the wrong idea about Damien?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Raising the Princess After Her Death
synopsis:
The long-term public service exam candidate, Minseo, finds himself trapped in the game, "Raising Lena" as he tries to escape his grim reality. In the game, Minseo becomes a character named Leo, and he must navigate through a world with three different scenarios to accomplish his mission of turning the protagonist, Lena, into a princess. However, the game "Raising Lena" boasts an overwhelming level of difficulty due to enemies who are set to thwart Minseo with their immense power and influence. Will Minseo be able to complete the game by making Lena a princess and return to reality?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
titleEnglish: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
synopsis:
The character with the highest difficulty and the worst performance, Baek Yuseol, was considered a trash character in-game because he could not use magic in a fantasy setting where everyone else could. However...

[Because the wrong ending has been reached, 90% of Aether World has been destroyed.] [Please reach the "True Ending."]

Suddenly, those words echoed in my mind before I was transmigrated to the Aether World.

[You can use the skill "Blink."]

"Just why did I possess this character?"

Blink was the only magic skill I had. Surviving in Stella Academy among genius mages, I became the notorious Blink Mage.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Tonari no Seki no Yatsu ga Souiu Me de Mitekuru
titleEnglish: The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen
synopsis:
It all starts with a steamy exchange of sexually charged looks. Average teen boy Ikezawa can't help noticing Eguchi's tight top, and when he comments on it, she quips right back that his plunging neckline accentuates his toned chest! From then on, Eguchi tells Ikezawa every single hot thing she notices about him. Ikezawa can't help feeling flustered by her attention and even starts showing off for her. With chaotic flirtation in full force, what are these two smitten seatmates going to do but play even more to each other's gazes?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Kuroko to Heel-kun
synopsis:
First impressions of Rento Shishima always leave people breathless; he is incredibly beautiful and seems irresistibly charming. However, that only lasts until he opens his mouth. From the very first day of high school, Shishima has gained the reputation of a devil—he is rude, disrespectful, and feared by everyone.

Kayoko "Kuroko" Kuroda has always dreamed of helping others, joining various clubs and taking on menial tasks for anyone in need. Like everybody else, she avoids Shishima—until she accidentally catches his attention. As if unable to believe someone can be so genuinely kind, Shishima begins to follow her around, showing a softer side of himself that no one else gets to see. Despite Shishima's fiendish image, Kuroko soon finds her heart racing around the boy who, in her eyes, is nothing short of an angel.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Watashi no Megami ga Kyou mo Oseru: Korekara mo, Itsumademo
titleEnglish: My Goddess Is Precious Today, Too
synopsis:
They start off as friends, total opposites who watch each other from afar, or maybe they're locked in a fierce competition. Either way, they can't stop thinking about one another. These fluttery feelings can only mean one thing: first love! Swoon over these budding teenage romances that celebrate girls loving girls.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Moto Konyakusha kara Nigeru Tame Kyuuketsu Hakushaku ni Koibito no Furi wo Onegaishitara, Nazeka Dekiai Mode ni Narimashita
titleEnglish: I Fell into a Situationship with the Vampire Count?!
synopsis:
"I would like you to become my lover." Daughter of a viscount, Freya Villiers was being pressured into taking back her ex-fiance, Nathan, after their engagement was broken off due to him cheating on Freya with her sister. In order to flee her parents, who are all for her reconciliation with Nathan, she visits Count Bloodbury, feared by the nobles as a "vampire." With nothing to lose, she asks him to pretend to be her lover and...?!

(Source: K Manga)

title: Comic Party Wonder Love
synopsis:
Raizo and TOS are two men who also write BL in their spare time. Raizo is a cool, laidback and handsome guy whose dark BL style is popular, while TOS has a light and fluffy writing, but is less popular due to his social awkwardness and difficulty communicating. Even though they are complete opposites in everything, they find themselves inexplicably drawn to one another...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!
titleEnglish: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!
synopsis:
Paik Hyeon sacrificed everything to become the best actor in the industry. So when he's about to die in a plane crash, he makes a desperate wish for another chance to live. Hyeon's plea is granted, but who said anything in life was free? Reborn as his younger self, Hyeon must first become a successful K-pop idol if he wants to be an actor again. Can Hyeon make it in the cutthroat world of fierce competition, demanding schedules, and fake smiles? Or will he fail and lose his second shot at fame?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kishi Danchou no Musuko wa Akuyaku Reijou wo Dekiai suru
synopsis:
"Alice, I'm breaking off my engagement to you!" are the words Echs, the son of the Knight Commander, remembers from his previous life. In the very place where the prince's engagement is about to be broken off, he remembers the exact same situation from his previous life in a dating sim game. Though clearly fale, the villainess is blamed together with another character. And when he saw the heroine sneakily smiling at him, he made up his mind. He wants to save his favorite villainess and make her his own. This is just a sweet story about a hero reincarnated as the son of a knight commander in a dating sim game who dotes on the villainess.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Exorcist no Kiyoshi-kun
synopsis:
The most powerful exorcist in history—Kiyoshi! In order to protect that which is precious to him, Kiyoshi has attained ultimate strength. But he has a secret he can't tell anyone... Become a sword that slays evil! Become a shield that protects the weak!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Himaten!
synopsis:
High school home ec expert Tenichi earns extra money with a part-time job cleaning houses. But one day, Himari, the owner and model of the popular cosmetics brand Hima Riz, transfers into his class. Say hello to some company president girl x house-cleaner boy romantic comedy hijinks!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Muryoku Seijo to Munou Oujo: Maryoku Zero de Shoukan sareta Seijo no Isekai Kyuukokuki
titleEnglish: Helpless Saint and the Powerless Princess
synopsis:
One day, part-timer Tamura Nana was summoned out of her room and into another world, after which her summoners declared her a saint and asked her to save their world. However, though she was hailed as a saint, it turned out that Nana possessed no magical power at all! And to make matters worse, she was chosen as a partner by a princess who can't use magic...

The helpless saint who has no magic and the powerless princess who can't use magic. And so begins the adventure of these two leftover heroes!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Drunk Bullet
synopsis:
After surviving World War I, Gary, a liquor-loving ex-serviceman, finally makes his way home. To his shock, Prohibition has post-war America in a chokehold! The curtains open on Gary's action-packed quest for a sweet, shining glass of booze!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Wareta Cup wo Modosu ni wa
titleEnglish: How to Repair a Broken Cup
synopsis:
It's been ten and a half years since Keita and Kippei started dating. But even after all that time, they realize they still have difficulties communicating after Kippei accidentally breaks a sentimental mug. Suddenly, Kippei is struck by a time-twisting phenomenon that gives the couple the chance to reflect on their time together. The eighteen-year-old Kippei wakes up in 2020, and the twenty-eight-year-old Kippei wakes up in 2010! Can the two reignite their relationship and sex lives with their partners from the past?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: MAD
synopsis:
Mysterious alien life-forms invade Earth! Most of humanity is wiped off the face of the planet. John, his sister, and the remaining survivors hope to find a new world to inhabit... But one day, they're targeted by aliens again!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yume ka Utsutsu ka
synopsis:
Daydreamy Iroha is too shy and anxious to talk to her high school classmates, so she finds solace in confiding in upperclassman Sou, who is always encouraging and supportive. With such a great friend by her side, Iroha just may have found a dream come true!

Iroha avoids the awkwardness she feels around her classmates by sitting outside and talking to Sou, the handsome boy she met at the library. However, one day, a boy from her class discovers the secret she's been keeping from everyone. Has Iroha found her perfect match in Sou, or just an illusory love?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Koharu to Minato: Watashi no Partner wa Onnanoko
titleEnglish: Koharu and Minato: Happy Life with My Girlfriend
synopsis:
Koharu and Minato are two women who met online. Despite there being a ten-year age gap between them, the two fall hard and fast. Before long, they decide to load up the moving van and move in together!

Relationships aren't always easy, but Minato and Koharu find a way to work things out. Whether it's having a celebratory feast, taking a late-night stroll, or just enjoying their domestic bliss, the two make every minute together count!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Haitatsusaki no Oneesan ga Kowasugiru
titleEnglish: My Favorite VTuber Is Scary IRL
synopsis:
An introverted part-time food delivery guy working in the countryside receives a food delivery order. When he reaches the delivery address, he discovers that the recipient is a tall and intimidating-like woman. However, as the story unfolds, he eventually discovers...

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Shuu ni Ichido Classmate wo Kau Hanashi: Futari no Jikan, Iiwake no 5000-en
synopsis:
Once a week, Miyagi pays 5,000 yen to her classmate Sendai. The 5,000 yen is to buy three hours of Sendai's time, which gives the right for Miyagi to give her orders.

Miyagi is at the bottom of the school caste while Sendai is at the top. The two, who never crossed paths at school, spend time together after school under such a contract. Miyagi's orders are determined by her mood of the day, and Sendai cannot disobey. One day after school, Miyagi calls Sendai to her room and gives her an order that she usually does not give.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Fukuzatsu na Kyoudai no 4-koma
synopsis:
"Nee-chan!?" "Kouta!?" The two of them were enjoying an in-game romance (without knowing each other's identities). Upon seeing each other's faces at their long-awaited offline meetup... they were both shocked to see that the other was in fact their own sibling!? These are complicated feelings for sure... and rather hard to accept!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Gwichon Village Mystery
synopsis:
Heo Mumyeong is a cold-blooded serial killer. Following his latest murder, he disposes of the evidence and decides to move to his late grandmother's home in Gwichon Village. From the moment he approaches the village, the atmosphere is unnerving. Strange and hostile individuals question his identity and reason for coming, and his grandmother's house has been oddly well-maintained. The villagers seem to want the apathetic outsider gone, while burying dark truths and worshiping the mysterious "Mother." Mumyeong does not believe in ghosts or shamanism, but the violence, death, and creepy rituals prove that something far worse than him is watching.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Behind Her Highness's Smile
synopsis:
When the king offers Aerik Cladinae his own sister's hand in marriage for his meritorious deeds in battle, he didn't expect to get saddled with a limping, drooling woman like Miesa Esquillre. Driven insane by her brother's physical and psychological torture, Miesa rolls around on the ground, spills food all over herself, and screams unintelligebly as a way of communicating. But sometimes, Aerik catches a flash of shrewd understanding behind those vacant eyes. Is Miesa truly as mad as everyone thinks... or is she hiding something?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Favela no Mangaka
synopsis:
Hiroto Takei, a manga artist who failed a serialization conference, decided to give up on his dream and went on a heartbreak trip to Brazil to put everything behind him. In a favela (slum) that he happened to wander into, Hiroto met João, a poor boy with a piercing gaze. He lives right on the other side of the world, and to his surprise, he has a dream of becoming a Japanese manga artist!

No matter where you live, you don't have to give up. The story of two slum dwellers chasing their dreams begins!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Warrior Grandpa and His Supreme Granddaughter
titleEnglish: Warrior Grandpa and His Supreme Granddaughter
synopsis:
A fallen clan, a lone survivor, and a warrior grandfather. Jinsan Yu, once a legendary martial artist, swears to the heavens he would survive until Seol, a child with an extraordinary gift, comes of age. Through fate's hand, they encounter allies and enemies alike from the unlikeliest of places, and unearth deep conspiracies concerning the Yu Clan's downfall. "I'll protect you, Grandpa!" The supreme cry of his youngest granddaughter ignites a dying warrior's spirit.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Amateur Vigilante
synopsis:
Action thriller about an obsessed lonely man with a delusional plot to save Japan by assassinating a politician. But his twisted plan is disturbed when he witnesses a young girl next door getting abducted by the Yakuza. He decides to save her but his attempt ends in a chaotic massacre where he manages to kill the gangsters. But things only get worse from here on out, now he's getting hunted down by even more ruthless killers.

(Source: MU)

title: Top 1 Fighting Tutoring
synopsis:
The bullied loser Kim Jaehyuk receives "Top 1 Fighting Tutoring!"

Kim Jaehyuk is a high school student who has been living in despair under the torment of bullies. He's good at studying, but he'd rather be good at fighting. Then, as if by fate, a "fighting tutor" comes into his life!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Tears on a Withered Flower
synopsis:
Na Haesu's life unravels when her husband betrays her with an affair, leaving her burdened with debt and losing their child. In a devastating blow, she witnesses him with a younger woman. Broken and despondent, Na Haesu feels her life crumbling around her. However, a mysterious young man unexpectedly enters her life, asking to be taught about adult love. His vulnerability and sincerity begin to stir emotions within Na Haesu, challenging her to reconsider her path forward.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Shibatsuki Bukken
synopsis:
The highly popular one-shot is finally back!! A newly built 1LDK apartment with rent of 4,800 yen! The reason is the "earthbound spirit of a Shiba Inu"...!? A heartwarming comedy about a cool and sightly awkward high school girl, Kori, and a quirky Shiba Inu spirit, Mu-chan, begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koroshi Korosare Sankaku Kankei ni Watashi ga Ima kara Hairun desu ka?
synopsis:
Kohaku is a girl who spent her junior high school years as a loner and dreams of living a fulfilling life in high school. However, on her first day of school she falls down the stairs and ends up hospitalized for a month! This means that everyone besides her has already formed a group of friends at school... In order to avoid being a loner, she summons up the courage and calls out to the only odd-numbered group in her class, but it seems that they are high up in the school caste system, and are actually involved in a blood-splattered yuri love triangle with a non-human...! A high-strung high school comedy about escaping loner status!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Exclusive Contractor's Quitting Chronicles
synopsis:
In a world where hunter rank is everything, Rank F Yoon Seora is lucky to even have a job at the Hunter Association. But when she's trapped in a dungeon, she yells at the system, blaming her inability to escape on her low rank. Out of pity, it offers her an exclusive contract, which Seora accepts, soaring to Rank S! She begs the system to keep this a secret until she can earn enough money to quit her job. Can Seora resign with riches, or will her fellow Rank S hunters track her down first?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo, Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
titleEnglish: "Hitokiri" Girl Becomes Bodyguard for Duke's Daughter
synopsis:
Shurine has mastered the sword as a girl raised to serve as a bodyguard. However, she has been falsely accused of assassinating a client and is forced to go on the lam. Driven out of her homeland to a foreign land, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger, because she is embroiled in a dispute over the succession to the throne. Lutecia is attacked by an assassin, and Shurine makes a proposal.

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Otaku mo Koi mo Rensa suru
synopsis:
"The girl sitting next to me, Yuzuru Kakoi, has the cutest face. Alas, she also has an absolute stunner of a boyfriend, Chihiro Kawai. And me? Well, I'm just their biggest shipper, Wataru Otonari, living out a happy-go-lucky high school life!"

A school-life romcom revolving around an avid shipper otaku who has been blessed with killer looks for no good reason!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Driver's High
synopsis:
The famous L1 racecar driver Leonardo "Leo" Lombardi is on a winner's high, basking in success and fame. He is on the path to claim the world champion title for the second year in a row, and his wonderful and supportive boyfriend of five years, J.J., follows him everywhere as one of the mechanics on his team. However, seemingly out of nowhere, J.J. breaks up with Leo with no signs of wanting to get back together.

With the sudden breakup, Leo is forced to look inward and recognize his mistakes, though he believes he is incapable of wrongdoing. Despite the glaring issues with his wild behavior, arrogance, and complacent disinterest in J.J.'s life and career, Leo struggles to change. Still, Leo realizes how much J.J. means to him and resolves to do everything he can to improve, return on the track to victory, and win back the heart of the one he loves.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Students of Illip Arts High
titleEnglish: The Students of Illip Arts High
synopsis:
Meet Sol Han, the human photocopier who can replicate anything she sees with precision! One day, she stumbles upon a mysterious genius's drawing in a VR game, igniting her passion for art. Curiosity leads her from a quiet countryside to Illip Arts High School, the epitome of artistic excellence. Amidst challenges and tangled friendships, Sol's journey, a captivating tale of youthful growth and camaraderie, unfolds in the picturesque halls of Illip.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kimi dake ni
synopsis:
1. Nayamigoto (Worries)
2. Kimi dake ni (Just For You)
3. Bell-Up
4. Toaru Shuumatsu (A Certain Weekend)
5. Toaru no Chakushin (A Certain Arrival)
6. Purity Bitch
7. Minikui Bitch na Ko (The Unattractive, Slutty Girl)

title: Sakamoto Holidays
synopsis:
Sakamoto and Shin catch a shoplifter, but the shoplifter returns with his gang to ambush them. Can Sakamoto and Shin defend themselves without spilling blood, keep Hana unaware of what's happening, and complete the housework perfectly?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Dungeon Elf: Dungeon ni Takarabako ga Aru no wa Atarimae desu ka
titleEnglish: Dungeon Elf: What's a Dungeon without Treasure Chests?
synopsis:
A question that even the most ardent of RPG lovers struggle to answer: Why are there treasure chests placed so conveniently throughout the dungeons? In the grass fields of the Forest of Beginnings, in deadly realms where even the greatest heroes must be prepared to face total annihilation, and even in people's homes―there, treasure chests sit, aiding unwitting adventurers and maintaining the world's balance. This is the story of someone, unbeknownst and unnoticed by anyone, who carries those chests.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Opposites Attract
synopsis:
Can you overcome incompatibility?

Despite the fact that business major Dojae is far from his type, Euntak falls in love at first sight. Truth be told, the two of them couldn't be any more different. But after a one-night stand with Dojae, Euntak faces a new dilemma...

(Source: Manta)

title: Juvenile Detention Center
synopsis:
Juyeong is in a juvenile detention center for the attempted murder of his father, Gang-ryong. He clings to hope, dreaming of a future in Seoul with his childhood friend, Dayeon. But everything shatters when Dayeon is tragically killed by a rogue truck, and the devastation deepens when Juyeong learns that his father was behind the wheel. In a cruel twist, Gang-ryong regains consciousness and offers Juyeong an ultimatum: "If you want revenge, become the king of this detention center!" Now, Juyeong must navigate the treacherous world of prison politics, determined to rise to power and avenge his friend.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Aisare Tenshi na Classmate ga, Ore ni dake Itazura ni Hohoemu
titleEnglish: The Classmate Who Is Adored by Everyone Smiles Teasingly Only at Me
synopsis:
Souma Ichinose is a high school student who dreams of becoming a pastry chef and devotes himself to making sweets. He meets Chika Satomi, a female classmate, when he brings her some sweets. Chika is a beautiful girl with a soothing personality, known at school as the "Angel of Peace." Souma thought she was a good girl who would kindly listen to his worries about making sweets, but... "Ichise-san, your embarrassed face is really cute." Chika shows an unexpected side of herself only when they are alone, and Souma's heart is on the verge of exploding! A sweet and stimulating boy-meets-girl story with a mischievous angel connected by sweets begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Flower That Swallowed the Beast
titleEnglish: The Flower That Swallowed the Beast
synopsis:
A bargain for her life, to escape a tragic future. When Iris Whittle is murdered by her sadistic husband, she is sent back in time to when she was 20 years old. As the unwanted daughter of a duke, Iris realizes she can leverage her status and foresight to secure a better life this time around. Thus, Iris makes a daring marriage proposal to the fearsome Count Keibrandt Green, the most eligible bachelor of Gavizar Empire, whose gruff and stern demeanor hides the fangs of a wolf.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: 'Cause Calypso Can
synopsis:
Calypso has experienced repeated reincarnation, and is her 4th reincarnation. In her previous lives, she always died before she reached the age of 22 and returned to where everything started. During her 3rd life, she discovered that when a dragon goes on a rampage, it distorts dimensions. Determined to use this knowledge, she plans to exploit the dragon's power to return to her original world. Currently, Calypso finds herself in a childcare story, where she encounters a man who she believes to be her father but doesn't recognize her. Seeking his help, Calypso involves her "father" and family in her quest, turning them into unwitting allies in her journey.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Dying Villainess Denies Adoption
synopsis:
After transmigrating into the body of a terminally ill villainess, Ibellin decides to find a peaceful life and a happy ending instead. Rather than selling off the main villain, Raven, to get the expensive medicine needed to treat her illness, Ibellin decides to heal the boy and then quickly send him on his way. But when Raven's father comes to seek her out, Ibellin is given a choice she's never imagined before. Will she accept it, or will she decline in hopes of finding happiness elsewhere?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Virtual God Is a Teenage Girl
titleEnglish: My Virtual God Is a Teenage Girl
synopsis:
From good looks, brains, hot body, wealth, and a gorgeous family. It seemed like Jumin's life was god perfect. Until he realized that his world was merely a simulation controlled by... well, a teenage girl! With just a click of her mouse, Jumin loses everything and returns to high school! Will he break free from the program and reclaim what he lost?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Manemane Nichinichi
synopsis:
Set in a high school baseball club, it is a "coming-of-age sideline story," focusing on the three team managers with very different personalities: Nagisa, who barely knows the rules of baseball; Ichinose, a flamboyant gal; and Himemiya, the quiet girl with a surprisingly nasty side.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: The Countdown of My Death Is Spamming My Status Window
titleEnglish: The Countdown of My Death Is Spamming My Status Window
synopsis:
A masterpiece of over 3,000 volumes, I was incarnated into "Dawn of Repentance." Moreover, as the successor to the duke's family, facing a grim fate, I became my cherished character, "Michel Nephthys." But upon opening the status window, the countdown to death was D-3. With the thought that I couldn't die like this, I somehow managed to survive, and each time I changed the development, experience points were granted?! If that's the case, I'll change the original storyline drastically to reap the benefits. Leaving the deceased Michel Nephthys aside, I lived as the nanny's daughter, "Evan Laeff," doing as told, but missions kept pouring in on the status window, and failure meant death. Now that it's like this, whether the storyline changes or not doesn't matter. I will definitely survive and prevail!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Multiverse no Watashi, Koishite Ii desu ka?
titleEnglish: Can I Fall in Love with a Multiverse?
synopsis:
If things had been different, we would never have met. Would you regret not saying you loved me? A one-shot multiverse romantic comedy that explores new possibilities!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Worst Villainess
synopsis:
Possessing a character in a fictional story is one thing, but possessing a character in your own story is another... especially when you've become a dramatic villainess in a typical K-drama series. The only way Miso can escape from this world is to live through all of the episodes, but she has to deal with cliché tropes such as an arranged marriage with the male lead and an unnecessary rivalry with the female lead. Will Miso be able to break away from this predetermined destiny and find another happy ending for all of her characters?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Galaxias
synopsis:
Even though Jio desires to see the wider world shaped by dragonfolk—individuals with supernatural abilities—her dreams may well be out of her reach. Her father insists that Jio live out her life in their quiet, rural hometown. The thought of becoming an adventurer like her legendary idol, Yuri Holst, seems even more improbable than ever before.

One day, Jio crosses paths with a young man named Neraid, who is on a journey to recover his lost memories. To make matters more interesting, the missing memories seem to be connected to Yuri. However, a run-in with the authorities makes Jio realize that her idol might not be so heroic after all. In order to uncover the truth behind who they both are, Jio and Neraid set off on a perilous journey to explore the depths of the kingdom they reside in.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Dead Mansion
synopsis:
A private orphanage in Russia called "Dead Mansion" trains young children to become agents. "Codename Sean," the legend of Dead Mansion, who was thought to be lost, has suddenly appeared at a middle school in Korea?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover
titleEnglish: You Are a Four Leaf Clover
synopsis:
Uichi, once a happy and popular boy, is now the victim of cruel bullying. Then suddenly Yotsuha, his childhood friend and first love, shows up. How will this cute and kind-hearted girl try to help him...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Dear Summer Sky
synopsis:
Gihu, a high schooler with a passion for photographing the sky, dreams of entering a photography contest. However, the contest requires a portrait photo, which he's terrible at. He enlists the help of Haneul, a mysterious new transfer student who accidentally appears in one of Gihu's sky photos. Despite his struggles, he finds himself wanting to take more photos of her. As they prepare for the school festival, Gihu becomes more intrigued by Haneul, while she, initially misjudging him, helps him out of guilt after realizing she underestimated his abilities.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Bouken ni wa, Buki ga Hitsuyou da! Kodawari Rudy no Kajiyagurashi
titleEnglish: Every Adventure Needs a Weapon! The Blacksmith Life of Rudy the Obsessed
synopsis:
Rudy has a goal—to become a top-tier weaponsmith and make the coolest weapons the world has ever seen! Sure, her boss always gets mad about her bizarre creations, but she has a blast crafting them. And she lives right outside a dungeon, so she's in the perfect spot to aid adventurers passing through on their way to fight monsters. Surely she won't bite off more than she can chew...right?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo
synopsis:
Ueno and Kanada seem like two complete opposites in the office. Ueno is an accountant who can strike fear into his co-workers with his strict and unbending ways. Meanwhile, Kanda is the superstar of the sales department—and thanks to his friendly and outgoing personality, he is even next in line to be manager! While most would think these two could never mesh, the truth is they're actually very close friends outside of work. 

Kanda often crashes at Ueno's place, and the two spend time with each other constantly, growing closer than most co-workers would. But when Ueno confesses to Kanada that he's gay, a myriad of unsaid feelings begin to grow between them. Ueno has mixed feelings about how close and touchy Kanada can be, while Kanada is hung up on the fact that Ueno claimed he wasn't his type! 

Can these two salarymen navigate their true feelings and realize the growing love between them?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: To Whom It No Longer Concerns
titleEnglish: To Whom It No Longer Concerns
synopsis:
Exploited by her brother, betrayed by her sister, and killed by her husband. So ended the tragic story of Ariana Lopez—until, at the moment of her death, she suddenly finds herself back in the past. Now that she has a chance to do it all over again, she enlists the help of Duke Dante Heigenberg, the most feared and desired man in the entire empire, to take revenge against her family and reclaim what's rightfully hers. But strangely, the duke seems to want Ariana more than just for her extraordinary musical talent...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Seinaru Otome to Himegoto wo
titleEnglish: Doing Secret Things with the Holy Maidens
synopsis:
After spending the night playing the latest 18+ game, Itsuki Kusaka finds himself waking up in an entirely different world! Despite the fact he has no desire to be a hero, his attitude changes when a giant, naked goddess tells him the details of his mission. All Itsuki has to do is teach her disciples a thing or two about sex. With hands-on learning, of course. Is this a dream come true for this adult gaming fan, or will Itsuki find his mission to be more challenging than he expected?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Even When I'm Dead
synopsis:
On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Bokura no Ai wa Kimochi Warui
synopsis:
Everyone is hiding a "secret."

Azuki Komugi is obsessed with ruminating on her memories of her high school girlfriend "Meguru," and creating a body model of hers out of clay. One day, Azuki drops her homemade "Meguru" at the 100-yen shop where she works part-time, and sneaks into her workplace on her off-shift to get "her" back. However, what she sees there is a fellow co-worker, high school girl Yoyuki Remu, who is about to express her lust for "Meguru" in a way that is different from Azuki's...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Osananajimi wo Erabenai!
titleEnglish: I Can't Choose a Childhood Friend
synopsis:
For Yuu Suzukaze, reuniting with the childhood friend he adored feels like a dream come true. After ten long years apart, they can finally enjoy high school life together. But it turns out, this girl isn't exactly "single"!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Watashi no Koi no Hajimekata
synopsis:
"I'd like to see the look on Senpai's face when she falls in love." Chisaki, a fan of romantic reality shows, has formed many couples in her daily life, earning her the nickname "MatchApp Senpai." She has no experience but is constantly gaining knowledge, and has given up on love for herself, but for some reason she is drawn to her kouhai Reo-kun! While supporting his friends' love lives, she ends up rehabilitating her own love life with Reo-kun!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok
synopsis:
After witnessing the death of one of their own, the Absolute Ones—creators of the many universes outside of our own—frantically seek to fill the power void left by their fallen brother. With earth's existence in danger once more as gates spill monsters into our dimension, Sung Suho must answer the call and conquer the shadow dungeon while learning of his father's legendary legacy.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lady Solea Just Wants to Go Home
titleEnglish: Lady Solea Just Wants to Go Home
synopsis:
Lady Solea's family can't figure out how she lost her memories or why she keeps raving about her "jackpot." They don't realize she's actually Yoon Jiyoon, a lottery winner who was suddenly brought into their world! Determined to return to her reality and claim her riches, Jiyoon sets off a series of shenanigans to send herself home. Yet when Solea's family proves more fun than expected and distracts her from the mission to leave, Jiyoon begins to wonder if family is worth more than a fortune...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Holy Emperor's Grandson Is a Necromancer
titleEnglish: The Holy Emperor's Grandson Is a Necromancer
synopsis:
After a near-death experience, something has changed about the Holy Emperor's troublemaker of a grandson. To be precise, his body was taken over by a Korean man who died while playing a VR video game! But when his necromancer character is mixed with a Holy Prince's blood, things start getting funky. The zombies he makes are incredibly nice, his curses start healing people, and the girl he saved from being turned into a zombie suddenly gains super strength. Now he has to play the hero, but he'd really rather just go for a nap.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Emperor's Sword
synopsis:
Zhu Yunwen, who barely survived the Jingnan campaign, received the souls of two of the world's strongest martial artists, the First Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Cult and Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of the Shaolin Temple, in his body, and was reborn as Heaven Destroyer. This is the story of the Heaven Destroyer's journey to become an absolute existence!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Meririrarariri
synopsis:
When she loses her calm, she is unable to use magic. In order to become a great witch, Merrily has lived her life according to her mother's teachings, keeping her mind clear no matter what. Then one day, Merrily meets a boy named Danka. As she interacts with him, Merrily's heart changes...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Xiao Mogu
synopsis:
In the year 2020, Earth's magnetic poles disappeared and humankind was nearly wiped out by cosmic radiation. Within the span of a hundred years, living creatures began to mutate and devour each other while the remaining humans, numbering in the tens of thousands, struggled bitterly in their man-made bases.

In the Abyss, home to the mutated xenogenics, there lived a sentient little mushroom. Because it had been nourished by the blood and flesh of the deceased human An Ze, not only did it take on a similar-looking human form, but a similar name as well: An Zhe.

An Zhe is determined to go to the human base to search for his spore, which had been harvested by humans. Once there, however, he faces the omnipresent risk of discovery and certain death as he tries to keep his non-human nature hidden from the Judges, whose responsibility is to inspect for and eliminate xenogenics like himself. And of all the Judges, Colonel Lu Feng is the most perceptive and merciless—as soon as he determines that someone is a xenogenic, he will execute that person on the spot.

But An Zhe's mutation goes undetected by Lu Feng's eyes, and so a tale of humans and xenogenics unfolds...

(Source: Peach Flowe…

title: The New Hire Is the Demon Lord
titleEnglish: The New Hire Is the Demon Lord
synopsis:
Dullahan, the demon lord who once terrorized the world, finally revives in modern-day Korea, eager to take revenge against the hero who defeated her centuries ago. But all she can find is his descendant, Yongrae Kim: a hapless, incompetent office worker with no prospects and no joy in life. Ending his life now would only be doing him a favor, so Dullahan decides to improve his life first... but Yongrae's two-timing girlfriend and his many strict superiors at work stand in the way. Can Dullahan crush the office hierarchy and awaken Yongrae's dormant hero abilities to make her revenge more satisfying?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: No\Name
synopsis:
In a world where peoples' names grant them superhuman powers... Two agents from the Nordic Naming Bureau (NNB), an agency specialized in investigating crimes committed by "Namers," handle the case of a man and his missing wife and son. Things take a turn, however, when the duo come face to face with the man, who wishes to give his son the same name as himself...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Villainous Tyrant Has Returned
synopsis:
Was there ever a greater tragedy than love turned to hate? Such is the tragic downfall of Emperor Ludwig of Berzantium, as he is betrayed and murdered in a fiery blaze by his empress. Olive Charleterre was once a bright young debutante, until her spirit was broken by the emperor's cruelty. Yet when Ludwig opens his eyes, he finds he has been sent back in time to his childhood. Whether he uses this boon to reclaim his lost love and forge a new path away from his villainous future—only time will tell.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Archduke's Magical Business Partner
synopsis:
After dying in a car accident, I possessed the villainess Daphne in an R-rated dark romance novel. Of all people, why did I have to possess her? This life wasn't going to be easy either... But this life is surprisingly sweet and enjoyable! Thanks to the knowledge of herbs I gained in my past life to make a living, I developed a hit business.

"My sister is a hero who saved us!"
"Weren't you calling me a witch before?"
"Th-that was in the past...."

I also gained adorable twin cousins. Somehow, I ended up restoring strained family relationships, making my taciturn and awkward family members cry tears of joy. And even...

"Why would you eat something unsavory when there's something delicious right in front of you?"

I even acquired a business partner who, despite being frail but full of charm, is determined to win me over with their good looks! (Of course, I didn't realize this innocent Grand Duke was the mastermind behind everything at the time.) Could life get any better? A 200% happiness index, living the high life as a villainess!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Roses and Champagne
synopsis:
Korean-Russian lawyer Lee-Won Jeong rushes to work one day when he literally collides with a striking, blond-haired, gray-eyed stranger. Lee-Won thinks nothing of the chance encounter—until their paths cross again under far more ominous circumstances.

The stranger is revealed to be Ceasar Sergeev, the heir to the powerful Sergeev mafia empire. But even that is just the tip of the iceberg.

As a dedicated civil rights attorney, Lee-Won suspects the mafia is pressuring a senator to cheat his client, and he's determined to uncover the truth. But as Lee-Won delves deeper, Caesar's obsession with him grows more intense. Now, Lee-Won is about to learn just how perilous it is to attract the attention of the Russian mob.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Black Chains
synopsis:
Despite standing by Black Dragon Akelans' side for 14 years as his loyal vassal, Hasolan was never accepted as his mate, her love left unrequited until the day she took her own life. But upon opening her eyes, Hasolan finds herself back in the past on the day she first awakened Akelans. Though she tries to change her fate in this life, she ends up in the merciless dragon's clutches once more. Except this time, there's something different about him. To Hasolan's shock, Akelans acknowledges her as his mate right away. But at this point, it may be too late...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Absolute Regression
synopsis:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him—even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom's father. But Mugeuk didn't accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Koori no Hime wa Chiisana Hidamari de Tokasaretai
synopsis:
Miharu Aoba is a high school boy who, in lieu of his busy parents, looks after his kindergarten-age siblings. Although he doesn't have time for romance, he enjoys spending time with his younger siblings. One day, Aoba brings them to a play date at the home of a classmate of his, the cool beauty Yuki Mizudori, who is known as the "Ice Princess." Mizudori asks him, "Can you make me smile?" A youthful romantic comedy about high school students who cherish their little siblings!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Let Me Kidnap the Male Lead!
titleEnglish: Let Me Kidnap the Male Lead!
synopsis:
Following a carriage crash, our heroine recalls being reincarnated as Vivian in a novel called "The Bloody Flower." Poor Vivian now knows she's a side villain who dies after kidnapping the male lead. But if she doesn't kidnap him and guide him to the female lead, the demon will destroy the world anyway! Unfortunately, the male lead was only described as "handsome," and this world is crawling with handsome men. Thirty kidnappings later, all Vivian has is a handful of good-looking fans who loved their luxury hostage experience. If only someone could point her to the man she's looking for...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Ookami wa Tsuki ni Koi wo Suru
synopsis:
Runa Ookamigawa is a beautiful and perfect student council president. She is scary when she gets angry, so the frivolous and incompetent vice president Yuuga Tsukiyama calls her "Wolf-senpai." The two are like the moon and the turtle, contrasting with each other and not getting along.

One day, Tsukiyama finds out about Wolf-senpai's true nature through a secret part-time job...!? The mismatched love story of two people with secret faces begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: One-Room TA
synopsis:
When college student Uyun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jinhyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jinhyeong moves in with him, and that's when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He's thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having Uyun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jinhyeong's ideas are, Uyun doesn't entirely hate it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Urenokori no Dorei Elf wo Hirotta node, Musume ni Suru Koto ni Shita
