titleEnglish: My Daughter Was an Unsold Slave Elf
synopsis:
Weiss comes across a high elf girl for sale, a superior species of elf that is thought to be extinct. He decides to buy her and raise her as his daughter. She doesn't even know the language, but Weiss's hard work raising her pays off...? You won't be able to take your eyes off the high elf as her growth doesn't stop!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shadow of the Supreme
synopsis:
Yangcheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world's most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn't end with the same regrets?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tonari no Kurokawa-san
synopsis:
Hajime Takahashi enrolled in Shuubi High School solely because it's the sacred place of his favorite manga. Everywhere in the school are locations that appeared in the manga, and he's super excited! Amidst this excitement, Takahashi meets a beautiful girl, Yayoi Kurokawa, who looks just like the heroine from his favorite work, and they come to share a certain secret. This awkward duo weaves a sweet and tangy youth romantic comedy that will make you grin!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Multiverse no Watashi, Koishite Ii desu ka?
titleEnglish: Can I Fall in Love with a Multiverse?
synopsis:
Jogo has a crush on his classmate, Miyato. One day, they unexpectedly end up walking home together after school. When Miyato is about to be hit by a truck, Jogo throws himself in harm's way to save her. In the final moment before impact, Jogo wishes he could have told Miyato how he felt. But then he hears a mysterious voice saying, "You can do it over. This time, don't have any regrets."

When he wakes up, he finds himself unharmed, lying on the ground, with a different version of Miyato beside him—she looks the same, but her clothes and hairstyle are different.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Izuki-kun wa Tadasaretai
synopsis:
Izuki-kun has a crush on an older student: Ririko-senpai, the president of the disciplinary committee! Izuki repeatedly tries wearing his uniform sloppily, just to have a chance to talk to her even a little bit, but Ririko is way ahead of him...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Isekai Maid no Mitsuboshi Gourmet: Gendai Gohan Tsukuttara Oukyuu de Dai-bazuri shimashita
titleEnglish: The Maid's Three-Star Cuisine in Another World I Used Real-Life Dishes to Become a Palace Sensation
synopsis:
Gluttonous girl Shirley has been reborn in another world, but there is one problem: the new world does not seem to have hamburgers, beef bowls, or ramen noodles she loves so much. While missing the previous life's age of plenty, she rouses herself to action, declaring, "Well, if you don't have one, you just got to make it yourself!" In order to recreate the modern-day dishes, Shirley busies herself with cooking every day and the rumor of her starts to spread. Then one day, a scout from the royal palace pays Shirley a visit and asks her to be a maid to make snacks for the prince?! B-grade gourmet food and sweets are her areas of expertise! A culinary maverick causes quite a stir in the royal palace?! 

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Oniure Idol ga Kyou mo Watashi wo Oshitekuru
synopsis:
Unpopular underground idol and actress, Enatsu Sayuki, faces her work diligently everyday to achieve her dreams of making it big in the world of acting. ...However, for some reason, the superstar idol Sera Touma—who should be her rival—becomes her biggest fan!! Adorable enough to make Sayuki jealous, Sera takes every chance to passionately declare her love, throwing Sayuki’s life into chaos. Will Sayuki be able to achieve her dreams? And what will become of the one-sided love(?) between Sera and Sayuki…!? The curtain rises on the clash between these young talents in the fierce age of idol showbiz—let the show begin!!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Seasons of Lovesome
synopsis:
Life isn't always perfect, but love certainly makes it better. The exciting tale of young love continues a year following the story Seasons of Blossom. Bomi and her university classmate Pureum's lives center around a new place, "Cafe Blossom & Nemone Art Studio," as they navigate the joy and hardships of university and professional life.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Dang Clan's Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life
titleEnglish: The Dang Clan's Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life
synopsis:
The Dang clan of Sacheon, once renowned for its poison and hidden weapons, is now on the path to its demise. That is, until Yeonmyeung Dang, an outcast boy of the clan, awakens by recollecting the memories of his past life as the "god of swords" who devoted his life to mastering the sword. Will the boy be able to protect his family and fulfill his dream of living a normal life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tsumi to Batsu no Spica
synopsis:
Hatori is a teacher living a typical life at an ordinary high school. One day, he notices that a student of his, Supika Tsumugi, is being bullied. On the way home in the rain, he happens to find himself alone with Tsumugi. Hatori tells her, "I'll do something about it," but Tsumugi holds his hand gently and says with a laugh, "Hatori-sensei is such a liar." A teacher and a student... two people who shouldn't get overly close. A somewhat fascinating girl completely changes Hatori's ordinary life...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kozure Batsuichi, Saigo no Koi wa Numa deshita.
titleEnglish: When a Divorced Single Mother Met Her Love Swamp
synopsis:
A scummy but perfect bachelor soothes the heart of a hardworking single mom!!

Touko is a single mom who spends her days working and raising her kid without relying on anyone. One day, Touko collapses from overwork and is rescued by a male university student who lives in the unit next door. He's a handsome-grade eligible bachelor, but also a bit scummy. For Touko, who hates men, it seems to be the start of a final love...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: We Are Not Dating!!
synopsis:
"Why do you keep asking if we're dating? We're just holding hands, we're not dating!!" It's a slice-of-life romantic comedy about couples who aren't really couples!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Press Play, Sami
synopsis:
After her parents died, Sami gave up her life of fortune to live independently, doing odd jobs to make ends meet. When she starts to get involved with two of the most popular boys at her high school, Sami faces twists and turns—Chan is her neighbor, and Pyojun makes her have conflicted feelings. Things get more complicated when she finds out that Chan has feelings for Pyojun as well! With her mom's only keepsake in hand to keep her feet on the ground, Sami navigates obstacles that she wasn't prepared for—and aren't even in her budget!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Dark Mermaid
synopsis:
She just wants to start fresh so she can graduate in peace. She just wants to leave behind all the bad memories—her sleepwalking, the trauma from being bullied at school—all of it. She did everything she could to keep to herself, but the class president, Hae-on, just won't leave her alone. One day, when Seulbi visits the local lake Hae-on recommended, she comes across something she never imagined seeing in her wildest dreams: a wild, dark mermaid.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Momose Akira no Hatsukoi Hatanchuu.
synopsis:
Highlights of Akira's carefully orchestrated strategy to court Hajime include covering his eyes with her hands, tricking him into saying her name, and making his heart race. But she might have better luck impressing him with her academic and athletic prowess. Or not. Because he's too dense to figure out she likes him. And she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Our Sunny Days
synopsis:
Sung Ho's not the kind you'd typically expect to settle down in the countryside. He's in his late 20s, ex-military, and...a single father with a year-old baby his ex-girlfriend pawned off on him. Jobless and without any prospects but a house, Sung Ho hopes the peaceful Nuldongmae village will make a good new home for him and his daughter. Rumor has it that the head of the village, despite his young age, is a real jerk... But he won't have to deal with that, will he? But on the very day he moves in, Sung Ho clashes with a tall, good-looking guy who's got quite the temper and accuses Sung Ho of stealing from his store. This new guy really gets on his nerves, but he does seem to know a lot about the village... Sung Ho's always been a bit of a lone ranger wherever he goes, so will he be able to let someone else in his life for sunny days up ahead?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Light of Arad: Forerunner
synopsis:
Jinseong streams the online action game Dungeon and Fighter for a living, and while assisting a ranger, he ends up doing exactly what the player warned him not to—helping him fight the boss. Little did Jinseong know that the ranger was a person sucked into the game world, and was now dead for failing his mission. Transported into the world of DNF to take responsibility, Jinseong must work his way through the quest line as a Dark Knight to stop the contamination from leading players astray and destroying the world of Arad. Will he make it through alive?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mahou Shoujo Dandelion
synopsis:
Across the world, heinous creatures known as phantoms drain the life force of their human victims, and the only ones capable of defeating them are magical girls. But one being challenges this conflict between good and evil: the shadow phantom Shade, who has protected the 16-year-old Tanpopo Ohanami from other phantoms and her occasional missteps since her childhood.

One day at school, Tanpopo is called upon by the special anti-phantom organization Butterfly responsible for managing magical girls. They believe Tanpopo has a great potential to become a powerful magical girl herself, but Shade warns her that should she become one, they will become enemies. All Tanpopo ever wanted was to fight alongside her most trusted friend—but when she inadvertently awakens her powers, she realizes that the truth behind both phantoms and magical girls is a far cry from the reality she once knew.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Hannelore no Kizokuin Gonensei
titleEnglish: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Hannelore's Fifth Year at the Royal Academy
synopsis:
Half a year has passed since Yurgenschmidt inaugurated its first underage aub. Hannelore, now an archduke candidate for the country's top-ranked duchy, is in the midst of a crisis. Despite her natural indecisiveness, she finds herself pressed to choose from a growing list of marriage candidates. Her father suggests Kenntrips and Rasantark—her childhood friends—but then her half-brother Raufereg throws his hat into the ring. And what about Wilfried, the apple of her eye? Convinced that Liebeskhilfe the Goddess of Binding is toying with the threads of her fate, Hannelore turns to her dear friend Rozemyne for guidance. In the debut volume of this battle fantasy, the divine avatar fights to settle an engagement! Features two original short stories and four-panel manga by You Shiina.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Stalker x Stalker
synopsis:
Getta and Taiyou, two university students, were close friends. One day, it is revealed that Taiyou has been stalking Getta. However, Getta has also been stalking Taiyou, collecting his baby teeth and so forth... A reciprocal love-suspense(?) comedy about two stalkers stalking each other!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shinkon Quest: Maou no Musume wa Majime Yuusha wo Otoshitai♡
titleEnglish: The Newlywed Quest: The Demon King's Daughter Wants to Bed the Diligent Hero
synopsis:
A hero who defeated an evil demon king—his descendant, Harold. In this peaceful era, Harold has become a convenient handyman for the townsfolk.

One day, a sacred book predicting the world's destruction is discovered. The condition to avert this catastrophe is... "You must complete the 'Shinkon Quest' with the demon king's daughter." Thus begins Harold's unexpected married life with Yona, the demon king's daughter. While Harold feels bewildered, Yona expertly handles household chores and sweetly pampers him when he's tired. However, she harbors a secret... 

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tonari no Seki no Yankee Shimizu-san ga Kami wo Kuroku Sometekita
titleEnglish: The Delinquent Girl Beside Me Suddenly Dyed Her Hair Black
synopsis:
Why is the toughest girl in school trying to be my type?! "My type? A girl with long black hair who carries herself well."

That's what I told my friends during a casual conversation about romance. The very next day, Shimizu—the blonde delinquent who sits next to me—suddenly shows up with her hair dyed black. From then on, every time I mention my ideal girl, she starts doing things she normally wouldn't—showing up to cooking class (which she used to always skip), packing me homemade lunches, etc.

This is the heartwarming slice-of-life high school rom-com about the awkward advances of the school's most intimidating delinquent girl.

(Source: One Peace Books)

title: The Ki Sisters
synopsis:
In the shadowy heart of Seoul near Cheonggyecheon Stream lies a sinister mansion whose porch only fools would dare tread. Welcome... to the house of the Ki sisters: Jang-nyeo, Sal-gyo, Jae-rim, and Jenny. Homeschooled and raised in isolation, the four sisters and their inadvertently menacing demeanor may strike terror into the faint-hearted, but don't judge a book by its cover: the youngest, Jenny Ki, is a scary—I mean, starry-eyed hopeless romantic who's out to find love! The problem is... everything she knows about love is from romance novels. Will Jenny put the Ki in "kiss" or "kill?"

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Became a Ruined Character in a Dark Fantasy
titleEnglish: I Became a Ruined Character in a Dark Fantasy
synopsis:
Ian Hope was once a normal gamer who downloaded the latest dark fantasy game, Aquilonia. The problem is he downloaded it illegally, which he believes is why he was transported into the game's world! Now, as his game character, he has to survive this cutthroat place full of corruption and betrayal. But that won't be easy since his character has already been ruined with skills that won't help him as the game progresses toward an apocalypse. Will he survive this dark fantasy? Or is all hope lost?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lord Hero of House Remes
synopsis:
No one understands why local lowlife Lord Aden Remes suddenly acts like the upright knight he was meant to be. The truth is, Aden's been possessed by Aden Albireo, the empire's hero who died after defeating the villainous Underlord and facing betrayal by his closest friends. Now, Aden's out to get revenge on those who killed him with the help of a few new allies and none other than the Underlord himself! Can Aden and his gang buckle down and power up? Or is the lord hero fated to fail once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Subscribed to GodTube
synopsis:
Living by selling information about monsters, Maeng Siwoo is considered completely useless in the hunter industry without any standout qualities. However, he fiercely battles to provide for his sick younger sister. One fateful day, he is gifted a mysterious smartphone by a transcendent being within a dungeon, appointing him as the channel manager for such beings. Upon subscribing to the channel, he unlocks the ability to wield the powers of the gods.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Wakaba-san Chi no Aoi Koi
synopsis:
Youth romcom about 4 sisters who are all experiencing their first love at the same time. While the eldest is having a crush on the guy at her part-time work, the other three are dealing with their first romantic experiences with boys in their classes and school clubs. Every night, the four have heart-to-heart girls talks as they navigate their respective first loves.

(Source: MU)

title: The Password Is 002!
synopsis:
The night before Sujeong plans to confess her feelings for Dojin, she runs into him on the street and is devastated to find out that he doesn't even know her name. Too afraid to face him in class the next day, Sujeong hides in the storage locker, where she meets Dojin's younger brother Jaeyun. With Jaeyun's help, will she able to win Dojin's heart?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Incognito Princess
synopsis:
When a woman dies prematurely, a goddess allows her to choose a new world to reincarnate into. Without hesitation, she picks the web novel Infinite Splash—home to her beloved favorite character, Kylo Grey. In a stroke of irony, she becomes the stunningly beautiful but utterly evil Princess Agnes Saint, who obsesses over the male lead, Raymond Spencer, and detests Kylo for being a commoner.

In the original story, Kylo's bitter rivalry with Raymond and deep insecurities made him Agnes' sworn enemy. Yet fans ultimately wept at his death, as his sacrifice was devastatingly selfless. The new Agnes, however, could not care less about the established plot. All she wants is a front-row seat to Kylo's life and to prevent his senseless death. But to live her fangirl dreams, she must drop her fixation on Raymond, convince everyone that she has changed, and somehow earn Kylo's trust.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Divorcing the Emperor
synopsis:
Ten years after the end of the territorial war that engulfed half the continent, a document with a seal of pure gold arrives at the estate of the war hero, Isaac Meserin. It's a divorce decree from the emperor addressed to his only daughter, Clicia Meserin, who isn't even married yet. As if the sudden divorce wasn't enough to drive her mad, she is ordered to be exiled for ten years according to imperial regulations!

"Is everyone crazy? I haven't even gotten married yet! What do you mean divorce!!!"

She can't let this slide, so she decides to go to the capital to set things straight! However, contrary to her confident initial plans, the situation keeps getting more complicated.

Clicia barely arrives on time, but she is speechless. Not because the bank was closed or her black card was blocked. But because of the wanted posters plastered on both sides of the bank's main entrance—dozens of them.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: I Possessed a Villainess, but I Wanna Raise Cats!
titleEnglish: I Possessed a Villainess, but I Wanna Raise Cats!
synopsis:
Seo Eunsu was only looking for her lost cat when she was hit by a truck. The next thing she knows, she's in the body of Lewayne Rarsel, a villainess from a novel! She's the cruel paramour of the emperor and has nothing but contempt for therianthropes, people with animal forms. Now, the only way to avoid her fate of becoming the emperor's consort is to marry Duke Dimitri de Blua, a feline therian. But can the duke forget her notorious reputation and realize that Lewayne just wants to raise cats?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Adopted by My Enemy
synopsis:
My nineteen years of life were taken advantage of by a fake family. With the vow to seek revenge still fresh in my mind, I chose to live my life again. Yet why have I returned to the night I was kidnapped from a burning castle?

"Hwelp me! Hwelp me! The willian ish twaking Maedie!"

My savior ended up being the enemy's son?! For days and nights I followed him to the enemy's castle, but upon arrival, a warm welcome—"Ack! Father! Second Brother's picked up another living thing!"—wasn't what awaited me.

"You're my daughter, do whatever you want."
"Brother is here, it's okay. No one can touch you. No one."
"Liana, my dear child."
"Why shouldn't you marry your brother?"

They've all gone crazy...

(Source: Malang, translated)

title: We Hate the Male Lead
synopsis:
Baron Pelles is a pitiful, penniless noble, and it appears that his only daughter, Luna, is a wretched villainess who tarnishes their already poor reputation. Luna obsesses over her childhood friend, Fersen Rodrien, and all the other noble ladies sympathize with his tender-hearted fiancée, Seira Granada, to the point of bullying and physically harming Luna and her servants.

When Luna regains memories of a novel from her past life, she realizes death is near—and Fersen is to blame. Fersen is charming only on the surface; in reality, he is delusional and suffocatingly obsessive, and Luna truly loathes him. Out of frustration, she swears that even the empire's infamous cold-hearted psychopath and Fersen's enemy, Antes Vincent, would be a better match for her. Though determined to pull her family out of poverty and sever ties with the main leads, Luna soon regrets her words—because Antes might just take them seriously.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Seventh Time's the Charm!
synopsis:
How would you win over an enemy who just won't stop killing you? Laila thought she had escaped death by figuring out how to turn back time, but her assassin finds her again... and again... and again! All because her sadistic villain of a father had to murder his entire family... When all her evasion plans fail, there's only one option left: coddle her enemy through his childhood and hope he'll spare her when he comes back to exact his revenge. But why is this wacko so pigheaded?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Houmurareta Kimi e
synopsis:
In ten or so years, the moon will collide with the Earth, bringing with it the end. Before the apocalypse happens, Nekuro confesses to her best friend Kiri. Kiri, seeing no hope for the future, takes her confession half-jokingly until one day, when Nekuro dies.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Unsleep
synopsis:
All Lee Seung-hyeon wants is to pass his final summer class, taught by an infamously strict professor. Seung-hyeon has already failed once after missing the final presentation due to a misunderstanding in a crowded train. This time, he is determined to ace the group project—if only a certain evasive classmate, Seo Chaejun, would show up and do his part.

Seung-hyeon tracks Chaejun down and realizes Chaejun was behind the train incident that led to his previous failure. Determined not to let the same guy ruin his grade twice, Seung-hyeon insists Chaejun participate—only to discover that Chaejun suffers from chronic insomnia that is relieved solely through sexual acts. While most would back off, Seung-hyeon sees a chance: if it gets Chaejun to class, he is willing to go all the way.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mayaka-neesan wa Uso ga Tsukenai
synopsis:
Junya is a third-year junior high school student. He's good at sports, but as for studying... he's rather terrible. Recently, he's had a problem. His childhood friend, Mayaka-neesan, keeps messing with him! Could that mean she really likes him? The beginning of a playful and deceptive romantic comedy where he's at the mercy of an ever-shifting liar!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shinimodori Oujo wa Ikinobiru Tame ni Yuri Harem wo Tsukuru Koto ni Shita
titleEnglish: The Death Defying Princess Creates a Yuri Harem to Survive
synopsis:
As queen, Marie had it made: she spent her days in luxury and her nights bedding multiple beautiful women. Alas, her tyrannical ways eventually caused her downfall, and her people sent her to the guillotine. Yet when the blade drops down, Marie doesn't die. Instead, she wakes up one year in the past! Stuck in an endless loop, nothing she tries seems to change her fate. Her only chance of avoiding certain death is to win over the countless women who have it in for her...by seducing them one by one! A brand-new bawdy yuri comedy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kotoba no Shinkai
synopsis:
Ever since childhood, Hiroki struggled to express his feelings. Only his beloved dog Karo truly understood him. But one day in high school, Karo passes away...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: 303-goushitsu no Kamisama
titleEnglish: A Deity Stands with A Ghost
synopsis:
Aruka, a silver-haired, blue-eyed girl, somehow finds herself becoming a goddess!

Even so, she still gets hungry, so she spends her days secretly eating strange creatures. Then she meets Akira, a boy who doesn't go to school. He lives listlessly at home and attracts strange creatures, which makes him useful for Aruka...!

This is a story of friendship, pure but strange, and sweet relationship revolving around an unusual goddess and gloomy boy.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shuuri wo Miru
synopsis:
A young man crashes during a race. As he falls to the ground, he begins a journey to rediscover his roots. A 30-page one-shot story of a boy and a tranquil craftsman!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Muscle Joseon
synopsis:
"What's this? Kyaaaa!!! Wh-Why did I suddenly turn into a beanpole?!"

Choi Young-jik was a Food and Nutrition academic nerd. A certified fitness enthusiast with a first-grade qualification in Lifestyle Sports Instruction. But then... One morning, waking up with all his bountiful muscles gone, he finds himself in the body of Grand Prince Suyang, the second child of Sejong the Great. Unable to hide his excitement at the thought of seeing the Great King Sejong in person and wondering whether it is a dream or reality, Young-jik goes to see his father, the Great King Sejong.

"Uh...? Is this the Great King... Sejong?"

Before him sits a pot-bellied man who looks like he's having trouble even breathing. What on earth is this? The Great King Sejong is severely obese and diabetic, and all the officials are suffering from chronic illnesses... Having been a fitness trainer for 15 years, the gym rat pride of Choi Young-jik begins to ignite passionately.

"Well, shall we spread the fitness fever in Joseon for once?!"

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Black Corporation: Joseon
synopsis:
The maniac who was crazy about all kinds of fields such as military and steampunk had been reincarnated. However, his father was King Sejong the Great? The mania-wise king and his crazy maniac son. Along with the ministers, and countless humans who were getting exploited. Even today, the night of Joseon was filled with the light of overtime.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: 7-kakan Gentei Kanojo
synopsis:
A yuri romantic comedy centered on a temporary relationship between a gal and an honor student.

The story begins when Manatsu, a gal who is on the verge of repeating a grade, starts receiving tutoring from Sumie, an honor student. Manatsu loves shoujo manga and romantic gossip but has the vague that having a boyfriend somehow doesn't fit her. When she casually brings this up, Sumie suggests, "Why not try starting with just the form?" and offers "How about dating me for just seven days?"

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Trapped in a Soap Opera
synopsis:
After a life of hardship as an orphan, Jia Han finally achieves the dream of homeownership... only to have her moment of jubilation cruelly cut short. While indulging in her guilty pleasure—a riveting soap opera—she experiences a sudden, piercing chest pain and meets an untimely demise. But when she wakes up, she finds herself not in the afterlife, but within the very drama she was watching and as none other than its villainess! In a realm where a glance sparks a scandal and a step triggers a landmine of emotions, what fate lies ahead for Jia?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Kyouji: Konyakusha wo Ubaitotte Gishi wo Oidashita Watashi wa, Douyara Ima kara Hametsu suru you desu.
titleEnglish: Proud to be the Villainess: I'm Doomed After Stealing my Half-Sister's Fiancé and Having Her Banished
synopsis:
Once a commoner, Wellmy Ernest ascended to nobility when her mother married an earl. She tormented her same-age half-sister at home and school, stole her heirship and fiancé, and finally sold her off to the allegedly cruel Lord of Magic. It's not like her plain, meek sister could oppose. Wellmy got everything she wanted.

One day, Wellmy receives an invitation to a late-night soiree from the Lord of Magic, likely to announce her sister as his fiancée. Wellmy attends with her mother and father, but what awaits them isn't the brilliant banquet they were expecting...it's a tribunal condemning them for their abuse of Wellmy's sister.

Which means everything has gone just as Wellmy planned...

This is the story of a lone villainess who plans to make her sister happy even if it means she's hated in return.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Plaything
synopsis:
Lee Myung-jun, the Vice Chairman of Hyun-do Group, lost his daughter to a group of bullies. Seeking revenge, he adopts Yoon Karma, a psychopathic defector girl. Yoon Karma: A sadistic human weapon created through drug experiments in North Korea. After killing everyone in the research lab, she escaped to South Korea on her own.

Having just been released from a juvenile detention center in South Korea, Yoon Karma sets out to hunt down the bullies at school, driven by the desire to avenge her new father and satisfy her sadistic pleasures.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Madan no Ichi
synopsis:
A long time ago, humanity stumbled upon magical creatures called Majik. To acquire the powers of a Majik, one has to pass a trial set by the being itself. While men are unable to use magic, a woman who has the ability to capture and tame Majiks is granted the title of a witch.

Abandoned as a child in the middle of a mountain, Ichi learned to fend for himself by hunting. While he is a pacifist at heart, he would not hesitate to defend himself if he senses danger. Believing a sleeping creature in the woods poses an extreme threat to humanity, Ichi has prepared to kill it.

Unbeknownst to Ichi, the creature is King Uroro, the King Majik who hates humankind. No witch—including the Abyssal Witch Desscaras—has been able to pass Uroro's test. However, Ichi miraculously acquires Uroro, thus becoming the first and only male witch. Armed with his newfound power and thirst to hunt down danger, Ichi is about to turn the lives of witches and Majiks alike upside down!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ore no Vaccine dake ga Zombie-ka shita Sekai wo Sukueru
synopsis:
Yuu Oikawa, who has been shut up in his house, is certain to die as a virgin at the age of 21. This is because the whole world has become a place filled with zombies... One day, a survivor visits Yuu's house. The woman, who calls herself Sunny, injects Yuu with a vaccine that may save the world from the zombies... but as a result, Yuu gains the ability to turn zombies back into humans by having sex...?

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Apocalyptic Chef Awakening
synopsis:
Shin Young-jun, a sergeant chef, was greeted by the apocalypse just days before vacation. The battalion turned into chaos in an instant, and the communication network was cut off. Then something appeared before his eyes! [Congratulations on your awakening!] [Job: Novice Chef Lv.1] If I had been a warrior or an assassin, I would have tried to stand alone... What was assigned to him was chef, which is obviously a support job. There's nothing to be done if it's like this. "From here on, I will feed you."

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Yuri no Hajimari wa Dorei kara
synopsis:
Chiyoko Hanamura, a self-proclaimed gyaru who failed her high school debut, was skipping class as usual on the rooftop when her junior, Sakine, approached her. It seemed like Sakine had a favor to ask, as she handed Chiyoko a love letter.

"Could you turn down this confession for me?" she asked. However, the sender was unknown. For the sake of her adorable junior, and to maintain her gyaru dignity, Chiyoko resolved to take on the task and went to refuse the confession.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: I Love Amy
synopsis:
Bibi is a bubbly girl who's deeply obsessed with Peter, the cutest boy at her high school. So when she sees a random girl talking to him, Bibi invites her to a sleepover with malicious intent... only to have a surprisingly nice time! That's how she makes friends with Amy, a shy and sweet girl who agrees to help Bibi get with Peter. But as they cook up all sorts of love schemes to win Peter over, Amy's place in Bibi's heart grows bigger and bigger by the day...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kaijin Mira no Dai 2 Keitai ga Kawaisugiru
synopsis:
"Cuteness is indomitable!" Day after day, the mysterious Mira rampages around, trying to steal the hero's transformation belt. Mira is at full power, having been remodeled by the doctor, but it turns out her new form is that of an incredibly cute girl! Mira, who has been remodeled based on the theories that "a hero won't raise a hand against women and children" and "justice cannot defeat cuteness," has been ordered to make the hero fall in love and to steal his belt. Meanwhile, the hero, who thinks love is a source of trouble, is at the mercy of Mira's cuteness, but he swears he will never fall in love with her. So begins a romantic comedy where justice and evil refuse to yield to each other!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: The Reluctant Demon Cult Leader
synopsis:
The leader of the demonic cult is a formidable entity that everyone is afraid of. However, while the demonic cult members expect him to exude great violence, the new Demonic Cult Leader, Do Yu-gang, wishes to live a simple and peaceful life. Will his modest wish be granted in the end?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Maxed Talent Player
synopsis:
In 2018, monsters swarmed Seoul, and heroic "players" saved the city. Fast forward a decade, Hyukjin Kim, stuck in a seven-year rut after failing to become a player himself, gets a do-over. Zapped back to 2018, Hyukjin seizes his chance to rewrite history. With knowledge from the future and his re-awakened player talents, Hyukjin battles beasts and conquers dungeons in a pulse-pounding quest for redemption and survival!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Fullmetal Alchemist Chronicle
synopsis:
A guidebook containing interviews, illustrations, and extras that had not been compiled in volume form.

1-2. Tokumori!! Hagane 4-koma Dairensei
3. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Simple na Hitobito
4. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Sore mo Mata Kare no Senjou
5. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Prototype
6. Untitled omake

title: Fullmetal Alchemist 20th Anniversary Book
synopsis:
A memorial book featuring side stories of Fullmetal Alchemist and other content.

1. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Moumoku no Renkinjutsushi
2. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Shishou Monogatari
3. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Nagai Yoru
4. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi 44.5: Tsukanoma
5. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Tobenai Tenshi Prologue
6. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi 2: Akai Elixir no Akuma Prologue
7. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi 3: Kami wo Tsugu Shoujo Prologue
8. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Akatsuki no Ouji Prologue
9. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Tasogare no Shoujo Prologue
10. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Tabi no Hajimari

title: Shikkoku no Harinezumi: Shadow the Hedgehog
synopsis:
Shadow the Hedgehog, a failed wonder drug meant to cure Maria, struggles to find the meaning to his life. When the Earth National Defense raided the Space Colony ARK, they aimed to dispose of everything, including Maria and Shadow.

After Maria's tragic demise, Shadow is sent to a mysterious dimension known as White Space, in which he meets a mysterious one-eyed creature. The creature promises that Maria can be brought back to life as long as Shadow finds the Three Wishing Orbs.

(Source: Sonic Wiki Zone)

title: Eiyuu Kikan
synopsis:
In a near-future where humanity stands on the edge of extinction, we turn our gaze to the stars. But in the depths of space, a new menace looms—the "Star Beasts." To combat these creatures, warriors donning mechanical armor emerge as humanity's last hope. Prepare yourself for a groundbreaking mecha action saga, where breathtaking visuals meet an expansive universe. The battle for survival starts now!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Academy's Sashimi Sword Master
synopsis:
Chef Kim, Korea's legendary sashimi master, is transported into the world of Blessing M, a mobile game he once played. But instead of being a hero, he finds himself as Geomma Kang, a mere background extra. Forced into a new life, Geomma discovers a new power: the Blessing of the Blade God. Now, to survive in this game-like world, he must slice through challenges and enemies alike. Will his unmatched skills in the kitchen be enough to carve out a new destiny?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Just Read Me Already!
synopsis:
300 years. That was how long it had been since he had last been opened. For 3 whole centuries, the mysterious book of magic, also known as Grimoire, has been stuck on the shelf of the Le Temis Royal Academy Library. Just then, an apprentice mage opens the Grimoire, only to die in a freak accident. As the dismayed Grimoire awaits his teleportation to a new location, the library door creeps open and a mysterious girl, Riley, approaches and opens the Grimoire, becoming his new contractor.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shinobigoto
synopsis:
Even in modern Japan, ninja still hide in the shadows. Young ninja Yodaka has received his mission--protect high school student Aoi at all cost. But can a ninja survive the wild world of high school while also fulfilling his mission?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: All for My Dearest Juliet
synopsis:
Due to her terminal illness, Princess Juliet has spent her entire life inside the Rozenta Kingdom's palace without any peers to talk to. So she's delighted to meet a kind young servant named Lete who provides her with much-needed company. However, their pleasant strolls end abruptly when Juliet is suddenly told to marry the archduke of Herventel, Enoch Letrachi. What comes as a greater shock is that Lete is actually Enoch, and that he has refused to see Juliet until she signs the marriage papers! Can Juliet find happiness when her trust in her husband-to-be has already been shattered?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Update Kareshi
synopsis:
Ever since he was young, Leo struggled with many things that came easily to others. Both in his daily life and at work, he grew tired of himself for always causing trouble for those around him. Then one day, Leo got into a terrible traffic accident. When he woke up, he discovered that his brain had been replaced with a machine...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Last Boss Shoujo Akari: Watashi yori Tsuyoi Yatsu ni Ai ni Gendai ni Iku
synopsis:
The strongest final boss of another world, whom nobody could defeat, transmigrates into the body of a bullied high school girl in the modern age!? The unrivaled school life of the demon king of another world!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Count's Secret Maid
synopsis:
For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public. And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Wakaranai desu Yoshida-san
synopsis:
A love story about two university students who can't proceed from "friends" to "lovers."

Tsukumo is a plain and unremarkable university student. As he's preparing to head home from his university lectures, Mao Yoshida, a solitary beauty, passes by. Tsukumo and Yoshida have an intimate relationship, but because Yoshida is so expressionless, their relationship can't seem to make any progress...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ohitorisama ni wa Naremashita node. Konyakusha Houchichuu!
titleEnglish: Perfectly Fine on My Own, so My Fiancé Can Twist in the Wind
synopsis:
Noble young lady Nicole has had her heart broken more times than she can count. Her fiancé Keios is so devoted to Princess Caroline, his childhood friend and the unrivalled belle of their aristocratic academy, that he seems to forget Nicole even exists. But no longer. Tired of waiting around and conforming to Keios' needs, Nicole makes a most liberating decision: I'll give up on love and go it alone. Her arranged marriage may be unavoidable, but that doesn't mean she can't enjoy her own life, right? Emboldened and excited, Nicole begins to shine as she never had before—so brightly, in fact, that even the clueless Keios can't help but notice...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Ultimate Tutorial Warrior
synopsis:
Junsu is an ordinary college student who spends an extraordinary amount of time trying to beat a pay-to-win hero collector game called Arcane Seoul. All his hours of painstaking gameplay finally pays off when he lands Cheonma, one of the ultimate SS-ranked characters in the game, seconds before a truck runs him over. Now, he finds himself as Jeonsa Kim, a basic tutorial-stage character who can learn any skill. Can he use his gaming knowledge to survive the godforsaken, magic-driven, and monster-ridden alternate world of Arcane Seoul?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Taida na Akujoku Kizoku ni Tensei shita Ore, Scenario wo Bukkowashitara Kikakugai no Maryoku de Saikyou ni Natta
titleEnglish: Reborn as an Aristocratic Scoundrel, I Broke the Game and Mastered Magic Beyond Limits!
synopsis:
I don't know how it happened, but somehow I've died and reincarnated into my favorite academy game. And if that wasn't weird enough, I'm now the depraved and lazy villain, Weiss Fansent, whose misdeeds lead him to a deadly end. Something I'm determined to avoid at all costs. With little time left until the academy's entrance exams, I have no choice but to dive headfirst into serious and grueling training. Which means swordsmanship with the S-rank adventurer Miruku Abitas, followed by intense magic practice. It was demanding and exhausting, but getting stronger means I have a better chance of avoiding my disastrous end. But I seriously underestimated just how powerful Weiss truly is, and I wind up stunning everyone at the exams! Have I somehow become more powerful than the hero? A fantasy series about changing the villain's fate with hard work and amazing powers!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Saboten Buddy
synopsis:
A lawless wasteland known as the Choya Desert was created by a past war. Romeo Rubin, a lone mercenary who's made a name for himself in this harsh land, finds an unexpected new sidekick—a cactus?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: A Tidal Wave of Glory
synopsis:
Halo, the best musician of the time, suffers a traffic accident on the way to the Grammy ceremony. And when he regains consciousness, he finds himself in the body of a little Korean boy named No Hae-il. He finds himself in a completely different place and time. He confirms that No Hae-il's English name is Halo and feels a strong destiny. Halo, who entered Hae-il, proves to be a musical genius at this time as well.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Solo Resurrection
synopsis:
[Innate Ability: Resurrection]

"What? What's with this super OP cheat skill?"

However, Kang Hyeon didn't know. What it meant to die, want to die, and not being able to. The man who became the most infamous hunter on Earth with his immortal body!

As a human disaster—no, as one against the disasters facing the human race, I will solo resurrect today as well!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
titleEnglish: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
synopsis:
Cecil Perdium, the Mercenary King, was killed in battle before he could avenge his family. As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. With their soldiers and knights defecting due to the harsh conditions they must endure, he has his work cut out for him. Can Cecil become the mighty warrior he once was and avert his family's fate?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Heir
synopsis:
As a young boy, Taeha Jin's life is turned upside down when an attack during a family yacht trip robs him of his parents and future as heir to the Cheon-gu Group—Korea's leading conglomerate. Uncovering the dark truths behind the accident—one of vicious power struggles and family betrayals—he escapes to Italy, vowing revenge. Seventeen years later, Taeha is finally back in Korea. A man driven by vengeance, he can't wait for the sweetest revenge as he makes those who robbed everything from him pay dearly. The stakes are high, and the battle with Cheon-gu begins!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
titleEnglish: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
synopsis:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men's hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Danky Night
synopsis:
Office worker Umesawa had a nemesis: Haze, a stubborn and opinionated man who had worked with him on a joint development team. Haze quit without saying a word to Umesawa. Umesawa, who is still hung up on Haze to the point of getting furious just thinking about him, stops into a bar and, by chance, is reunited with Haze! Umesawa has a blunt and drunken interaction with Haze, who coldly tells him, "Go home. This is a gay bar."

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Kaji Daikou no Arbeit wo Hajimetara Gakuen Ichi no Bishoujo no Kazoku ni Kiniirarechaimashita.
synopsis:
Harusho Ootsuki lost his parents when he was young, and his grandmother took him in and taught him housework and cooking. Harusho uses his skills to start a part-time job as a housekeeper during the summer vacation of his second year in high school. The story begins when his first client turns out to be the home of the most beautiful girl in school.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: To Drown In You
synopsis:
Hyeseong, a boy living on a remote island, and Yunhae, a mysterious mermaid, become each other's only friend. But soon after they meet, they're separated after Hyeseong moves away. Six years later, Yunhae develops a mysterious power and finds Hyeseong again. Unfortunately, too much has changed, and Hyeseong can no longer dedicate all his time to her as he did in their childhood. He tells her they are too different, but Yunhae's attachment to Hyeseong slowly transforms into an obsession...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mayonaka no Ore wo Mite
titleEnglish: My Noons and Midnights Are for You
synopsis:
The gloomy, unconfident Mayo is the face behind the bright and cheerful "Mahiru," a currently popular Vtuber. As people grow to love his complete opposite, "Mahiru," Mayo can't help but feel the crushing reality of his own loneliness grow more and more. Even his manager Ogino, who spoils him and showers him with praises, probably only sees him as "Mahiru" and not as the real "Mayo." 

Because he understands this, Mayo can never admit that he wishes to take Ogino's words seriously and wants to be loved by him. But, as if he can clearly see through Mayo and his "desire to be teased," Ogino asks "Would you rather me bully you instead?" uncovering the depths of his body as it trembles with anticipation...?!

(Source: Shu-cream, translated)

title: A First of Summers
synopsis:
Lim Hyeonseon has followed the well-traveled path of life: he graduated, secured a job, and got married. But the marriage ended in a divorce, and on his 40th birthday, he finds himself lonely and constantly bombarded with questions about his non-existent love prospects. In search of anything resembling fulfillment, Hyeonseon recalls an old electric guitar he bought 16 years ago but never attempted to learn. He hesitantly enrolls in a music class taught by the spirited 24-year-old Cha Yeoreum.

Although Hyeonseon is persistently self-conscious about his age, seeing people of all ages so excited to learn fills him with newfound enthusiasm. Most unexpectedly, he befriends his young instructor and soon realizes just how much he enjoys Yeoreum's company and boundless energy. But Yeoreum's feelings seem to gravitate toward love, and no matter how much Hyeonseon tries to draw a line between them, it appears impossible to resist the pull of a summer romance.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Watashi no Kokoro wa Ojisan de Aru
titleEnglish: This Alluring Dark Elf Has the Heart of a Middle-Aged Man!
synopsis:
With no friends, family, or romance to speak of, Haruka has lived his life just going through the motions—until the day he awakens in the body of a beautiful, and womanly, dark elf! Suddenly, a world beyond his wildest imagination awaits, and uncontainable excitement races through him. There's just one problem: He gave up on putting himself out there a long time ago and has no idea how to strike up a conversation with other people. Teenagers and (other) women are certainly no exception.

But with a bottomless well of mana and a ridiculously tough body to boot, Haruka won't let any overthinking get in the way this time. Little by little, the dark elf works past his (her) fears and self-doubt, forging deep bonds with precious new friends and growing together with them. So begins a heartwarming story of an old man determined to make the most of this new fantastical lease on life!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: My Avatars' Path to Greatness
synopsis:
Seonghyeon Han is a victim of a violent crime that left him with impaired legs and a fear of the outside world. Now, he faces an even greater challenge: while he gained the power to create clones, he has just 24 hours before being sent to another dimension. As the countdown ticks down, Seonghyeon makes a desperate move—he sends his clone through the interdimensional portal, and discovers his real body can remain safe at home. Thus begins the epic tale of Seonghyeon's... clones.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Absolute Reign
synopsis:
Twenty years have passed since the Great War, but petty theft and exploitation have taken root during times of peace. The once dazzling world of Murim is a mere shadow of its former self, but one young enigmatic swordsman has sworn to restore Jianghu to its former glory. Will the noble principles of justice and loyalty prevail over corruption and greed?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy
synopsis:
Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tonari no Jiisan
synopsis:
Yuki, a girl living in a rural town, studies art with a goal of becoming a painter in the big city. One day, her older sister decides to leave town to fulfill her dream. Yuki rides the train with her to see her off, but on the way there, Yuki is assailed by a strange phenomenon!? Reality or an illusion... a chilling horror!

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Smother Me
synopsis:
In the gray streets of Detroit, young Akio experiences the warmth of his mother's hand for the first time as they make their way to meet a stranger. The harrowing reality seeps in when he realizes that he is sold to Moreh, a child trafficker, never to see his mother again. After passing a life-or-death test, Akio is presented with the choice to abandon his past life and become an assassin.

Under the alias "Snake," Akio enters a cycle of regular killings. While he grows more efficient, all of his assassinations haunt him. Everything changes when Snake meets a blind girl whose innocence and compassion give him a new goal, setting him on a tumultuous path that will alter his life forever.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Gomidame no Garnet
synopsis:
Kanae, a hitman, encounters a half vampire named Sara at a dump site and is attacked. With nothing to lose, Kanae is completely indifferent to having his blood sucked or his home invaded.

Sara, a bloodthirsty defective vampire abandoned by his parents, offers Kanae a deal: "In return for taking care of your decrepit lifestyle, become my food..." What begins as a physical relationship fueled by the arousal of bloodsucking, brings a warmth they've never known, melting away the loneliness they've both carried...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Boss, Bxtch, Baby!
synopsis:
Would you rather be the target of a ruthless gang of loan sharks or become the boy-toy of an unhinged corporate heir for a year? This is the predicament Hojin finds himself in when Yooseong, a former one-night stand, wrestles him into a deal that'll solve all his money problems. He'll have to pay a hefty price in return, but Hojin soon comes to learn that his cruel master for a year hides a rather lonely heart. Thus, the two begin to grow closer... Will they actually find comfort in each other or will this year crush Hojin for good?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Genius Grandson of the Loan Shark King
synopsis:
Kim Mu-hyuk, the Grandson of the Loan Shark King Cheon Tae-san, whom even the wealthy elites of South Korea bowed to, strives to be recognized as a member of the Cheon Family. Despite his efforts, Mu-Hyuk is betrayed and killed by his uncles in a vicious struggle over his grandfather's inheritance. However, instead of dying, he wakes up in the 1990's, with a second chance to rewrite his fate. Determined to prevent the death of his grandmother, who raised him, and reclaim the legacy of the Cheon family, Mu-hyuk sets out to preserve his severed friendships and take brutal revenge on his uncles and anyone else who stands in his way. Though once a troublemaker, Mu-hyuk quickly rises to the top both academically and socially, earning his grandfather's trust. As he solidifies his place in the family, Mu-hyuk begins manipulating the underworld, gaining control over criminal organizations and influential figures in politics and business. Gradually, he paves his path to fulfill his ambitions and exact his revenge, one step at a time.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: I Was Mistaken as a Monstrous Genius Actor
synopsis:
Kang Woo-jin, an ordinary man, unexpectedly discovers that he has a unique ability: whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he can enter a mysterious subspace and fully embody the characters within. When he accompanies a friend to an audition, he seizes the opportunity to demonstrate the extraordinary acting skills he acquired through these experiences in the subspace, which leads to a change in the course of his life forever.

Out of nowhere, I was called a tremendous monster. So what? I just nodded in response.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: E ga Umai Yamashita-san
synopsis:
Yamashita always sneaks in some sketching in her notebook during class. One day, Miya, who sits in front of her, compliments her drawings. Suddenly, Yamashita's peaceful daily life begins to change...! A heartwarming coming-of-age drama that lovingly portrays the self-consciousness in youth!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Involuntary Romance
synopsis:
Baekya is childhood friends with Jichan, a well-known trash magnet. It has been and always will be Baekya's job to console Jichan after every one of his bad break-ups. One day, as Baekya was consoling Jichan yet again, the most popular boy in school, Lee Hyeon, appears in front of them. Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hitori Kagome
synopsis:
An anthology of horror stories.

1. Shouhisha no Umeki
2. Koujou Kinmu
3. Zarigani
4. Musuu no Kodoku
5. Hyakuen no Choubou
6. Pet
7. Hitori Kagome
8. Chizu
9. Yumeutsutsu
10. Wadachi wa Yami ni Nomikomare
11. Genshou
12. Nokosareta Chourihou

title: Tensei shitara Suterareta ga, Hirowarete Tanoshiku Ikiteimasu.
synopsis:
Millie is reincarnated as a baby with memories of her previous life.However, at the age of five months, she is abandoned in the cold...! She was picked up by Joe and Marissa who happened to be passing by, and her life was saved, but the life of the common people in another world that awaits her is quite severe... She finds herself in a dirty room full of dust and stains, without the delicious food she had in her previous life! The couple's restaurant and inn, "Cat's Pavilion in the Shade of the Trees," is in financial trouble! In order to return the favor she was given, she changes the store with her cheat magic and knowledge from her previous life...

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Black Blood
synopsis:
Ethan, a battle-weary cyborg soldier, retreats to a tranquil planet in search of peace. There, he meets Mikhail, a gentle botanist whose warm smile and delicate touch seem almost fragile. Ethan finds himself inexplicably drawn to Mikhail, experiencing a restless unease whenever they're together. He longs to touch, to cherish—feelings that are undeniably human. Bewildered by the feelings stirring within him, Ethan begins to question if he truly has a heart after all.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Akugyaku Hadou no Brave Soul
synopsis:
"Dungeon Brave Soul." It's a game that has won over many men, but then its sequel—with its NTR, depressive, and bad ending developments—has broken the brains of many men. I've been reincarnated as Zenon Baskerville, the game's overwhelmingly despised villain!? To avoid the bad ending, I try to live quietly, but for some reason, the protagonist suddenly glares at me...!?

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Alt Account Trap!
synopsis:
Everyone knows Kang Su-hyun. The Class president, social butterfly, the kind of guy who shines in every corner of campus life. But even the brightest star has shadows.

His secret? He runs a private "alt account," an anonymous SNS page where he draws and posts scandalous 19+ art. It's his hidden world, one that absolutely no one can ever discover.

At least, that was the plan.

One day, his double life is accidentally exposed to the very last person he'd want: Lim Ji-ah, the school outcast who barely talks to anyone. "Wait... sunbae, you're that famous lewd artist? Hehe... guess I've got some leverage now, huh?"

From that moment on, Su-hyun's carefully maintained image as Mr. Perfect begins to crumble. Stuck between bribes, blackmail, and the most awkward partnership imaginable, can a campus golden boy survive having his NSFW alter ego in the hands of an unlikely accomplice?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Bastard of Swordborne
synopsis:
Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the "Ragnar Defect," he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Obsessed With Hazel the Sweet Witch
titleEnglish: Obsessed With Hazel the Sweet Witch
synopsis:
Waking up in a fairy tale she illustrated, Hazel is rumored to be a wicked, man-eating witch. In truth, all she wants to do is bake sweets and share the kindness. So when the adorable Luna and Luca show up at the door of her gingerbread house, Hazel is determined to care for the siblings. However, things go awry when their guardian and brother, Grand Duke Elliot Blaine, show up, accusing her of kidnapping them. Now, with her charm and cooking skills, Hazel must prove she is indeed a sweet witch!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Jakdu: Shaman's Blade
synopsis:
Yongjin is a struggling orphan—a blunt realist with no time or money to spare on superstitious nonsense. But on his 16th birthday, he finds his life taking a dramatic turn when his classmate Huisu, whom he had never interacted with before, suddenly asks to be his girlfriend. For the first time, Yongjin isn't alone—but his new company isn't exactly the kind he had always wished for, as he finds himself being chased by spirits instead! Though this wasn't quite the sweet sixteen he had in mind, Yongjin must now navigate through a new world he never thought existed.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Wicked Spot
synopsis:
After spending over a century hiding in the shadows, powerful sorceress Sadako stumbles upon the dazzling world of social media and decides to post her way into her first real contact with humanity. She soon becomes an internet sensation, attracting a huge following of doting fans—and shocks them all by announcing she is a witch. The big reveal turns one follower called Hanako, a lonely young woman with seemingly inhuman strength and a curious resistance to magic, into a dedicated hater, and inadvertently sends them both on a whirlwind adventure beyond their wildest dreams!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Changing the Genre From Angst to Heartwarming
titleEnglish: Changing the Genre From Angst to Heartwarming
synopsis:
I've been reincarnated. Into a novel I used to enjoy in my past life, no less! My name is Renatis, and I'll be playing the part of little sister to the female lead in this dark, tragic whirlwind of a story where a beastly bad boy shatters my sister's hopes, dreams, and her life. My sister is too good and too beautiful, and I'm not about to let that happen to my perfect sister. So, I'm taking charge. I shall turn this dark, tragic story into a heartwarming tale of healing. I will save my sister.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: My Way with You
synopsis:
Some wounds are slow to heal. Giran's been alone ever since his grandmother died, and he has no intention of letting anyone into his life. But one day, out of nowhere, he meets an exceptionally pretty face...who's also exceptionally good in bed. This one-night fling turns into something more when Giran finds out that his meeting with Seon-gyeong was more than just a coincidence. The two have similar pasts that are stained with painful losses. Trauma can be all-consuming, but every walk through life is made better with someone by your side.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tori to Ookami
synopsis:
Born into slavery, Kagi is a wolf with a passion for writing and a burning desire for freedom. Then he meets Yoa, a bird who is also a slave. Unlike Kagi, Yoa has accepted his life in servitude. What fate awaits two slaves with conflicting views?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ushimitsugao
synopsis:
The story follows 33-year-old housewife Megumi Sano, who has strong spiritual sensitivity. One night, while having sex with her husband, a ghost suddenly appears in her room. She feels humiliated instead of terrified after the ghost witnesses her boring sex life with her husband. The ghost begins appearing in their bedroom nightly.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Night Light Hounds
synopsis:
Jimmy is a gang member in one of the world's few underground cities, Silent Bay City. One day, he meets a girl and gets embroiled in a fight between the creatures of the night.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Goodbye Boy
synopsis:
Mel and I were dating for two and a half years. Then, out of the blue, she dumped me. Unable to let it go, I tried to get her to tell me why. In the process, I stumbled upon her bizarre secret...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: 10-gatsu no Hanabi
synopsis:
After his first summer break in college, Taichi installs a dating app out of frustration at not having a girlfriend. To his surprise, he matches with a woman he once saw crying at his summer beach job...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Darling, Why Can't We Divorce?
synopsis:
A sickly woman falls asleep while ruminating on the disappointing ending of a romance novel following a countess and a lost prince, torn apart by two villains: the power-hungry Duke Sylvester Lizen and his unwilling wife, Ophelia McGuffin. The woman found Ophelia's character the most tragic: because of her obsessive love for the prince, he tricks her into killing Sylvester and then ensures that she dies for her crimes.

When the woman awakens as Ophelia, she realizes she has not yet murdered Sylvester but has begun to harass the countess. She tries to divorce her wicked husband, but Sylvester only appears to enjoy her depravity. Out of options, Ophelia strikes a deal with her husband: if she successfully seduces the prince, Sylvester will grant her the divorce—but in time, Ophelia may realize that her marriage to the other villain is not all that bad.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ha
synopsis:
Akane, a reckless elementary schooler, chips her front tooth after jumping from the second floor of her school. As she starts visiting the dentist, she runs into Tatchi, a classmate who's stopped going to school. The two begin to get along with each other, but where will their friendship lead?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: 4 Week Lovers
synopsis:
Wanna fake-date for 4 weeks?

Dojun's life at college is off to a perfect start! Until he meets his roommate, Jaehee, a high school friend whom he may have ghosted. Jaehee claims he's over their unresolved past, but after an accident resulting in a fractured wrist, he makes Dojun a proposition...

(Source: Manta)

title: Belladonna no Koibito
synopsis:
Bella has been cursed with a poison that takes the life of anyone she touches. The only way to break the curse is to receive "true love"... Before long, Bella is living a life of solitude in the woods of the rumored "Witch of Poison," but one day she meets Anna, an unsuccessful painter...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse
titleEnglish: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse
synopsis:
Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That's exactly what's happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world. But as he ventures into the ravaged city of Seoul, he realizes there is more to this apocalypse than meets the eye as he encounters other survivors and mysterious monsters on his quest to find his family.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Phantom Whispers
synopsis:
Noa has struggled with hearing unsettling voices since she was a child. But when a mysterious murder takes place, the voice in Noa's head urges her to uncover the killer. With the police skeptical and her sanity on the line, Noa must navigate a web of fear and suspicion, guided by a ghost, to catch a ruthless killer before she herself becomes the serial killer. Will Noa uncover the murderer, or will her own mind betray her?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ilya
synopsis:
Fugo, a rookie exorcist, burns with hatred for the demon who destroyed his family. His master, concerned about Fugo's obsession with revenge, urges him to speak with a certain demon. This demon is "Ilya." As Fugo engages in repeated conversations with her, gradually, he has a change of heart...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: My Girlfriend
synopsis:
One day, Jio is horrified to witness his girlfriend, Miho, devouring human flesh. How could this be happening? He's struggling to understand the events that transpired when Miho killed his close buddy. Jio flees in panic, only to run into his friend—whom he was sure was dead—still alive. Jio grapples with doubt, struggling to maintain his grip on sanity. Is Miho really the monster, or is everything just a horrible nightmare?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nito no Joreishi
synopsis:
Exorcists Gotsuji and Uruka spend their days exorcising evil spirits on request, inching ever closer to their goal: to cut down a specific spirit as a means of mourning the woman it killed. Uruka, mystified by Gotsuji's actions, accompanies him in his quest for revenge, but where will their journey lead...? Bunny outfits or traditional garb—doesn't matter! Just cut those spirits down! The curtain rises on a new and exciting story full of action and the occult!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Herald
synopsis:
There's only one rule: "Never speak to the evil spirit." I might have caused my family's death by talking to one. Overwhelmed by guilt, I now see my loved ones as demons...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Gokumama: Gokudou Datta Ore ga Mama ni Natta Hanashi
synopsis:
A yakuza who was supposed to have died gets reincarnated as a woman who at that very moment is giving birth!? A single mother who's a yakuza on the inside struggles with raising her first child! A thrilling child-rearing comedy of laughter and tears!

(Source: Cygames, translated)

title: Inma no Tenteki
synopsis:
Morgamaria, the Succubus Queen, was defeated in her original world and has been transmigrated to the room of a certain adult male (residing in Japan). She tries to use her powers of charm to once again dominate the world. However, the man she meets in her new home turns out to be a succubus's natural enemy...?

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: The Civil Servant of the Sword Returns
titleEnglish: The Civil Servant of the Sword Returns
synopsis:
Ahn Soo-ho, the greatest prosecutor in the world and a civil servant of the Korean Hunters Association. He became a public servant to end the Gate, but was betrayed by his colleagues when one of the so-called final gates, the disastrous gates, was conquered. Why did his colleagues betray him? Because their power would disappear when the Gate ended. Is this the end? When Soo-ho's consciousness began to fade!

[Ahn Soo-ho's player system reboots.]

The system gave Soo-ho one more chance. A chance to go back to the past and set everything right.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Sankakukei no Kowashikata
synopsis:
Koto, Aya, and Erika were secretly in love with each other. Koto's thoughts reach Aya for a short while, but Aya disappears as if she had been spirited away. Seven years later, however, Aya appears to Koto and Erika as she was then.

(Source: MU)

title: Genin no Yukue wo Oikakete
titleEnglish: In Pursuit of the Commoner's Fate
synopsis:
In a bid to save the broadcasting club from disbandment, protagonist Yuuto Shimoda is tasked with reading "Rashomon" for the upcoming reading contest. But he feels somehow detached from the assignment. That is, until he encounters a girl in the broadcast room at school whose acting prowess eerily evokes the old woman from "Rashomon."

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Minasoko
synopsis:
Shin Takasago, a skilled high school kendo player, faces a turning point in his life. A chance encounter shakes his confidence and forces him to question his path. In the world of clashing swords and quiet rivalries, Minasoko explores the pursuit of strength, purpose, and self-discovery.

(Source: Hyakuro Translations)

title: Danjo Hi 1:5 no Sekai demo Futsuu ni Ikirareru to Omotta? Gekiomo Kanjou na Kanojo-tachi ga Mujikaku Danshi ni Hanrou saretara
synopsis:
Before he knew it, the protagonist, Masato, had been transported to a world where the number of women was just a bit higher than in his original world. However, aside from the fact that women were a little more assertive, the world wasn't much different from the one he came from... or so he thought. Little did he know, the kindness he spread, based on the standards of his old world, was saving those around him more than he could imagine. He was unaware that this kindness was causing the women around him to develop intense feelings for him. This is the story of a protagonist who believes he can live an ordinary life, unknowingly making the heroines fall in love with him, and eventually realizing just how heavy their feelings are—until they make him understand it for himself...!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Zenith
synopsis:
Jinwol Ma, better known in the martial realm as the "Mad Demon," once stained the earth with blood in his pursuit to become the pinnacle of all living things. That was until his final battle with the Five Supreme Masters, where the leader of the Fire Dragon sect sealed him away using the Demon-Sealing Sword. Now, three thousand years later, Jinwol awakens, but he is no longer on Earth. Instead, he finds himself surrounded by hostile alien civilizations. Will Jinwol rise once again to aim for the peak of all living creatures?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Duchess in Ruins
synopsis:
Edele Lancaster is the perfect noble lady who has been groomed for the job. But when her husband whom she married reluctantly commits treason, she is branded a traitor and becomes a slave. Distraught, she tries to kill herself to preserve honor as a noble lady, but her new master, Count Laslo Krissus prevents her from doing so. Will Edele be able to find freedom and happiness in her new life as Count Krissus' maid?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Back to Chanbi
synopsis:
Gyeono Kang, a lucky high schooler, used to enjoy the mutual love he shared with the prettiest girl in his class, Chanbi Baek. She was always all about him until an accident wiped her memories of the past year, and just like that, she no longer had feelings for him. But what about Gyeono, whose heart still beats for her? Is it even possible to win her back? Did she really like him back to begin with?! Somebody help!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Special Civil Servant
synopsis:
After failing the Grade Nine civil service exam four times and many twists and turns, Han Maru finally succeeded in becoming a special civil servant under the Ministry of Environment. Goodbye, gosiwon! Goodbye, convenience store lunchboxes! But the joy of passing was short-lived. It turned out to be a life-threatening national secret job?! Along with the yellow dust came the demons, creatures that kill and eat humans. The Grade 9 special civil servant job involved waging war against these demons! Han Maru's life-threatening civil service career begins.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Genius Lout Composer Returns
synopsis:
Success, fame, family... In an instant, the genius composer, Min Hyunseung, lost it all. On the brink of death, he wanted to live a different life, one where all those continuous misfortunes couldn't just be claimed as karma.

"How did this happen...?"

He was given another chance to live.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Hyoukaku no Meteoria
synopsis:
It's a world where the steam engine has been developed using a special fossil fuel called "Meteorian coal." Kanata, a young boy working in a coal mine, studies hard and strives to improve himself despite the harsh environment. Wherein, as he starts to mine a new vein of ore, the gears of the boy's destiny start to turn...!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Enrolling Was a Mistake
synopsis:
Ban Yuwon just wanted to get into college. But instead, he was summoned to an academy in another dimension. There, every student must climb the legendary Tower of Babel, built by Yuwon's own ancestor. Armed with the "Babylonian Code," an ability that lets him absorb and manipulate all languages, he sets out to conquer the tower and reclaim his family's lost honor. However, with deadly monsters, hidden traps, and ruthless rivals from across dimensions, can Yuwon survive the climb?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Valhalla Saga
synopsis:
A professional gamer dies unexpectedly during an E-Sports tournament and is sent to Valhalla, a heaven reserved for only the greatest of warriors. The warriors of Valhalla are pitted against a struggle for survival in the face of a common enemy. Fortunately, within each warrior lies the roots to their own saga, a legendary tale of their ascendance to fame and feats of great achievement alike. Witness the birth of an epic saga as this gamer challenges legends and carves a path toward the ultimate glory.

(Source: NovelUpdates)

title: Mr. Magical Girl
synopsis:
202X, in the back alleys of Seoul, South Korea... He looked down at the heroes under his feet—the heroes who adorned themselves in a variety of colorful clothes, as if they were K-pop idols on TV. Those heroes? They were crawling beneath him, their gaudy outfits smeared with dirt. That was the true nature of being a hero. He hoped the individuals before him learned that lesson well. It was time to ensure they never forgot it. As a magical girl, he swung his hammer down. This is a bright story. The story of a man reclaiming his light.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World
titleEnglish: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World
synopsis:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Sichuan Tang Clan's Entomologist
synopsis:
Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the Tang Clan, the masters of poison and devious tactics. "I see potential in you. Become a part of our family."

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Toshi Densetsu-senpai
synopsis:
Mokume is a first-year college student and occult fanatic! She hunts down an older student, Kugutsu, who is rumored to attract urban legends of all kinds... What will happen when she joins the Occult Club?
