(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Bad Born Blood
synopsis:
All this is for the Empire. Luca had never once questioned his dream of joining Accretia's Imperial Guard. Not until he met Ilay, that is. The most unexpected of friends, Ilay's personality and family background are nothing like Luca's. However, it is through their differences that the two friends will begin to shape not only each other, but even the very planet on which they live.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Swim in the Cherry
synopsis:
During his innocent and naive high school days, Suyeong had the worst first kiss with his first love, Chaeri. Before they can clear up the misunderstanding, Chaeri transfers schools, leaving Suyeong with an unresolved first love. Years later, after his military service, Suyeong attends a welcome party and runs into Chaeri, who has transferred as a new student to his school. He is swayed by her mysterious approach and ends up having an impulsive first experience.

"What if I gave you a chance to make it up to me?" "You started it first."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Toshishita Joushi wa Homeraretai
synopsis:
"This is a suggestion to help our work go more smoothly... Why don't we compliment each other?"

Kashiwagi, in his 30s, has just moved into a new industry. His brilliant younger boss and mentor, Amamiya, seems a bit uncomfortable interacting with him, an older subordinate. Concerned about their relationship, Kashiwagi waits for an opportunity to have a relaxed conversation with him, but catching up with the very busy Amamiya proves difficult.

One day after work, Kashiwagi runs into Amamiya who is working overtime. He offers to help, hoping to improve their relationship even if just a little, but...?

What surprising suggestion comes from Amamiya, the capable younger boss...!?

(Source: Bunendou, translated)

title: Mythical Archmage Returns
synopsis:
Hayool was supposed to be a genius mage and the next head of his clan, but when he turns out to be incompatible with magical AI, his friends and family expect him to give up on his dreams. Too determined to abandon his ambitions, he discovers a book written by the founder of magic itself, and it teaches him to do magic without AI. Suddenly much more powerful than his classmates and school bullies, it seems he might have a bright future after all—if he can survive the secret plots against him.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Madara Rumble
synopsis:
Modern Japan is overrun by "vampires" who mimic and eat people. In order to hunt them down, there are girls who fight in secret with silver weapons in their hands! Among the vampire exterminators, there is a unit of "troublemakers," a.k.a. "Mazarasou." Newly assigned there is Reo, a girl with a certain secret. She meets a woman named Kaika Kiriya, who is one of the most "dangerous" women in the group. A painful, extreme, and sometimes friendship. Hunting, hunting, hunting!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Senki Survival Saga: Isekai no Unmei wo Kaketa Mujintou Fujun Isei Kouyuu
synopsis:
Anastasia, an elf renowned as a once-in-a-millennium magical talent, faces the final battle of a three-way war in another world. In the midst of battle with her arch enemies, the demon race, Anastasia is enveloped in an intense light and, when she awakens, finds herself on an uninhabited island. As Anastasia strolls around the island, a mysterious human appears before her, but she can no longer use magic...!?

A survival comedy featuring the most powerful and beautiful girls from another world and an old man washed ashore on an uninhabited island!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Taishou Gakusei Aisaika
titleEnglish: The Noble Student and His Cinderella
synopsis:
Tokyo, the 10th year of the Taisho period (1921). Fuki, a 24-year-old maid working at the manor house of the distinguished Tachibana family, is reunited with their son Yugo, who has returned home to enroll at The First Imperial University. With Fuki's engagement having been dissolved and Yugo having been charged with finding himself a suitable wife, she accepts his proposal of marriage. In an era when parents' consent is necessary for marriage, and despite the gap between the two in both age and social standing, the admirable maid and elite student's married life is about to begin.

(Source: K Manga)

title: The Regressor Only Protects Me
synopsis:
Humanity was designated as a disruptive species of the Cosmic Ecosystem. To reduce humanity's numbers, the universe's administrators initiate a survival game. Jin Jaehee, having returned from the final stage of the game, reaches one clear conclusion: "Kang Shion, only he can lead us to victory in this game."

Kang Shion, a genius with an unparalleled mind. Jin Jaehee, a regressor who lost in the survival game and returned to the past. With the regressor as his ally, Kang Shion begins to unravel the death game with unprecedented skill.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Henkyou Mob Kizoku no Uchi ni Totsuidekita Akuyaku Reijou ga, Mechakucha Dekiru Ii Yome Nanda ga?
titleEnglish: The Villainess Who Came to Marry into the Frontier Noble's Household Is an Exceptionally Capable Wife, Isn't She?
synopsis:
Ragna has reincarnated as the third son of a noble family with lands in the frontier.

Thrilled at the prospect of living freely in another world without the responsibility of inheriting the family estate, his excitement was short-lived. Following the death of his father and two brothers in battle, Ragna finds himself unexpectedly taking over the family.

Unfamiliar with managing the estate and continuing the family legacy, he now faces the challenge of navigating noble duties, including attending an elite academy in the capital. As if adjusting to these responsibilities wasn't overwhelming enough, an arranged marriage to a high-ranking noble's daughter is thrust upon him.

This is when Ragna recalls a crucial detail about his new reality—this world mirrors that of an otome game, where his fiancée is known as the game's antagonist.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Horror Story Club
synopsis:
On his first day at Nakseong High, Lee Jun enters more than a new environment. After a status window warns him of the school's horror stories, he is killed in a wave of gore and sent back to his first day. This time, Jun ignores the ominous window and tricks fate, only to be killed again three years later, forced to restart high school, and lead a brand-new horror story club. Pulled into this life-and-death game, can Jun rewrite the Nakseong urban legend once and for all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Love Is an Illusion! Superstar
synopsis:
Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gekitsumi Dungeon desu ga "Skill: Hanshoku" de Gyakuten shitai to Omoimasu
titleEnglish: It's a Very Crowded Dungeon, but I Want to Turn It Around with "Skill: Breeding"
synopsis:
Reborn as a dungeon master in another world, Akira Hanamura quickly constructs a comfortable dungeon within his first 30 minutes in this new realm. However, he soon realizes his creation is a "zero-defense" setup—vulnerable to the constant influx of adventurers and, if conquered, spells instant death for him. Faced with this dire predicament, Akira must use his unique "Reproduction" skill to multiply his monster minions and fortify the dungeon. With each encounter, he gradually transforms his humble lair into an ultimate stronghold, utilizing strategies, monster alliances, and swift adaptability to fend off every challenge.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Obsessed With Shuelina
synopsis:
Shuelina has only ever wanted to be loved as she grew up in an orphanage. But after her birth father rejected her in a previous life, she tries to find a family who will accept her in this one. Luckily, Archduke Bylot and his sons fall for her indomitable spirit, and they shower her with the love she has longed for. But once they find out she's the long-lost imperial princess, can she be a part of their family? Or will she have to go back to the people who sent her away in the first place?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon shitara Mecha Amai
titleEnglish: It's So Sweet When I Marry My Organization's Nemesis.
synopsis:
"...I hate you!"
"What a coincidence. So do I."

The two once belonged to opposing organizations of supernatural power users, and fought for their own opposing goals. Roushi Saikawa, also known as the "Feather Hunter," and Ritsuka Yanagi, the strongest supernatural power user known as the "White Demon." The two spent their days battling each other and had no normal social experience, but...

"I love you, Rou-kun."
"Me too, Ritsuka."

After their organization was disbanded, they somehow started dating and then got married! Is their hatred 100 times more adorable? Now, they are the epitome of a lovey-dovey couple, kissing each other at the door every morning when they go to work. But the husband had just one problem. That is, he had never shared a bed with his wife... In other words, even though he was married, he was still a virgin! This is the story of the hardships faced by such a husband, who gets caught up in numerous troubles but continues to make desperate attempts to deepen his love with his strict wife.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
titleEnglish: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
synopsis:
"In my next life, I wish to walk a completely different path..."

The Heavenly Demon, whose life revolved around fear and reverence, gained a crucial clue to mastering the Soul-Augmentation Art at the moment of his death: the "Soul-Augmentation Art" wasn't just about consuming the souls of others. The Heavenly Demon then awakened in the body of Byeok Taesan, a frail young noble who could die at any moment... To survive, he must make his way to the courtesan house! The Heavenly Demon, now transformed into the "Night King," begins his ambitious journey of survival.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Ultimate Shut-In
synopsis:
Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jaehyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch—he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalyptic world they find themselves in.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Drama Queen
synopsis:
After saving the earth, aliens have taken up residence with the humans in Japan. Nomamoto, a factory worker with an abusive alien boss, one day meets Kitami, who tells her his own family was killed by aliens. The two quickly forge a friendship, but one day Kitami does the unthinkable...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kanshuu no Ou
synopsis:
Despite having access to numerous mistresses, King Faslan, who ascended to the throne at a young age, chose only one woman. Though he continued to love her and her alone, their happiness was fleeting and brief. All that remained was her 'custom' that she left behind—

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.
titleEnglish: The Phantom Girl in Games of Death.
synopsis:
When Yuuki wakes up in an unfamiliar manor wearing a maid uniform, she recognizes this as the start of a new death game. After assessing the situation, Yuuki begins to wander before discovering a room with five other maids. Each one is visibly anxious, and she learns from them that they are all new players who joined this lethal game for the prize money.

But Yuuki is different: she is a death game veteran whose only goal is to achieve 99 consecutive wins. Tasked with navigating a manor filled with countless instruments of murder, Yuuki takes point as the only experienced player in an environment that is designed to actively work against her. Despite this, she is determined to reach the end of the game with as many people as possible—if it coincides with her final goal.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Bishoujo Senshi Stress
synopsis:
The truth behind those dreamy Magical Girls and Pretty Guardians who inspire children's dreams...?! A new tale of a Pretty Guardian that's both realistic AND totally awesome!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: How to Raise Your Skeletons
synopsis:
A necromancer is a profession considered the noble of nobles, with less than 1,000 in the population worldwide! I was born with a diamond spoon, no, a necromancer spoon in my mouth! ...Or so I thought.

"I'm just a defective necromancer."

[Using skill, "Summon Ordinary Skeleton" (E-rank).]

You'd think a necromancer should be able to summon liches, Dullahans, or death knights. But nope, I can only summon skeletons. But then one day, suddenly...

[Hidden condition achieved!]
[Condition: The 10,000 Uses Rule]
[Your rank has upgraded to D-rank!]

I achieved the hidden condition and gained the ability to raise my skeletons. From E-rank to S-rank! The story of Joo Donghoon unfolds, the world's only cursed necromancer, who's speeding toward becoming a ranker!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Asura no Sata
synopsis:
"Only do good deeds."—Asura follows his late mother's teachings and always strives to do good in life. No matter how much he is bullied, he goes on with a smile, firmly believing that evildoers will receive divine punishment. Until one day, an ominous old man offers him a key that can open the doors to hell...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
titleEnglish: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
synopsis:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she'll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel's hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending—easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona's dangerous past, and the grand duke's affections, can Rona stick to the story?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tamagawa-san Detemashita?
synopsis:
The erotic comedy manga centers on a convenience store manager named Tamagawa-san, who is doing a job interview with a girl who greatly resembles the famous sexy actress Yuri Miyama. The sexy actress retired at the height of her popularity, and Tamagawa really wants to ask and confirm if the girl is indeed Yuri Miyama.

(Source: ANN)

title: Magical Realm Shopkeeper
synopsis:
The protagonist Chan, who was looking for a part-time job after his previous company went bankrupt, coincidentally discovers a convenience store. Lured by the very high hourly wage, he decides to become a part-timer from that day. But the customers who come in seem a bit strange. Vampires, kobolds, and even succubi??

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: "Osananajimi ga Hoshii" to Tsubuyaitara Yoku Issho ni Asobu Onna Tomodachi no Yousu ga Hen ni Nattan da ga
synopsis:
"I want a cute girl as a childhood friend."

―It was a casual remark made by Akito while having lunch with his usual friend group of four. However, he didn't know that the person sitting right in front of him, Natsumi, was actually his childhood friend who had moved away when they were small!

Since then, Natsumi has been trying to express her feelings to Akito, but because they had always been friends, it hasn't been easy for her to convey them...

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Maybe Undefeatable
synopsis:
Yu Hyeol, a third-rate warrior infamously nicknamed "The Star of the Dark Arts" due to his menacing appearance, lived a life plagued by false rumors and endless misunderstandings. One day, Seolhwa—the woman he once vowed his future to—reappears before him, no longer the gentle figure he remembered but a formidable master of martial arts. From that moment, his name becomes entangled with the lives of countless warriors, spiraling his already infamous reputation. As his so-called "notoriety" spreads, the Murim Alliance, the Demon Cult, and even the royal court take notice of him.

"No, really... it's all just a big misunderstanding!"

But can he convince the world otherwise? Or will he unintentionally become the legend he never aimed to be?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Doukyuusei A
synopsis:
Asaoka, the delinquent who rules the high school, and Saji, his untalkative classmate. Asaoka looks down on Saji for being unremarkable and friendless, but one day, a single comment from Saji completely changes their relationship...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Aori-kei Game Haishinsha (Hatachi), Haishin no Kiriwasure ni Yori Ii Hito Bare suru.
synopsis:
"What happened today is a secret between us, okay?"

Haruto Nakayama is a gaming commentator known for his toxicity as the streamer "Oni-chan," After finishing his usual streaming session, Haruto accidentally forgot to end the stream. As a result, his secret life as a streamer working to support his younger sister's education and living expenses is exposed. Furthermore, it's also revealed that he meticulously prepares scripts to provoke others, all while being, in reality, a genuinely nice person!

To make matters more complicated, during a livestream by the popular VTuber and professional gamer, Ayaya (aka Aya Shirayuki), Haruto unintentionally reveals his true personality once again. Unexpectedly, this led to them growing closer to each other as they continued to play games and go on outings together.

Thus begins a one-on-one romantic comedy between the business-minded toxic streamer and the popular VTuber heroine!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Daiakutou Shounen
synopsis:
Everything in the world is absurd. The heroes who fight under the guise of righteousness, the small-time villains who can only commit petty crimes, the classmates who can only huddle together in groups... and his own weak and miserable self. And so the boy yearns to become a lonely, aloof, and supreme "supervillain," to change himself and the world!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Mabataki no Oto
synopsis:
The young boy "I" becomes swallowed up by the pleasure of drawing and completing a painting, embarking on a long creative journey. Along the way, he must confront "you" who lies in the shadows. What is the true nature of "I," that weaves between impulse and imagination?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness
synopsis:
Rebecca grows up with her big brother Pilar as they pursue their shared dream of becoming a legendary edgerunner like their father. In the megalopolis of Night City, where obsessions with technology, violence, and power run rampant, they struggle, suffer, and cause chaos wherever they go! As they go about their daily lives, a mysterious man appears before them—changing the trajectory of their future. In this manga, a prequel to Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, siblings Rebecca and Pilar's lives are full of madness as they rush through Night City to prove themselves as edgerunners!

(Source: Dark Horse)

title: Mizu Mahou gurai shika Torie ga Nai kedo Gendai Chishiki ga Areba Juubun dayone?
titleEnglish: Though I've Got Nothing but Aquamancy, It's Enough to Have Modern Wisdom, Isn't It?
synopsis:
Frim, a 5-year-old orphan living in the streets of the slums district, was a Japanese person in her past life.

Her everyday life is filled with violence and injustice, and she has no one she can rely on for help. All she has is "magic that can produce water" and "modern knowledge." Even hoping for a roof to sleep under is a luxury under such circumstances.

But this world is lacking in things like ideas for improving working conditions, and by coming up with new ways to use aquamancy aside from producing potable water, Frim gradually makes her presence known!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shachiku Kensei, Haishinsha ni Naru: Black Guild Kaishain, Ukkari Kaishayou Kaisen de S-kyuu Monster wo Aite ni Musou suru Tokoro wo Zenkoku Haishin shiteshimau
titleEnglish: Overpowered and Underpaid: An OP Swordmaster Turns Hit Streamer
synopsis:
"Work—that's the true grave of life..." With a heavy sigh, exploited guild employee Makoto Tanaka trudges into yet another dungeon. Per protocol, he starts a stream for company records—only this time, he accidentally sets it to PUBLIC.

Soon, over a hundred million viewers from all over the country are watching live as this so-called "modern-day swordmaster" takes down the Tyrant Dragon with a single strike! Overnight, Tanaka becomes a viral sensation. Seizing the chance, he ditches his soul-crushing job to begin a new career: an overpowered ex–office drone turned solo dungeon streamer!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Dead or Alive
synopsis:
Calahan, a famous hunter who has captured 999 wanted criminals, chooses Johnny the Grifter as the final target of his career for a reward of 10 million pais. But Johnny, a con man who preys on the pockets of the elderly, insists he's innocent... "If I prove my innocence, you give me a million pais." Calahan and Johnny embark on a wild ride with a million pais on the line, and a mysterious group of men in hot pursuit. There's only ten days until they reach their destination, and both will do whatever it takes to win the bet—dead or alive.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sadistic Beauty: Side Story A
synopsis:
Gyerin decides to leave behind her ill-fated first love with Doona and start anew. She quickly meets a woman who looks like her ideal type from head to toe... Is Juyeon, full of armor-piercing amounts of charm, her fortune or woe?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Sadistic Beauty: Side Story B
synopsis:
Byun Minho watched Duna from behind as she was congratulated by everyone for winning the competition's grand prize. Minho had always believed she was beneath him. Feeling a mix of jealousy and defeat, he went to the school rooftop to cry his heart out. That day, Cha Wookyung secretly followed Minho and watched him quietly. Ever since he saw Minho spill his raw emotions, Wookyung dreamed of claiming Minho as his. After 7 years of waiting, Wookyung's vanquish begins now.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Yuusha yo, Ware wo Sodateyo!
synopsis:
Demon King Velgar met a dramatic end after his battle with the hero Karen. Although the Demon King left behind his last words, "In my next life.. I swear I'll come back to destroy you!!!," he later does indeed achieve reincarnation. What awaits him in his humiliating new life after being reborn...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Please Stop the Pope
synopsis:
While livestreaming about his struggles, Siwoo receives a donation with a strange request. He agrees, only to discover it came from Limen, the goddess of Eden, who has suddenly tasked him with defending her world from seven demon rulers. Ten years later, Siwoo returns to Earth as the pope of Eden, only to find it overrun by monsters. The demon rulers show signs of reappearing, and to maintain his divine power, he must spread Limen's faith across Earth. Can Pope Siwoo complete his holy mission?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Legendary Hero Is an Academy Honors Student
titleEnglish: The Legendary Hero Is an Academy Honors Student
synopsis:
In the Age of Catastrophe, five heroes saved the world from a primordial evil. One of the heroes, now reborn as Leo Plove, is excited to revisit his glorious past—only to find his name erased from history. Determined to uncover the truth, he joins Lumerne, a hero military academy, unaware he's about to discover dark secrets surrounding his reincarnation. Why are his past records hidden, and who wants to keep them that way? Will Leo be able to set things right and reclaim the credit he deserves?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Sankakuboshi no Horobi no Yama
titleEnglish: The Mountain of Remains on Planet Triangle
synopsis:
On a planet existing remote from other planets in space, there extends a land of white ashes. Organisms that resemble a triangular rice ball inhabited the land. The planet was once a place where humanity built a civilization. One day, something that looks like a human wakes up...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: My Daddy Hid His Power
synopsis:
Q: Describe your feelings upon discovering your trusted dad isn't just an extra.
A: W-what the heck... Give me back my "Random Imperial Citizen #1" life...

Living in a world of constant war—365 days of chaos—a simple, extra's existence was a blessing. At least, that's what I thought. In a small village, I enjoyed a humble life with my loving, ordinary father, James Brown, 27, the epitome of an unremarkable single dad. Or so I believed.

"Ladies and gentlemen, presenting my father! The quintessential symbol of extras everywhere! Brown hair, brown eyes, plain and simple! This man screams 'background character,' living a quiet life chopping wood in a mountain village with his adorable daughter. Right? ...RIGHT?"

The knight commander merely stared at me in silence. And then, the unthinkable happened. Behind me, my father's worn staff began to glow with a strange, blue aura.

"...Dad?"

Before I could process what was happening, his unassuming brown hair and eyes shifted. Slowly but surely, they transformed into... Shimmering silver locks and piercing blue eyes—practically shouting "I'm the protagonist!"

"WHAT?!"

My simple, extra life shattered into a million pieces as my dad—no, t…

title: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
titleEnglish: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
synopsis:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she's determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kaze no Iro made Oboeteru
titleEnglish: Crush on You Like Spring Thunder.
synopsis:
The first year of high school: Spring. Mori, who has just entered school, learns of his classmate, Michioto, who is rumored to be the "treasure of the boys' school." Mori volunteered to ask for Michioto's contact information on behalf of a friend who was too scared to talk to him. Mori headed towards Michioto without really thinking about it, but the moment Mori sees him, it's love at first sight...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Shimeitehaikan
synopsis:
A police officer is assigned to a small town. As she relentlessly pursues criminals and shows zero tolerance for evil, what awaits her—words of gratitude, or something else? This is a story that explores the nature of justice and evil.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Genius Wants an Ordinary Life
titleEnglish: The Genius Wants an Ordinary Life
synopsis:
A man who has everything and yet nothing. The only thing successful corporate executive Jinhyeok Son ever really wanted was an ordinary life with a beloved family, a desire arising from the tragic death of his parents when he was a child. This all changes after he finds himself back in his nine-year-old body after an accident—to a time when his parents are still alive, to the very life he had longed to return to! Can Jinhyeok change the past and finally fulfill his dream of an ordinary life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Villainess Makes Amends
synopsis:
After trouble child Kiana Ellie Freley leaves home to pursue her passion, she is satisfied living the academic life as a professor of magical engineering. That is, until her family is wrongly accused of treason and sentenced to death! In a last-ditch effort to reverse their fate, Kiana's cousin Melissa turns back time by one year, but only Kiana retains her memories. With just her summoned creature Chirpy by her side, can Kiana amend relations with her family and prevent their unjust end?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Danshi Kinsei Game Sekai de Ore ga Yarubeki Yuiitsu no Koto: Yuri no Aida ni Hasamaru Otoko toshite Tensei shiteshimaimashita
synopsis:
"Everything for the Score"—nicknamed "Esco"—is a renowned masterpiece in the world of yuri games. A boy who reincarnates into its world suddenly finds himself in the role of Sanjou Hiiro, infamously known as "the guy who gets in the way of yuri."

Hiiro is a nuisance character who ends up ruined no matter which route he's in. To avoid triggering his death flags, he begins to train and search for a safe path—but for some reason, heroine events keep unfolding around him as the central figure...!?

"I don't want a harem romcom! Just give me yuri! Let me see the yuri!"

(Source: MangaDex)

title: The Dragon Slayer's Regression on Another Level
titleEnglish: The Dragon Slayer's Regression on Another Level
synopsis:
Zeke Draker was the first of House Draker to fail his Awakening. And for that, he was cast out. Forced to survive in a brutal world, Zeke rose from disgrace and earned the name Phantom of the North. On a mission to stop the emperor from obtaining an ancient relic, Zeke was hunted and killed by imperial forces. But fate had other plans. Zeke awakens as a 12-year-old boy back in the Cradle, House Draker's elite training ground. Given a second chance, Zeke's determined to rewrite his fate.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Munou na Mamahaha desu ga, Kazoku no Dekiai ga Tomarimasen!
synopsis:
Dismissed as incompetent and neglected by her family, the Duke's daughter, Elsha, is suddenly ordered to marry the infamous Archduke Iceberg—a war hero feared for his ruthless reputation. Rather than despair, she seizes this chance for a fresh start. But upon arriving at his manor, she finds the Archduke missing and is instead met by his wary adopted sons, Wilbert and Hugh—who had no idea their father was remarrying. With an absent husband, distrustful stepchildren, and a manor full of secrets, can Elsha carve out a place for herself and find happiness at last?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Belle Poupée no Super Darling Konyaku: "Konomi ja Nai" to Iwareta Ningyou Hime, Gaman wo Yametara Ouji ga Deredere ni Natta. Jitsu ni Ui!
synopsis:
Nicknamed "Belle Poupee"—the Beautiful Doll—duke's daughter Lady Leticia is admired for her elegance and delicate beauty. But behind her porcelain mask lies her true self: a bold and compassionate soul, more knight than damsel. She ends up engaged to the infamous second prince, Gilbert, whose cursed crimson eyes and icy demeanor have made him the subject of troubling rumors. Fate binds together an infallible Princess Charming and a lonely, awkward prince as they search for their happily ever after in this ultimate role-reversal love story.

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Glass-goshi no Koibito
synopsis:
Shoko, who's searching for a partner, hits it off with Ukai, whom she meets on a dating app. However, he's from a parallel world, and the only way they can connect is through her smartphone screen... As she spends her days with a boyfriend she can neither meet nor touch, Shoko uncovers a certain truth about him...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Sono Akuyaku Kizoku, Mama Heroine ga Sukisugiru: Shinshi na Doryoku de Saikyou to Nari Fuguu na Oshi Chara Tasukemakuru
synopsis:
The mom characters that appear in the game are all unfortunate sub-heroines who always get bad ending routes. "Why... Why does such a cute mom have to die?!" Even though the protagonist tried very hard to request a route where they get saved, all of his efforts were in vain, making him spend his days in frustration. Then, he suddenly gets reincarnated into the world of MamaFan on a certain day. ...However, he gets reincarnated as a villainous aristocrat who's got nothing but the worst routes. This guy, who's crazy about mom characters—his fulfilling days of saving his beloved mom characters and his journey to create his harem full of plump women are about to begin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Moonstruck
synopsis:
How far would you be willing to go for love? The unavoidable temptation to destroy one's deepening love is an age-old dilemma for many. This provocative collection of love stories will show you how dangerous passion can sometimes be.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Seikou Ooja
synopsis:
Unable to accept the death of his best friend Octo-chan, Yota makes a forbidden wish on a night of despair. What appeared before his eyes was...? The genius Ichinohe-sensei debuts with an impactful serialization! A new sensational fantasy tale of everlasting friendship!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Sekai Saikyou no Kishi wa, Kanarazu Shinu Heroine wo Sukuu Tame Isekai demo Saikyou no Kishi to Naru: Ryoute ni Hana wo, Ryoute ni Ken wo
synopsis:
He fell in love with the heroine and overturned her destiny to save her from her timely demise.

Abandoned by his parents, bullied in high school, and left in solitude—a young boy named Kenya Mikazuki. At the brink of despair, he encounters a fateful meeting in his only hobby, VR gaming. He has a fateful meeting with "Kaguya" and "Reina," the heroines from the immensely popular game "Knight of Giant." The time spent with the two heroines saved him, and he was head over heels for both of them.

However, in the story, one of them is destined to die... To change that fate, he dedicated his life to mastering the game and becoming the strongest in the world. Suddenly, Kenya finds himself entering the world of "Knight of Giant"?!

The strongest gamer embarks on a heroic tale of becoming the strongest in another world, in order to save the heroines he fell deeply in love with. The story begins.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Taika no Risei
synopsis:
Due to a declining birth rate, pets are being transformed into humanoid members of society. But are they truly human? Or are humans truly animals?

When misanthrope Ao discovers her family dog, pit bull Taika, standing over the mauled body of her father, she must decide whether to forgive or forget. Ao isn't ready to lose both her beloved father and her devoted pet, so when her mother has Taika humanized, Ao embraces the new dogman and even brings him to school with her. There, Taika meets a German shepherd, an elite police dogman, and begins to unlearn canine behaviors and replace them with human customs. Now, the two dogmen compete to see who will be the first to track down the source of the mysterious traces of blood in Ao's locker...

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: The Investor Who Sees the Future
synopsis:
After experiencing an accident in the military, Kang Jinhu gained the ability to foresee the future. He decides to use this ability to invest in various companies and make money, aiming to become the world's number one investor. How far do the limits of his foresight extend? Beyond investments, it touches economics, politics, corporations, and even global affairs. From now on, he's reshaping the world of finance!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Kanojo no Real ga Kirinukenai!
synopsis:
Riku Mikami, who is starting as a university student in the spring, finds out that his favorite VTuber is taking a hiatus. The one who cheers him up is Rui Saionji, his classmate. Will Riku resolve to make Rui his "oshi"?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
synopsis:
The United Kingdom of Euchronia is thrown into chaos following the assassination of its king... Our Hero, the Traveler Will, and his Fairy Companion Gallica, race to Grand Trad to undertake a Special Mission. Discover the bonds that form between eight races across three countries.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Saneka no Yomeiri
synopsis:
Tatsuhiko inherits his grandfather's home after his passing. It's been ages, so he heads to the old homestead for a visit. In a storage room there, he encounters a tanuki who claims to be a god. Tatsuhiko and the tanuki god repair the home together while sharing stories about his grandfather. Following this strange turn of events, the two decide to get married?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
titleEnglish: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
synopsis:
One feverish night, 6-year-old Liliana Bercchio suddenly recalls the plot of a tragic reverse harem novel. Unsure if she's been reincarnated or has time traveled, her young mind struggles to make sense of it all. Her family is doomed to get caught up in the protagonists' mess—but there's still time... or so she thought. When she witnesses the female lead's death and the deranged male leads appear before her sisters, the story takes a turn. They seem different now, but is her family truly safe?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kuromaku Ikka ni Tensei shita kedo Gensaku Mushi shite Dokuritsu suru
titleEnglish: I've Been Reborn into a Mastermind Family, but I'm Going Independent, Ignoring the Original Story.
synopsis:
A voluntary banishment declaration from the family, known as a "mastermind family!" In order to avoid destruction, Yuri decides to live an unconventional slow life in the frontier...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Black Serpent
synopsis:
"I shall destroy the factions of justice and avenge the deaths of my comrades!"

Jeonghwa, the captain of the Black Serpent Squad, loses everyone she grew up with when the lawful factions betray them after the battle against the chaotic factions. On the verge of death herself, she must now claw her way up to deliver true justice to the so-called justice factions.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Toumei to Zanzou
synopsis:
Shoko, an aspiring artist, made her living drawing portraits. One day, a young man wrapped in bandages asked her to draw his self-portrait, but as it turned out, he was actually an invisible man...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ex-Love Review
synopsis:
Giju is highly competent, but when it comes to love, she always seems to choose the wrong guy. This time, she thought things would be different. But again her faith is betrayed, and during a heated argument, she ends up falling down a flight of stairs. When she awakens in the hospital, she starts seeing suspicious "relationship reviews" of others!

"Love reviews written by their former exes...?" Could this strange phenomenon be able to save Giju's love life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Surviving in a Romance Fantasy Novel
synopsis:
I, Seo Taepyung, ended up transmigrating as the younger brother of the heroine in the fantasy romance novel Celestial Love. As romantic as this place is supposed to be, I was too busy just trying to adapt to my new life. Romance? Yeah, right. My goal was to keep a low profile and live quietly. But then...

"How could you make the crown princess fall for you of all people?!" At that point, I had no idea. I was only just beginning to scrape the surface of this bizarre turn of events...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Shiromaru
synopsis:
A white, round SOMETHING has appeared in the Sea of Japan! The notoriously lazy Harusame gets appointed as the mysterious marine creature "Shiromaru" handler along with two quirky companions! While Harusame wants nothing more than to avoid human interaction, his encounters with Shiromaru force him to confront the past... A coming-of-age sci-fi drama for anyone who finds this world hard to live in!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Boyish Kanojo ga Kawaisugiru
synopsis:
Daichi and Akira have been childhood friends forever but have only started dating recently. While Akira is very much a tomboy, there are some parts of her that are surprisingly girly?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Bungou Stray Dogs: Stormbringer
synopsis:
It's been roughly one year since Chuuya Nakahara joined the Port Mafia, and he's got his sights set on an executive position. But as he makes plans to move up, a man by the name of Paul Verlaine—claiming to be his younger brother—appears and vows to assassinate everyone he cares about! Now, Chuuya must team up with Adam, a European A.I. investigator, to stop this lunatic before the storm swallows Yokohama once again...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Nan Pei Xiang Yao Zhengjiu Yixia
titleEnglish: I Want to Be a Big Baddie
synopsis:
A true villain needs to be ruthless, evil, and self-destructive! After torturing the protagonist to hell and back, they will exit the scene fabulously with a bang as their work is done. Wang Yi was determined to act that kind of villain. Unfortunately... His male lead could read minds. (:з)∠*)

"You mongrel!" Mr. Yi chuckled as he looked down on the novel's male lead. Suddenly, a thought bubble filled with cute emojis (⁄ ⁄ ⁄ω⁄ ⁄ ⁄) with the words "You're so cute..." appeared in front of Qin.

Qin: ?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: On the Way to Meet Mom
titleEnglish: On the Way to Meet Mom
synopsis:
Only some children in the orphanage are lucky enough to have a patron—and a small, curious child named Mori starts receiving gifts one day. Mori does not speak, but he listens and enjoys the company of his friend, Rowena, who tells him everything he needs to know. But once Rowena disappears in the warm embrace of her mother, Mori realizes one thing: if every child has a mother, then his own must be out there somewhere.

Having packed his little bag, put on his boots, and donned a red cape—undoubtedly a gift from his mother—Mori sets foot outside of the orphanage and begins his journey. The outside world is dangerous; ever since aliens took over Earth, humans have dwindled in numbers, and various creatures roam the vast lands and build their settlements. Ryder, a scarlet-skinned alien with horns and five eyes, encounters Mori and, realizing his origins and the dangers that await him, decides to help Mori's quest and protect him until he meets his mom.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Space Cheon-ma 3077
synopsis:
Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua
titleEnglish: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua
synopsis:
Phantom Swordsman Dokgo Heon, an unrivaled master of the Unorthodox Faction, and Hyun Jo, the master of the Mount Hua Sect, forged a friendship through crossing blades. However, the Demonic Cult launched a sudden attack, tragically ending the life of Hyun Jo. At the brink of death, Dokgo Heon possesses the body of Hyun Jo's disciple, Mu Hwi... and thus began Mu Hwi's struggle in fulfilling his friend's dying wish—to save the Mount Hua Sect.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Genius Prismatic Mage
synopsis:
In the slums lived a young boy named Ray who lacked emotions. He suddenly gained the ability to see "colors" that no one else could, and he had the power to control them. One day, he lost his shelter, an underpass, and his friends to a magician. He even lost Niles, whom he had believed in and followed. The emotionless boy swore to take revenge, beginning his search to regain his emotions.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Destined Killer
synopsis:
Number is not your average serial killer. Equipped with the ability to identify future murderers, Number takes the law into his own hands. He believes in ridding the world of destined killers. Simple, right? One day, he runs into Jihyeon, whose number changes constantly as she develops a special power of her own. Will the two work together to eliminate would-be murderers? Or will Jihyeon's very existence threaten Number's moral compass?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Black Haze
synopsis:
A long time ago, a portal to another world was opened, and those who acquired special abilities along with marks began to be called mages. After the incident known as "that day," the first-class mage from Ophion, known as "Blow," has become very famous. One day, he receives a very special mission: to protect the second son of the Artian family, who suffers from being called a "monster" at the magic school Helios! Thus, Blow enrolls in Helios under the name "Rood Krisch" to hide his true identity...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Rules for Dating Trash
synopsis:
After a messy breakup with a trashy ex forces Seon Ihyeon to take a three-year-long break from college, the last thing she wants to do upon her not-so-inconspicuous return is to dive straight into another relationship. But then comes Nam Chanu, a notorious bad boy who finds himself having a vested interest in Ihyeon. And suddenly, what was supposed to be a low-key senior year is looking like it's going to be anything but. The harder Ihyeon pushes Chanu away, the stronger he keeps pulling her back. But something's gotta give–so who's giving in first?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Miss Pendleton
synopsis:
Twenty-nine-year-old spinster Laura Pendleton is known to be a talented matchmaker in London society. When she's asked to find a wife for the eligible bachelor lan Dalton, she believes it will be an easy task―until she meets the gorgeous yet blunt and aloof Mr. Dalton in person.

Although Miss Pendleton introduces him to several beautiful young ladies, the cynical Mr. Dalton appears to have eyes only for his matchmaker. But Miss Pendleton has no interest in marriage, especially not to such a wealthy nobleman, due to her shameful past. Instead, Miss Pendleton makes arrangements to become a governess and thereby escape her abusive uncle on her own. But Mr. Dalton is nothing if not persistent. When Miss Pendleton faces unexpected troubles, he offers her the governess position for his young nephews in order to get closer to her.

Mr. Dalton's love, bordering obsession, for Miss Pendleton means that he won't give up until he can convince her to become his―despite all that is at stake.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kokoro no Ichiban Kurai Heya
synopsis:
Scary stories tend to hide what's truly within an author's heart. What exactly could this truth be, as it comes to light between author and listener...? Frightening yet gentle, eerie yet warm. A new and exciting therapeutic horror story takes the stage!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Sotsugyou Album no Kanojo-tachi
titleEnglish: The Heroines in My Graduation Albums
synopsis:
"A love that was supposed to be just a memory starts moving all at once!!"

Kanae Meguru, a movie enthusiast, had potential romantic interests throughout elementary, middle, and high school. However, due to his lack of experience in love, he was never able to take action. Learning from that, he vowed to focus entirely on his university film club activities, completely ignoring romance. But that resolve was short-lived—before he knew it, he found himself falling for Ootsuka Ozora, a girl he met in the film club...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Holy Hella's Ultimate End
synopsis:
Kim Isaac, once the all-powerful Skeleton King, is now a baby in a onesie. Tricked by the gods and sealed away, he's reincarnated into a family of saints at the heart of the Holy Empire. He can't walk or talk, but he can plot. And with his loyal demon followers working from the shadows and a grudge deeper than the underworld itself, this baby isn't here to be cute—he's here for payback. The Holy Empire has no idea what's coming... and the gods are about to regret ever crossing the Skeleton King.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Akuma de Fukei!
synopsis:
Seeking a bad guy worthy of being her servant, Eclair goes to a police box out in the countryside. There she spots a serious cop who has a villainous look to him, Kuwabara Daichi. Eclair wants to bring Daichi down to the underworld, but Daichi just wants to send her back there. Their love is war...! Or maybe Eclair is a fool and Daichi just can't leave her be.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kanojo ni Shitai Joshi Ichii, no Tonari de Mitsuketa Amari-chan
synopsis:
Fukusuke Mogi, a plain but nice guy, secretly admires Yua Kureha, the most beautiful girl in the class. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is Fukusuke's best friend Fujisaki, the ace of the basketball team.

Feeling down about being a "mob character" overshadowed by his best friend, Fukusuke discovers another super cute girl who's hidden in Yui's shadow and doesn't stand out—Amari Usuha!

"W-Would you... be my friend?"

Sharing similar circumstances, Fukusuke and Amari decide to practice "becoming normal" together—what could possibly happen next?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Net no "Oshi" to Real no "Oshi" ga Tonari ni Hikkoshitekita
titleEnglish: My Fave Persons Moved into Condominium Where I Live
synopsis:
Souma Tendou, who spends his days in idle monotony, has two "favorites." His online favorite is Henrietta, a hugely popular VTuber. His real-life favorite is Hiyori Yatsumi, an idol and voice actress. Souma was supposed to be spending his university life supporting these two idols... But then, one of his favorites unexpectedly moves into the room next door!? Excited by this dream-like turn of events, Soma is thrilled, but what he discovers is the disappointing true nature of his favorite...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Genikasuri
synopsis:
After one fateful match, former professional boxer Ryou Harima awakens from a two-year vegetative state to find out his career is over, his father has died, and he's been betrayed by his gym... Broken and fueled by rage, he vows to make it to the top of the boxing world, but this time as a promoter. Prepare yourself for a story about manipulation and money from the dark corner of the boxing world!!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Dungeons and Crayons
synopsis:
At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: For Your Murder
synopsis:
Elementary school teacher Go Gijeong has lost almost everything: her parents when she was a child, her freedom when she had to support her shut-in younger brother, and now her very dignity as the class bully among her students and his mother threaten to turn her life into a living hell. Upon meeting the mild-mannered yet inscrutable lawyer Oh Inseop, Gijeong begins to find her life changing, though little does she know that wherever Inseop goes, death follows.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby
titleEnglish: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby
synopsis:
The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: What Death Taught Me
synopsis:
As Rinette Dikla Hilt burns at the stake, she begs the heavens for a second chance to atone for her sins and escape her wretched fate. Unaware that Argos, the second prince and her beloved, and Kanna, her adopted sister, were conspiring against her, Rinette played her part in the death of Crown Prince Pinberk. The blame fell on her as Argos and Kanna dropped their masks and displayed their wicked greed for power.

Waking up on the day her father brings in Kanna, Rinette decides to utilize what death taught her. Although Rinette ruins Kanna's initial plans, Kanna still covets all that Rinette possesses and is prepared to kill for it. Rinette plots to avoid Argos and grow closer to Pinberk—occasionally relying on an unexpected ally—but she knows not to trust anyone while ensuring that Kanna never gains a place in her family and the opportunity to destroy her again.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koukou Jidai ni Gouman datta Joou-sama to no Dousei Seikatsu wa Igai to Igokochi ga Warukunai
synopsis:
"Hey, wanna do it?"

A romantic comedy about living together with a scarred queen in a relationship that's more than friends but less than lovers!!

One late night, Yamamoto, a college student working part-time at a convenience store, reunites with Hayashi Megumi, his high school classmate and the most beautiful girl in their class. Known as the "Queen" for her strong-willed and arrogant personality, Yamamoto had always found her difficult to get along with. However, during a routine conversation, he notices painful bruises on her wrist. After learning that her boyfriend had been abusing her, Yamamoto decides to let Hayashi stay at his place...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Marshal King
synopsis:
Nobody on the continent hasn't heard of the evil deeds of the great outlaw M. Godspeed. But one day, a young man claiming to be the criminal's son suddenly appears trekking through the harsh desert. This Jim Godspeed says he's killed his father and has the corpse to prove it! A steampunk western from the mind of the master, Boichi!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Our Guild's Idol
synopsis:
Bae Ajin suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world's top MMORPG, using her brother's account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she's mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who's secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait... I know this girl!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Hounds of Sisyphus
synopsis:
The dead no longer stay dead. They rise—not as monsters, but as aimless wanderers—plunging the world into chaos. Hope of immortality fades as disasters push humanity to the brink of extinction. Amidst the ruin, Pyo Guwon walks against the tide of fleeing survivors. On his path, he finds Heo Jinwoo, left for dead after an attack. Instead of passing by, Pyo offers a hand, posing a single question: "How does it feel to survive hell?" With that, he leads Jinwoo to a village where death holds no meaning—but in a world that refuses to let go of the past, survival is never that simple.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: High School Boy
synopsis:
Il-tak Hong, the only girl in Daemun Boys' High School. Despite his name and nickname, he is a man, but due to his small stature and peculiar appearance, he was looked down upon by everyone. In the past, Il-tak, was a famous bully until his second year of middle school but he sank to the bottom of the food chain due to one problem... puberty struck for everyone but him. 

Il-tak came up with an idea for raising his ranking... "If I become friends with Hyun-woo Lee, the real powerhouse in the second grade of the school, I can rise to the ranks of the bullies again!" 

However, for some reason, Hyun-woo is trying to distance himself from Il-tak... Will he be able to regain his former glory?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
titleEnglish: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
synopsis:
Every night, Yeo-un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more. But Hae-in isn't just another fan—she's the voice behind the band, a secret she can't afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony... or heartbreak?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mou Ichido, Shitemitai.
titleEnglish: I want to do it again.
synopsis:
1. Mou Ichido, Shitemitai. (I Want to Try It Again.)
2. Madamada, Shitemitai.
3. Koi ni Naru made, (Until It Becomes Love)
4-5. Petunia
6. Koi no Susumekata (How to Advance Your Love)
7. Warui Ko no Shitsuke (Lesson for a Naughty Girl)

title: Ano, Mou 1-kai Shimasen ka...?
synopsis:
1. Oniisan Ohitori desu ka? (Are You Alone, Mister?)
2. Kyou, Tomete Kuremasen ka? (Can You Stay Over Today?)
3. Chotto dake, Kyuukei shinai...? (Wanna Visit the Hot Springs, Mister?)
4. Gomu wo Tsukete to, Iimashita yo ne... (Hey, Where's the Condom?)
5. Kyou wa Damette Iimashita yo ne... (I said NO Mister!)
6. DeliHeal Yondara Dekachichi Shimai ga Kita

title: Zense wa Reikoku Koutei, Konse wa Youjo
synopsis:
"Juliana, your fiancé has been decided."

At that moment, the frail daughter of an earl awakened to a shocking truth—within her resided the soul of the infamous "Cold-Hearted Emperor" Julius. A man whose ruthless conquests left behind mountains of corpses and an empire under his iron rule.

Now, reborn as a delicate young noble girl, Julius finds himself in a seemingly peaceful era. But beneath the surface lurk corruption, poverty, and disease, all exploited by scheming villains. With the wisdom and might of a former emperor, Juliana will not stand idly by. The young lady who once ruled as a tyrant is ready to cleanse the empire once more—this time, with her tiny hands.

A dark yet thrilling tale of power, justice, and a battle against the hidden evils of the empire begins!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Yuumei VTuber no Ani dakedo, Nazeka Ore ga Yuumei ni Natteita
synopsis:
I have a stepsister named Isuzu. She is a super popular VTuber with over 1 million subscribers, "Isuzu Wine." One day, she forgot to turn off her stream, and our candid conversation was accidentally broadcasted worldwide! The clip of the streaming incident quickly went viral, and overnight, I became an internet sensation...!? The more accidents happen, the more popular she gets!! Together with my overly beautiful and clingy stepsister, and a cute senior VTuber, I aim to rise in the streaming industry!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: As the Heart Leads
synopsis:
Kang Yijae seems to have the worst luck. She's an orphan, can see ghosts, and can't go near water. To make matters worse, she reincarnates as Hailey Duncan, a noblewoman who took her own life before her marriage to King Rodrick of Kaien—who happens to have evil spirits attached to him! To help ease his burden, Hailey's days are spent exorcising these spirits. The more they spend time together, the better Rodrick seems to feel... Could he be falling for her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hero of All Trades
synopsis:
Gang-in Na wakes up in the year 2024 in the middle of South Korea with no memory of where or who he is. Upon hearing a voice that sounds strangely familiar, he comes face to face with a robot named ACE (Autonomous Combat Entity), who informs him that he was once part of the Earth Federation Forces in the year 2082 and possesses a wide array of skills. Gang-in decides to join forces with ACE to recover his lost memories and adapt to life on Earth, but the two look to be in for a bumpy ride.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Imanin
synopsis:
Rio Mikazuki is a shinobi. That is, a shinobi living in the modern worldーa "shinewbi" of sorts. All of the ninjutsu and ninja tools of the current era are at her immediate disposal and are considerably more high-tech than before. However, it seems as though her senior partner, Igarashi, has learned how to use real ninjutsu through the long-forgotten traditional training methods of the old shinobi... The stage unfolds for a romantic comedy of two shinobi working in a modern world!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Toumin Shoujo
synopsis:
In a world where winter claims half the year, Haru Tamura, a florist's daughter, feels suffocated by her high school life of merely conforming to others. Her peaceful days are disrupted when she encounters a mysterious girl who repeatedly hibernates. This is a tale of small hopes blossoming in the hearts of 2 girls.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ori no Naka
synopsis:
Jirou Gomi, a 29-year-old virgin, has spent the past nine years nerding out with his work colleagues about anime during lunch and drawing erotic doujinshi at night so he can masturbate. However, one day, this comfort zone of his is thrown into disarray by the introduction of a new colleague, Kuroko Yumezora, a bespectacled beauty with long, dark hair and a massive chest.

It only takes a moment to fall in love, just like how it takes a moment to lose your footing. This is the story of a weak man's sins and sexual fixations.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Taida na Akuyaku Kizoku no Ore ni, Konyaku Haki sareta Akuyaku Reijou ga Totsuidara Saikyou no Fuufu ni Narimashita @comic
synopsis:
Alban realized he had been reincarnated as the villainous noble in a certain novel. Just as he began training in swordsmanship and magic to avoid defeat by the protagonist, he learned that Leticia, a noblewoman surrounded by nasty rumors, was to become his wife!

He was nervous about what kind of "evil woman" she might be... but, upon meeting her, he found an incredibly pure girl—angelic, and exactly his type! Alban, forgetting all about avoiding his doom due to her adorableness, resolved to take revenge on the mastermind who had set up his beloved wife!

Using their villainous reputation to their advantage, they set out to lure the culprit, but... will they succeed?
 
(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: I'm Not a Soccer Genius!
synopsis:
Lee Jian, who was released from a prestigious youth team in Italy, spends his days idling away as a substitute. As usual, he boasts to his childhood friend, Kim Jiwoo, claiming to be a genius, but then he hears the shocking news that Jiwoo is coming to Italy to study abroad. Determined not to disappoint his precious (?) friend Jiwoo, Jian sets his sights on becoming a starter.

In truth, Jian is a genius that appears once every few decades. But even he doesn't know this about himself...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Kirei na Kimi ni Korosaretai.
synopsis:
Hijiri Tomoaki, a university counselor, lives a peaceful yet unfulfilling life. However, his life changes completely after he reunites with an old acquaintance, Hajime Amawashi. The mysterious problems that Tomoaki's patients bring to him gradually begin to encroach on his daily life. What is the true nature of the strange phenomena in which they become embroiled, and what is the true intention of Hajime, who has suddenly appeared before Tomoaki...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Game Akuyaku Kizoku ni Tensei shita Ore wa, Cheat Kinniku de Musou suru
synopsis:
Our protagonist is reincarnated as the scum of a noble Noah Francis in the renowned game "Absolute Oblige." In order to somehow evade all the game scenarios where he dies, he will have to fight against fate with his muscles!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Mein Hole
synopsis:
1. Doukyuusei to Oyakodon!
2. Otodoke! Ane Ero Body
3. G4P! 3-nin no Chijo to Goukon 4P
4. Onna Taiiku Kyoushi to Megane-kun (Female PE Teacher & Four Eyes)
5. Mama Soap
6. Ranko-san, Sonna Koto mo Shiranai no?
7. Mama & Gal
8. Yoroshiku! NTR
9. Cos♥Ona (Cos♥Mas)
10. Hiyake Imouto wa Gal Imouto! (My Tan-lined Litter Sister Is a Kogal!)

title: Gal Oshi JK wa Gal ni Naritai
synopsis:
"Living as a gal is seriously the best!!"

Mimiru was an introvert in middle school, but when she entered high school, she made her long-awaited debut as a gal, thinking, "Maybe I can become a gal too!?" She made friends with three girls: Yuuhi, a cool beauty with a calm and pretty look; Fuuka, a cute gal with a soft and fluffy look; and Kurumi, a cheerful and energetic gal who is good at sports. Now she has joined the gal group she has always admired! While she lives the sparkling life she has always dreamed of, she also pushes herself too hard to keep up with her friends. And she also notices new feelings growing within her...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Houkago, Bokura wa Uchuu ni Madou
titleEnglish: After School, We Wander in Space.
synopsis:
"This love shot up like a rocket."

Kinoshima Rocketry Club casually uploaded a test vlog of a test firing of their hybrid engine. The engine exploded—carrying away the dreams of reaching space with it—but that wasn't the only thing that exploded in that vlog. Madoi Ayame, from the engine section, who just so happened to appear in the vlog, also exploded in popularity when viewers from across the world found her cute. While she finds this bewildering, she actually has someone she wished found her cute...

From the author of Giji Harem, Yuu Saitou, a youthful, buzzing romantic comedy that sparks from a single video!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: The Villain's Survival Route
synopsis:
Fresh out of a breakup, game developer Woojin has little going for him. So when he hears that the middle boss of their game is based on him, he can't resist adding a few traits to make his virtual alter ego a tad more noble. Little did he know, he would soon end up trapped in said villain's skin! With a 1 in 1,000 chance of survival, Woojin now has to navigate the countless variables leading him to his impending doom. Will the tweaks he made to the character tip the scales in his favor?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Destined to Be Loved by the Villains
titleEnglish: Destined to Be Loved by the Villains
synopsis:
After a night of playing "Savior Rising," Daud Campbell wakes up in the game as an unimpressive minor character. Despite his plans to lay low and avoid trouble, he runs into both the final boss and the main hero on his first day at the game's academy. As Daud struggles to make it through the game, he only seems to attract more danger, including the attention of evil characters. Will the love of these powerful villains help Daud survive till the end? Or are they just too wicked for his own good?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Koi no Gunfight
synopsis:
1. Koi no Gunfight
2. Koi no Gunfight: Love Steal
3. Koi no Gunfight: Heart Retake
4. Koi no Gunfight: Overtime
5. Koi no Gunfight: After Game
6. Daken no Tadashii Shitsukekata
7. Let's Study!

title: Shiou no Kikan: Motoyuusha no Ore, Jibun ga Soshiki shita Chuuni Himitsu Kessha wo Tomeru Tame ni Futatabi Isekai ni Shoukan sareteshimau
titleEnglish: The Return of the Corpse King
synopsis:
"How could my past self get so excited doing all those embarrassing things!?"

When he was in the third year of middle school, Shiou Hizaki was summoned to another world to save it. After defeating the Demon King, he was forcibly returned back to the present day. Yet another three years later, he is summoned to the other world once again, this time to stop the rampage of the secret society "Helheim."

That organization was supposedly actually the one that he had founded during his chuunibyou phase, where he called himself the "Corpse King"—a dark past too embarrassing to remember!

Someone seems to be impersonating the name of "Helheim" and tarnishing its reputation. To uncover the truth behind this mystery and clear the organization's name, the Corpse King reunites with his former subordinates, the "Hakkai," who once made Helheim the strongest it had ever been. While agonizing over his dark past, he begins to take action in the other world once again.

Their first stop is the Steel City of Gagiul—rescue the city struggling through famine as well as the pale-looking count's daughter in distress. "Helheim, moving out."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hitokui Mansion to Ooya no Maison
synopsis:
The clock strikes at the single second before the end of the world. Yet humanity has escaped extinction and carry on with their daily lives in the strange and terrible apartment where time stands still. A young girl Maison, Landlord by birth, is on the brink of revealing its secrets...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Bijutsu Souko no Rapunzel
synopsis:
On the 4th floor of the school building, there's an art storage room. They say it's haunted by the ghost of a female student with endlessly flowing golden hair.The truth behind the students' whispered rumors is Amane, Shusuke's childhood friend. Ever since losing her father, she lost her voice and has been supporting herself by continuously painting.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Cupid 13
synopsis:
Ghost—he deadliest sniper who's left countless targets in his wake across countless battlefields. His next mark: the heiress of a corporate empire. But as the mission progresses, he finds himself invested in her love life...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Choueki Isshun
synopsis:
Ever since obtaining a device that could stop time, a power straight out of dreams, Shishigami had been living each day exactly as he pleased. One day, while in his usual frozen time, he encountered a classmate who was in the midst of attempting suicide by jumping...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Concept Café-jou wa Koi wo Kiru
titleEnglish: The Concept Cafe Girl Wears Love
synopsis:
Tsumugu Aisaka is a huge fan of clothing and an aspiring fashion designer. One day, she meets a con-cafe girl in Kabukichou and ends up working as a new employee. What will happen when she meets new people and all she can talk about is clothes!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Crawling My Way to the Top!
titleEnglish: Crawling My Way to the Top!
synopsis:
With money, looks, and a successful career, Seongguk has it all. That is, until he dies and is reborn as a baby! To make things worse, his new parents are dead broke. However, alongside his new loving family, Seongguk soon learns that perhaps some things are better than money... not! He's going to have loving parents and money in this life, and there's no better time to start than now. Armed with an adorable face and the skills of a business tycoon, can Seongguk take his new family to the top?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Oyome-sama
synopsis:
One day, Carina, a lady who has been groomed to be queen, suddenly has her engagement annulled by her fiancee, the prince. Now he is sending Carina into exile while standing beside her sister, Aurora, instead. Exiled to the far north, where beasts are said to dwell, Carina ventures out to investigate the identity of a disturbing sound and has a fateful encounter in the snow...? A predatory love fantasy between a lady sworn to revenge and a strange girl seeking love!

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

title: The Fable: The Third Secret
synopsis:
When you're the infamous prodigy hitman known only as "Fable," many things come easy. Being a normal person, however, isn't one of them. In fact, being told that he can't kill anyone for a while may just be the hardest job Fable's ever taken...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Melting Point
synopsis:
After twelve years, a former teammate—no, a thorn in his side—suddenly reappears. Eunsan isn't thrilled to be working with Ian again, having long buried both his ice hockey past and any memories of him.

Unlike Eunsan, who hopes their meeting will be a one-time thing, Ian insists on keeping him around with an offer he can't refuse. With his beloved younger sibling caught in the middle, Eunsan reluctantly agrees, but he can't shake the feeling that Ian has an ulterior motive.

Why does Ian keep pulling him closer? There's no way this guy actually has feelings for him...right?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Footsteps in the Snow
synopsis:
In a world where blue snow freezes everything it touches, humanity has long forgotten what warmth feels like. Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. The snow will soon erase his footsteps but not the promise that keeps him moving.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Isekai Shounin: Skill "Isekai Tokou" wo Kushi shite, Yuuyuu Jiteki na Okanemochi Slow Life wo Okurimasu
synopsis:
One day, the protagonist Allen, who has been reincarnated from Japan into another world, realizes that his unique skill, Moon Gate, allows him to travel freely between Japan and the other world. With this power, Allen comes up with the idea of traveling between Japan and the other world and making money by selling various items to people from the other world, those who have been transferred, and those who have been reincarnated, who are hungry for entertainment! Before long, he gets to know the daughter of a large company and the princess of a kingdom in the other world, and enjoys the other world to the fullest...!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e: 3-nensei-hen
synopsis:
From their humble beginnings as Class 1-D, Horikita and her classmates are ready to begin their third year as Class 3-A! But there's no time for celebrating–the battle is far from over. With only one year left until graduation, even the smallest failure can pull them off track. Not only will they have to fight harder than ever, they'll have to do it without their most influential student: Ayanokouji Kiyotaka.

Amid the chaos of losing Ayanokouji to Class C, Horikita's class finds themselves faced with one cruel truth: if they can't defeat Ayanokouji, they don't stand a chance to graduate from Class A. Do they have what it takes to remain on top, or are they doomed to fail?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Okaeri Suiheisen
synopsis:
Ryouma runs a public bathhouse with his grandfather in a seaside town. One day, during his usual routine of running the bathhouse after school, a boy named Reo appears, claiming to be his father's illegitimate son. A bittersweet yet heart-warming drama unfolds between half brothers in a public bathhouse!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Like Father, Like Daughter
synopsis:
Once known as the White Night Witch, Alisia is reborn without her powers as a young princess neglected by her father, the emperor. When she regains her magic after hearing the news of his death in battle, she plans to rule the chaotic empire herself... That is, until the emperor returns alive. Now, Alisia must mend fences with her father while also handling schemes and secrets lurking around them. Will these two, so different yet so similar, make amends and work together? Or is it all too late?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ctrl+Alt+Resign
synopsis:
Kang "Max" Donggu is a socially anxious developer who hates working with others. When the beautiful and outgoing Jang "Joy" Chae-rin transfers into his department, Max is quickly overwhelmed by her bright nature. Although he wants to avoid any unnecessary interactions, Max finds himself in a difficult situation after he discovers that Joy is secretly planning to change jobs. Surprisingly, she asks him to start a study group with her, hoping they can cooperate and aim for better jobs. While reluctant at first, Max eventually agrees as Joy is the only colleague who seems to care about him.

Despite her seemingly being his polar opposite, Max gradually begins to enjoy Joy's company. While the quiet and solitary work life he wishes for may never come, a genuine friendship begins to bloom between the pair, which may develop into something more.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Genius Who Sees Through the World
synopsis:
As a child, Shin Woo-jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn't like other children. He had an extraordinary gift: the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans. "As I thought... living a normal life is far too difficult."

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Anta to Osananajimi tte dake demo Iya nanoni! Zekkou kara Hajimaru S-kyuu Bishoujo to no Gakuen Nariagari Seikatsu
synopsis:
Kazuma Suzuki was just your average high schooler—until his childhood friend, Rua Takayashiki, a beautiful, sharp-tongued girl who also happened to be the granddaughter of the school chairman and the nation's top idol, cut all ties with him using a line straight out of a drama.

Forced into submission for years as her so-called childhood friend, Kazuma decides it's finally time for his first-ever rebellion. He's done playing lapdog. This time, he's taking back his freedom—and aiming for a normal school life.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Everyone Loves Her
synopsis:
With the sudden acquisition of the "Teleportation" ability, Kang Mina's life is completely turned upside down. Now, she stands at a crossroads where a single choice can lead to irreversible consequences. Amidst anger, confusion, and a suppressed sense of justice, Mina struggles with how to use her newfound power as she embarks on a new journey. Where will her power take her?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kowaiyasan
synopsis:
Step into "The Creepy and Freaky," where fear is our commodity. Take your time, shop around, and immerse yourself in these tales of terror for as long as you please.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One
titleEnglish: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One
synopsis:
Bianca is just another noble lady with a simple dream: to marry into a dukedom and enjoy a life of luxury. But everything changes when she stumbles upon a book—one that casts her as the villainess, doomed to stand in the way of her real-life fiancé's love story with a commoner girl. As Bianca realizes the book accurately depicts her own fate, she refuses to accept her tragic ending. Can she rewrite her story, or is she simply destined to become a villainess?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
