titleEnglish: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
synopsis:
Who was that guy that once said, "An army marches on its stomach?" When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG "Paladins of Blood" to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Aoi no Heya ni Mata Haru ga Kita
synopsis:
Living a self-destructive lifestyle, young Aoi finds her room visited by various symbols of spring—cherry blossoms and butterflies—all silently watching over her days. A new tale of love and life from the unique mind.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Playing the Perfect Fox-Eyed Villain
synopsis:
Lee Shihu has logged 20,000 hours playing Let's Kill the Demon Lord! for the past 5 years. But when the game takes a turn he doesn't like, Shihu cancels his pre-order of the DLC in anger, only to find himself sucked into the game! Now in the body of Julian Kreipart Prason, the villain, he has to play the part perfectly to survive the many enemies around him while unable to use the moonlight blade, Julian's signature ability. Under the watchful eye of Eileen, the genius gold mage, and his family members who want him gone, can Julian make it?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: 222-nichime no Aka
synopsis:
One day, high schooler Makoto discovers a mysterious red number "222" on his pinky finger. Visible only to him, the number decreases by one each day. What fate awaits him when the countdown hits zero?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The White Tower's Rogue Mage
synopsis:
Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness
titleEnglish: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness
synopsis:
The world has ended. I was a genius hero, but my efforts were too little, too late—I couldn't stop the Blood Demon Emperor. As I died, I prayed for a second chance... but this isn't what I meant! Of all people, I've become Christian, a rogue member of the House of Dark Demons. As if that wasn't enough, the world is still ending in just five years. There's only one way to save it: I must become the emperor myself and stop the war! I know it sounds ridiculous, but I'm a genius—I can make it work!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Game Chishiki de Saikyou ni Natta Mob Heishi wa, Shin no Jitsuryoku wo Kakushitai
synopsis:
One day, Silva realized that he reincarnated into a mob soldier from the game that he was hooked on in his previous life. Even though he utilizes his game knowledge to do his utmost best to survive in this dangerous world, he opts to hide his true strength in order not to throw the scenario into disarray. However, an unexpected turn of events led him to easily defeat a powerful demon that even the hero is hard-pressed to defeat. And to make matters worse, he did that in front of his favorite heroine in the game... Upon this incident, word started getting out about his true strength...!! A heroic fantasy about the strongest soldier who will bring his full strength to bear for the sake of his favorite character is about to unfold!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: NakiNagi
synopsis:
A quiet witch meets a girl in love. Nakika was once a feared witch of the deep sea, but has started a life on the surface to learn about "human emotions." Nagisa is a naive romantic and Nakika's best friend—and although she might not always understand Nagisa's infatuation, her compassion for Nagisa is deeper than the Pacific Ocean! As she uses her magical powers to support Nagisa's quest for love, she gradually learns about "human emotions." Follow the 1000% wholesome story of a girl in love and her watchful guardian!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Gunjou Moratorium
synopsis:
1. Renjou no Hokorobi (Love Coming Apart at the Seams)
2. Omoikiri

4. Koi ni Naranai
5. Kesou no Rondo (A Yearning Rondo)
6. Zeijakusei Identity
7. Yume no Owari

title: Otona Taisen
synopsis:
What makes a 'proper adult'? Inspired by the words of his late father, Yutaro Urashima sought to become an upstanding member of society by developing and strictly adhering to his own "Articles of Adulthood." Little did he know, however, that those same articles would go on to dramatically change the world... A new series from the author of Hidarikiki no Eren! Witness the dramatic battle for survival in a surveillance society where reputation is everything!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Delightfully Fuckable and Unrefined All You Can Sex!
synopsis:
1. Delightfully Fuckable and Unrefined!
2. Anal Fuck Day
3. Fellatio Day
4. Toilet Cleaning Girls
5. Paizuri Day
6. Delightfully Fuckable and Unrefined! in Shibuya
7. Delightfully Fuckable and Unrefined! in Commonwealth

title: I Became the Successor of the Martial God
synopsis:
One day, I suddenly became the protagonist of a game. However, the more you look at this protagonist... the more you'll sigh. He's got the worst stats, the worst talent and zero connections. But still...

You have acquired [Heavenly Martial Physique].
You have become the master of the [Martial God's Tome].

"So what? I'm the ultimate veteran player!"

He's not just a veteran player—he's a full-blown obsessive maniac. Thus begins the legendary playthrough of a hardcore veteran!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: My Wife Is the Demonic Cult Leader
synopsis:
I became the first son of the Demonic Heaven clan—one of the Six Great Clans of the Heavenly Demonic Cult—Jin Yeomyung. I was ready to enjoy a sweet life with a silver spoon in my mouth, but thanks to that damn Murim Alliance, the Heavenly Demonic Cult was destroyed. But in my final moments, Cult Leader Cheon Yura turned to me and said...

"Would you mind seducing me?"

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Isekai kara Kikan shitara Chikyuu mo Kanari Fantasy deshita. Ato, Make Heroine-domo Kocchi Minna.
synopsis:
Six years ago, Natsuki Yura was summoned to another world as a hero. After defeating the Demon King and finally managing to return to his original world, he discovered that Earth was actually full of fantasy too—psychics, aliens, angels, gods, you name it... A modern ultra-fantasy saga begins!!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!
titleEnglish: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!
synopsis:
Betrayed by her team and abandoned to die in a dungeon, timid C-rank hunter Cho-i Hyeon discovers a cursed ring that keeps her alive by endlessly regenerating her body. Time stretches into years as she's killed over and over, unable to escape. When she finally does, she's no longer the girl who was left behind. Stronger, colder, and haunted by something growing inside her, she wants answers—and revenge. But the ring may have a will of its own, and its true cost is only beginning to surface. Whatever it is, it may already be too late to stop.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Awaku, Koi, Koi.
synopsis:
1. Yakousei no Ao
2. In ni Tomoru
3. Tana no Mukou, Nuno no Mukou
4. Usagi na Watashitachi
5. Kimi wa Kirei da
6. Senpai Refrain
7. Shiroi Kemuri to Brim
8. Shimekiri Girigiri Threesome

title: The End Has Come
synopsis:
Minjun wished for the world to end—until it did. When a zombie appears at his door, the bullied teen chooses to fight for survival. Teaming up with Yena, his sassy yet charming classmate, he flees the collapsing city. Hunted by the infected and haunted by enemies old and new, they discover that in a world without rules, trust may be their only chance at survival.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hug shite! Kaeru-san
titleEnglish: Give Me a Hug, Mr. Frog!
synopsis:
Takanashi is the capable student council president admired by his classmates for his perfection, but recently, he's been hiding quite a secret. Lately, he's been secretly visiting a frog-themed milk tea cafe and indulging in an odd habit. For every cup he buys, he gets a hug from the adorable frog mascot that works in the cafe! He has no idea who inhabits the suit, only that the soothing hug seems to relieve him of the pressures of everyday life. But after so many visits, he starts to get curious: who is the person inside?! Will knowing who they are ruin his reputation as the perfect student council president, or could this be the start of a totally new relationship? Grab a lilypad and jump into this adorable manga about two total opposites!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Villainess Streamer
synopsis:
Ji-u Shin has been transported into her own dating game. Her life inside the game is now being broadcast live across the cosmos. If she wants the broadcast to end, she must win the game. The catch? The game is set to the hardest difficulty, and she's been cast as the notorious villainess, Theresa. If she fails to win, she will lose her life. Can she avoid all of Theresa's bad endings and bring this broadcast to an end once and for all?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Haikei, Arishihi ni Saku Hana-tachi e
synopsis:
Kasumi, a serious girl who has just started at an all-girls school, discovers a letter tucked into an old book she found in the library. The letter's writer yearns to have a special relationship with another girl, like how it was described in the book.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Fox-Eyed Villain of the Demon Academy
synopsis:
The very last moment before the novel was about to end... The strongest villain met a pitiful fate. But that wasn't the end.

"So, this is how I die."

I, who was once the author, woke up as the fox-eyed villian who was never once understood. A fallen family. A life thrown away for revenge. A future sealed in tragedy. I'm going to rewrite it all.This villain's end... will be reversed.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kami Eshi no Ude ga Tabetai
titleEnglish: I Want to Eat the Arm of a God-Tier Artist
synopsis:
Dave, a struggling artist, gets his hands on the severed arm of his best friend Lewis, known as a artistic prodigy. When Dave recalls a rumor that eating parts of an artist's body transfers their talent... The story of friendship and jealousy leads to an unexpected conclusion!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Date or Kill: Himitsu no Matching
synopsis:
Ayame, a top-notch assassin who has lived 25 years without anything such as romance, is convinced by a colleague to register on a dating app, while hiding her true identity! She ends up matching with none other than her next target: Murai, the ruthless and coldhearted young boss of a yakuza group...!? A covert love comedy where everything ends if her secret is exposed!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Tsuihou sarenakatta Otoko: Nidome no Jinsei wa Dogeza kara Hajimarimashita
synopsis:
A mere villager, Cross Vish, somehow ended up joining the hero's party by some strange twist of fate. Cross, an ordinary man with no special powers whatsoever. Yet, for some reason, the heroes genuinely considered Cross a true comrade. There was no way he would ever be banished from the party. And that was precisely why Cross kept agonizing. What could a useless person like him possibly contribute to the hero's party? And then... Cross came to understand his role. At the very moment when the Demon King, on the verge of death, unleashed magic toward the hero—

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Emperor of Solo Play
synopsis:
Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he's determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he's playing by his own rules.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Majo to Kyurasu
synopsis:
Long ago, the talented witch Shien helped her apprentice Tama escape from the witch hunts and then disappeared. Hundreds of years later, the two finally reunite in modern-day Japan! However, there is no trace of Shien's former self. She is now a "downer witch" smoking cigarettes by the window...! A decadent comedy about the everyday lives of the diligent Tama and the lethargic Shien!

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: Ghost Dating Simulation
synopsis:
Choi Do-yeon, a gaming streamer struggling to make ends meet in a semi-basement rental, receives a game link from "Sakje-hyung," a senior from his hometown and a fellow content creator who has always supported him. Without giving it much thought, he downloads "Heart-pounding Ghostly Poem," only to encounter eerie figures that should never have appeared.

Before he can even process what's happening, he finds himself trapped in a high-stakes dating simulation—with vengeful spirits.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Osoraku Kanojo wa Ore no Aniki wo Neratteru
synopsis:
A high school guy who doesn't trust girls anymore has been tricked too many times by girls who just wanted to get close to his good-looking older brother. After all that, he decides he'll never trust a girl again. But then, a pretty girl in his class suddenly starts talking to him a lot. Is she just trying to get to his brother too...? Or does she actually mean something else?

(Source: MU)

title: S-kyuu Boukensha ga Ayumu Michi: Tsuihou sareta Shounen wa Shin no Nouryoku "Weapon Master" de Sekai Saikyou ni Itaru
synopsis:
In a world where 40% of humanity awakens to unique abilities, magical beasts and dungeons are everywhere, making the adventurer profession one of the most lucrative paths.

Sasha, the leader of the team Sacred, was on the brink of being promoted to S-rank adventurer. On the same day, another person was also confirmed to achieve S-rank—a boy named Haise. Haise was once a member of Sacred, an F-rank adventurer who had been expelled from the team by Sasha. Possessing an unusual ability, Haise struggled to understand its nature. Misunderstood and abandoned by his childhood friend Sasha, he was cast out of the team under the pretense that "Haise couldn't keep up." The true reason behind his expulsion was Sasha's desire to protect him—she didn't want Haise to die while adventuring. However, Haise refused to give up. Even on his own, he worked tirelessly to continue his journey as an adventurer.

One day, Sasha deceived Haise into venturing into a forest inhabited by a dragon, where he was nearly killed. Betrayed by the trust he had placed in Sasha, Haise vowed never to believe in her again and resolved to grow stronger as an adventurer on his own. At 16, both Haise and Sasha were recogn…

title: Ginsei no Proust
synopsis:
Kazuki, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, and a straight-A student at a prestigious school for girls, meets Moeka, a wild girl from a rowdy school. What becomes of Kazuki when witnessing a steamy moment between Moeka and her boyfriend leaves her all shaken up...?! Find out in this seaside tale of two polar opposites and their fated encounter.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: War of Corpses
synopsis:
Uce, a down-on-his-luck young man, dreams of becoming the champion in the brutal and legendary War of Corpses—a sport where necromancers and their knights battle for supremacy. In a desperate bid, he revives Eleonora, an abandoned corpse who claims to have been the deadliest mercenary alive. There are two big problems, though. One, Eleonora is alive—a fact that cannot be revealed at any cost. Two, she and Uce can't seem to coordinate their movements. Can this unlikely duo overcome all obstacles, win the War of Corpses, and prove everyone wrong?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tower of God: Urek Mazino
synopsis:
You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mikoto-chan wa Kirawaretakunai!
synopsis:
My beautiful, big-breasted childhood friend, Mikoto, is completely in love with me. It sounds like a dream scenario that anyone would envy, but there's just one big problem. She's turned into a clingy, mentally unstable mess with love that's way too heavy!!

This is a dark everyday comedy about being at the mercy of Mikoto's unstable behavior and unintentional sexiness.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Magic Theory Prodigy
synopsis:
Rowan glimpses a dark future just ten years away. Unfortunately, he's no powerful leader—just an orphan with an incredible talent for magic. Luckily, his potential won't stay hidden forever. He joins Union Academy, which is filled with potential partners in the fight against dark magic... if only his teachers and classmates could understand magic theory on his level. But if Rowan can keep everyone focused, they might just stop their world from going up in flames.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mahou Shoujo to Mayaku Sensou
synopsis:
"Candy," a mysterious drug whose main ingredient is just ordinary sugar, is spreading like wildfire in Tokyo. When Susui, a narcotics agent who has infiltrated the yakuza to get closer to Candy's manufacturer, finds himself in danger, a self-proclaimed "magical girl" named Riri Hoshina comes to his rescue...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Urakata de Support shiteta Geinou Ikka wo Tsuihou sareta Boku wa, Futsuu no Seishun wo Ouka shitai.
synopsis:
A boy named Atsumu was branded as "useless" by his famous sisters and banished from his entertainment-industry family. However, hidden within him was an extraordinarily talented "behind-the-scenes support" skill that neither he nor his family had noticed! After transferring schools, Atsumu is now determined to live a normal life, but as he crosses paths with talented entertainers—VTubers, idols, and models—his natural ability starts to shine, making him their indispensable support. They can't help but adore him, turning his simple wish for normality into a showbiz underdog success story!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Punk Gun
synopsis:
On the outskirts of the crime-infested Dead City, a young boy named Aiboba and his band of orphans become involved in a dangerous incident.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yachiru-san wa Homeru to Nobiru
synopsis:
Yachiru is a Hasshakusama youkai living in the human world. Because the prevailing public image of Hasshakusama is that they're lewd (not scary), her powers have weakened and her height has shrunk from its original 8 shaku (240 cm) to about 190 cm. She strives to correct that impression, but each day is another failure. However, while at the cinema to study horror films, she meets Seiichirou, a young man who is a huge fan of Hasshakusama. That's when Yachiru realizes that whenever Seiichirou praises her, her height returns to its original size...!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Inkya no Ore ga Sekigae de S-kyuu Bishoujo ni Kakomaretara Himitsu no Kankei ga Hajimatta.
synopsis:
My peaceful school life... is officially over.

Izumiya Ryouta, an introverted otaku, suddenly finds himself surrounded by the top three beauties of the class after a seat change. In front of him sits the little-sister-type Miyama Airi. To his left, the cool and detached gyaru, Ichinose Yuria. And to his right, the refined, black-haired class rep, Kuroki Ruri. On the surface, they're flawless beauties—but Ryouta stumbles upon secrets that none of them can ever let out...

"P-Please...! Just don't tell anyone about this!"

"From now on, we're in that kind of relationship."

"This is a secret... just between you and me, Ryouta-kun."

All he wanted was a quiet otaku life—so how did things end up like this?! Caught between three troublesome girls, an introverted otaku desperately fights to avoid any more chaos in this love-comedy showdown!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shachou to Sake to Hoshi
titleEnglish: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
synopsis:
At 24, Reina Izutsu has recently become the new president of Izutsu Printing after taking over for her late father. Young and not quite experienced, Reina wants to do her best but unfortunately comes across as harsh with her employees. Stressed and feeling lost, Reina spends an evening drowning her sorrows in beer at an empty park. She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. Except, she fails to realize that her subordinate, 37-year-old section chief Kenichi Ishizumi, heard her drunken ramblings! But rather than use this against her, Kenichi finds himself charmed by the young woman. He vows then and there to support her and help her find her way as company president, no matter what!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yomigaere Taiyou
synopsis:
One day, without warning, the sun vanished from sight... Young Navit from the village sets out on a journey to reclaim the sun. When his traveling companion and brother becomes possessed by a mysterious evil spirit, his adventure takes an unexpected turn...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tomoshibi no Otr
synopsis:
The world is encased in winter due to the advances of the Ice Kingdom. Kind-hearted Otr, who dreams of being a warrior like his dad, has been entrusted with keeping the fires burning as a cook in the fortress. But when the fortress is attacked by the demonic army of the Ice Kingdom, the people and the flame are in danger of being snuffed out. Can Otr awaken a power that can turn the tide? A hero's journey of fire and ice now begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Lv. 99 Princess of Black Flame
synopsis:
Cha Eunha, a first-generation hunter who disappeared inside the mysterious Unknown Gate has returned. Wearing a black dress and carrying a parasol, she stayed behind to save her comrades and survived alone, fighting monsters for decades. Then one day, a human appears before her and Eunha finally finds her way back to the real world. 

"Welcome to the world 30 years later, senior."

What awaits her is not the world she left, but one that has moved on without her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Class de Ichiban Kawaii Gal wo Ezuke shiteiru Hanashi
synopsis:
Sakura Kouzuki, a top-tier gal who's the star of the class and even works as a reader model, and Houri Kazami, who prefers discussing otaku stuff with his comrades in the corner of the classroom. These two, who seem to live in completely different worlds, are actually step-siblings—and secretly live together as a couple. And none of their classmates know the truth. While Sakura sparkles at school, once she's home she relaxes completely and falls head over heels for Ori's cooking. And Houri, who's in charge of meals, doesn't mind one bit... "The simmered fish is so good♡!" "As expected, your cooking is the best, Brother!" A sweet and fluffy feeding story about a cute gal and their double life at school and at home!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Bucchuri Micchaku Jittori Seikou
synopsis:
1. Araara Mama to Seikou
2. Shiro One-Piece Oneesan to Babubabu Inaka Ecchi
3. Shiro One-Piece Oneesan to Babubabu Amayadori Ecchi
4. Fuuki no Haiboku: Dosukebe JK Gal Combi no Otouto Netori
5. Fuuki no Haiboku After
6. Aku no Onna Kanbu Slime Lady no Yuuwaku

title: Ore ni dake Koakuma na Kouhai wa Genjitsu demo Kawaii ga, Yume no Naka dewa Motto Kawaii
synopsis:
Keigo, the strict and disliked student council president, and Chiharu, a junior council member who is the child of famous actors and is well-behaved and popular, are both unaware that the other has feelings for them, making it hard for them to get closer.

One day, they buy matching amulets at a matchmaking shrine, and that night, they meet in a dream. Since it's just a dream, they reveal their true feelings and passionately confess to each other.

"Don't act flirtatiously with someone like me, who's an outcast!" "But I like you! Everything I do is for the sake of being united with you, Senpai!"

However, is Keigo the only one who remembers the events of the dream...? In reality, she's a cunning little devil, but in the dream, her feelings are fully exposed, leading to a reversal of roles?! A fresh and transparent love comedy begins here!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Call My Squall
synopsis:
After a decade of unrequited feelings, Kanta has grown cautious when it comes to love. That's why it feels almost ironic when Ryou—whose older brother is now dating Kanta's former crush—starts gravitating toward him. The two quickly connect through their shared love of gaming and begin spending a lot of time together. Kanta can't help but enjoy Ryou's bright, straightforward nature, hardly even bothered by the complicated family tie to his past heartbreak. But then, out of nowhere, Ryou confesses that he just might be falling for him.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Jikan no Kamisama
synopsis:
A girl named Yuki discovers a mysterious watch that stops time—and uses it to save a boy, Hiroki, from certain death. Drawn together by the secret of the clock, the two find themselves bound by an unforgettable summer. In a world frozen in time, an unprecedented suspenseful romance begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shinyuu ni Suki na Hito ga Dekita Rashii
synopsis:
Ayame has been dumped by the boyfriend she was living with and decides to move in with her best friend, Ema, a free-spirited woman who secretly harbors affection for Ayame. "I want to be happy!" Seeing Ayame retain her optimism on life, Ema decides to confront her own feelings and cuts her hair short, transforming into a handsome woman who makes even Ayame's heart race!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Kimi no "Gizaba" ga Mitemitai.
synopsis:
One day, Yamato Satsuki saw the jagged teeth behind Aisu Kiraragi's mask. As he approached her, those teeth marked the beginning of a sharp and prickly romantic comedy.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Qilin wa Tamekomu Type
synopsis:
College student Qilin has a habit of releasing "IT" when she holds back too much. She meets Koza, a fellow student from the same college who can't help but speak his mind without restraint. As they gradually become attracted to each other, Qilin tries to confess to him about "IT," but...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Chiyoku no Karyuudo
synopsis:
In the blink of an eye, his blissful days with his little sister are suddenly stolen from him forever by a certain "being". What lies in store for a man sworn to vengeance? Find out as you follow him on his enthralling mission for revenge, with the aid of his sword imbued with the flames of his intense anger and hatred.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Namaiki Asahi-chan wo Wakarasetai
synopsis:
Ryou is a third-year high school student who is enjoying his otaku life to the fullest, but one girl is giving him a headache. She's Asahi-chan, a cheeky childhood friend two years younger than him who attends the same high school! Even though Asahi-chan is his junior, she always teases and teases Ryou! And yet, when someone teases her, she is at a loss for words and makes a defeated face. She is also a cute girl who has few friends, is shy, and not very honest. Today, he has to teach this cheeky Asahi-chan a lesson!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Fallen Lamb
synopsis:
In 1960s America, stoic and solitary ranch hand Dennis is hired for a summer of shepherding under a strange warning: trust nothing but the sheep. A month in, a stranger named Tod appears, claiming to be a hunter passing through. Though Dennis is wary, he finds himself slowly drawn to the man, unsettled by the pull between suspicion and desire. As the line between threat and connection blurs, tragedy strikes when a coyote slips past his guard and kills one of the flock. With loyalty shaken and feelings he can't name, Dennis must choose. Will he hold on to his doubt, or take a chance on the one thing he's been told not to trust?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Baka ni Kokuhaku
synopsis:
Ayumu Ootsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Despite lacking friends or romantic experience, she started the Astronomy Association by herself, which is the only place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she dropped an association poster, but an upperclassman picked it up for her. The upperclassman introduced herself as Hayami, and Ayumu completely fell in love at first sight when Hayami recognized her passion! Ayumu's mind is now filled with love, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, the senpai seems to already adore something else. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Osake to Senpai Kanojo to no Amaama Doukyo Love Comedy wa Hatachi ni Natte kara
synopsis:
"Why don't we try living together?"

That's the question Takashi's girlfriend Kureha-senpai asks him on the day he turned twenty. From there, their lovey-dovey cohabitation begins, and there's practically zero distance between them!  Kureha Senpai, who loves alcohol, becomes even more enchanting and seductive once she starts drinking... Takashi's reasoning is about to explode! The two of them, deeply caring for each other, grow bolder in their affection whether they're drinking at home or out, using every trick in the book to flirt and get closer!

A slightly naughty and pure love comedy about two people who can't contain their love for each other, living out their exciting days together!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Jinsei Gyakuten: Uwaki sare, Enzai wo Kiserareta Ore ga, Gakuen Ichi no Bishoujo ni Natsukareru
synopsis:
At the end of summer, Eiji Aono witnesses his childhood friend and girlfriend, Miyuki Amada, cheating on him with Kondo, the ace of the soccer team. Betrayed by her and emotionally shattered, Eiji becomes the target of baseless slander and harassment. Cornered and with nowhere to turn, he escapes to the school rooftop—where he meets a mysterious girl...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mahoui Rex no Hentai Karte
synopsis:
In a world where peace has returned after the Demon King was defeated, magical doctor Rex runs a clinic. However, the patients who come in are the most hopeless in the world, such as those who XX with slimes or stick XX into man-eaters!? A comedy about perverted medical treatment in another world begins!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Ochinai Yogore wo Boku wa Nanto Yobeba Yokatta noka
synopsis:
This world is filthy… Nakayama, a high school boy with an extreme case of germophobia, avoids all social interaction and tries to enjoy his private time alone in a perfectly clean space. But his peaceful days are constantly disrupted by Nishino-san, the cheerful and unpredictable girl who ends up sitting next to him. "Don’t pollute my sanctuary! Don’t intrude on my time!" Contrary to his wishes, day after day, Nakayama is at Nishino's mercy in this chatty rom-com about a germophobe and an unsophisticated high school girl!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Anata e Sasageru Sadistic
synopsis:
Shibasaki, a high school teacher, is adored by others for her deep love for her students and her gentle personality. One day, she encounters the bullying of Masono, a student who hasn't been attending school because of bullying, and decides to rescue her. Shibasaki visits Masono's home to try to listen to her story, but the response Shibasaki receives is something unexpected...!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Jinsei Gyakuten: Uwaki sare, Enzai wo Kiserareta Ore ga, Gakuen Ichi no Bishoujo ni Natsukareru
synopsis:
At the end of summer, Eiji Aono witnesses his childhood friend and girlfriend, Miyuki Amada, cheating on him with Kondo, the ace of the soccer team. Betrayed by her and emotionally shattered, Eiji becomes the target of baseless slander and harassment. Cornered and with nowhere to turn, he escapes to the school rooftop—where he meets a mysterious girl...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Sword-Bearing Flower
synopsis:
Echineacea Roaz is graceful, beautiful, and impeccably dressed, even on the dueling grounds. Yet beneath the lace gloves and silk hats is a deadly swordsman with a dark secret. As the Demon of the Cursed Sword, she once slaughtered all she loved, including Captain Eurien, the one man who believed in her. Granted one chance to rewrite fate, she turns back time and joins the knighthood to protect those she once failed. Can this elegant swordsman bloom anew, or will she cut everything down again?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Harukaze Mound
synopsis:
"We twins were born on the same day and share the same dream! And we've made a promise to each other!" Nobody's more passionate about baseball than the Kuzumi twins. Younger brother Aokaze and his golden right arm is a once in a generation talent! Older brother Nagiharu is a lefty bench warmer. These two have walked the same dream since birth, but when they meet a certain catcher, their destinies will begin to change. The creators of Phantom Seer bring you a serious baseball epic!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ookii Mukimuki Chiisai Muchimuchi
synopsis:
Everyday, the muscular young man Kataoka dedicates himself to building his muscles. At his regular gym, there's one staff member he can't take his eyes off. Her name? Shiina. But what catches his attention is her voluptuous... belly!? A fetish-fueled rom-com, about a chubby and adorable staff member and a musclehead with a serious love for softness♡

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Reincarnation of the Fist King
synopsis:
Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he's reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yuusha Party wo Kubi ni Natta node Kokyou ni Kaettara, Member Zenin ga Tsuitekitan da ga
synopsis:
"Jin... We're expelling you from the party."

Jin has been adventuring with his childhood friend, Reki the Hero, aiming to defeat the Demon Lord. Along the way, they were joined by Yuri the Saint and Luschka the Sage, and at last, they reach the Demon Lord's castle. However, just before the final battle, Jin is suddenly told he is no longer part of the party.

Heartbroken, Jin returns to his hometown... But soon after, the remaining party members—who swiftly defeated the Demon Lord—begin showing up one after another with marriage proposals!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tonari no Seki no Mukuchi Gal ni Ezuke shitara
synopsis:
In middle school, he was constantly toyed with by gals. Striving to no longer be that sort of person, he enrolled in high school, but once again, he finds a gal in the neighboring seat. However, she seems a bit different from the other gals...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kimi no Tame nara Nandodemo
synopsis:
Yuugo, the protagonist, is deeply in love with Shiina-chan and has witnessed her death countless times. His abnormal love for her has granted him a "gun" with the power to transcend space and time. However, every reset comes at a cruel cost: causing her memories to fade one by one. Even so, the burning flame of his love never goes out. To save Shiina-chan from her untimely demise, and until Yuugo can reach the one irrefutable "proof of love"—a kiss—he won't stop pulling the trigger.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Osananananajimi
synopsis:
Yuuichi Momose and Sumi Fujino are childhood friends who have been together since they were little. Now, they're high school classmates, but since they've reached puberty, they don't feel as close as they used to. They know each other well, but there's a sense of formality there. This is the delicate relationship between them, until one day, Sumi suddenly comes to Yuuichi's house...?

(Source: MU)

title: Falling for It
synopsis:
Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Echoes
synopsis:
Kotone, who possessed the power to hear other people's inner thoughts, lived with anger and suffering in a constrained world due to her ability. After meeting the pure-hearted and kind Yuuka, Kotone began finding joy in her daily life. However, Yuuka had a serious problem...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Makemasen kara to Iiharu Kao no Ii Onnanoko wo, Zenryoku de Kuppuku saseru Yuri no Ohanashi
synopsis:
Sara Kureha is the reigning "Super Onee-sama" of an elite ladies' academy, a position she's earned through nothing but relentless effort. Her status is suddenly challenged by Rui Mareshino, an effortlessly perfect beauty who proposes a secret contest to determine who is truly fit to get on top. With the school-wide popularity poll just two months away, they need a way to settle the score, just the two of them. Rui's method is... quite unexpected.

"So, that's why... you're going to be my girlfriend." 
"Huh...?"

The rules of their new relationship are simple: the first one to make the other completely submit proves she is worthy of ruling the school! And so begins a secret war of seduction, with each girl launching an all-out offensive to make the other fall for them first. In this heated battle, whose heart—and body—will be the first to surrender? And who will be the one to conquer them? Prepare to be dominated by this romantic comedy showdown between two pretty girls!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: 1-pun Utakata Laundry
synopsis:
After collapsing from overwork, Hinata can only retain memories for a minute. Her younger sister Shizuru struggles alone to support her, but the unimaginable hardship takes its toll both mentally and physically. As she approaches her limit, even the sisters' bond begins to waver...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Veludo no Hanamuke
synopsis:
After losing his wife, Yuichi Akamatsu struggled to maintain a relationship with his only daughter, Yuki. One night, he happens to witness Yuki wandering alone and when he decides to follow her..?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: A Regressor's Tale of Cultivation
synopsis:
Is infinite regression a blessing—or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape. Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon's relentless struggle to break free.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Futei no Olympia
synopsis:
A dull, unreliable middle-aged salaryman, Tamaki Kuroudo, is treated as a hopeless old man by everyone. Teased about his pot belly, treated coldly by his daughter at home, and when he happens to glance at his wife’s phone, he sees suspicious call logs with one of her coworkers. As he spends his pathetic days, his capable subordinate Ayase Mizuki invites him to the equipment room. While helping her move some equipment, he accidentally touches her breast and she records that very moment on video. After work, he’s blackmailed with the video and taken to, of all places, a sports gym? The price of sexual harassment is body transformation? A secret muscle-training comedy he hides from his wife!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Return of the Apocalypse-Class Death Knight
synopsis:
Damian Haxen was a man born with a talent destined to go down in history. However, he was transformed into a Death Knight by a dark mage, Archlich Dorgo, and was forced to live like a slave. By the archlich's command, he slaughtered his family with his own hands and brought ruin to every kingdom. Just as the entire world was about to fall under the archlich's control, Damian regained his consciousness, but it was already too late. Right when he was ready to give up everything, a miracle happened: regression. Now back to the time before it all began, his goal was clear.

"This time, I'll live only for my family's happiness and future. Of course..."

He would purge all traces of the filthy dark mage and make him taste hell first!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Chronicles of the Lazy Sovereign
synopsis:
The great warrior who ended the chaos that plagued the world—that is Wi Yeonho, the Radiant Martial Sovereign. He was known as a gentleman, a great man, and a chivalrous warrior...

"That guy? He's a total scumbag."

The shocking truth that's too shameful to be let known to the world, behind the so-called greatest chivalrous warrior in history, is finally revealed!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Ringoku kara Kita Yome ga Kawaisugite Doushiyou.
synopsis:
Saryu, known as the Winter Bear of Tidros for his formidable presence that scatters enemies, suddenly finds himself in an engagement with Lady Sitoen, a noblewoman from a neighboring kingdom whose previous engagement was called off! Starting with a forehead kiss, he's nervous around a woman he's not used to. Her smile makes his heart race, and a glimpse of her chest leaves him flustered. As improper fantasies run wild in his mind, Saryu's rationality is on the verge of collapse?!

(Source: Shufu to Seikatsu Sha, translated)

title: The S-Class Guide as Sweet as Honey
titleEnglish: The S-Class Guide as Sweet as Honey
synopsis:
Jin Hyoseop is an S-class guide whose powers leave him aroused and smelling as sweet as honey. In order to hide his embarrassing secret, he joins a C-class guild on the condition that he only does the minimum guiding required to heal his esper guildmates. It shouldn't be an issue since the guild's kind and understanding commander Andante assures him that they don't handle any dangerous jobs. But then, why does everyone keep coming back injured and in desperate need of guiding? Little does Hyoseop know that he has just stepped into a lair of criminal S-class espers!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: XXX Buddy
synopsis:
Seo Hyunsoo is sure of one thing: people are scum and they will always disappoint you. Sure enough, at his very first company dinner after his transfer to a new department, he finds his coworker, the obnoxiously upbeat Baek Youngchan, performing an unsavory deed in the men's bathroom. As much as Hyunsoo would like to avoid Youngchan from that point on, Youngchan seems intent on not letting him out of his sight... Will Hyunsoo be able to evade the encroaching chaos of his new work neighbor? Or will these two clashing coworkers find that opposites really do attract?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hatsujou Kisetsu
synopsis:
1. Yakusoku Breaker
2. Majime na Kouhai ni Aniken no Ore ga Oshieteyareru Koto
3. Gankake
4. Houkago Secret
5. Kataguruma x Shoujo
6. JK Yome Sakura no Kagai Jugyou
7. JK Yome Sakura no Yagai Jugyou
8. JK Yome Sakura no Inokori Jugyou

title: Mahou Gakuen to Sugoi Majo
titleEnglish: The Magic Academy and the Amazing Witch
synopsis:
After being praised as a genius witch in her countryside village, Azami gets overconfident and applies to the Magic Academy in the city. However, after failing the entrance exam miserably and falling into depression, a transfer student from the Magic Academy arrives, and...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Jimi na Ojisan, Jitsu wa Eiyuu deshita. Jikaku ga Nai Mama Musou shitetara, Mei no Dungeon Haishin de Sarasareteta you desu
titleEnglish: The Plain Salary Man Turned Out to Be a Hero: He Was Invincible, Only to Be Exposed on His Niece's Dungeon Stream
synopsis:
Keita Sato (41, single) is overworked at his corporate job, dealing with tedious and stressful tasks day in and out. How does he relieve his stress? By sneaking into modern-day "dungeons," using them as a batting cage, and blasting away ferocious monsters! One day, his live-in niece Hikari secretly follows him and livestreams his adventures, only for his unbelievable strength to go crazy viral!! Keita unknowingly captures the attention of not only viewers, but other big-name streamers. So begins the fantasy tale of an ordinary office worker's unwitting rise to fame and glory!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
synopsis:
Every night, he prayed to every god in existence: Please, when I wake tomorrow, let me find myself in the middle of a fantasy. One day, that long-cherished prayer was answered, just not in the way he had hoped. He awoke to a blindingly white world, a snow-covered land of frost and silence... as a Barbarian. The term "Barbarian" was unfamiliar to him, but overwhelmed with awe at having entered a fantasy realm, he became eager to learn more about the world he had dreamed of for so long. Unlike ordinary barbarians, he earnestly studied the human language and accumulated knowledge to better understand this new world, even earning a legal mercenary license. However, his fearsome appearance and immense strength constantly led to one misunderstanding after another...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
titleEnglish: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
synopsis:
Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn't the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future's secrets in his hands. This time, he won't serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Marugaki Shimai
synopsis:
Dependable older sister Izumi and her energetic younger sister Rakko are close siblings. As Izumi's birthday approaches, the excited Rakko seems to be plotting various ways to make her sister happy, but...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Infinite Leveling: Murim
synopsis:
Killed on the battlefield without glory to his name, Yuseong Dan receives an opportunity to grow stronger with a strange quest and level system. But each quest he's forced to fight only seems to be getting harder and harder. Can he level up enough to avoid the same miserable ending and become the powerful hero he wishes to be?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Cheolsu Saves the World
synopsis:
A massive asteroid is about to hit earth!

Humanity has failed to stop a giant asteroid from plummeting into Earth, and life as we know it has ended. An ordinary Korean office worker named Cheolsu is somehow given the chance to go back in time and prevent this catastrophe from ever happening. Does he have a chance?

(Source: Manta)

title: Your Eternal Lies
synopsis:
Don't believe a word she says.

Infamous jailbreaker Rosen Walker is finally being transferred to the Isle of Monte, the most notorious maximum security prison in the world. Her guard? None other than the beloved war hero of the empire himself—Ian Connor. Now he must unravel the truth. Is Rosen really a murderer? Or is there more to the story?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low
synopsis:
Life's never quiet when you've got S-Rank Rizz.

Former S-Rank Hunter Uijae, a.k.a. J, saved humanity from eldritch horrors emerging from dimensional rifts, only to time-leap 8 years into a future where he's presumed dead. Now a manager at a hangover soup joint, all J wants is a quiet life. But between selling off the relics of his past and catching the obsessive attention of Korea's #1 Hunter Sayoung, peace isn't on the menu!

(Source: Manta)

title: Reborn as the Enemy Prince
synopsis:
Imagine being kin to your sworn enemy.

Killed in battle while defending his country, Bern wakes up in the body of the enemy prince, Kalian, and vows to avenge his people. But between taming an abusive half-brother and surviving his mother's deadly web of intrigue, sweet revenge seems to slip further beyond his grasp at every turn.

(Source: Manta)

title: Father, Unrivaled
synopsis:
Gajang Noh is a strong, dedicated, and humble man, with much respect for the martial arts. After the death of his lovely wife, this muscle-for-hire just wants an easy job that allows him to be a good father to his three little babies. He’s even happy to pull guard duty and fend off amateur fighters if it means he can return home safely each night. But when a creepy cult starts stealing children from the city, Gajang must step up to the challenge and discover his true warrior potential.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Passion
synopsis:
Jeong Taeui has always lived in the shadow of his genius twin brother, but he's never been unhappy with his ordinary life. When his uncle shows up at his doorstep with a dangerous job offer disguised as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, Taeui is skeptical, but he reluctantly agrees to work as an agent for half a year. Despite his initial qualms, he quickly adjusts to his new environment using his outgoing, positive personality. But from the moment Taeui meets Ilay Riegrow, an agent from another branch, his peaceful life slowly starts to change. Everyone says Ilay is a sadistic psychopath who should be avoided at all costs, but Taeui knows there's more to him than meets the eye. But getting to know Ilay is like playing with fire, and Taeui isn't sure if he's ready to get burned.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Reunion
synopsis:
Maybe we're destined to meet.

Struggling to pay his mother's hospital bills, Hakyung receives an offer: the fees will be taken care of. The catch? In exchange, he must pretend to be a girl he once knew in order to deceive the chairman of a powerful company. It's going well until Yoonsung, the chairman's grandson, appears...

(Source: Manta)

title: You Get Me Going
synopsis:
Not even if he were the last man left on Earth!

Youngwon yearns for true love, but his overbearing nature always leads to failed relationships. Lately, he finds himself clashing with his polar opposite, Hyunwoo, at work. However, things heat up when they go on a business trip together. Will these sparks of enmity turn to love?

(Source: Manta)

title: Under the Oak Tree
synopsis:
Love is a fairytale. Or is it?

Stuttering lady Maximilian is forced into a marriage with Sir Riftan, but he leaves on a campaign after their wedding night. Three years later, he triumphantly returns, ready to cherish her. All fairytales end with a wedding and a happily-ever-after. Their love began with a wedding—this is no fairytale.

(Source: Manta)

title: Love Tractor
synopsis:
When family obligations force Sun Yool, a stressed-out law school student, to the countryside, it seems like a great opportunity to escape the chaos of the city. After all, the great outdoors promises fresh air, sunshine... and a new romance?! Soon after arriving, Sun Yool is thrown into a series of strange encounters and misunderstandings with his 20-year-old neighbor, Yechan. But in spite of Yechan's bumbling first impression and Sun Yool's prickly exterior, the two find themselves drawn to each other... Will this tractor-driving stud's rustic charm be enough to melt this cold city boy's heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Paws & Claws
synopsis:
Life sure is ruff, especially when you're Gyeon Heeseong. Abandoned by his pack of fellow dog shifters, he is forced to become a drug runner for a gambling ring. For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yoon Chi-young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form...a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Heeseong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. Will Heeseong be able to escape the ruthless, terrifying outpour of love Chi-young showers him with and escape his criminal past? Or will he be forever leashed to a life of kibble and kennels?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nerd Project
synopsis:
Luke is having a rough time in college, and his breakup with his girlfriend Stacy is not helping. This is all because of that nerdy stud, Andrew! If only Stacy didn't obsess over Andrew's dorky charms, then Luke wouldn't have had to break their relationship off! To make matters worse, Luke is then forced to live in the same dorm room as Andrew! But with nowhere else to go and no money to his name, Luke resolves to make it his project to befriend Andrew, whether the nerd likes it or not!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kiss Me If You Can
synopsis:
"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over." After a one-night stand with Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he's pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase's bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn't seem to remember him, Josh's comfort is short lived—something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh's heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over... Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Codename: Anastasia
synopsis:
Agent Kwon Taekjoo is dispatched to Russia with two tasks. First, he must find "Anastasia," a new weapon that could change the world forever. Second, he is to avoid Russia's psychotic killer, Psikh Bognadov, at all costs. To assist him on his undercover mission, Taekjoo is sent a partner who only reveals himself to be a man named Zhenya. But Zhenya quickly proves himself to be just as dangerous and unhinged as the infamous Psikh himself. Just who could he truly be? And will Taekjoo succeed in tracking down "Anastasia"?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Netkama PUNCH!!!
synopsis:
Netkama—a male who portrays himself as female online. This is what Kim Seyeong decides to become after reencountering Shin Heejae, the guy who destroyed Seyeong's gaming career in "Arcadia" a year prior. His plan is to pretend to be a girl in the game, get Heejae to fall for him, and then make the big reveal to everyone so that his archnemesis will also be humiliated out of "Arcadia" forever. But being a dude trying to become the girlfriend of your worst enemy is no easy feat, especially more so when said worst enemy starts to show a bit too much interest in you. Will Seyeong come out the victor of this scheme? Or will he find himself losing to Heejae all over again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Red Thread Quest
synopsis:
As a first-year law student, Lee Yeon never expected to cross paths again with his middle school crush—the charming upperclassman Hong Kihoon. But a chance reunion on campus leads to an even more unexpected twist: a spontaneous trip, and a strange challenge known only as the Red Thread Quest.

Red Thread Quest, Round 1: Five Kisses on the Cheek!

Skeptical about soulmates and fate, Yeon finds himself drawn into the legend of the Red Thread of Fate—and as each round of the quest unfolds, his relationship with Kihoon begins to take an unpredictable turn.

What started as a game might just lead them to something real...if the Red Thread Rock has anything to say about it.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ranker's Return
synopsis:
During the early years of the hottest MMORPG called Arena, the world's top ranker Meleegod vanished after setting every possible record in the virtual world. In the real world, this deathly melee damage dealer was the happy-go-lucky Kang Hyeonu, who simply deleted his character and quit his hobby to finish mandatory military service and inherit his father's company. This rosy future dissolves within two years when a business rival makes his father go bankrupt. Hyeonu struggles to make ends meet with a string of part-time jobs, but his best friend has a better idea. He urges Hyeonu to conquer the Arena once again and earn a cushy living as a gaming celebrity. Vowing to strike it rich and avenge his father, the former Meleegod returns to the Arena as a newbie. Only this time, he's out for blood!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Pizza Delivery Man and the Gold Palace
titleEnglish: The Pizza Delivery Man and the Gold Palace
synopsis:
Woo-won is a pizza delivery guy down on his luck, and Seo-an is wealthy man suffering from panic attacks and social phobia. You wouldn't think these two would have any reason to get to know one another, but one small kindness leads to a series of encounters that bring the two men closer together than either of them anticipated. Maybe they can find the solutions to their problems together... or perhaps they don't need solutions, but simply each other.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Third Ending
synopsis:
Suh Yoonseul has had life easy—everyone likes him, he's good at his job, basically everything has always worked out as smooth as butter. However, there's something that brings all of his good luck down, and it's the infrequent dreams he has of Kang Jun. Who knew that rejecting a guy once would hang so heavy on your life? To make things worse, after he runs into Jun the dreams keep on coming daily. At his wit's end, Yoonseul takes some advice from a friend so that he can free himself from this jinx. It's simple. Make Kang Jun think that he's a nice person. That can't be hard, right?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Traces of the Sun
synopsis:
I can help you kill your friends.

Strange dungeons have started appearing all over the world and wreaking havoc. Yiseon, a guy with the power to rebuild cities, witnesses his friends being turned into the undead. Hyeon, a powerful hunter, comes to him with an interesting proposition. Yiseon has no choice but to accept his offer.

(Source: Manta)

title: Crimson Karma
synopsis:
Kasiya, a fearless warrior, embarks on a daring solo mission to take down the enemy's most powerful leader. Little does she know that the very allies she trusted have set this mission as a trap, which leaves her fighting for her life. When Kasiya awakens from one perilous encounter, the world around her has transformed into a realm teeming with knights, sorcerers, and royalty. Suddenly thrust into this dangerous dimension, she must unlock the secrets of this new realm in order to survive as it tests her skills, courage, and cunning.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Getting to Know Grace
synopsis:
Andrew is the only daughter of the famous Grace family. She also has an incurable disease. Due to her family's high status in society, Andrew grew up with no friends save for her maid, Herta, whom she has become intensely infatuated with. Little does she know, her family is responsible for ruining Herta's life. Can Andrew break the hierarchy and be with her? Or will Herta end her suffering first...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Origin of Species
synopsis:
Lee Youngjin has never been like other Omegas. Rather than being physically superior to humans like the rest of his species, Youngjin is a gifted hacker. But when his talent leads him to an ill-fated heist mission, Youngjin finds himself trapped in the clutches of a powerful Alpha businessman named Seo Seunghyun. Now, he must do anything he can to guarantee safety for himself and his colleagues - even if it means sleeping with the enemy. But as the business deal between Youngjin and Seunghyun quickly becomes more personal, will they be able to see eye to eye? Or will their differences be too much to overcome?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Dirtiest High
synopsis:
A one-night stand turns into a messy love story.

Josh, a brilliant lawyer and obsessive neat freak, is coping with a broken engagement. The only upside? His firm changed cleaning services. But when the new cleaner is Angel—his one-night stand from last night—chaos ensues. Is this love or just a messy disaster waiting to unfold?

(Source: Manta)

title: Savor the Taste
synopsis:
Can a princess's food save a kingdom?

Luana is reborn as an illegitimate princess inside a book. Resigned to her fate, she decides to spend her days cooking. Not long after, the cursed Duke Legion arrives and sacks the kingdom, but instead of falling for the princess, he's bewitched by Luana's food. He orders her to cook for him or die!

(Source: Manta)

title: Cozy Obsession
synopsis:
Huimin Seo happened to read a tragic BL novel where the two main characters had both his name and even his best friend's name, Iheon Cha. But rather than remaining as an incredible coincidence, this book becomes a new reality for Huimin. Before he knows it, he is transmigrated right into a major scene in the novel where Huimin Seo, a rare dominant omega, gets bought off in an auction by Iheon Cha, a powerful dominant alpha. Aware of the complications in this love-hate relationship that he cannot escape from, Huimin must tread carefully to turn things around entirely.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Dear. Door
synopsis:
After a devastating personal loss, Kyungjoon wants nothing more than to drown his grief in the silence and safety of his houseplants. But Kyungjoon is also a cop, and it's a cop's job to go after criminals.

One day, hot pursuit of a suspect leads to Kyungjoon discovering signs of cult activity. Soon, the policeman is caught up in the machinations of monsters and demons, the worst of which is the demon king, Lord Cain, whose survival in this world depends on mana that can only be accessed through a "door." Cain's door happens to be inside Kyungjoon, and these two will have to get up close and very personal to open it.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Concubine Walkthrough
synopsis:
At first, Yona gave some major side-eye to the popular game "Concubine Walkthrough" until she got sucked into it—literally! Now stuck as the villain, she has her hands full facing the infamously cruel emperor, shaking off scheming concubines, and befriending NPCs. There's only one way the Game Master will let her out and that's to become the Empress! Will she be able to stay true to her honest and straightforward self despite the palace's intrigues? One extra problem: she's got competition...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mr.A's Farm
synopsis:
Little A travels to a rural farm to reunite with the uncle who raised him—only to find the place eerily silent and his uncle nowhere in sight. What awaits him is a chilling "bible" detailing how to care for the livestock... but something feels off.

Because on this farm, the "livestock" aren't animals—they're humans.

Now thrust into the role of acting farm manager, little A is forced to manage Mr. A's Farm, a facility that produces livestock products using beast-like humans—creatures who think and act like people but are bred for their byproducts.

Dark secrets plague the estate in the uncle's absence. Little A must do all he can to keep the farm safe and sound... at least until his missing uncle, Mr. A, comes back.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Undefeatable Swordsman
synopsis:
The son of a lowly innkeeper, Wumoon Song always dreamed of being a martial arts master, a dream that would never become a reality thanks to his frail body. Then one night, a mysterious guest leaves behind a painting as payment that enthralls Wumoon for reasons he can't explain. It soon becomes clear that it's no ordinary painting when Wumoon starts showing prowess in the martial arts he's never had before. Thus begins the path for a scatterbrained kid to change his destiny and become truly undefeatable!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Flower of Allure
synopsis:
Iyeon wanted a quiet life as an arborist—but hidden upstairs is a comatose killer who once tried to murder her. When he wakes with no memory, she panics... and lies: "I'm your wife." Can she survive the man who doesn't remember her—or what he did?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Golden-Haired Summoner
synopsis:
Following the trauma of a studying-induced death, Jinny is reborn into a fantastical realm filled with magic, orcs, and talking spirits. As Geenie Crowell, the daughter of a noble and a bona fide genius, everyone has big plans for her, including her new parents, teachers, and even the king! Not too keen on all these high expectations that might end badly for her again, Geenie thinks up the perfect way out from slaving over a hot magic wand: if she becomes a summoner, she'll be able to summon a spirit and have them do all the work!

But Geenie will soon learn that there's more to it all than just adorable spirit companions and collecting mana. Being a summoner comes with great responsibility–and dangerous consequences as well.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: December
synopsis:
One frigid December dawn, Song Yeon-woo meets an injured runaway alpha; inexplicably drawn toward his woodsy scent, he is compelled to help the young man. Despite his aversion to alphas due to trauma in his past, Yeon-woo somehow feels safe and welcomed in his presence. The two part in the moonlight, never to see one another again...but fate has other plans. Two years later, Yeon-woo has finally returned to the city to begin anew—still wary of alphas around him, he has built barriers in nearly every aspect of his life to keep himself safe. But when that a familiar scent begins to pierce through his boundaries, Yeon-woo is unable to stop himself from following them in pursuit of something thrilling...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: OmegaComplex
synopsis:
Yoonwoo and Taegyeom have been best friends since childhood, but Yoonwoo is hiding a secret that could tear them apart–he's an omega... and he's in love with Taegyeom.

When a traumatic event leads Taegyeom to despise all omegas, Yoonwoo is forced to keep his identity a secret. After struggling for years to avoid Taegyeom, they both end up at the same college, and Yoonwoo's carefully guarded secret is in danger of being exposed...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I'm No Heroine!
synopsis:
A girl obsessed with a novel suddenly finds herself transported into the thick of the plot. The problem is, she has taken on the role of the villain in the story. And she knows how this ends... it's off with her head! Maybe she'll just let this play out and wake up back in reality... But after a few too many deaths to no avail, it's finally time to go off-script. She's going to have a little fun with this tale. She's made up her mind... to live!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Walk on Water
synopsis:
Ed's job as a security guard hasn't made a dent in the enormous debt he has to pay off. But when he overhears someone talking about how easy it is to make money performing in gay porn, a way out of his penny-pinching day-to-day becomes clear. But what starts out as a way to make a quick buck turns into much more after Ed meets Glenn Mcqueen, the CEO of the production company he will be acting for.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: When Fate Finds Us
synopsis:
One kiss could save my life.

As a prophetess, Noemi can see the futures of those she touches. Yet sadly, as the wife of a god, she sees only death in her own fateful future. But then, a sudden kiss with an unruly merchant brings a vision of life. Could he be Noemi's key to survival? Or will she be unable to escape her destiny?

(Source: Manta)

title: Smyrna and Capri
synopsis:
What if your sworn enemy holds the key to your future?

Theo Peserus: an alpha of the mighty Peserus clan, called forth to provide the clan with a child. For a tree to bear fruit, a worthy Capri must be chosen to inseminate him.

Seram Marita: a revolutionary army soldier hailing from the Langeres clan. Having escaped from his imprisonment, he now weaves through the maze-like halls of the Peserus castle, looking for a way out.

But a tempting odor permeates the air and leads Seram straight to the enemy. Intoxicated on pheromones, the two adversaries are now engaged, not in a battle for their lives, but in a war of lust... What fruit will come to bear when these foes, this Smyrna and this Capri, become entangled in a decadence that they both cannot resist...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Unromantic Romance
synopsis:
In a world where Omegas rule supreme, it's tough being an Alpha. But Hyeon-oh's been able to lead a decent, if a little boring, life so far and it seems like things'll stay that way. He'll graduate from university, get a job as a reporter, meet an Omega who'll take care of him, start a family with them and live happily ever after. The perfect romance. The kind of romance that starts when you ask the bartender to make a drink for the only other person in the bar. Little does Hyeon-oh know how that innocent gesture will pull him headfirst into the most unromantic of situations...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Uncanny Charm
synopsis:
Yoon-jae is just a normal college student who lives alone...until his new neighbor, Beom-jin, moves in one floor below him. Then, things get weird. Namely, Yoon-jae starts seeing ghosts everywhere, and they start stalking him. Turns out, a mysterious bell that belongs to Beom-jin is now tied to Yoon-jae's wrist, and it summons ghosts wherever he goes. Unable to remove the cursed thing, Beom-jin suggests that Yoon-jae help out with his work until they find a way to remove it. Oh, what kind of work? Sending ghosts to the afterlife, of course.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Miscreants and Mayhem
synopsis:
"I missed you, Dad. Did you miss me too?"

Gang member Ryu Nanmu may be one of the top dogs in his "organization," but in life he's hit rock bottom. He dreamed of building a family once, with his boss' mistress and her son Pil-gyun, but he's had to pay dearly for coveting something that could never be his. After several long years, the hope for a family had become barely anything more than a nostalgic memory for Nanmu... until a grown-up Pil-gyun dramatically reappears in Nanmu's life. Except, this isn't the child that Nanmu remembers. Pil-gyun is calculated, deadly, and obsessively in love with him. Although Nanmu knows he should put an end to this futile relationship, Pil-gyun's tender words of love can't help but tug at his heartstrings...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Blood Link
synopsis:
A human, lycan, or a vampire—what am I?! 

Completely unaware of the existence of these predators, Hwa Gok goes about his everyday life... That is, until Lee Bin turns his life upside down by biting him on the neck, setting off a whirlwind of events neither of them could foresee.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Taming the Tiger
synopsis:
Ahn Geum-hoo needs a butcher to provide fresh animal blood for his sickly brother's medicine. While most of the butchers seem reluctant to provide him with what he needs, Nobody is willing to do Geum-hoo's bidding. With striking features and a strong build, Nobody has quite a reputation amongst the village folk. Yet, Geum-hoo finds a way to tame this wild tiger. First, he gives him a name—Beom. Then, he invites him to a world that this nobody's never experienced...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Minmotion Syndrome
synopsis:
"I'll repay that 450 thousand for you...but in exchange, you're mine." Due to the debt left behind by his father, alpha Seo Taeyoon is at the mercy of Park Jae-in, a mob boss with a penchant for violence. But when Taeyoon is able to identify Jae-in as an omega by scent alone, the ruthless criminal is taken aback—because nobody should be able to smell his pheromones. Seeing this as his opportunity to regain what once was lost, Jae-in offers to pay off Taeyoon's father's loan in exchange for a life of servitude. Now Jae-in holds the key to both the physical and metaphorical locks around Taeyoon's neck. And so begins their relationship as master and slave...but there's no telling how it will end.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Illusion Hunter from Another World
synopsis:
"I have a little secret. I'm from an alien planet far, far away. However... fate had other plans. I found myself reincarnated into the body of someone who had literally starved to death! Will Gi-ryeo be able to find a way to adapt to this strange planet called Earth and keep his true identity hidden?"

(Source: Manta)

title: Betrayal of Dignity
synopsis:
Would you sacrifice your honor to marry a duke?

In order to save her family from ruin, Chloe Verdier must find a groom for her sister, Alice. She soon runs into the handsome but arrogant Duke Thisse who makes a proposal that could save them. When Alice flees with a mysterious man, Chloe must seek out the duke in the biggest gamble of her life.

(Source: Manta)

title: High Clear
synopsis:
Han Juwon has the worst habit ever. He's an average guy with an average college life, but his facial expression and words become terrifying the second he feels shy. Although he's trying his best to fix it, Juwon realizes he messed up yet again when he says something rude to his hoobae, Jeong-min. And not only that, but he also keeps unintentionally touching Jeong-min's chest every time they meet! Juwon knows he has to find a way to apologize to Jeong-min, but even while he feels guilty, he can't stop thinking of what he accidentally discovered about Jeong-min's chest... Turns out Juwon's soft-hearted interior and gruff exterior aren't the only things that are completely inverted...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love in Orbit
synopsis:
Some people win the lottery or find their dream job, but Sohan...has an alien spaceship land on his brand-new house?! To make matters even worse, there's an—admittedly sexy—alien inside threatening to wipe out the entire population. Sihwa has come to earth in search of someone specific and has no qualms about using Sohan to get what he wants. The thing is, things work differently on Sihwa's home planet, and he seems to be expecting things from Sohan that sound downright impossible! Nevertheless, Sohan finds himself making a deal: help Sihwa find the person he's looking for in exchange for the safety of humanity. But will this strange partnership turn into something...out of this world?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Sacred Serpent's Seduction
synopsis:
How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Taesun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Taesun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Taesun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Taesun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being's seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love So Pure
synopsis:
"I... got a boner" is what Jihyun blurts out the first time he lays eyes on Yohan's handsome face... It's easy to get laid when you're a pretty, sassy bartender working at a popular gay bar. This lifestyle suits Jihyun just fine since he loves casual hookups without any intimacy... That is until he meets Yohan—his big, scary-looking classmate who's actually a pure-hearted sweetie. Can Yohan's simple love help commitment-phobic Jihyun heal from the traumas of his past?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bongchon Bride
synopsis:
He bought me for 50 sacks of rice.

Soongap is nearly beaten to death by his master when friendly giant Bongchun buys him and saves his life. Bongchun's blind mother is delighted, believing her son has finally brought home a bride. And the more Bongchun treats Soongap like his darling bride, the more things get heated...

(Source: Manta)

title: The Unquenchable Mr. Kim
synopsis:
Mr. Doyun Kim's a pretty quiet, unassuming guy at the office—with a big secret. He's actually half vampire! But without full vamp status, he can't drink blood and has to seek out some human essence (read: sex! and more sex!) to live. Drained and desperate, he finds a "special" companion but everything goes wrong. Now he's caught up in a one-sided office relationship, and most importantly, it's not working!!! Will Doyun survive and keep his secret intact?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dead Man's Switch
synopsis:
We've all had that nightmare where we're late for a test, right? How about the one where your teacher's trying to kill you?! Just me, huh? Guess it's only fair then that I woke up in an actual zombie-infested nightmare! Almost everyone on my campus has become a creepy, flesh-eating monster! Except for this one ax-wielding badass named Youngwon Ki. He seems perfectly fine with all the chaos. I'm glad he's here, but I don't get why he acts like we're close!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Red Candy
synopsis:
Shihyeon, aka "Red Candy," is a secret agent whose code name comes from bathing in the blood of his marks on dangerous missions. Shihyeon's tasked with seducing and obtaining intel from Hajun, a hot college professor. Shihyeon can disarm enemies, but didn't expect to be disarmed himself by Hajun's own tight body. Now Shihyeon's caught between loyalty to his spy agency and Hajun. Can Red Candy survive the incoming wave of enemies and still indulge in the sweet ecstasy of Hajun's embrace?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Who's That Girl?
synopsis:
Kim Sanghyeon has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman? Sanghyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ring My Bell
synopsis:
Hell yeah! A major publisher wants Mai Sohn to write a webcomic on relationships. But she's struck with heartbreak as her girlfriend abruptly dumps her. It's hard writing about relationships without being in one, so she needs to find the inspiration for love—and find it fast. And what's up with her possibly homophobic neighbor? Why is she cool with Mai one minute and then so awkward and weird to her the next?! Can't a girl catch a break?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Nibanme na Boku to Ichiban no Kanojo
synopsis:
