Minamino Chinatsu is a beautiful girl who's incredibly popular and easygoing. Ever since I met her in the fall of my first year of high school, my life has been anything but ordinary. It all changed when another guy with the same name as me showed up at school-–a handsome one, no less-–and suddenly my classmates started calling me "Number Two."

"You're not 'Number Two' to me," she said. "Besides, it's me who wants to kiss you first."

My relationship with Chinatsu goes beyond just school. We play street basketball after class, cook meals together, share secrets, and even grow physically closer. I thought I was fine being alone, but she accepts me for who I am. And because of that, I want to give her the same in return.

This is a coming-of-age love story about realizing how precious even the simplest desires can be.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Fighting Girls
synopsis:
Koume was top of her local karate class until Tiara showed up and beat her soundly. Koume vows to beat her rival the next time, but months and years go by without a single win...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Semekano Lovers
synopsis:
1. Dakara Anata wa Fukukaichou
2. Shukusei Mattress
3. Rifure Yattete Nani ga Warui!?
4. Otouto wa Ane no Ottoman
5. Oneechan no SM Kouza
6. Rental Otouto
7. Tsukiko-chan wa Shinpaishou
8. Oneechan no Stocking

title: Shinyuu no Furin Aite wa, Otto deshita
synopsis:
"Who stole my husband?"

Mahoro Inoue, 29 years old, married. Surrounded by her three friends and her husband, she had everything to lead a happy life. Or at least, she was supposed to...

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Sun-ouji wa Tsuma ni Naritai
titleEnglish: Prince Sun Wanna Be a Wife
synopsis:
Keitarou, dreaming of a soulmate, meets a beautiful brown girl(?) Sun. Apparently, he'd promised to marry Sun when they were young—and it turns out he's a prince of the kingdom of Caglionia! Will they find their soulmate in each other!?

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Nitamono Doushi
synopsis:
Teru is a boy who, haunted by a childhood trauma, sees himself as a loner and avoids human connection. His only joy comes from video games... until a fateful encounter at his usual arcade starts to shake up his quiet world.

A heartfelt, 88-page, full-length boy-meets-girl story of two awkward souls drawn to each other night after night.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo
synopsis:
It's been 68 years since the Culling Game. In 2086, an alien race known as the Simurians arrive on Earth in a spaceship. The fate of the world lies in the hands of two jujutsu sorcerers Yuka and Tsurugi Okkotsu. Jujutsu sorcerers and aliens, what chaos will be born from this meeting?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Release Your Persona
synopsis:
Jae-gyu Oh is an actor known throughout the country. He has been loved for his brilliant acting since his years as a child actor, but he is exhausted by the unjust rumours that constantly follow him and keeps his distance from people. One day, while feeding some cats, Jae-gyu is approached by a strange man. Jae-gyu is wary of the man, who turns out to be his neighbour, Yoon Cheong-rok. After being followed to the elevator, Jae-gyu mistakes Cheong-rok for a stalker, but to his surprise, Cheong-rok doesn't recognise him at all. Jae-gyu's pride is hurt after meeting someone who doesn't recognise him for the first time, but a subtle excitement is brewing inside him. Later that night, Cheong-rok appears in Jae-gyu's dreams...

"Does everyone in the world know you? Is there anybody that knows who you really are?"

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Kurumizawa Yoshihiko no Gukou
synopsis:
The year is 1971 and the once popular manga artist Kurumizawa is in a major slump. The pressure builds as each new submission is rejected. But one day, he meets a young, promising artist named Hata. When he sees Hata's wonderful work, Kurumizawa hatches a dark plan...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yamiochi Last Boss Reijou no Osananajimi ni Tensei shita. Ore ga Shindara Bad End Kakutei nanode Saikyou ni Natta kedo, Mou Yamiochi "Yandere-ka" shitemasen ka?
synopsis:
"If you were to disappear... I might just lose myself."

Arcs is reborn into the world of the wildly popular otome game Celestia Kingdom. He thought he was just a background character—until it's revealed he's actually the childhood friend of the final boss! Determined to avoid the bad ending, he throws himself into his daily life as her servant. But it seems the true cause of her descent into darkness is... her childhood friend!?

An unpredictable tale of master and servant, between a slightly (maybe more than slightly?) yandere heroine and an obliviously overpowered protagonist, begins...!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Mia Is Back
synopsis:
Mia was Taesu's first love, who suddenly disappeared one day. After five years of silence, she reappears as a freshman at his university. But she's not the girl he remembers. He plays it cool, trying to ignore her, but can first love truly be forgotten? Or will fate give them a second chance?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kikikaikai
synopsis:
Aoi, a demon boy hiding his true identity, lives a quiet life as a normal high school student. But one day, a girl suddenly falls from the sky, and she's not what she seems. Get ready for a modern-day pop demon battle from a highly skilled artist in the manga world!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Zodiac Girls
synopsis:
Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Gather twelve Zodiac Spirits for the ultimate competition. The catch? They've all possessed girls from his school. Can an ordinary boy survive refereeing an extraordinary battle between Heaven-sent superpowered heroines?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Someone Hertz
synopsis:
Mimei shares the hobby of listening to a late-night comedy radio show with the funny and mysterious Kurage from his class. And she's famous for sending in hilarious comments that are read on the show? But Mimei wants to be just as funny as her! Are they friends, are they rivals, are they something more...? This radio rom-com is on the air!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: I Became the Villain the Hero Is Obsessed With
synopsis:
Da-in, ended up possessing the villain of a story. To make Stardust—the story's protagonist and his favorite character in a dystopian manga—happy, he resolves to become the villain Egoistic for her growth. Da-in deliberately causes terror to enhance Stardust's abilities and preemptively prevents all the tragic events from the original story, but in the process, he gains public support while also drawing Stardust's suspicion. Stardust, who initially opposed him, gradually opens her heart, and soon even begins to show signs of obsession toward him...?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Divine Demon's Grand Ascension
synopsis:
While Bu Eunseol was still young, he lost his grandfather to a mysterious killer. For revenge, he will devour the martial arts of the 10 demon sects and endure countless bloodshed to become the strongest.

"I will find you, and I will kill you." Now, in the heart of where all demons reside, the divine demon awakens.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Breakers
synopsis:
Ju In-gong was dragged into the remake of a game he was playing called Knight Saga:Re. However, something wasn't right. The only playable characters should be Loch of the human side and Zephyr of the demon side. Instead, he awakens in the body of Siutra—the ninth prince of the Demon Realm, a character who actually didn't exist in the game's story.

Granted two mysterious powers, "Protagonist Setting Adjustment" and "Power of Conquest," Ju In-gong now must alter the game's plot to survive against Zephyr. Yet, with every twist of the plot, he garners more attention...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Chanto Suki tte Ieruko Musou
synopsis:
There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward.

[The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki.
[Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku.
[The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga.

However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach.

"Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me."
"Here, say 'ahh'~♪"
"Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?"

In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tonari no Yasaka
synopsis:
Since they were kids, Kaoru and his childhood friend Houko have had one rule: the loser in judo buys the winner a meal. But now that they're in high school, Kaoru just can't keep up—Houko only gets stronger every year, and he's stuck paying the bill. Then, after one crushing loss too many, Houko teases him with a single remark... and Kaoru snaps. He stakes everything on a final match: "If I lose this time, I'll buy you meals for the rest of my life!"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hatsukoi Yakkyoku
synopsis:
A boy who looks up to his police officer father keeps getting hurt while helping others, until one bandage leads to a fateful encounter. But there's a reason they can never be together...?! A pure story about defying destiny begins‼︎

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koi to Yobu ni wa Sasayaka desu ga
synopsis:
High school girl Umi Sayama is placed in the care of the neighboring Hiroi family while her mother is away on a long business trip. The Hiroi household is home to Shouya, an eight-years-older figure she admires, and Umi's heart races at their long-awaited reunion. But the Shouya she encounters is completely different from the one in her memories...

A faintly sparkling cohabitation story about meeting changed memories once more.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Kurokami Seiso no Reikoku Bishoujo wo Tasuketara, Ore to Futarikiri no Toki dake Dereru You ni Natta Ken
synopsis:
At Seiryo High School, where second-year student Minato Ichijou attends, there is a girl known as the "Cold Princess." Her name is Rei Nanase. With her stunning beauty and exceptional talents, many admire her, yet she rejects all advances with an icy attitude. Minato, however, has little interest in romance due to personal reasons.

Even though Rei sits next to him in class and works part-time at the same café, he pays her no special attention. One day, Minato stumbles upon Rei in a back alley, quarreling with a persistent man he recognizes as a customer who had been turned down by her at the café.

Acting on impulse, he steps in to help. The very next day after work, Rei unexpectedly appears in the staff room, despite not being scheduled, and suddenly demands a kiss from Minato. Thus begin Minato's bewildering days, swept up by a slightly offbeat kuudere young lady.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Chie Aru Koibito
synopsis:
A story of awkward first love between two honor students. They're hesitant yet bold when it's just the two of them in the classroom after school.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: The Dawn to Come
synopsis:
School is home to judgmental eyes and home a source of abuse. But that's ok because Yun Junyeong found an abandoned home where she could study to her heart's content. Unfortunately, soon after, Kwon Beomjin, the town's most notorious delinquent, has also begun using the home to catch up on sleep. As the two are forced to coexist, they come to learn about their reasons for avoiding others.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kami Kill
synopsis:
In a run-down shopping street, brothers Fuji and Kiri run a small barbershop as they wait for their father’s return. In their effort to make ends meet, every day brings something new to their door.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kurokami Long Gomi Talk Deck Senpai
titleEnglish: The Long-Haired Girl's Garbage Small Talk
synopsis:
She's this untouchable upperclassman at school, but she's completely different on the bus ride there. This girl who's way out of my league keeps hitting me with the most garbage conversations, and I'm the only one who gets to see this side of her.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Karei Naru! Uwakitsu Sanjuuni-sai
synopsis:
A burned-out office worker meets a former otaku group princess who still hangs out at arcades. A cringe-comedy about observing the heroine!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koujo Tensei: Densetsu no Daimadoushi (♂), Himekishi to Narite Densetsu no Reijou Kishidan wo Tsukuri Musou suru
titleEnglish: Reincarnated as a Princess: The Legendary Archmage Becomes a Lady Knight and Forms the Noblewomen Knight Corps!
synopsis:
"I also wanted to be... the strongest in the world."

An Arch Mage who died without fulfilling his dream wakes up to finds himself being reincarnated as a member of the imperial family. And what's more is that his new body has a talent for close-quarters combat! This time he holds hope that he finally might be able to fulfill his desire of being world's strongest...

But after reincarnating his new name is Evangeline. Indeed, he had become a girl. In her princess life where muscle training and fighting are forbidden, Eva brings dumbbells to her room and wields a sword! And before long, she becomes the strongest!?

A fantasy about a tomboy princess' rise to the top!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: WITCHRIV
synopsis:
A girl named Nona lives in plain sight among humans, hiding her true identity as a mage as she spends her days in peace with her best friend Lovi. But one day, Nona uses magic to fix Lovi's glasses and subsequently catches the attention of the Bureau of Magic Surveillance. A simple good deed becomes the trigger that sets Nona's destiny in motion...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Raising Villains the Right Way
synopsis:
I, a corporate slave, ended up possessing the body of a noble inside a game, but I'm supposed to be an extra fated to be killed by the future villains? No way. I'll reform those brats and live out my noble life in peace! To stop the young villains from turning evil, I sponsored them and helped them overcome their harsh circumstances, and they all grew up to be admirable, upstanding, perfectly normal individuals as a result. And that's how I ended up becoming the final boss of the kingdom.

...Wait, what?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Utopia
synopsis:
In 2045, extreme summer weather and A.I. automation have transformed daily life. As traditional summer culture fades away, children of this generation find themselves yearning to experience the intense heat of summers past...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kemono no You ni Ueteiru
synopsis:
"I'm gonna make the funk music I love popular." This was once Aida's resolution, but time slipped by, leading to an ordinary career instead. Now, with each passing day, the sensation of being trapped continues to torment him. In the midst of this, a former bandmate extends an invitation. And when Aida takes up his bass guitar for the first time in a long while, sure enough, his heart trembles to the music...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Watashi no Midara na Kugutsu
synopsis:
At work, you're the cold, strict senior colleague. At home, you're the gentle, sweet lover. Which one is the real you? A one-shot about a secret, warped obsession no one can know about!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tonari no Osoegawa
synopsis:
In the Magic Realm, mages train hard to master their arts. However, one mage named Toya Osoegawa only cares about using magic to live a comfortable life! But now, thanks to the orders from the Divine Magus, the least motivated man in the Magic Realm has been sent to the Human Realm! Can he use his bizarre magic to protect humans and send evil wizards back to their world?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Futari Bus
synopsis:
Shunpei lives in a rural town of barely 3,000 people. Every day, he rides the same bus as his classmate An Takayagawa, the only one who went off to a private middle school. The two haven't really talked since elementary school... until one day, something gives them a reason to.

A soft, sky-blue not-quite-love comedy, born on a bus for two.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: JK Yuusha to Inkyo Maou
titleEnglish: Hero Girl and Demon Lord Call It Quits
synopsis:
With the ages-old battle between good and evil settled...the demon lord becomes roommates with the hero?! A slice-of-life comedy with the oddest roommates ever!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yotaka Futatabi
synopsis:
That woman is "Yotaka." Once famous in the underworld as the strongest assassin, she is now a 33-year-old (and very unlucky) drug addict and alcoholic. She's enjoying her unemployed life in a rundown apartment. ♪ With her mind and body completely slack, Yotaka receives an invitation from her assassin friend, "Kohai," to return to active duty...!!

Will she return to the battlefield once again?! Yotaka!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Demon King Overrun by Heroes
synopsis:
After diligently following the "demon king's standards," I ended up getting killed by the heroes. What, my tower and I are a custom-made hunting ground for heroes now? With this chance at life regained through regression, to hell with the damn demon king's standards! This is the story of surviving as the hard-headed(?) demon king, Berje!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Mukashi Mukashi no Warui Majo
synopsis:
Once upon a time, in a land far, far away, there was a small kingdom. However, a wicked witch suddenly appeared and the kingdom that was once beautiful grew ever poorer. After 300 years of living in terror of the witch, the king decided to capture the witch. This task was given to one peasant boy, Len...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Gal no Jitensha wo Naoshitara Natsukareta
titleEnglish: When I Repaired a Gal’s Bicycle, She Became Attached to Me.
synopsis:
Kousei Kutsuzawa is an introverted boy with zero friends. One day, as he was walking home alone as always, he bumps into the class's most popular girl, a beautiful gal sought after by every boy.

After saving her from falling and repairing her bicycle, he plans to leave right away... but she looks at him with admiring eyes.

An introvert and a social butterfly, two people who were never supposed to cross paths. Awkward yet irresistibly drawn to each other, their youthful rom-com story begins.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Hochiya-san wa Amari Aru
synopsis:
Norito Yonezawa is a low-energy high schooler with little interest in reality. He can't stop thinking about his classmate, Hochiya. She's the complete opposite of him, eating whenever and wherever she wants with no regard to those around her. Despite this, somehow, he just can't look away...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Moriagaranai Date
synopsis:
Haida, cursed with chronic bad luck, signs up for a dating app as part of her “what-the-heck” phase. She matches with Kuroi, a man who joined for equally reckless reasons. But their conversation never quite clicks, and an unmistakably low-key, awkward mood sets in. Everything they do backfires, resulting in a date that is astonishingly unexciting. Thinking there’s no way there’ll be a second date in an atmosphere like this… wait, what? Why are they making plans to meet again!?

A first date with someone you met on a dating app that just doesn’t take off? The deadpan, surreal banter is way too addictive! A slow-burn, gently unfolding romance that begins with a dating app.

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Share House Aobayu
synopsis:
Satoru Satomi, who inherited his family's financially struggling bathhouse "Aoibayu," hits upon a plan to revamp the business as a "bathhouse share house!" Then, a cool beauty applies to see the place...

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)
